    72:         subject_id: 登记时使用的演示人员标识，默认 "SELF"。
    73:         status_file: 可选；把状态文本写到该文件，供自动化冒烟测试读取。
    74:         diagnostic_dir: 可选；给定时窗口出现"保存基准帧/标记失败帧"按钮，
    75:                         仅在手动点击时保存当前原始帧，用于复现检测失败。
    76:     返回：
    77:         退出码 0。
    78:     """
    79:     if not subject_id:
    80:         raise ValueError("subject_id must not be empty")
    81: 
    82:     def report(message: str):
    83:         """把一行状态写到状态文件（供外部脚本/测试观察，非必需）。"""
    84:         if status_file:
    85:             status_file.write_text(message, encoding="utf-8")
    86: 
    87:     # Windows 上用 DirectShow 后端打开摄像头更稳，其他平台用默认后端。
    88:     backend = cv2.CAP_DSHOW if sys.platform == "win32" else cv2.CAP_ANY
    89:     capture = cv2.VideoCapture(camera, backend)
    90:     if not capture.isOpened():
    91:         capture.release()
    92:         report("ERROR: camera could not open")
    93:         raise RuntimeError(f"无法打开本机摄像头 {camera}")
    94:     capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH, 640)
    95:     capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT, 480)
    96: 
    97:     # Pillow needs a CJK font; OpenCV's built-in text renderer cannot draw Chinese.
    98:     # OpenCV 自带的绘图函数画不了中文，所以用 Pillow 加载系统中文字体来写标签。
    99:     # 逐个尝试常见字体路径，都找不到就退回到默认字体（此时中文会显示成方块）。
   100:     label_font = next(
   101:         (ImageFont.truetype(str(path), 17) for path in (
   102:             Path("C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc"),
   103:             Path("C:/Windows/Fonts/simhei.ttf"),
   104:             Path("/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc"),
   105:         ) if path.exists()),
   106:         ImageFont.load_default(),
   107:     )
   108: 
   109:     # ============ 界面搭建 ============
   110:     root = tk.Tk()
   111:     root.title("人脸算法：本机摄像头识别测试")
   112:     root.configure(bg="#111827")
   113:     image_label = tk.Label(root, bg="#111827")
   114:     image_label.pack(padx=12, pady=(12, 4))
   115:     status_label = tk.Label(root, text="请正对摄像头，点击登记本人", fg="white", bg="#111827")
   116:     status_label.pack(pady=4)
   117:     note = ("单张登记照测试，阈值未校准；仅点击标记按钮时保存诊断帧"
   118:             if diagnostic_dir is not None else "单张登记照测试，阈值未校准；照片和特征不会写入磁盘")
   119:     # 把两个模型实际跑在什么后端上显示出来（CUDA 还是 CPU），便于一眼确认环境。
   120:     detector_backend = getattr(engine.detector, "backend", "未知")
   121:     recognizer_backend = getattr(engine.recognizer, "backend", "未知")
   122:     detail_label = tk.Label(root, text=f"{note}\n推理后端：检测 {detector_backend} / 特征 {recognizer_backend}",
   123:                             fg="#9ca3af", bg="#111827")
   124:     detail_label.pack(pady=(0, 5))
   125:     controls = tk.Frame(root, bg="#111827")
   126:     controls.pack(pady=(0, 12))

   128:     # 单工作线程：一次只跑一个推理任务。
   129:     worker = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="camera-demo-inference")
   130:     overlay = CameraBoxOverlay()

   132:     pending_frame: np.ndarray | None = None  # 该任务所用的帧

   134:     # 结果回来后逐帧推进覆盖层，让框"补上"推理期间的位移。
   135:     pending_previews: deque[tuple[float, np.ndarray]] = deque(maxlen=24)

   147:     def start_enrollment():

   149:         nonlocal enrolling, enrolled, enrollment_frame
   150:         enrolling = True
   151:         enrolled = False
   152:         enrollment_frame = None
   153:         overlay.clear()

   157:     def close():
   158:         """关闭窗口：释放摄像头、停掉工作线程。可重入保护。"""
   159:         nonlocal closed
   160:         if closed:
   161:             return
   162:         closed = True
   163:         capture.release()
   164:         worker.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
   165:         report("CLOSED")
   166:         root.destroy()
   167: 
   168:     def save_diagnostic(kind: str):
   169:         """保存诊断帧。只在用户主动点击时调用，绝不自动保存。
   170: 
   171:         kind="reference" 存登记时的基准帧（限 1 张）；
   172:         其余情况存"失败帧"（限 5 张），用于事后复现漏检。
   173:         """
   174:         nonlocal reference_count, failure_count
   175:         if diagnostic_dir is None:
   176:             return
   177:         if kind == "reference":
   178:             if enrollment_frame is None:
   179:                 status_label.configure(text="请先完成登记，再保存基准帧")
   180:                 return
   181:             if reference_count >= 1:
   182:                 status_label.configure(text="基准帧只保存 1 张")
   183:                 return
   184:             reference_count += 1
   185:             name = f"reference_{reference_count:02d}.png"
   186:         else:
   187:             if failure_count >= 5:
   188:                 status_label.configure(text="失败帧最多保存 5 张")
   189:                 return
   190:             failure_count += 1
   191:             name = f"failure_{failure_count:02d}.png"
   192:         selected_frame = enrollment_frame if kind == "reference" else latest_frame
   193:         if selected_frame is None:
   194:             status_label.configure(text="当前没有可保存的摄像头帧")
   195:             return
   196:         diagnostic_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   197:         target = diagnostic_dir / name
   198:         encoded, buffer = cv2.imencode(".png", selected_frame)
   199:         if not encoded:
   200:             raise RuntimeError("无法编码诊断帧")
   201:         target.write_bytes(buffer.tobytes())
   202:         status_label.configure(text=f"已保存 {name}，仅供本机诊断")
   203:         report(f"CAPTURED {target}")
   204: 
   205:     tk.Button(controls, text="登记本人（1 张）", command=start_enrollment).pack(side="left", padx=6)
   206:     if diagnostic_dir is not None:
   207:         tk.Button(controls, text="保存基准帧", command=lambda: save_diagnostic("reference")).pack(side="left", padx=6)
   208:         tk.Button(controls, text="标记失败帧", command=lambda: save_diagnostic("failure")).pack(side="left", padx=6)
   209:     tk.Button(controls, text="关闭摄像头 (Esc)", command=close).pack(side="left", padx=6)
   210:     root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", close)
   211:     root.bind("<Escape>", lambda event: close())
   212:     root.attributes("-topmost", True)  # 先置顶确保窗口被看到，1.2 秒后取消
   213:     root.after(1200, lambda: root.attributes("-topmost", False))
   214:     root.lift()
   215:     root.focus_force()
   216: 
   217:     def update():
   218:         """主循环回调：读一帧 → 收取推理结果 → 提交新任务 → 刷新画面。"""
   219:         nonlocal pending, pending_frame, pending_kind, enrolling, enrolled
   220:         nonlocal last_submit_at, frame_count, latest_frame, enrollment_frame
   221:         if closed:
   222:             return
   223:         ok, frame = capture.read()
   224:         if not ok:
   225:             status_label.configure(text="摄像头读取失败，请关闭窗口后重试")
   226:             report("ERROR: camera read failed")
   227:             root.after(100, update)
   228:             return
   229:         frame_count += 1
   230:         latest_frame = frame
   231:         now = time.perf_counter()
   232:         gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
   233: 
   234:         if pending is not None:
   235:             # Captured preview frames bridge the inference-to-display motion gap.
   236:             # 推理进行中的每一帧都留一份灰度图，待结果回来后用于推进框的位置。
   237:             pending_previews.append((now, gray))
   238: 
   239:         # ===== 收取已完成的推理结果 =====
   240:         if pending is not None and pending.done():
   241:             try:
   242:                 value = pending.result()
   243:                 if pending_kind == "enroll":
   244:                     bbox, vector = value
   245:                     if pending_frame is not None:
   246:                         enrollment_frame = pending_frame.copy()
   247:                         overlay.reset(pending_frame,
   248:                                       [{"bbox": bbox, "status": "ENROLLING"}], last_submit_at)
   249:                         # 用推理期间缓存的中间帧把框推进到当前画面位置。
   250:                         for captured_at, preview in pending_previews:
   251:                             overlay.advance_gray(preview, captured_at)
   252:                     # 登记前清空库：本演示只维护一个人。
   253:                     engine.index.clear()
   254:                     engine.index.add(subject_id, vector)
   255:                     enrolled, enrolling = True, False
   256:                     status_label.configure(text="单张登记完成。离开画面再回来，观察识别结果")
   257:                     report("ENROLLED")
   258:                 elif pending_kind == "recognize":
   259:                     if pending_frame is not None:
   260:                         overlay.reset(pending_frame, value, last_submit_at)
   261:                         for captured_at, preview in pending_previews:
   262:                             overlay.advance_gray(preview, captured_at)
   263:                     if value:
   264:                         # 展示分数最高的那张脸的详细信息。
   265:                         best = value[0]
   266:                         score = best["similarity"]
   267:                         label = best["status"]
   268:                         score_text = f"{score:.3f}" if score is not None else "--"
   269:                         x1, y1, x2, y2 = best["bbox"]
   270:                         size = f"{x2-x1:.0f}x{y2-y1:.0f}"
   271:                         detection = f"{best['detection_score']:.3f}"
   272:                         status_label.configure(text=f"{STATUS_LABELS.get(label, label)}  相似度 {score_text}  检测 {detection}  人脸 {size}")
   273:                         report(f"RESULT {label} similarity={score_text} detection={detection} size={size} faces={len(value)}")
   274:                     else:
   275:                         status_label.configure(text="未检测到人脸")
   276:                         report("RESULT NO_FACE faces=0")
   277:             except Exception as exc:
   278:                 # 登记/识别失败（例如画面里有多人）时把原因显示给用户，而不是崩溃。
   279:                 overlay.clear()
   280:                 status_label.configure(text=str(exc))
   281:                 report(f"ERROR: {exc}")
   282:             pending = None
   283:             pending_frame = None
   284:             pending_previews.clear()
   285:             pending_kind = ""
   286: 
   287:         # ===== 提交新的推理任务 =====
   288:         # A single pending job prevents stale-frame buildup; preview remains responsive.
   289:         # 只有上一个任务完成后才提交新的，这样不会积压一堆过期帧。
   290:         # 登记时限流 0.35 秒一次，避免用户还没摆好姿势就连续提交。
   291:         interval = 0.35 if enrolling else 0.0
   292:         if pending is None and now - last_submit_at >= interval:
   293:             if enrolling:
   294:                 pending_frame = frame.copy()
   295:                 pending_previews.clear()
   296:                 pending = worker.submit(_enrollment_sample, engine, pending_frame)
   297:                 pending_kind = "enroll"
   298:                 last_submit_at = now
   299:             elif enrolled:
   300:                 pending_frame = frame.copy()
   301:                 pending_previews.clear()
   302:                 # 注意：送进去的是原始帧副本，source_id 只是给结果打个来源标签。
   303:                 pending = worker.submit(engine.recognize_image, pending_frame, f"WEBCAM_{camera}")
   304:                 pending_kind = "recognize"
   305:                 last_submit_at = now
   306:             elif frame_count % 12 == 0:
   307:                 report(f"LIVE {frame.shape[1]}x{frame.shape[0]} READY")
   308: 
   309:         # ===== 刷新画面 =====
   310:         # Only display is mirrored; inference always sees the original camera frame.
   311:         # 只有显示做了水平镜像（像照镜子）；算法输入始终是未镜像的原始帧。
   312:         display = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(cv2.flip(frame, 1), cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
   313:         shown = overlay.advance_gray(gray, now)
   314:         if shown:
   315:             draw = ImageDraw.Draw(display)
   316:             width = frame.shape[1]
   317:             for item in shown:
   318:                 x1, y1, x2, y2 = item["bbox"]
   319:                 status = item["status"]
   320:                 # 按状态配色：匹配绿、待复核黄、未知红，其余（如登记中）蓝。
   321:                 color = {"MATCH": "#22c55e", "REVIEW": "#f59e0b",
   322:                          "UNKNOWN": "#ef4444"}.get(status, "#38bdf8")
   323:                 # 画面已水平镜像，所以框的横坐标要用 width - x 换算到镜像后的位置。
   324:                 draw.rectangle((width - x2, y1, width - x1, y2), outline=color, width=3)
   325:                 label = STATUS_LABELS.get(status, status)
   326:                 bounds = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=label_font)
   327:                 label_width = bounds[2] - bounds[0] + 10
   328:                 label_height = bounds[3] - bounds[1] + 6
   329:                 label_x = max(0, min(width - label_width, width - x2))
   330:                 label_y = max(0, y1 - label_height)
   331:                 draw.rectangle((label_x, label_y, label_x + label_width,
   332:                                 label_y + label_height), fill=color)
   333:                 draw.text((label_x + 5 - bounds[0], label_y + 3 - bounds[1]),
   334:                           label, fill="white", font=label_font)
   335:         photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(display, master=root)
   336:         image_label.configure(image=photo)
   337:         image_label.image = photo  # 必须自己持有引用，否则会被垃圾回收导致图片消失
   338:         root.after(1, update)  # 立即排下一次刷新，保持预览流畅
   339: 
   340:     report("OPENING")
   341:     root.after(1, update)
   342:     root.mainloop()
   343:     return 0

     1: """【预览框跟随】只在本地摄像头预览窗口里，让检测框在两次推理之间平滑跟随画面。
     2: 
     3: 重要边界：
     4:     本模块只负责"把框画在哪"，不参与任何身份判定。
     5:     它移动的是最近一次真实推理得到的框，框上的 MATCH/REVIEW/UNKNOWN 标签
     6:     始终来自 FaceRecognitionEngine，本模块不会、也绝不能改变身份结论。
     7: 
     8: 为什么需要它：
     9:     摄像头 30fps，但推理一帧可能要几十毫秒。如果只在推理完成时刷新框，
    10:     框会一卡一卡地跳。这里用光流估计两帧之间画面的位移，
    11:     把框平移到当前帧的对应位置，看起来就跟手了。
    12: 
    13: 为什么是"短时"的（max_age 默认 0.8 秒）：
    14:     位移估计是靠相邻帧的小运动累积出来的，时间越长误差越大。
    15:     超过 max_age 就主动放弃、把框藏起来，
    16:     宁可短暂不显示，也不要画一个明显错位、可能误导人的框。
    17: """
    18: 
    19: from __future__ import annotations
    20: 
    21: import cv2
    22: import numpy as np
    23: 
    24: 
    25: # 状态标签的中文案。注意这是给本机演示界面看的，
    26: # 与算法输出的 status 字符串一一对应，不改变语义。
    27: STATUS_LABELS = {
    28:     "MATCH": "匹配",
    29:     "REVIEW": "待复核",
    30:     "UNKNOWN": "未知",
    31:     "ENROLLING": "已登记",
    32: }
    33: 
    34: 
    35: class CameraBoxOverlay:
    36:     """在最多 max_age 秒的时间窗内，跟随最近一次推理得到的人脸框。"""
    37: 
    38:     def __init__(self, max_age: float = 0.8):
    39:         """参数：
    40:             max_age: 框的有效期（秒）。超过这个时间没有新的推理结果就把框清掉。
    41:         """
    42:         self.max_age = max_age
    43:         self.clear()
    44: 
    45:     def clear(self) -> None:
    46:         """清空全部跟随状态。"""
    47:         self._gray: np.ndarray | None = None  # 上一帧灰度图，作为光流的参考帧
    48:         self._items: list[dict] = []  # 当前跟随的框及其状态
    49:         self._points: list[np.ndarray | None] = []  # 每个框内用于跟踪的角点
    50:         self._detected_at = 0.0  # 最近一次真实推理的时刻
    51: 
    52:     def reset(self, frame: np.ndarray, results: list[dict], detected_at: float) -> None:
    53:         """用一次真实推理的结果重新建立跟随锚点。
    54: 
    55:         关键：框和用来跟踪的像素必须来自同一帧。
    56:         如果框来自 A 帧而角点取自 B 帧，位移估计就会错位。
    57: 
    58:         参数：
    59:             frame: 该次推理所用的原始帧。
    60:             results: 该次推理得到的人脸结果列表。
    61:             detected_at: 推理时刻（perf_counter 秒）。
    62:         """
    63:         self.clear()
    64:         if not results:
    65:             return
    66:         gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    67:         height, width = gray.shape
    68:         for result in results:
    69:             x1, y1, x2, y2 = (int(round(v)) for v in result["bbox"])
    70:             # 把框夹到画面范围内，避免越界切片。
    71:             x1, x2 = max(0, x1), min(width, x2)
    72:             y1, y2 = max(0, y1), min(height, y2)
    73:             if x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1:
    74:                 continue
    75:             # 在框内取至多 40 个角点作为跟踪特征。
    76:             # 角点是纹理明显的位置，光流跟踪最稳；纯色区域取不到点。
    77:             points = cv2.goodFeaturesToTrack(
    78:                 gray[y1:y2, x1:x2], maxCorners=40, qualityLevel=0.01,
    79:                 minDistance=4, blockSize=3,
    80:             )
    81:             if points is not None:
    82:                 # 角点是在框内局部坐标里取的，这里平移回整帧坐标系。
    83:                 points[:, :, 0] += x1
    84:                 points[:, :, 1] += y1
    85:             item = dict(result)
    86:             item["bbox"] = [float(x1), float(y1), float(x2), float(y2)]
    87:             self._items.append(item)
    88:             self._points.append(points)
    89:         self._gray = gray
    90:         self._detected_at = detected_at
    91: 
    92:     def advance(self, frame: np.ndarray, now: float) -> list[dict]:
    93:         """按一帧新画面推进框的位置（BGR 版本，内部转灰度）。"""
    94:         return self.advance_gray(cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY), now)
    95: 
    96:     def advance_gray(self, gray: np.ndarray, now: float) -> list[dict]:
    97:         """按一帧灰度画面推进框的位置，返回当前应显示的框。
    98: 
    99:         参数：
   100:             gray: 当前帧灰度图。
   101:             now: 当前时刻（perf_counter 秒）。
   102:         返回：
   103:             当前仍可信的框列表；不可信的框会被丢弃（不返回）。
   104: 
   105:         算法思路：
   106:         1. 用金字塔 LK 光流把角点跟踪到当前帧，得到每个点的位移。
   107:         2. 反向再跟踪一次做"前后一致性校验"：能回到原点的点才算跟踪成功。
   108:            这一步能过滤掉大部分错误匹配（例如跟踪到了另一个人脸上）。
   109:         3. 取所有成功点位移的中位数作为框的整体位移（中位数抗个别离群点）。
   110:         4. 与中位数偏差小于 8 像素的点才算"意见一致"，再取一次中位数精化。
   111:         5. 位移超过 120 像素（画面突变/物体丢失）或有效点不足 4 个 → 放弃该框。
   112:         """
   113:         # 没有锚点，或已超过有效期 → 直接清空，不再显示。
   114:         if self._gray is None or now - self._detected_at > self.max_age:
   115:             self.clear()
   116:             return []
   117:         height, width = gray.shape
   118:         visible: list[dict] = []
   119:         updated_points: list[np.ndarray | None] = []
   120: 
   121:         for item, points in zip(self._items, self._points):
   122:             # 角点太少（少于 4 个）无法可靠估计位移，跳过这个框。
   123:             if points is None or len(points) < 4:
   124:                 continue
   125:             # 正向跟踪：上一帧 → 当前帧
   126:             moved, found, _ = cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK(
   127:                 self._gray, gray, points, None,
   128:                 winSize=(31, 31), maxLevel=3,
   129:             )
   130:             if moved is None or found is None:
   131:                 continue
   132:             # 反向跟踪：当前帧 → 上一帧，用于校验
   133:             back, back_found, _ = cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK(
   134:                 gray, self._gray, moved, None,
   135:                 winSize=(31, 31), maxLevel=3,
   136:             )
   137:             if back is None or back_found is None:
   138:                 continue
   139:             # 双向都成功，且回到原点附近（误差 < 2.5 像素）的点才可信。
   140:             valid = (found[:, 0] == 1) & (back_found[:, 0] == 1)
   141:             valid &= np.linalg.norm(back[:, 0] - points[:, 0], axis=1) < 2.5
   142:             if np.count_nonzero(valid) < 4:
   143:                 continue
   144: 
   145:             offsets = moved[valid, 0] - points[valid, 0]
   146:             shift = np.median(offsets, axis=0)  # 粗估计：位移中位数
   147:             # 与中位数偏差 < 8 像素的点视为一致，用它们再取一次中位数精化。
   148:             agreeing = np.linalg.norm(offsets - shift, axis=1) < 8.0
   149:             # 一致点太少，或整体位移过大（画面突变）→ 不可信，丢弃。
   150:             if np.count_nonzero(agreeing) < 4 or np.linalg.norm(shift) > 120:
   151:                 continue
   152:             shift = np.median(offsets[agreeing], axis=0)
   153: 
   154:             # 把框按估计出的位移整体平移。
   155:             x1, y1, x2, y2 = item["bbox"]
   156:             moved_box = [x1 + float(shift[0]), y1 + float(shift[1]),
   157:                          x2 + float(shift[0]), y2 + float(shift[1])]
   158:             # 框被推出画面 → 放弃。
   159:             if (moved_box[0] < 0 or moved_box[1] < 0 or
   160:                     moved_box[2] > width or moved_box[3] > height):
   161:                 continue
   162:             moved_item = dict(item)
   163:             moved_item["bbox"] = moved_box
   164:             visible.append(moved_item)
   165:             # 只保留可信角点继续下一帧跟踪，防止误差累积。
   166:             updated_points.append(moved[valid][agreeing].reshape(-1, 1, 2))
   167: 
   168:         # 用当前帧作为下一次的参考帧。
   169:         self._gray = gray
   170:         self._items = visible
   171:         self._points = updated_points
   172:         return visible

     1: """Configuration arithmetic for deployment planning, never a hardware benchmark."""
     2: import math
     3: from collections import Counter
     4: 
     5: 
     6: def _positive(value, name):
     7:     if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0:
     8:         raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a positive finite number')
     9:     return value
    10: 
    11: 
    12: def capacity_report(config, camera_config):
    13:     cameras = camera_config.get('cameras', [])
    14:     targets = config.get('deployment_targets', {})
    15:     site_count = targets.get('camera_count', len(cameras))
    16:     if type(site_count) is not int or site_count < len(cameras):
    17:         raise ValueError('deployment camera_count must cover configured cameras')
    18:     target = _positive(targets.get('target_result_latency_seconds', 2), 'target latency')
    19:     acceptable = _positive(targets.get('acceptable_result_latency_seconds', 3), 'acceptable latency')
    20:     if target > acceptable:
    21:         raise ValueError('target latency cannot exceed acceptable latency')
    22:     scheduling = config.get('scheduling', {})
    23:     frequencies = scheduling.get('fps', [6, 2, 1])
    24:     if not isinstance(frequencies, (list, tuple)) or len(frequencies) != 3:
    25:         raise ValueError('three sampling frequencies required')
    26:     frequencies = [_positive(value, 'sampling frequency') for value in frequencies]
    27:     ids = [camera['camera_id'] for camera in cameras]
    28:     if any(count != 1 for count in Counter(ids).values()):
    29:         raise ValueError('duplicate camera_id in deployment configuration')
    30:     placeholders = sum(not isinstance(key, str) or not key or key.startswith('REPLACE_') for key in ids)
    31:     live = [camera for camera in cameras if camera.get('sub_url_env')]
    32:     captures = [camera for camera in cameras if camera.get('hikvision', {}).get('enabled')]
    33:     overlap = sum(bool(camera.get('sub_url_env')) for camera in captures)
    34:     inactive = len(cameras) - len(live) - len(captures) + overlap
    35:     output_fps = sum(_positive(camera.get('sample_fps', 10), 'decoder output frequency') for camera in live)
    36:     max_queued = scheduling.get('max_queued_cameras', 128)
    37:     notes = [
    38:         'Camera count does not determine face-event rate; native captures and live streams must be counted separately.',
    39:         'The live FFmpeg path decodes before applying its output FPS filter.',
    40:         'Class quotas and fresh queued frames do not guarantee every camera is inspected within the result latency target.',
    41:         'Measurements must include the intended gallery size, face density, graph, CPU/GPU, decoding and durable P2 writes.'
    42:     ]
    43:     if overlap:
    44:         notes.append('Some cameras enable both continuous streaming and native capture; both consume resources.')
    45:     if len(live) > max_queued:
    46:         notes.append('Continuous stream count exceeds live queue slots; admission may wait even when queued-frame age is low.')
    47:     if scheduling.get('max_frame_age_seconds', 2) >= target:
    48:         notes.append('Maximum live queue age already consumes the target latency budget before inference and P2 processing.')
    49:     classes = ('PRIORITY', 'NORMAL', 'UNREGISTERED')
    50:     def demand(count):
    51:         return {category: count * fps for category, fps in zip(classes, frequencies)}
    52:     # Image/face demand are separate: one image can have zero or many qualified faces.
    53:     offered = config.get('capacity_measurements', {})
    54:     required = ('source_evidence_id', 'peak_native_capture_images_per_second',
    55:                 'qualified_faces_per_image', 'sustained_images_per_second',
    56:                 'sustained_p2_events_per_second', 'result_p95_seconds')
    57:     assessment = {'status': 'UNMEASURED', 'missing': [key for key in required if key not in offered]}
    58:     if not assessment['missing']:
    59:         if not isinstance(offered['source_evidence_id'], str) or not offered['source_evidence_id'].strip():
    60:             raise ValueError('capacity measurements require a source_evidence_id')
    61:         native_rate = offered['peak_native_capture_images_per_second']
    62:         if isinstance(native_rate, bool) or not isinstance(native_rate, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(native_rate) or native_rate < 0:
    63:             raise ValueError('native capture peak rate must be finite and nonnegative')
    64:         for key in required[2:]:
    65:             _positive(offered[key], key)
    66:         scenarios = {}
    67:         for category, fps in demand(len(live)).items():
    68:             images = fps + native_rate
    69:             events = images * offered['qualified_faces_per_image']
    70:             scenarios[category] = dict(required_images_per_second=images, required_p2_events_per_second=events,
    71:                 within_reported_rates=images <= offered['sustained_images_per_second'] and events <= offered['sustained_p2_events_per_second'])
    72:         assessment = dict(status='REPORTED_MEASUREMENTS_ONLY', source_evidence_id=offered['source_evidence_id'],
    73:             scenarios=scenarios, reported_result_p95_seconds=offered['result_p95_seconds'],
    74:             within_target_latency=offered['result_p95_seconds'] <= target,
    75:             within_acceptable_latency=offered['result_p95_seconds'] <= acceptable)
    76:     return dict(scope='configuration arithmetic only; not a 3090 or 600-camera benchmark',
    77:         site_camera_target=site_count, configured_cameras=len(cameras), placeholder_cameras=placeholders,
    78:         unconfigured_cameras=site_count-len(cameras), inactive_cameras=inactive,
    79:         continuous_streams=len(live), native_capture_cameras=len(captures), dual_input_cameras=overlap,
    80:         target_result_latency_seconds=target, acceptable_result_latency_seconds=acceptable,
    81:         configured_live_sampling_images_per_second_if_all_in_class=demand(len(live)),
    82:         whole_site_sampling_images_per_second_if_all_continuously_streamed=demand(site_count),
    83:         configured_decoder_output_frames_per_second=output_fps,
    84:         illustrative_ppm_pipe_bytes_per_second={f'{width}x{height}': int(output_fps*width*height*3)
    85:             for width, height in ((640, 360), (1280, 720))},
    86:         illustrative_sizes_are_not_measured=True, live_queue_slots=max_queued,
    87:         assessment=assessment, notes=notes)

    41: def _model_path(configured: str) -> Path:
    42:     """把配置里的模型路径解析成绝对路径。
    43: 
    44:     配置中写相对路径时，以项目根目录为基准，
    45:     这样无论从哪个工作目录执行命令都能找到模型。
    46:     """
    47:     path = Path(configured)
    48:     return path if path.is_absolute() else _PROJECT_ROOT / path
    49: 
    50: 
    51: def _models(config: dict):
    52:     """按配置加载检测器和特征提取器。
    53: 
    54:     若配置里给了 small_image_input_size，就额外建一个小输入尺寸的检测器，
    55:     用 SizeAwareSCRFDDetector 包装：小图走小模型省算力，大图走标准模型保精度。
    56:     """
    57:     d, r = config["detector"], config["recognizer"]
    58:     detector_path = _model_path(d["model_path"])
    59:     recognizer_path = _model_path(r["model_path"])
    60:     # 模型权重不随仓库分发，缺失时给出明确的修复指引而不是让它后面崩溃。
    61:     missing = [str(path) for path in (detector_path, recognizer_path) if not path.is_file()]
    62:     if missing:
    63:         raise FileNotFoundError(
    64:             "Missing ONNX model weights: " + ", ".join(missing)
    65:             + ". Put licensed SCRFD/ArcFace models there or edit --config."
    66:         )
    67:     cpu_threads = config.get("cpu_threads")
    68:     detector = SCRFDDetector(detector_path, d["input_size"], d["confidence_threshold"],
    69:                              d["nms_threshold"], config["device"], cpu_threads=cpu_threads)
    70:     if "small_image_input_size" in d:
    71:         small = SCRFDDetector(detector_path, d["small_image_input_size"], d["confidence_threshold"],
    72:                               d["nms_threshold"], config["device"], cpu_threads=cpu_threads)
    73:         detector = SizeAwareSCRFDDetector(detector, small, d["small_image_max_side"])
    74:     recognizer = ArcFaceRecognizer(recognizer_path, r["batch_size"], config["device"],
    75:                                    cpu_threads=cpu_threads)
    76:     # 打印两个模型实际跑在什么后端上（CUDA / CPU），便于确认环境是否符合预期。
    77:     print(f"Detector Backend: {detector.backend}")
    78:     print(f"Recognizer Backend: {recognizer.backend}")
    79:     return detector, recognizer

    82: def _image(path: str | Path) -> np.ndarray:
    83:     """读取一张图片为 BGR 数组。
    84: 
    85:     # np.fromfile + imdecode also handles Chinese file names on Windows.
    86:     用 np.fromfile + imdecode 而不是 cv2.imread，
    87:     因为后者在 Windows 上遇到中文路径会读不出来。
    88:     """
    89:     encoded = np.fromfile(str(path), dtype=np.uint8)
    90:     image = cv2.imdecode(encoded, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    91:     if image is None:
    92:         raise ValueError(f"Cannot decode image: {path}")
    93:     return image

    95: 
    96: def _enroll(args, config):
    97:     """建库：读 CSV 名单，每人一张照片，逐张检测→对齐→提特征，最后存成 .npz。
    98: 
    99:     CSV 格式（UTF-8）：
   100:         subject_id,image_path
   101:         FACE_000001,photos/one.jpg
   102: 
   103:     严格要求每张登记照片恰好检出一张脸：
   104:     - 检出 0 张：这张照片没用，应换图
   105:     - 检出多张：无法确定要登记谁，也应换图
   106:     而不是"随便挑一张"——那会静默地建出一个错误的库。
   107: 
   108:     特征按 batch_size 攒批提取，几万人时比逐张快得多。
   109:     """
   110:     from face_engine.quality import QualityPolicy, evaluate_face_quality
   111:     detector, recognizer = _models(config)
   112:     quality_policy = QualityPolicy.from_config(config.get("quality"))
   113:     manifest = Path(args.manifest)
   114:     ids, aligned_batch, embedding_parts = [], [], []
   115:     with manifest.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as stream:
   116:         reader = csv.DictReader(stream)
   117:         if reader.fieldnames is None or not {"subject_id", "image_path"}.issubset(reader.fieldnames):
   118:             raise ValueError("CSV requires subject_id,image_path columns")
   119:         for line, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):  # start=2：表头算第 1 行
   120:             subject_id = row["subject_id"].strip()
   121:             if not subject_id:
   122:                 raise ValueError(f"Missing subject_id on line {line}")
   123:             image_path = Path(row["image_path"])
   124:             if not image_path.is_absolute():
   125:                 image_path = manifest.parent / image_path  # 相对路径以 CSV 所在目录为基准
   126:             image = _image(image_path)
   127:             faces = detector.detect_faces(image)
   128:             if len(faces) != 1:
   129:                 raise ValueError(f"Expected exactly one face on line {line}; found {len(faces)}")
   130:             quality = evaluate_face_quality(image, faces[0], quality_policy)
   131:             if not quality["accepted"]:
   132:                 raise ValueError(f"QUALITY_REJECTED on line {line}: " + ", ".join(quality["reasons"]))
   133:             ids.append(subject_id)
   134:             aligned_batch.append(align_face(image, faces[0]["landmarks"]))
   135:             # 攒够一批就推理一次，然后清空重新攒。
   136:             if len(aligned_batch) == config["recognizer"]["batch_size"]:
   137:                 embedding_parts.append(recognizer.extract_embeddings(aligned_batch))
   138:                 aligned_batch.clear()
   139:     # 处理最后不满一批的零头。
   140:     if aligned_batch:
   141:         embedding_parts.append(recognizer.extract_embeddings(aligned_batch))
   142:     vectors = np.concatenate(embedding_parts) if embedding_parts else np.empty((0, 512), np.float32)
   143:     i = config["face_index"]
   144:     index = create_index(i["backend"], i["use_gpu"])
   145:     index.add_batch(ids, vectors)
   146:     index.save(args.output)
   147:     print(f"Saved {index.size()} subject embeddings to {args.output}")
   148: 
   149: 
   150: def _engine(config, index_path: str | None):
   151:     """组装一个完整的识别引擎。
   152: 
   153:     没给索引路径时库为空，此时所有检出的人脸都会是 UNKNOWN——
   154:     这样可以在没有人员库的情况下单独验证摄像头和检测是否正常。
   155:     """
   156:     detector, recognizer = _models(config)
   157:     i = config["face_index"]
   158:     index = create_index(i["backend"], i["use_gpu"])
   159:     if index_path:
   160:         index.load(index_path)
   161:     else:
   162:         print("No subject index supplied; detected faces will be UNKNOWN.", file=sys.stderr)
   163:     return FaceRecognitionEngine.from_config(detector, recognizer, index, config)
   164: 
   165: 
   166: def _recognize(args, config):
   167:     """识别单张图片，把结果以 JSON 打印出来。"""
   168:     engine = _engine(config, args.index)
   169:     results = engine.recognize_image(_image(args.image), source_id=args.source_id)
   170:     print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
   171: 
   172: 
   173: def _stream(args, config):
   174:     """持续识别一路视频源，每条结果输出一行 JSON（JSON Lines）。
   175: 
   176:     解码在这里完成，算法核心拿到的始终是已解码的帧（摄像头连接不进算法层）。
   177:     """
   178:     # Keep backend diagnostics visible on stderr; stdout stays JSON Lines.
   179:     # 建引擎时会打印后端信息，重定向到 stderr，
   180:     # 保证 stdout 是纯净的 JSON Lines，方便下游管道消费。
   181:     with redirect_stdout(sys.stderr):
   182:         engine = _engine(config, args.index)
   183:     source = int(args.source) if args.camera else args.source
   184:     capture = cv2.VideoCapture(source)
   185:     if not capture.isOpened():
   186:         capture.release()
   187:         raise RuntimeError("Cannot open video source")
   188:     video = config["video"]
   189:     try:
   190:         def frames():
   191:             """生成器：不断从摄像头/视频读帧，读不到就结束。"""
   192:             while True:
   193:                 ok, image = capture.read()
   194:                 if not ok:
   195:                     return
   196:                 position_ms = capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC)
   197:                 # 实时流拿不到有效位置信息，此时时间戳为 None。
   198:                 timestamp = position_ms / 1000 if position_ms > 0 else None
   199:                 yield Frame(image=image, timestamp_seconds=timestamp, source_id=args.source_id)
   200: 
   201:         for event in recognize_frames(frames(), engine,
   202:                                       detection_interval=video["detection_interval"],
   203:                                       recognition_interval=video["recognition_interval"],
   204:                                       cache_enabled=video["cache_enabled"],
   205:                                       cache_ttl_frames=video["cache_ttl_frames"],
   206:                                       max_frames=args.max_frames):
   207:             print(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)  # flush 保证实时输出
   208:     finally:
   209:         capture.release()
   210: 
   211: 
   212: def _camera_demo(args, config):
   213:     """启动本机摄像头可见窗口演示。
   214: 
   215:     索引固定用 NumPy 且禁用 GPU：演示只登记 1 个人，
   216:     用不着 FAISS，也避免占用显存。
   217:     """
   218:     from face_engine.camera_demo import run_camera_demo
   219: 
   220:     detector, recognizer = _models(config)
   221:     index = create_index("numpy", use_gpu=False)
   222:     engine = FaceRecognitionEngine.from_config(detector, recognizer, index, config)
   223:     return run_camera_demo(engine, camera=args.camera, subject_id=args.subject_id,
   224:                            status_file=args.status_file, diagnostic_dir=args.diagnostic_dir)
   225: 
   226: 
   227: def _benchmark_camera(args, config):
   228:     """测量摄像头相关耗时。
   229: 
   230:     两种模式：
   231:     1. 默认（不带 --full）：只测"读帧 + SCRFD 输入预处理"，不加载任何模型。
   232:        在还没有正式模型权重时也能跑，用于验证采集链路。
   233:     2. --full：加载真实模型，按 sample_every 抽帧，
   234:        分别测检测、对齐、特征批量、检索以及总耗时。
   235: 
   236:     注意：读帧耗时包含等待下一帧的时间，
   237:     所以 observed_fps 反映的是实际观测帧率，不是算法处理能力的上限。
   238:     """
   239:     if args.frames <= 0 or args.warmup < 0:
   240:         raise ValueError("frames must be positive and warmup must be nonnegative")
   241:     detector = recognizer = index = None
   242:     if args.full:
   243:         detector, recognizer = _models(config)
   244:         i = config["face_index"]
   245:         index = create_index(i["backend"], i["use_gpu"])
   246:         if args.index:
   247:             index.load(args.index)
   248:     source = int(args.source) if args.camera else args.source
   249:     # Windows 上 DirectShow 通常比默认后端更快更稳，用 --directshow 开启。
   250:     backend = cv2.CAP_DSHOW if args.directshow else cv2.CAP_ANY
   251:     capture = cv2.VideoCapture(source, backend)
   252:     if not capture.isOpened():
   253:         capture.release()
   254:         raise RuntimeError("Cannot open video source")
   255:     read_ms, preprocess_ms, shape = [], [], None
   256:     stage_ms = {key: [] for key in ("detection", "alignment", "arcface_batch", "search", "total")}
   257:     processed_frames = faces_total = 0
   258:     try:
   259:         # 预热：先丢掉若干帧，避开摄像头刚打开时的曝光/白平衡调整阶段。
   260:         for _ in range(args.warmup):
   261:             ok, _ = capture.read()
   262:             if not ok:
   263:                 raise RuntimeError("Video source ended during warmup")
   264:         started = time.perf_counter()
   265:         for frame_index in range(args.frames):
   266:             t0 = time.perf_counter()
   267:             ok, frame = capture.read()
   268:             t1 = time.perf_counter()
   269:             if not ok:
   270:                 break
   271:             read_ms.append((t1 - t0) * 1000)
   272:             shape = frame.shape
   273:             if not args.full:
   274:                 # 只做预处理：letterbox + 归一化，不跑模型。
   275:                 prepare_scrfd_input(frame, tuple(config["detector"]["input_size"]))
   276:                 preprocess_ms.append((time.perf_counter() - t1) * 1000)
   277:             elif frame_index % args.sample_every == 0:
   278:                 # 完整链路分阶段计时。
   279:                 faces = detector.detect_faces(frame)
   280:                 t2 = time.perf_counter()
   281:                 aligned = [align_face(frame, face["landmarks"]) for face in faces]
   282:                 t3 = time.perf_counter()
   283:                 if aligned:
   284:                     embeddings = recognizer.extract_embeddings(aligned)
   285:                     t4 = time.perf_counter()
   286:                     index.search_batch(embeddings, top_k=config["face_index"]["top_k"])
   287:                 else:
   288:                     t4 = time.perf_counter()  # 没检出脸就不用提特征/检索
   289:                 t5 = time.perf_counter()
   290:                 processed_frames += 1
   291:                 faces_total += len(faces)
   292:                 # t1→t2 检测，t2→t3 对齐，t3→t4 特征，t4→t5 检索，t1→t5 总计。
   293:                 for key, value in zip(stage_ms, (t2-t1, t3-t2, t4-t3, t5-t4, t5-t1)):
   294:                     stage_ms[key].append(value * 1000)
   295:         elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
   296:     finally:
   297:         capture.release()
   298:     if not read_ms:
   299:         raise RuntimeError("No frames captured")
   300: 
   301:     def summary(values):
   302:         """汇总均值和 P95（95 分位），P95 比最大值更能反映稳定表现。"""
   303:         ordered = sorted(values)
   304:         return {"mean_ms": round(statistics.mean(values), 3),
   305:                 "p95_ms": round(ordered[max(0, int(len(ordered) * 0.95) - 1)], 3)}
   306: 
   307:     result = {"mode": "camera_full_pipeline_stages" if args.full else "camera_capture_and_preprocess_only",
   308:               "model_inference": args.full, "frames": len(read_ms), "frame_shape": shape,
   309:               "observed_fps": round(len(read_ms) / elapsed, 2),
   310:               "read_including_frame_wait": summary(read_ms)}
   311:     if args.full:
   312:         result.update({"processed_frames": processed_frames, "faces_total": faces_total,
   313:                        "index_size": index.size(), "stages": {key: summary(value) for key, value in stage_ms.items()}})
   314:     else:
   315:         result["scrfd_preprocess"] = summary(preprocess_ms)
   316:     print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
   317: 
   318: 
   319: 
   320: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
   321:     """解析命令行参数并分发到各子命令。
   322: 
   323:     参数：
   324:         argv: 参数列表；None 表示从 sys.argv 取（正常命令行调用）。
   325:     返回：
   326:         退出码，0 表示成功。
   327:     """
   328:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m face_engine", description="Venue face recognition engine")
   329:     sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
   330: 
   331: 
   332:     enroll = sub.add_parser("enroll", help="build an index from a subject_id,image_path CSV")
   333:     enroll.add_argument("manifest")
   334:     enroll.add_argument("output")
   335:     enroll.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=_DEFAULT_CONFIG)
   336: 
   337:     recognize = sub.add_parser("recognize", help="recognize all faces in one real image")
   338:     recognize.add_argument("image")
   339:     recognize.add_argument("index")
   340:     recognize.add_argument("--source-id")
   341:     recognize.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=_DEFAULT_CONFIG)
   342: 
   343:     stream = sub.add_parser("stream", help="continuously recognize frames from one RTSP/USB/MP4 source")
   344:     stream.add_argument("source", help="RTSP URL, MP4 file, or USB camera number with --camera")
   345:     stream.add_argument("index", nargs="?", help="optional saved subject index; omit for detection-only testing")
   346:     stream.add_argument("--camera", action="store_true", help="interpret source as integer USB camera number")
   347:     stream.add_argument("--source-id", help="opaque source label to include in each face result")
   348:     stream.add_argument("--max-frames", type=int, help="stop after reading this many frames")
   349:     stream.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=_DEFAULT_CONFIG)
   350: 
   351:     camera_demo = sub.add_parser("camera-demo", help="visible webcam self-enrollment and recognition demo")
   352:     camera_demo.add_argument("--camera", type=int, default=0)
   353:     camera_demo.add_argument("--subject-id", default="SELF")
   354:     camera_demo.add_argument("--status-file", type=Path, help="optional local status file for smoke tests")
   355:     camera_demo.add_argument("--diagnostic-dir", type=Path, help="save only frames marked in the visible window")
   356:     # 演示默认用 configs/demo.yaml（临时研究模型），不动正式配置。
   357:     camera_demo.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=_PROJECT_ROOT / "configs" / "demo.yaml")
   358: 
   359:     benchmark = sub.add_parser("benchmark-camera", help="measure live capture and preprocessing without models")
   360:     benchmark.add_argument("source", help="RTSP URL or USB camera number with --camera")
   361:     benchmark.add_argument("--camera", action="store_true")
   362:     benchmark.add_argument("--directshow", action="store_true", help="use DirectShow on Windows")
   363:     benchmark.add_argument("--frames", type=int, default=90)
   364:     benchmark.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=10)
   365:     benchmark.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="profile actual detector, ArcFace, and search models")
   366:     benchmark.add_argument("--index", help="saved subject index for full model profiling")
   367:     benchmark.add_argument("--sample-every", type=int, default=15, help="recognize every Nth captured frame in full mode")
   368:     benchmark.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=_DEFAULT_CONFIG)
   369: 
   370:     args = parser.parse_args(argv)
   371:     try:
   372:         config = load_config(args.config)
   373:         if args.command == "benchmark-camera" and args.sample_every <= 0:
   374:             raise ValueError("sample-every must be positive")
   375:         if args.command == "enroll":
   376:             _enroll(args, config)
   377:         elif args.command == "benchmark-camera":
   378:             _benchmark_camera(args, config)
   379:         elif args.command == "stream":
   380:             _stream(args, config)
   381:         elif args.command == "camera-demo":
   382:             return _camera_demo(args, config)
   383:         else:
   384:             _recognize(args, config)
   385:     except KeyboardInterrupt:
   386:         # Ctrl+C 停止视频流属于正常操作，给出友好提示而不是堆栈。
   387:         print("Stream stopped.", file=sys.stderr)
   388:     except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
   389:         parser.exit(2, f"error: {exc}\n")
   390:     return 0

     1: """【运行时配置加载】读取并校验 configs/*.yaml。
     2: 
     3: 配置是唯一的可调参数来源（模型路径、阈值、批量大小、后端选择等）。
     4: 这里只做"结构校验"，不填默认值——缺字段就报错，
     5: 避免配置写错时程序带着错误的参数悄悄跑起来。
     6: 
     7: 注意：配置里的匹配阈值只是开发占位值，
     8: 正式场馆阈值必须用真实同人/异人样本标定后才能上线。
     9: """
    10: 
    11: from pathlib import Path
    12: from typing import Any
    13: 
    14: import yaml
    15: 
    16: 
    17: def load_config(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    18:     """加载 YAML 配置并做基本校验。
    19: 
    20:     校验项：
    21:     1. 顶层必须是字典（YAML 映射），而不是列表或标量
    22:     2. 六个必需 section 必须齐全：device / detector / recognizer / face_index / matching / video
    23:     3. 匹配阈值必须满足 -1 <= low < high <= 1（余弦相似度的合法值域）
    24: 
    25:     参数：
    26:         path: YAML 配置文件路径。
    27:     返回：
    28:         配置字典。
    29:     """
    30:     with Path(path).open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    31:         config = yaml.safe_load(stream)
    32:     if not isinstance(config, dict):
    33:         raise ValueError("Configuration must be a YAML mapping")
    34: 
    35:     required = ("device", "detector", "recognizer", "face_index", "matching", "video")
    36:     if any(key not in config for key in required):
    37:         raise ValueError(f"Configuration requires: {', '.join(required)}")
    38: 
    39:     low = config["matching"]["low_threshold"]
    40:     high = config["matching"]["high_threshold"]
    41:     if not (-1 <= low < high <= 1):
    42:         raise ValueError("Require -1 <= low_threshold < high_threshold <= 1")
    43:     return config

FILE: face-recognition-engine/src/face_engine/detector/base.py

     1: """【人脸检测器抽象契约】定义"检测人脸"这一环节的统一接口。
     2: 
     3: 本文件只规定接口，不实现任何具体模型。这样设计的目的：
     4: - 上层流水线（ImagePipeline）只依赖这个接口，不关心底层是 SCRFD、YuNet 还是其他检测器；
     5: - 将来换成 TensorRT、C++ 实现或虹软 SDK 时，只要新写一个满足本接口的类即可，
     6:   上层代码一行都不用改。
     7: 
     8: 检测器的职责边界：输入一张 BGR 图，输出 0 张、1 张或多张人脸。
     9: 它不做识别、不比对、不管摄像头，也不理解业务含义（谁是谁）。
    10: """
    11: 
    12: from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
    13: from typing import TypedDict
    14: 
    15: import numpy as np
    16: 
    17: 
    18: class _OptionalDetectionFields(TypedDict, total=False):
    19:     # Unclipped original-image coordinates for boundary quality measurement.
    20:     raw_bbox: list[float]
    21: 
    22: 
    23: class FaceDetection(_OptionalDetectionFields):
    24:     """单张人脸的检测结果（一个纯数据字典，不含任何业务逻辑）。"""
    25: 
    26:     bbox: list[float]  # 人脸框 [x1, y1, x2, y2]，单位是原图像素坐标
    27:     landmarks: list[list[float]]  # 五官关键点：5 个 [x, y] 坐标对，同样是原图像素坐标
    28:     score: float  # 检测置信度，越高越可能是人脸（由具体模型定义，不同检测器不可横向比较）
    29: 
    30: 
    31: class FaceDetector(ABC):
    32:     """人脸检测器抽象基类：所有具体检测器都必须实现 detect_faces。"""
    33: 
    34:     @abstractmethod
    35:     def detect_faces(self, image: np.ndarray) -> list[FaceDetection]:
    36:         """检测一张图里的全部人脸。
    37: 
    38:         参数：
    39:             image: OpenCV 格式的 BGR 图像，形状 [H, W, 3]，dtype 为 uint8。
    40:         返回：
    41:             人脸列表。空画面返回 []（不是错误）；有 N 张脸就返回 N 个元素。
    42:             注意：本引擎要求"多人脸"，因此绝不能只返回分数最高的那一张。
    43:         """

FILE: face-recognition-engine/src/face_engine/detector/scrfd.py
SHA256: 72a1e6239bf540918dac0e2d5fafc5cb579838fcca08651d231eb4f875bb70a1
================================================================================
     1: """【SCRFD 人脸检测器】用 ONNX Runtime 跑 SCRFD 模型，支持带五点关键点的标准模型。
     2: 
     3: SCRFD 是一种 anchor-based 的单阶段人脸检测器，一次前向就能给出：
     4: - 是不是人脸（分类分数）
     5: - 人脸框在哪（框回归量）
     6: - 五官在哪（5 个关键点）
     7: 
     8: 本实现支持两种常见的输出结构：
     9: - 9 个输出 → 3 个特征层级（stride 8/16/32）
    10: - 15 个输出 → 5 个特征层级（stride 8/16/32/64/128）
    11: 输出顺序约定为：[所有层的分数] + [所有层的框] + [所有层的关键点]。
    12: 不符合这个结构（例如不带关键点的纯检测模型）会直接报错，而不是猜着解。
    13: """
    14: 
    15: from pathlib import Path
    16: 
    17: import cv2
    18: import numpy as np
    19: 
    20: from face_engine.detector.base import FaceDetection, FaceDetector
    21: from face_engine.onnx_backend import create_session
    22: 
    23: 
    24: def prepare_scrfd_input(image: np.ndarray, input_size: tuple[int, int]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
    25:     """把任意尺寸的 BGR 帧预处理成 SCRFD 需要的输入张量。
    26: 
    27:     做两件事：
    28:     1. letterbox 等比缩放——保持宽高比不被拉扁（人脸变形会严重影响检测效果），
    29:        短边之外的空白处补黑。
    30:     2. 转 RGB + NCHW 排布 + 归一化。
    31: 
    32:     参数：
    33:         image: uint8 BGR 原图。
    34:         input_size: 模型输入尺寸 (宽, 高)，例如 (640, 640)。
    35:     返回：
    36:         (blob, scale)：
    37:         - blob: 形状 [1, 3, H, W] 的 float32 张量
    38:         - scale: 实际缩放比例，后续用它把框坐标还原回原图尺度
    39:     """
    40:     if image.ndim != 3 or image.shape[2] != 3 or image.dtype != np.uint8:
    41:         raise ValueError("image must be uint8 BGR [H, W, 3]")
    42:     height, width = image.shape[:2]
    43:     if min(height, width) == 0:
    44:         raise ValueError("image dimensions must be positive")
    45:     input_w, input_h = input_size
    46: 
    47:     # 等比缩放：取宽高两个方向上"缩得更狠"的比例，保证整张图能完整放进去。
    48:     scale = min(input_w / width, input_h / height)
    49:     resized_w, resized_h = max(1, round(width * scale)), max(1, round(height * scale))
    50: 
    51:     # 先铺一张全黑画布，再把缩放后的图贴到左上角——这就是 letterbox。
    52:     canvas = np.zeros((input_h, input_w, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    53:     canvas[:resized_h, :resized_w] = cv2.resize(image, (resized_w, resized_h))
    54: 
    55:     blob = np.empty((1, 3, input_h, input_w), dtype=np.float32)
    56:     # Fill the NCHW channels directly; avoids an extra interleaved float32 copy.
    57:     # 直接按通道填充 NCHW，省掉一次 HWC→CHW 的转置拷贝；
    58:     # 同时 OpenCV 是 BGR、模型要 RGB，倒序填充顺便完成了 BGR→RGB 转换。
    59:     blob[0, 0] = canvas[:, :, 2]
    60:     blob[0, 1] = canvas[:, :, 1]
    61:     blob[0, 2] = canvas[:, :, 0]
    62: 
    63:     # 归一化到约 [-1, 1]：SCRFD 训练时的标准预处理。
    64:     blob -= 127.5
    65:     blob *= 1 / 128
    66:     return blob, scale
    67: 
    68: 
    69: class SCRFDDetector(FaceDetector):
    70:     """SCRFD ONNX 检测器实现。
    71: 
    72:     构造参数：
    73:         model_path: ONNX 权重路径。
    74:         input_size: 模型输入尺寸，必须是 32 的倍数（下采样要求），默认 640×640。
    75:         confidence_threshold: 分数低于此值的候选直接丢弃。
    76:         nms_threshold: 非极大值抑制的 IoU 阈值，越大保留越多重叠框。
    77:         device: "cuda" 优先 GPU，不可用时自动降级 CPU（见 onnx_backend）。
    78:         session: 允许直接注入已建好的 session，主要用于单元测试注入假模型。
    79:     """
    80: 
    81:     def __init__(self, model_path: str | Path, input_size=(640, 640), confidence_threshold=0.5,
    82:                  nms_threshold=0.4, device="cuda", session=None, cpu_threads: int | None = None):
    83:         # 没注入 session 时才真正加载模型；注入时后端标记为 "TEST"（测试桩）。
    84:         self.session, self.backend = create_session(model_path, device, cpu_threads) if session is None else (session, "TEST")
    85:         inputs = self.session.get_inputs()
    86:         if len(inputs) != 1:
    87:             raise ValueError("SCRFD model must have one float32 NCHW input")
    88:         model_input = inputs[0]
    89:         self.input_name = model_input.name
    90:         self.input_size = tuple(input_size)
    91:         if len(self.input_size) != 2 or any(isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, (int, np.integer)) or
    92:                                           x <= 0 or x % 32 for x in self.input_size):
    93:             raise ValueError("input_size must be positive [width, height] divisible by 32")
    94:         shape = model_input.shape
    95:         if len(shape) != 4 or model_input.type != "tensor(float)":
    96:             raise ValueError("SCRFD model must have a float32 NCHW input")
    97:         expected_input = (1, 3, self.input_size[1], self.input_size[0])
    98:         if any(isinstance(actual, int) and actual != expected
    99:                for actual, expected in zip(shape, expected_input)):
   100:             raise ValueError("SCRFD model input shape conflicts with batch 1, RGB channels or configured size")
   101:         self.confidence_threshold = confidence_threshold
   102:         self.nms_threshold = nms_threshold
   103:         # 缓存 anchor 中心点：同一 (stride, anchor 数) 组合只算一次，反复调用可复用。
   104:         self._anchor_centers: dict[tuple[int, int], np.ndarray] = {}
   105: 
   106:         # 用输出个数推断模型有几个特征层级。
   107:         outputs = self.session.get_outputs()
   108:         if len(outputs) == 9:
   109:             self.strides = (8, 16, 32)
   110:             self.num_anchors = 2
   111:         elif len(outputs) == 15:
   112:             self.strides = (8, 16, 32, 64, 128)
   113:             self.num_anchors = 1
   114:         else:
   115:             # 不支持的结构宁可明确报错，也不要猜——猜错会得到一堆错误的框。
   116:             raise ValueError("SCRFD model must have 9 or 15 outputs including five keypoints")
   117:         if any(size % self.strides[-1] for size in self.input_size):
   118:             raise ValueError("SCRFD input_size must be divisible by the largest model stride")
   119: 
   120:     def detect_faces(self, image: np.ndarray) -> list[FaceDetection]:
   121:         """检测一帧里的所有人脸。
   122: 
   123:         流程：预处理 → 模型前向 → 逐层解码 anchor → 过滤低分 → NMS → 按分数降序返回。
   124:         """
   125:         if image.ndim != 3 or image.shape[2] != 3 or image.dtype != np.uint8:
   126:             raise ValueError("image must be uint8 BGR [H, W, 3]")
   127:         height, width = image.shape[:2]
   128:         if min(height, width) == 0:
   129:             return []  # 空帧视为 0 张脸，不报错。
   130:         input_w, input_h = self.input_size
   131: 
   132:         blob, scale = prepare_scrfd_input(image, self.input_size)
   133:         outputs = self.session.run(None, {self.input_name: blob})
   134:         count = len(self.strides)
   135:         if len(outputs) != count * 3:
   136:             raise ValueError("SCRFD runtime output count conflicts with model heads")
   137:         boxes, raw_boxes, points, scores = [], [], [], []
   138: 
   139:         # 逐特征层解码。输出按 [分数×count, 框×count, 关键点×count] 排布，
   140:         # 所以第 level 层的三类数据下标分别是 level、level+count、level+2*count。
   141:         for level, stride in enumerate(self.strides):
   142:             grid_h, grid_w = input_h // stride, input_w // stride
   143:             cell_count = grid_h * grid_w
   144:             anchors = self.num_anchors
   145:             expected_rows = cell_count * anchors
   146:             heads = []
   147:             # Validate actual runtime tensors, not possibly stale ONNX output
   148:             # metadata. Never reinterpret a mismatched grid as more anchors.
   149:             for offset, columns in ((0, 1), (count, 4), (2 * count, 10)):
   150:                 head = np.asarray(outputs[level + offset])
   151:                 if head.ndim == 3 and head.shape[0] == 1:
   152:                     head = head[0]
   153:                 if head.shape != (expected_rows, columns) or not np.isfinite(head).all():
   154:                     raise ValueError(f"Unexpected SCRFD output shape or values at stride {stride}; "
   155:                                      f"expected [{expected_rows}, {columns}]")
   156:                 heads.append(head)
   157:             score, box, kps = heads[0][:, 0], heads[1], heads[2].reshape(-1, 5, 2)
   158: 
   159:             # 先按分数筛掉绝大多数候选，后续解码只在幸存者上做，省时。
   160:             selected = np.flatnonzero(score >= self.confidence_threshold)
   161:             if not len(selected):
   162:                 continue
   163: 
   164:             # 生成（或复用）该层所有 anchor 的中心点坐标（输入尺度下的像素坐标）。
   165:             key = (stride, anchors)
   166:             centers = self._anchor_centers.get(key)
   167:             if centers is None:
   168:                 grid = np.stack(np.mgrid[:grid_h, :grid_w][::-1], axis=-1).reshape(-1, 2)
   169:                 centers = np.repeat(grid, anchors, axis=0).astype(np.float32) * stride
   170:                 self._anchor_centers[key] = centers
   171:             centers = centers[selected]
   172: 
   173:             # 框解码：模型输出的是"到左/上/右/下边的距离"，乘 stride 回到输入尺度，
   174:             # 再整体除以 scale 还原到原图尺度。
   175:             d = box[selected] * stride
   176:             decoded = np.concatenate((centers - d[:, :2], centers + d[:, 2:]), axis=1) / scale
   177:             raw_boxes.append(decoded.copy())
   178: 
   179:             # 裁剪到图像边界内，避免给出画外的框。
   180:             decoded[:, [0, 2]] = np.clip(decoded[:, [0, 2]], 0, width)
   181:             decoded[:, [1, 3]] = np.clip(decoded[:, [1, 3]], 0, height)
   182: 
   183:             # 关键点解码：相对 anchor 中心的偏移，加回中心后再还原尺度。
   184:             landmarks = (kps[selected] * stride + centers[:, None, :]) / scale
   185:             boxes.append(decoded)
   186:             points.append(landmarks)
   187:             scores.append(score[selected])
   188: 
   189:         if not boxes:
   190:             return []
   191:         boxes = np.concatenate(boxes)
   192:         raw_boxes = np.concatenate(raw_boxes)
   193:         points = np.concatenate(points)
   194:         scores = np.concatenate(scores)
   195: 
   196:         # 丢弃宽或高非正的非法框（数值异常时可能出现）。
   197:         valid = (boxes[:, 2] > boxes[:, 0]) & (boxes[:, 3] > boxes[:, 1])
   198:         boxes, raw_boxes, points, scores = boxes[valid], raw_boxes[valid], points[valid], scores[valid]
   199:         if not len(boxes):
   200:             return []
   201: 
   202:         # OpenCV NMSBoxes expects x, y, width, height; final order is score descending.
   203:         # NMS 去重：同一张脸常被多个 anchor 重复框到，只保留重叠框中最可信的那个。
   204:         # 注意 OpenCV 的 NMSBoxes 要求 (x, y, w, h) 格式，所以这里做一次转换。
   205:         xywh = np.column_stack((boxes[:, :2], boxes[:, 2:] - boxes[:, :2]))
   206:         kept = cv2.dnn.NMSBoxes(xywh.tolist(), scores.tolist(), self.confidence_threshold,
   207:                                 self.nms_threshold)
   208:         kept = np.asarray(kept).reshape(-1)
   209:         # NMS 返回顺序不保证按分数排，这里显式降序，
   210:         # 让调用方拿到的第一张脸总是分数最高的。
   211:         kept = kept[np.argsort(-scores[kept])]
   212:         return [{"bbox": boxes[i].tolist(), "raw_bbox": raw_boxes[i].tolist(),
   213:                  "landmarks": points[i].tolist(), "score": float(scores[i])}
   214:                 for i in kept]
   215: 
   216: 
   217: class SizeAwareSCRFDDetector(FaceDetector):
   218:     """按输入图大小自动选择检测器：小图用小输入尺寸模型，大图用标准模型。
   219: 
   220:     为什么需要它：
   221:         SCRFD 的输入尺寸（如 640×640）决定了计算量。如果输入本身就是一张
   222:         已经裁剪好的小人脸图（例如抓拍特写），再放大到 640 去做检测纯属浪费；
   223:         而全帧画面（如 1920×1080）则需要大输入尺寸才能检出远处的小脸。
   224: 
   225:     行为：
   226:         - 图像长边 <= small_image_max_side → 用 small 检测器（小输入尺寸，更快）
   227:         - 否则 → 用 standard 检测器（标准输入尺寸，更准）
   228: 
   229:     注意：两个检测器仍应是"同一套权重"，只是输入尺寸不同；
   230:     换输入尺寸会改变检测行为，因此阈值需按实际使用的分支分别验证。
   231:     """
   232: 
   233:     def __init__(self, standard: SCRFDDetector, small: SCRFDDetector, small_image_max_side: int):
   234:         if small_image_max_side <= 0:
   235:             raise ValueError("small_image_max_side must be positive")
   236:         self.standard = standard
   237:         self.small = small
   238:         self.small_image_max_side = small_image_max_side
   239:         # 对外暴露的后端以标准检测器为准，便于上层打印统一的后端信息。
   240:         self.backend = standard.backend
   241: 
   242:     def detect_faces(self, image: np.ndarray) -> list[FaceDetection]:
   243:         # 用长边（max of H/W）判断图的规模，避免宽高比影响判断。
   244:         if image.ndim >= 2 and max(image.shape[:2]) <= self.small_image_max_side:
   245:             return self.small.detect_faces(image)
   246:         return self.standard.detect_faces(image)

     1: """【人脸特征库（向量索引）抽象契约】定义"存特征、搜 TopK"这一环节的统一接口。
     2: 
     3: 人脸库只存两样东西：人员标识 subject_id 和对应的特征向量。
     4: 刻意不存姓名、票号、照片等业务字段——那些属于外部业务系统，算法层不理解也不保存。
     5: 
     6: 替换实现时（NumPy 暴力搜索 → FAISS → 未来可能的其他引擎），只要满足本接口，
     7: 上层流水线无需改动。
     8: """
     9: 
    10: from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
    11: from collections.abc import Sequence
    12: from dataclasses import dataclass
    13: from pathlib import Path
    14: 
    15: import numpy as np
    16: 
    17: 
    18: @dataclass(frozen=True)
    19: class SearchHit:
    20:     """一条检索命中结果。
    21: 
    22:     frozen=True 表示不可修改，避免在流水线传递过程中被意外改写。
    23:     """
    24: 
    25:     subject_id: str  # 库中的人员标识（由外部业务系统提供，算法不解释含义）
    26:     similarity: float  # 余弦相似度，范围 [-1, 1]，越大越像
    27: 
    28: 
    29: class FaceIndex(ABC):
    30:     """人脸特征库抽象基类。"""
    31: 
    32:     @abstractmethod
    33:     def add(self, subject_id: str, embedding: np.ndarray) -> None:
    34:         """往库里加一个人：人员标识 + 一条特征向量。"""
    35: 
    36:     @abstractmethod
    37:     def add_batch(self, subject_ids: Sequence[str], embeddings: np.ndarray) -> None:
    38:         """批量加人。建 4~5 万人的库时比逐条 add 快得多。"""
    39: 
    40:     @abstractmethod
    41:     def remove(self, subject_id: str) -> None:
    42:         """按人员标识删除一条记录；不存在时应抛 KeyError。"""
    43: 
    44:     @abstractmethod
    45:     def search_batch(self, embeddings: np.ndarray, top_k: int = 5) -> list[list[SearchHit]]:
    46:         """批量检索：为每条查询向量找出最相似的 top_k 个人。
    47: 
    48:         返回二维列表：外层对应每条查询，内层是该查询的候选（按相似度降序）。
    49:         库为空时返回空列表（而不是报错），这样"有脸但没库"能正常降级为 UNKNOWN。
    50:         """
    51: 
    52:     def search(self, embedding: np.ndarray, top_k: int = 5) -> list[SearchHit]:
    53:         """单条查询的便捷方法：把 1 条向量包装成批量再取第一行。"""
    54:         return self.search_batch(np.asarray(embedding).reshape(1, -1), top_k)[0]
    55: 
    56:     @abstractmethod
    57:     def clear(self) -> None:
    58:         """清空整个库。"""
    59: 
    60:     @abstractmethod
    61:     def size(self) -> int:
    62:         """返回库中人数。"""
    63: 
    64:     @abstractmethod
    65:     def save(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
    66:         """把库持久化到磁盘（.npz 文件）。"""
    67: 
    68:     @abstractmethod
    69:     def load(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
    70:         """从磁盘加载库。"""

     1: """【FAISS 检索实现】用 IndexFlatIP 做精确内积检索，优先使用 GPU。
     2: 
     3: 为什么用 FAISS：
     4:     NumPy 实现要对几万条向量做全量矩阵乘法，规模再大就慢了。
     5:     FAISS 是专门做向量检索的库，同样的精确搜索更快，而且可以把索引放到 GPU 上。
     6: 
     7: 为什么用 IndexFlatIP（Flat = 暴力、IP = 内积）：
     8:     因为入库和查询的向量都已经 L2 归一化，"内积"就等于"余弦相似度"，
     9:     所以直接用内积索引即可，无需额外的归一化步骤。
    10:     Flat 表示不压缩、不做近似，保证结果是精确的 TopK，不会漏人。
    11: 
    12: 继承关系：
    13:     FAISSIndex 继承 NumPyIndex，复用它的 ID 管理、输入校验和 .npz 持久化，
    14:     只重写搜索部分。这样两套实现的对外行为完全一致。
    15: """
    16: 
    17: import numpy as np
    18: 
    19: from face_engine.index.base import SearchHit
    20: from face_engine.index.numpy_index import NumPyIndex, _normalized_matrix
    21: from face_engine.recognizer.base import EMBEDDING_DIM
    22: 
    23: 
    24: class FAISSIndex(NumPyIndex):
    25:     """FAISS 精确内积检索索引，GPU 不可用时自动降级到 FAISS CPU。"""
    26: 
    27:     def __init__(self, use_gpu: bool = True):
    28:         try:
    29:             import faiss
    30:         except ImportError as exc:
    31:             # 没装 FAISS 时抛出明确错误，由 create_index 决定如何兜底。
    32:             raise RuntimeError("FAISS is unavailable; use create_index for NumPy fallback") from exc
    33:         self._faiss = faiss
    34:         self._use_gpu = False
    35:         self._gpu_resources = None
    36: 
    37:         # 尝试初始化 GPU 资源。两个 hasattr 判断是为了区分
    38:         # "装的是 faiss-cpu（没有 GPU 接口）" 和 "装了 GPU 版但初始化失败" 两种情况。
    39:         if use_gpu and hasattr(faiss, "StandardGpuResources") and hasattr(faiss, "index_cpu_to_gpu"):
    40:             try:
    41:                 self._gpu_resources = faiss.StandardGpuResources()
    42:                 self._use_gpu = True
    43:             except Exception as exc:
    44:                 print(f"FAISS GPU unavailable ({exc}); falling back to FAISS CPU")
    45:         elif use_gpu:
    46:             print("FAISS GPU unavailable; falling back to FAISS CPU")
    47: 
    48:         self.backend = "FAISS GPU" if self._use_gpu else "FAISS CPU"
    49:         super().__init__()  # 初始化父类的人脸库状态（空 ID 列表 + 空矩阵）
    50:         self._rebuild()
    51: 
    52:     def _rebuild(self) -> None:
    53:         """重建 FAISS 索引：数据每次增删改后都要重建一次。
    54: 
    55:         FAISS 的 Flat 索引不支持原地删除，所以父类 remove/add 之后
    56:         统一走"整体重建"这条路，逻辑简单且不会出错。
    57:         """
    58:         index = self._faiss.IndexFlatIP(EMBEDDING_DIM)
    59:         if self._use_gpu:
    60:             try:
    61:                 index = self._faiss.index_cpu_to_gpu(self._gpu_resources, 0, index)
    62:             except Exception as exc:
    63:                 # GPU 索引构建失败（显存不足等）→ 退回 CPU 索引，继续可用。
    64:                 print(f"FAISS GPU unavailable ({exc}); falling back to FAISS CPU")
    65:                 self._use_gpu = False
    66:                 self.backend = "FAISS CPU"
    67:         if self.size():
    68:             index.add(self._vectors)  # 把父类维护的全部向量灌进 FAISS
    69:         self._index = index
    70: 
    71:     def search_batch(self, embeddings: np.ndarray, top_k: int = 5) -> list[list[SearchHit]]:
    72:         """批量检索 TopK。
    73: 
    74:         与 NumPy 版行为一致：库为空返回空列表；top_k 超过库大小时返回全部。
    75:         注意 FAISS 返回的可能是 -1 下标（理论上 Flat 索引不会），
    76:         这里不做额外过滤以保持与父类一致的行为。
    77:         """
    78:         if top_k <= 0:
    79:             raise ValueError("top_k must be positive")
    80:         queries = _normalized_matrix(embeddings)
    81:         if not len(queries):
    82:             return []
    83:         if not self.size():
    84:             return [[] for _ in range(len(queries))]
    85: 
    86:         # FAISS 要求 k 不超过库中向量总数，否则会报错。
    87:         scores, indices = self._index.search(queries, min(top_k, self.size()))
    88:         return [[SearchHit(self._ids[int(j)], float(score)) for j, score in zip(row, row_scores)]
    89:                 for row, row_scores in zip(indices, scores)]
    90: 
    91: 
    92: def create_index(backend: str = "faiss", use_gpu: bool = True):
    93:     """特征库工厂函数：按名字创建索引，并在不可用时自动降级。
    94: 
    95:     降级链条：FAISS GPU → FAISS CPU → NumPy CPU。
    96:     每一次降级都会打印提示，绝不静默切换。
    97: 
    98:     参数：
    99:         backend: "faiss" 或 "numpy"。
   100:         use_gpu: 是否尝试把 FAISS 索引放到 GPU 上。
   101:     返回：
   102:         一个满足 FaceIndex 接口的实例。
   103:     """
   104:     if backend == "numpy":
   105:         return NumPyIndex()
   106:     if backend != "faiss":
   107:         raise ValueError("backend must be 'faiss' or 'numpy'")
   108:     try:
   109:         return FAISSIndex(use_gpu=use_gpu)
   110:     except RuntimeError as exc:
   111:         # 通常是没装 faiss 包，退回 NumPy 保证功能可用。
   112:         print(f"{exc}; falling back to NumPy CPU")
   113:         return NumPyIndex()

FILE: face-recognition-engine/src/face_engine/index/numpy_index.py

     1: """【NumPy 暴力检索实现 + 特征库持久化】精确余弦搜索的兜底实现。
     2: 
     3: 这是人脸特征库的基础实现，用 NumPy 矩阵乘法做"精确"搜索：
     4: 把所有库存向量和查询向量做点积，取最大的前 K 个。
     5: 因为是精确搜索（不是近似搜索），所以 100% 不会漏掉真正最相似的人。
     6: 
     7: 定位：
     8:     NumPy 实现主要供开发、测试和没有 FAISS 的环境使用；
     9:     几万人的库建议用 FAISS（见 faiss_index.py），后者继承自本类，
    10:     复用了本类的 ID 管理、校验和持久化逻辑，只重写搜索部分。
    11: 
    12: 重要：本文件也是特征库 .npz 文件格式的唯一定义处。
    13: 换模型、换对齐或换预处理后，旧库必须作废重建，不能混用。
    14: """
    15: 
    16: import os
    17: from pathlib import Path
    18: from uuid import uuid4
    19: 
    20: import numpy as np
    21: 
    22: from face_engine.index.base import FaceIndex, SearchHit
    23: from face_engine.recognizer.base import EMBEDDING_DIM
    24: 
    25: 
    26: def _normalized_matrix(values: np.ndarray, *, allow_empty: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
    27:     """校验并把一批向量 L2 归一化，作为入库/查询前的统一入口。
    28: 
    29:     这里集中做四件事，避免每个调用点各写一遍导致校验口径不一致：
    30:     1. 形状必须是 [N, 512]
    31:     2. 必须全是有限数（不能有 NaN/Inf）
    32:     3. 不能有零向量（零向量无法归一化，相似度也无意义）
    33:     4. 归一化成模长为 1，并返回 C 连续数组（矩阵乘法更快）
    34: 
    35:     参数：
    36:         allow_empty: False 时不允许空数组（入库场景要求至少一条）。
    37:     """
    38:     matrix = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float32)
    39:     if matrix.ndim != 2 or matrix.shape[1] != EMBEDDING_DIM:
    40:         raise ValueError(f"embeddings must have shape [N, {EMBEDDING_DIM}]")
    41:     if not allow_empty and len(matrix) == 0:
    42:         raise ValueError("at least one embedding is required")
    43:     if not np.isfinite(matrix).all():
    44:         raise ValueError("embeddings must be finite")
    45:     norms = np.linalg.norm(matrix, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    46:     if (norms <= 0).any():
    47:         raise ValueError("zero embeddings are invalid")
    48:     return np.ascontiguousarray(matrix / norms)
    49: 
    50: 
    51: class NumPyIndex(FaceIndex):
    52:     """基于 NumPy 的精确余弦检索特征库。
    53: 
    54:     内部状态只有两样：
    55:         _ids: 人员标识列表，下标即"库内行号"
    56:         _vectors: [N, 512] 的归一化特征矩阵，第 i 行对应 _ids[i]
    57:     两者必须始终等长。
    58:     """
    59: 
    60:     backend = "NumPy CPU"
    61: 
    62:     def __init__(self):
    63:         self._ids: list[str] = []
    64:         self._vectors = np.empty((0, EMBEDDING_DIM), dtype=np.float32)
    65:         print(f"Face Index Backend: {self.backend}")
    66: 
    67:     def _rebuild(self) -> None:
    68:         """子类钩子：数据发生变化后由子类重建自己的加速结构。
    69: 
    70:         本类无需重建任何东西；FAISSIndex 会重写它来重建 FAISS 索引。
    71:         """
    72: 
    73:     def add(self, subject_id: str, embedding: np.ndarray) -> None:
    74:         """加一个人：把单条向量包装成批量再调 add_batch。"""
    75:         self.add_batch([subject_id], np.asarray(embedding).reshape(1, -1))
    76: 
    77:     def add_batch(self, subject_ids, embeddings: np.ndarray) -> None:
    78:         """批量加人。建几万人的库时用这个方法，比逐条 add 快很多。
    79: 
    80:         校验规则（任一不满足就整体失败，绝不部分写入）：
    81:         - ID 数量与向量数量一致
    82:         - 每个 ID 都是非空字符串
    83:         - 本批内部不能有重复 ID
    84:         - 本批 ID 不能与库中已有 ID 冲突（一个人只保留一条特征）
    85:         """
    86:         ids = list(subject_ids)
    87:         vectors = _normalized_matrix(embeddings)
    88:         if len(ids) != len(vectors):
    89:             raise ValueError("subject_ids and embeddings length must match")
    90:         if any(not isinstance(sid, str) or not sid for sid in ids):
    91:             raise ValueError("subject_id must be a nonempty string")
    92:         if len(set(ids)) != len(ids) or set(ids).intersection(self._ids):
    93:             raise ValueError("duplicate subject_id")
    94:         if not ids:
    95:             return
    96:         self._ids.extend(ids)
    97:         self._vectors = np.concatenate((self._vectors, vectors), axis=0)
    98:         self._rebuild()  # 通知子类同步重建加速结构
    99: 
   100:     def remove(self, subject_id: str) -> None:
   101:         """按人员标识删除一条记录；ID 不存在时抛 KeyError。"""
   102:         try:
   103:             position = self._ids.index(subject_id)
   104:         except ValueError as exc:
   105:             raise KeyError(subject_id) from exc
   106:         del self._ids[position]
   107:         self._vectors = np.delete(self._vectors, position, axis=0)
   108:         self._rebuild()
   109: 
   110:     def search_batch(self, embeddings: np.ndarray, top_k: int = 5) -> list[list[SearchHit]]:
   111:         """批量检索：为每条查询向量返回最相似的 top_k 个人。
   112: 
   113:         实现要点（性能考虑）：
   114:         - 一次矩阵乘法 [Q, 512] @ [512, N] 算出全部 Q×N 相似度，
   115:           因为向量都已归一化，点积结果直接就是余弦相似度。
   116:         - 用 argpartition 而不是 argsort：只关心前 K 名，
   117:           做一次 O(N) 的部分选择即可，不必对几万个数全排序。
   118:         - 只在选出的 K 个候选里做完整排序，保证返回顺序按相似度降序。
   119:         """
   120:         if top_k <= 0:
   121:             raise ValueError("top_k must be positive")
   122:         queries = _normalized_matrix(embeddings)
   123:         if not len(queries):
   124:             return []
   125:         # 库为空时返回空结果而非报错——"有脸但没库"应降级为 UNKNOWN。
   126:         if not self.size():
   127:             return [[] for _ in range(len(queries))]
   128: 
   129:         scores = queries @ self._vectors.T  # [Q, N] 余弦相似度矩阵
   130:         k = min(top_k, self.size())  # 库里人不够时，最多只能返回 size 个
   131: 
   132:         # 先部分选择出 top-k 的下标（未排序），再对这 k 个排序。
   133:         candidates = np.argpartition(-scores, k - 1, axis=1)[:, :k]
   134:         order = np.argsort(-np.take_along_axis(scores, candidates, axis=1), axis=1)
   135:         indices = np.take_along_axis(candidates, order, axis=1)
   136:         return [[SearchHit(self._ids[int(j)], float(scores[i, j])) for j in row]
   137:                 for i, row in enumerate(indices)]
   138: 
   139:     def clear(self) -> None:
   140:         """清空整个库。"""
   141:         self._ids = []
   142:         self._vectors = np.empty((0, EMBEDDING_DIM), dtype=np.float32)
   143:         self._rebuild()
   144: 
   145:     def size(self) -> int:
   146:         """返回库中人数。"""
   147:         return len(self._ids)
   148: 
   149:     def save(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
   150:         """把库原子性地写入 .npz 文件。
   151: 
   152:         为什么写临时文件再 os.replace：
   153:             几万人的库文件很大，直接写可能写到一半崩溃/断电，留下一个损坏的库。
   154:             先写临时文件 + fsync 落盘，再用 os.replace 原子替换，
   155:             保证目标文件要么是完整的旧版本，要么是完整的新版本，
   156:             绝不会是"写了一半"的中间状态。
   157: 
   158:         保存内容（schema 版本 1）：
   159:             schema: 版本号，加载时校验，版本不符直接拒绝
   160:             subject_ids: 人员标识数组
   161:             embeddings: 特征矩阵
   162:         注意：schema 1 不记录模型/预处理版本，
   163:         因此换模型后必须靠流程约束重建库，不能靠文件本身判断。
   164:         """
   165:         target = Path(path)
   166:         target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   167:         temporary = target.with_name(f".{target.name}.{uuid4().hex}.tmp")
   168:         try:
   169:             with temporary.open("wb") as stream:
   170:                 np.savez(stream, schema=np.array(1), subject_ids=np.asarray(self._ids, dtype=np.str_),
   171:                          embeddings=self._vectors)
   172:                 stream.flush()
   173:                 os.fsync(stream.fileno())  # 强制刷到磁盘，防止只在页缓存里
   174:             os.replace(temporary, target)  # 原子替换
   175:         finally:
   176:             temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)  # 无论成功失败都清理临时文件
   177: 
   178:     def load(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
   179:         """从 .npz 文件加载库。
   180: 
   181:         加载时会重新校验并归一化，避免读入被手工篡改或不完整的脏数据。
   182:         allow_pickle=False 是安全考虑：不允许加载时执行任意 Python 对象。
   183:         """
   184:         with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as archive:
   185:             if int(archive["schema"]) != 1:
   186:                 raise ValueError("unsupported index schema")
   187:             ids = archive["subject_ids"].tolist()
   188:             vectors = _normalized_matrix(archive["embeddings"])
   189:         if (len(ids) != len(vectors) or len(set(ids)) != len(ids)
   190:                 or any(not isinstance(sid, str) or not sid for sid in ids)):
   191:             raise ValueError("invalid saved index")
   192:         self._ids = ids
   193:         self._vectors = vectors
   194:         self._rebuild()

   101:     def _capacity(self, fanout=False):
   102:         captures = self.db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM captures WHERE status='PENDING' AND image IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]
   103:         deliveries = self.db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM deliveries WHERE status='PENDING'").fetchone()[0]
   104:         # Separate ingress/egress budgets leave room to turn one image into many
   105:         # observations even when the capture inbox is completely full.
   106:         allowance = self.max_faces_per_capture if fanout else 0
   107:         if captures > self.max_pending or deliveries > self.max_pending + allowance:
   108:             raise RuntimeError("CAPACITY: durable pending queue is full")

   150:     def _next(self, table, columns, condition, params):
   151:         for _ in self.cycle:
   152:             category = self.cycle[self.cursors[table]]
   153:             self.cursors[table] = (self.cursors[table]+1) % len(self.cycle)
   154:             activities = [r[0] for r in self.db.execute(f'SELECT DISTINCT activity_id FROM {table} WHERE {condition} AND category=? ORDER BY activity_id', (*params, category))]
   155:             if activities:
   156:                 previous = self.activity_cursors.get((table, category), '')
   157:                 activity = next((item for item in activities if item > previous), activities[0])
   158:                 self.activity_cursors[table, category] = activity
   159:                 return self.db.execute(f'SELECT {columns} FROM {table} WHERE {condition} AND category=? AND activity_id=? ORDER BY created,id LIMIT 1', (*params, category, activity)).fetchone()
   160:         return None
