FILE: face-trajectory/cpp/include/face_trajectory/shared_json.hpp
SHA256: a4651cabe06509e3fafc1be1e66213d677bf4418c1151f4067cadae3a3e9ed82
================================================================================
     1: #pragma once
     2: #include "face_trajectory/state.hpp"
     3: #include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
     4: #include <algorithm>
     5: #include <map>
     6: #include <set>
     7: #include <stdexcept>
     8: #include <string>
     9: #include <vector>
    10: 
    11: namespace face_trajectory {
    12: // Immutable AVL sequences. Versions share unchanged subtrees, including nested
    13: // arrays. Evidence uses observation IDs as keys, so arbitrary IDs insert locally
    14: // rather than shifting every subsequent leaf. All other arrays use ordinal keys.
    15: // The cache lives for one operation; no reference can survive a transaction rollback.
    16: class SharedJson {
    17:     using J = nlohmann::json;
    18:     State& state_;
    19:     std::map<std::string,J> cache_;
    20:     std::map<std::string,J> values_;
    21:     J Node(const std::string& ref) {
    22:         if(ref.empty()) return {{"h",0}};
    23:         auto found=cache_.find(ref);
    24:         if(found!=cache_.end()) return found->second;
    25:         auto text=state_.Get("object",ref);
    26:         if(!text) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared trajectory node");
    27:         auto node=J::parse(*text);
    28:         if(node.contains("value_ref")) {
    29:             const auto value_ref=node.at("value_ref").get<std::string>();
    30:             const auto found=values_.find(value_ref);
    31:             if(found!=values_.end()) node["v"]=found->second;
    32:             else {
    33:                 const auto value=state_.Get("object",value_ref);
    34:                 if(!value) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared trajectory value");
    35:                 node["v"]=J::parse(*value); values_.emplace(value_ref,node.at("v"));
    36:             }
    37:             node.erase("value_ref");
    38:         }
    39:         cache_.emplace(ref,node); return node;
    40:     }
    41:     int Height(const std::string& ref) { return Node(ref).at("h"); }
    42:     std::string Make(const std::string& key,const J& value,const std::string& left,const std::string& right) {
    43:         J node={{"k",key},{"v",value},{"l",left},{"r",right},{"h",1+std::max(Height(left),Height(right))}};
    44:         auto stored=node;
    45:         // A path copy references an evidence body once, instead of copying that
    46:         // body's fields at every ancestor/version. Small scalar values stay inline.
    47:         if(value.is_object() || value.is_array()) {
    48:             const auto ref=state_.Intern(value.dump()); values_.emplace(ref,value);
    49:             stored.erase("v"); stored["value_ref"]=ref;
    50:         }
    51:         const auto ref=state_.Intern(stored.dump()); cache_.emplace(ref,std::move(node)); return ref;
    52:     }
    53:     std::string Balance(const std::string& key,const J& value,std::string left,std::string right) {
    54:         if(Height(left)>Height(right)+1) {
    55:             auto a=Node(left);
    56:             if(Height(a.at("r"))>Height(a.at("l"))) {
    57:                 const auto b=Node(a.at("r"));
    58:                 left=Make(b.at("k"),b.at("v"),Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),a.at("l"),b.at("l")),b.at("r"));
    59:                 a=Node(left);
    60:             }
    61:             return Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),a.at("l"),Make(key,value,a.at("r"),right));
    62:         }
    63:         if(Height(right)>Height(left)+1) {
    64:             auto a=Node(right);
    65:             if(Height(a.at("l"))>Height(a.at("r"))) {
    66:                 const auto b=Node(a.at("l"));
    67:                 right=Make(b.at("k"),b.at("v"),b.at("l"),Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),b.at("r"),a.at("r")));
    68:                 a=Node(right);
    69:             }
    70:             return Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),Make(key,value,left,a.at("l")),a.at("r"));
    71:         }
    72:         return Make(key,value,left,right);
    73:     }
    74:     std::string Put(const std::string& ref,const std::string& key,const J& value) {
    75:         if(ref.empty()) return Make(key,value,"","");
    76:         const auto node=Node(ref); const auto oldkey=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
    77:         if(key==oldkey) return Make(key,value,node.at("l"),node.at("r"));
    78:         if(key<oldkey) return Balance(oldkey,node.at("v"),Put(node.at("l"),key,value),node.at("r"));
    79:         return Balance(oldkey,node.at("v"),node.at("l"),Put(node.at("r"),key,value));
    80:     }
    81:     std::optional<J> Find(std::string ref,const std::string& key) {
    82:         while(!ref.empty()) { const auto node=Node(ref); const auto k=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
    83:             if(key==k) return std::optional<nlohmann::json>{node.at("v")}; ref=node.at(key<k?"l":"r").get<std::string>(); }
    84:         return {};
    85:     }
    86:     std::string Erase(const std::string& ref,const std::string& key) {
    87:         if(ref.empty()) return ref;
    88:         const auto node=Node(ref); const auto k=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
    89:         if(key<k) return Balance(k,node.at("v"),Erase(node.at("l"),key),node.at("r"));
    90:         if(key>k) return Balance(k,node.at("v"),node.at("l"),Erase(node.at("r"),key));
    91:         if(node.at("l")=="") return node.at("r");
    92:         if(node.at("r")=="") return node.at("l");
    93:         auto successor=Node(node.at("r"));
    94:         while(successor.at("l")!="") successor=Node(successor.at("l"));
    95:         return Balance(successor.at("k"),successor.at("v"),node.at("l"),Erase(node.at("r"),successor.at("k")));
    96:     }
    97:     void Keys(const std::string& ref,std::set<std::string>& keys) {
    98:         if(ref.empty()) return;
    99:         const auto node=Node(ref); keys.insert(node.at("k")); Keys(node.at("l"),keys); Keys(node.at("r"),keys);
   100:     }
   101:     std::string Build(const std::vector<std::pair<std::string,J>>& items,std::size_t lo,std::size_t hi) {
   102:         if(lo==hi) return "";
   103:         const auto mid=lo+(hi-lo)/2;
   104:         return Make(items[mid].first,items[mid].second,Build(items,lo,mid),Build(items,mid+1,hi));
   105:     }
   106:     void Values(const std::string& ref,J& values) {
   107:         if(ref.empty()) return;
   108:         const auto node=Node(ref); Values(node.at("l"),values); values.push_back(Decode(node.at("v"))); Values(node.at("r"),values);
   109:     }
   110:     static std::string Ordinal(std::size_t index) {
   111:         auto key=std::to_string(index); return std::string(20-key.size(),'0')+key;
   112:     }
   113: public:
   114:     explicit SharedJson(State& state):state_(state) {}
   115:     J Encode(const J& value,bool evidence=false,const std::optional<J>& previous={}) {
   116:         if(value.is_array()) {
   117:             if(previous && previous->is_object() && previous->contains("$avl") && previous->at("keyed")==evidence) {
   118:                 auto root=previous->at("$avl").get<std::string>();
   119:                 std::set<std::string> removed; Keys(root,removed);
   120:                 for(std::size_t i=0;i<value.size();++i) {
   121:                     const auto key=evidence?value[i].at("observation_id").get<std::string>():Ordinal(i);
   122:                     const auto old=Find(root,key); const auto encoded=Encode(value[i],false,old);
   123:                     if(!old || *old!=encoded) root=Put(root,key,encoded);
   124:                     removed.erase(key);
   125:                 }
   126:                 for(const auto& key:removed) root=Erase(root,key);
   127:                 return {{"$avl",root},{"count",value.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
   128:             }
   129:             std::vector<std::pair<std::string,J>> items; items.reserve(value.size());
   130:             for(std::size_t i=0;i<value.size();++i)
   131:                 items.emplace_back(evidence?value[i].at("observation_id").get<std::string>():Ordinal(i),Encode(value[i]));
   132:             if(evidence) std::sort(items.begin(),items.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return a.first<b.first;});
   133:             return {{"$avl",Build(items,0,items.size())},{"count",items.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
   134:         }
   135:         if(value.is_object()) { J result=J::object();
   136:             for(auto it=value.begin();it!=value.end();++it) result[it.key()]=Encode(it.value(),it.key()=="evidence",
   137:                 previous && previous->is_object() && previous->contains(it.key())?std::optional<J>(previous->at(it.key())):std::nullopt);
   138:             return result;
   139:         }
   140:         return value;
   141:     }
   142:     J Decode(const J& value) {
   143:         if(value.is_object() && value.contains("$avl")) {
   144:             J result=J::array(); Values(value.at("$avl"),result);
   145:             if(result.size()!=Count(value)) throw std::runtime_error("shared trajectory sequence count mismatch");
   146:             return result;
   147:         }
   148:         if(value.is_object()) { J result=J::object(); for(auto it=value.begin();it!=value.end();++it) result[it.key()]=Decode(it.value()); return result; }
   149:         return value;
   150:     }
   151:     static std::size_t Count(const J& sequence) { return sequence.at("count").get<std::size_t>(); }
   152:     J At(const J& sequence,std::size_t index) {
   153:         if(sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || index>=Count(sequence)) throw std::out_of_range("shared sequence index");
   154:         const auto value=Find(sequence.at("$avl"),Ordinal(index));
   155:         if(!value) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared sequence entry"); return *value;
   156:     }
   157:     void Set(J& sequence,std::size_t index,const J& encoded) {
   158:         if(sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || index>Count(sequence)) throw std::out_of_range("shared sequence index");
   159:         sequence["$avl"]=Put(sequence.at("$avl"),Ordinal(index),encoded);
   160:         if(index==Count(sequence)) sequence["count"]=index+1;
   161:     }
   162:     void Append(J& sequence,const J& value) { Set(sequence,Count(sequence),Encode(value)); }
   163:     void InsertEvidence(J& sequence,const J& evidence) {
   164:         const auto key=evidence.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
   165:         if(!sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || Find(sequence.at("$avl"),key)) throw std::logic_error("append proof reused an existing observation");
   166:         sequence["$avl"]=Put(sequence.at("$avl"),key,Encode(evidence)); sequence["count"]=Count(sequence)+1;
   167:     }
   168: };
   169: }

   160: std::optional<json> ActivityStore::Before(json& r,State& scope) {
   161:     const auto now=TrustedNow(r);const auto c=Context(Text(r,"activity_id"));
   162:     if(!Event(r)) {
   163:         if(r.contains("activity_num")&&r.at("activity_num")!=c.at("activity_num"))throw std::invalid_argument("SOURCE_CONFLICT: activity_num disagrees with authoritative mapping");
   164:         for(const auto* k:{"config_version","binding_version","monitoring_version"})
   165:             if(Version(r,k)!=c.at(k))throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("VERSION_CONFLICT: stale ")+k);
   166:         if(r.at("op")=="association_correct")r["observation_id"]=json::array({Text(r,"source_id"),Text(r,"observation_id")}).dump();
   167:         return {};
   168:     }
   169:     const auto key=EventKey(r);
   170:     const auto content=Content(r);
   171:     const auto fingerprint=Digest(content.dump());
   172:     const bool known=r.contains("_normalization") && r.at("_normalization").value("status","")=="NORMALIZED";
   173:     r["_source_event_key"]=key;r["_content_digest"]=fingerprint;
   174:     const auto old=scope.Get("activity_intake",key);
   175:     if(const auto tombstone=scope.Get("retention_tombstone",Digest(key))) {
   176:         const auto hashes=json::parse(*tombstone).at("fingerprints");
   177:         if(std::find(hashes.begin(),hashes.end(),fingerprint)==hashes.end())throw std::invalid_argument("SOURCE_CONFLICT: expired idempotency key content changed");
   178:         return WithContext({{"ok",true},{"status","EXPIRED"},{"reason_codes",json::array({"RETENTION_EXPIRED"})},{"duplicate",true}},c);
   179:     }
   180:     json rec=old?json::parse(*old):json{{"first_quarantined_unix_ms",now},{"had_untrusted_capture",!known},{"fingerprint",fingerprint},{"fingerprints",json::array({fingerprint})},{"expired",false}};
   181:     if(!rec.contains("had_untrusted_capture"))rec["had_untrusted_capture"]=!rec.value("capture_trusted",known);
   182:     const bool changed=old && rec.at("fingerprint")!=fingerprint;
   183:     if(changed) {
   184:         throw std::invalid_argument("SOURCE_CONFLICT: same activity/source/event key has different content");
   185:     }
   186:     const auto captured=known?r.at("_normalization").at("captured_at_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>():0;
   187:     const auto cutoff=now-RetentionMs;
   188:     const bool fixed_known=rec.value("capture_trusted",known);
   189:     const auto fixed_capture=fixed_known&&rec.contains("captured_at_unix_ms")?rec.at("captured_at_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>():captured;
   190:     const bool expired=rec.value("expired",false) || (fixed_known && fixed_capture<cutoff) ||
   191:         ((!fixed_known||rec.at("had_untrusted_capture")==true)&&rec.at("first_quarantined_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>()<cutoff);
   192:     if(expired) {
   193:         scope.Put("retention_tombstone",Digest(key),json{{"fingerprints",rec.at("fingerprints")}}.dump());
   194:         scope.Erase("activity_intake",key);
   195:         return WithContext({{"ok",true},{"status","EXPIRED"},{"reason_codes",json::array({"RETENTION_EXPIRED"})},{"duplicate",bool(old)}},c);
   196:     }
   197:     if(old && !changed && rec.contains("response")) {
   198:         auto response=rec.at("response");response["duplicate"]=true;return response;
   199:     }
   200:     rec["content"]=content;rec["capture_trusted"]=known;
   201:     if(known){rec["captured_at_unix_ms"]=captured;rec["clock_uncertainty_ms"]=r.at("_normalization").at("clock_uncertainty_ms");}
   202:     scope.Put("activity_intake",key,rec.dump());
   203:     auto deadline=rec.at("first_quarantined_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>()+RetentionMs;
   204:     if(known)deadline=rec.at("had_untrusted_capture")==true?std::min(deadline,captured+RetentionMs):captured+RetentionMs;
   205:     const auto previous=std::stoll(root_.Get("retention_meta","next_deadline").value_or(std::to_string(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max())));
   206:     if(deadline<previous)root_.Put("retention_meta","next_deadline",std::to_string(deadline));
   207:     auto reasons=json::array();
   208:     for(const auto* k:{"config_version","binding_version","monitoring_version"})if(Version(r,k)!=c.at(k))reasons.push_back(std::string("STALE_")+k);
   209:     if(r.contains("activity_num") && r.at("activity_num")!=c.at("activity_num"))reasons.push_back("ACTIVITY_MAPPING_CONFLICT");
   210:     if(c.at("enabled")!=true)reasons.push_back("ACTIVITY_STOPPED");
   211:     const bool face=r.at("op")=="monitoring_observe";
   212:     if(face && r.at("observation").contains("activity_id") && r.at("observation").at("activity_id")!=c.at("activity_id"))reasons.push_back("OBSERVATION_ACTIVITY_CONFLICT");
   213:     if(!face && r.contains("binding") && r.at("binding").is_object() && r.at("binding").contains("activity_id") && r.at("binding").at("activity_id")!=c.at("activity_id"))reasons.push_back("BINDING_ACTIVITY_CONFLICT");
   214:     const auto source=face?Text(r.at("observation"),"source_id"):Text(r,"source_id");
   215:     const auto device=face?Text(r.at("observation"),"camera_id"):Text(r,"gate_id");
   216:     bool bound=false;
   217:     if(r.contains("route_rule_id"))for(const auto& b:c.value("bindings",json::array()))if(b.at("source_id")==source && b.at("device_id")==device && b.at("kind")== (face?"CAMERA":"GATE") && b.at("route_rule_id")==r.at("route_rule_id"))bound=true;
   218:     if(!bound)reasons.push_back("DEVICE_ACTIVITY_BINDING_UNRESOLVED");
   219:     if(!reasons.empty()) {
   220:         auto response=WithContext({{"ok",true},{"status","HOLD"},{"time_admitted",known},{"reason_codes",reasons},{"association",nullptr},{"monitoring",nullptr},{"trajectories",json::array()}},c);
   221:         Receipt(r,response,scope);return response;
   222:     }
   223:     // Composite event identifiers isolate sources within the activity. Person
   224:     // identifiers remain unchanged. Frame/track/session keys include source.
   225:     if(face){auto& o=r["observation"];o["observation_id"]=key;for(const auto* f:{"frame_id","track_session_id"})if(o.contains(f) && o.at(f)!="")o[f]=json::array({source,o.at(f)}).dump();}
   226:     else {r["event_id"]=key;if(r.contains("binding") && !r.at("binding").is_null()){auto& b=r["binding"];b["observation_id"]=json::array({Text(b,"source_id"),Text(b,"observation_id")}).dump();}}
   227:     return {};
   228: }
   229: void ActivityStore::Receipt(const json& r,const json& response,State& scope) {
   230:     if(!r.contains("_source_event_key"))return;
   231:     const auto key=r.at("_source_event_key").get<std::string>();auto rec=json::parse(scope.Get("activity_intake",key).value());
   232:     rec["response"]=response;rec["accepted"]=response.value("status","")=="ACCEPTED" || response.value("status","")=="BOUND";
   233:     scope.Put("activity_intake",key,rec.dump());
   234: }
   235: void ActivityStore::Notify(const json& r,const json& response,State& scope) {
   236:     if(!Event(r) || response.value("duplicate",false) || response.value("status","")=="EXPIRED")return;
   237:     auto seq=std::stoull(scope.Get("activity_result_meta","sequence").value_or("0"))+1;
   238:     // Notification is a compact committed algorithm result, independent of
   239:     // backend delivery acknowledgements. Full trajectory history stays queried.
   240:     json e={{"sequence",seq},{"operation",r.at("op")},{"status",response.value("status","")},
   241:         {"retention_deadline_unix_ms",response.at("retention_deadline_unix_ms")}};
   242:     for(const auto* k:{"activity_id","activity_num","venue_id","config_version","binding_version","monitoring_version","route_rule_id","association","monitoring","reason_codes"})
   243:         if(response.contains(k))e[k]=response.at(k);
   244:     // Nested monitoring may contain session history; retention removes results
   245:     // whenever their activity's dependent evidence is pruned.
   246:     std::ostringstream key;key<<std::setfill('0')<<std::setw(20)<<seq;
   247:     scope.Put("activity_result",key.str(),e.dump());
   248:     scope.Put("activity_result_meta","sequence",std::to_string(seq));
   249: }
   250: void ActivityStore::ExternalIds(json& v) {
   251:     if(v.is_array()){for(auto& e:v)ExternalIds(e);return;}
   252:     if(!v.is_object())return;
   253:     const bool direct_connection = v.contains("meaning") && v.at("meaning") == "DIRECT_CAMERA_POINT_CONNECTION";
   254:     for(auto it=v.begin();it!=v.end();++it){
   255:         if((it.key()=="observation_id" || it.key()=="event_id" || it.key()=="frame_id" || it.key()=="track_session_id" ||
   256:             (direct_connection && (it.key()=="from_observation_id" || it.key()=="to_observation_id"))) && it.value().is_string()) {
   257:             try{auto p=json::parse(it.value().get<std::string>());if(p.is_array() && p.size()==2 && p[0].is_string() && p[1].is_string()){
   258:                 if(it.key()=="observation_id" || it.key()=="event_id")v["source_id"]=p[0];
   259:                 if(it.key()=="from_observation_id")v["from_source_id"]=p[0];
   260:                 if(it.key()=="to_observation_id")v["to_source_id"]=p[0];
   261:                 it.value()=p[1];}}catch(const json::exception&){}
   262:         } else ExternalIds(it.value());
   263:     }
   264: }

    16: template<class T> std::int64_t Lower(const T& o) {
    17:     return o.captured_at_unix_ms < std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() + o.clock_uncertainty_ms
    18:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() : o.captured_at_unix_ms - o.clock_uncertainty_ms;

    22:     return o.captured_at_unix_ms > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - o.clock_uncertainty_ms
    23:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() : o.captured_at_unix_ms + o.clock_uncertainty_ms;

    67: AssociationPolicy CheckedPolicy(AssociationPolicy p) {
    68:     const auto unit = [](double v) { return std::isfinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 1; };
    69:     if (p.policy_id.empty() || !unit(p.new_target_threshold) || !unit(p.match_threshold) ||
    70:         p.new_target_threshold >= p.match_threshold || !unit(p.template_update_threshold) ||
    71:         p.template_update_threshold < p.match_threshold || !unit(p.max_template_similarity) ||
    72:         p.max_template_similarity < p.template_update_threshold || !std::isfinite(p.min_margin) ||
    73:         p.min_margin < 0 || p.min_margin > 2 || !unit(p.min_detection_score) ||
    74:         !std::isfinite(p.min_face_size_px) || p.min_face_size_px <= 0 ||
    75:         p.max_clock_uncertainty_ms < 0 || p.max_templates_per_target == 0) {
    76:         throw std::invalid_argument("invalid association policy");
    77:     }
    78:     for (auto& pair : p.overlapping_cameras) {
    79:         if (pair.first.empty() || pair.second.empty() || pair.first == pair.second)
    80:             throw std::invalid_argument("overlapping cameras must name two different cameras");
    81:         if (pair.first > pair.second) std::swap(pair.first, pair.second);
    82:     }
    83:     std::sort(p.overlapping_cameras.begin(), p.overlapping_cameras.end());
    84:     p.overlapping_cameras.erase(std::unique(p.overlapping_cameras.begin(), p.overlapping_cameras.end()),
    85:                                 p.overlapping_cameras.end());
    86:     return p;
    87: }

   118: void AssociationStore::SaveTemplates(const std::string& target) {
   119:     const auto found=templates_.find(target);
   120:     if(found==templates_.end() || found->second.empty()) {
   121:         if(state_)state_->Erase("owned_template",target);
   122:         templates_.erase(target);return;
   123:     }
   124:     if(!state_)return;
   125:     auto j=nlohmann::json::array();for(const auto& t:found->second)j.push_back({{"observation_id",t.observation_id},{"template_id",t.template_id},{"quality",t.quality}});
   126:     state_->Put("owned_template",target,j.dump());
   127: }
   128: void AssociationStore::SaveRecord(const Record& record) {
   129:     // Derive changes before overwriting the observation or its revision. This
   130:     // upgrades legacy indices lazily within the same transaction.
   131:     const auto previous = state_ ? LoadRecord(record.observation.observation_id) : std::optional<Record>{};
   132:     std::map<std::string, TargetSummary> summaries;
   133:     if (state_) {
   134:         for (const auto& target : record.result.affected_target_ids)
   135:             summaries.emplace(target, EnsureTargetIndex(target));
   136:         if (previous && previous->result.target_id && !summaries.count(*previous->result.target_id))
   137:             summaries.emplace(*previous->result.target_id, EnsureTargetIndex(*previous->result.target_id));
   138:         const auto old_target = previous ? previous->result.target_id : std::optional<std::string>{};
   139:         const auto& new_target = record.result.target_id;
   140:         if (old_target != new_target) {
   141:             if (old_target) {
   142:                 auto& counts = summaries.at(*old_target).camera_counts;
   143:                 auto found = counts.find(previous->observation.camera_id);
   144:                 if (found == counts.end() || !found->second)
   145:                     throw std::logic_error("association camera index is inconsistent");
   146:                 if (--found->second == 0) counts.erase(found);
   147:             }
   148:             if (new_target) ++summaries.at(*new_target).camera_counts[record.observation.camera_id];
   149:             if (!record.observation.local_track_id.empty()) {
   150:                 const auto track = TrackIndexKey(record.observation);
   151:                 auto counts = TrackTargetCounts(track);
   152:                 if (old_target) {
   153:                     auto found = counts.find(*old_target);
   154:                     if (found == counts.end() || !found->second)
   155:                         throw std::logic_error("association track index is inconsistent");
   156:                     if (--found->second == 0) counts.erase(found);
   157:                 }
   158:                 if (new_target) ++counts[*new_target];
   159:                 state_->Put("association_track_targets",track,
   160:                     nlohmann::json({{"schema_version",1},{"counts",counts}}).dump());
   161:             }
   162:         }
   163:         if (new_target) {
   164:             const auto& o = record.observation;
   165:             state_->Put("association_frame",o.observation_id,
   166:                 nlohmann::json::array({o.track_session_id,o.local_track_id}).dump(),
   167:                 *new_target,FrameIndexKey(*new_target,o));
   168:         } else if (old_target) state_->Erase("association_frame",record.observation.observation_id);
   169:     }
   170:     for (const auto& target : record.result.affected_target_ids) {
   171:         if (state_) state_->Put("association_target_revision", target, std::to_string(record.result.version));
   172:         else target_revisions_[target] = record.result.version;
   173:     }
   174:     if(!state_){records_.insert_or_assign(record.observation.observation_id,record);return;}
   175:     const auto& o=record.observation;
   176:     const auto track=nlohmann::json::array({o.source_id,o.camera_id,o.track_session_id,o.local_track_id}).dump();
   177:     auto meta=nlohmann::json(o);meta.erase("embedding");meta.erase("feature_space");
   178:     // Metadata includes the sighting but never the 512D vector.
   179:     meta["sighting"]=record.result.sighting;meta["target_id"]=record.result.target_id;
   180:     state_->Put("observation",o.observation_id,nlohmann::json({{"observation",o},{"result",record.result}}).dump(),
   181:         record.result.target_id.value_or(""),track,meta.dump());
   182:     for (auto& [target, summary] : summaries) {
   183:         summary.revision = TargetRevision(target);
   184:         SaveTargetSummary(target,summary);
   185:     }
   186:     state_->Put("version","association",std::to_string(version_));
   187: }
   188: 
   189: void AssociationStore::SaveTargetSummary(const std::string& target, const TargetSummary& summary) const {
   190:     state_->Put("association_target_summary",target,
   191:         nlohmann::json({{"schema_version",1},{"revision",summary.revision},
   192:                         {"camera_counts",summary.camera_counts}}).dump());
   193: }
   194: 
   195: AssociationStore::TargetSummary AssociationStore::EnsureTargetIndex(const std::string& target) const {
   196:     const auto revision = TargetRevision(target);
   197:     if (const auto stored = state_->Get("association_target_summary",target)) {
   198:         const auto value = nlohmann::json::parse(*stored);
   199:         if (value.value("schema_version",0)==1 && value.at("revision").get<std::uint64_t>()==revision)
   200:             return {revision,value.at("camera_counts").get<std::map<std::string,std::uint64_t>>()};
   201:     }
   202:     TargetSummary summary{revision,{}};
   203:     // Remove stale derived rows, never authoritative observation history.
   204:     std::vector<std::string> stale;
   205:     state_->Scan("association_frame",[&](const auto& id,const auto&){stale.push_back(id);},target);
   206:     for (const auto& id : stale) state_->Erase("association_frame",id);
   207:     for (const auto& o : TargetMetadata(target)) {
   208:         ++summary.camera_counts[o.camera_id];
   209:         state_->Put("association_frame",o.observation_id,
   210:             nlohmann::json::array({o.track_session_id,o.local_track_id}).dump(),target,FrameIndexKey(target,o));
   211:     }
   212:     SaveTargetSummary(target,summary);
   213:     return summary;
   214: }
   215: 
   216: std::map<std::string,std::uint64_t> AssociationStore::TrackTargetCounts(const std::string& track) const {
   217:     if (const auto stored = state_->Get("association_track_targets",track)) {
   218:         const auto value=nlohmann::json::parse(*stored);
   219:         if (value.value("schema_version",0)==1)
   220:             return value.at("counts").get<std::map<std::string,std::uint64_t>>();
   221:     }
   222:     std::map<std::string,std::uint64_t> counts;
   223:     state_->Scan("observation",[&](const std::string&,const std::string& text){
   224:         const auto value=nlohmann::json::parse(text);
   225:         if (!value.at("target_id").is_null()) ++counts[value.at("target_id").get<std::string>()];
   226:     },{},true,track);
   227:     state_->Put("association_track_targets",track,
   228:         nlohmann::json({{"schema_version",1},{"counts",counts}}).dump());
   229:     return counts;
   230: }
   231: std::vector<AssociationStore::CaptureMetadata> AssociationStore::TargetMetadata(const std::string& target) const {
   232:     std::vector<CaptureMetadata> result;
   233:     if(state_)state_->Scan("observation",[&](const std::string&,const std::string& value){
   234:         const auto j=nlohmann::json::parse(value);CaptureMetadata o{};
   235:         o.observation_id=j.at("observation_id");o.source_id=j.at("source_id");o.camera_id=j.at("camera_id");o.frame_id=j.at("frame_id");
   236:         o.captured_at_unix_ms=j.at("captured_at_unix_ms");o.clock_uncertainty_ms=j.at("clock_uncertainty_ms");
   237:         o.local_track_id=j.at("local_track_id");o.track_session_id=j.at("track_session_id");result.push_back(std::move(o));
   238:     },target,true);
   239:     else {auto it=target_observations_.find(target);if(it!=target_observations_.end())for(const auto& id:it->second){const auto& o=records_.at(id).observation;
   240:         result.push_back({o.observation_id,o.source_id,o.camera_id,o.frame_id,o.local_track_id,o.track_session_id,o.captured_at_unix_ms,o.clock_uncertainty_ms});}}
   241:     return result;
   242: }
   243: 
   244: CameraCompatibility AssociationStore::Compatible(const FaceObservation& o, const std::string& target,
   245:                                                   const AssociationPolicy& policy, const CameraGraph& graph) const {
   246:     if (state_) {
   247:         const auto summary = EnsureTargetIndex(target);
   248:         if (summary.camera_counts.empty()) return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
   249:         if (summary.camera_counts.size()==1 && summary.camera_counts.begin()->first==o.camera_id) {
   250:             bool conflict=false;
   251:             state_->Scan("association_frame",[&](const std::string&,const std::string& text){
   252:                 const auto track=nlohmann::json::parse(text);
   253:                 if (o.local_track_id.empty() || track.at(1).get<std::string>().empty() ||
   254:                     track.at(0)!=o.track_session_id || track.at(1)!=o.local_track_id) conflict=true;
   255:             },{},false,FrameIndexKey(target,o));
   256:             // CheckCaptureChain makes exactly this same-camera conclusion,
   257:             // after applying the original same-source/frame collision rule.
   258:             return conflict ? CameraCompatibility::Conflict : CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
   259:         }
   260:     }
   261:     const auto history = TargetMetadata(target);
   262:     if (history.empty()) return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
   263:     std::vector<CaptureInterval> captures{{o.camera_id,Lower(o),Upper(o)}};
   264:     for (const auto& old : history) {
   265:         if (o.camera_id == old.camera_id) {
   266:             // Two different face observations in one source frame cannot be one person.
   267:             if (o.source_id == old.source_id && o.frame_id == old.frame_id &&
   268:                 (o.local_track_id.empty() || old.local_track_id.empty() || Track(o) != Track(old))) {
   269:                 return CameraCompatibility::Conflict;
   270:             }
   271:         }
   272:         captures.push_back({old.camera_id,Lower(old),Upper(old)});
   273:     }
   274:     switch (CheckCaptureChain(std::move(captures),graph,policy.overlapping_cameras,policy.topology_is_complete)) {
   275:         case ChainFeasibility::Feasible: return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
   276:         case ChainFeasibility::Infeasible: return CameraCompatibility::Conflict;
   277:         default:return CameraCompatibility::Unknown;
   278:     }
   279: }
   280: 
   281: void AssociationStore::ForgetTemplate(const std::string& observation_id, const std::string& target) {
   282:     auto owner=templates_.find(target);if(owner==templates_.end())return;
   283:     auto& entries = owner->second;
   284:     const auto found = std::find_if(entries.begin(), entries.end(), [&](const auto& t) {
   285:         return t.observation_id == observation_id;
   286:     });
   287:     if (found != entries.end()) {
   288:         gallery_.Remove(found->template_id);
   289:         entries.erase(found);
   290:         SaveTemplates(target);
   291:     }
   292: }
   293: 
   294: void AssociationStore::Assign(Record& record, const std::string& target, const std::string& evidence,
   295:                               const AssociationPolicy& policy, bool update_template) {
   296:     auto& result = record.result;
   297:     const auto& o = record.observation;
   298:     const auto owner=templates_.find(target);
   299:     auto entries=owner==templates_.end()?std::vector<OwnedTemplate>{}:owner->second;
   300:     const auto by_quality = [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.quality < b.quality; };
   301:     while (entries.size() > policy.max_templates_per_target) {
   302:         const auto worst = std::min_element(entries.begin(), entries.end(), by_quality);
   303:         gallery_.Remove(worst->template_id);
   304:         entries.erase(worst);
   305:     }
   306:     if (update_template) {
   307:         const auto quality = o.detection_score * o.face_size_px;
   308:         const auto worst = std::min_element(entries.begin(), entries.end(), by_quality);
   309:         if (entries.size() < policy.max_templates_per_target || quality > worst->quality) {
   310:             const auto template_id = "assoc-template:" + o.observation_id;
   311:             if (entries.size() >= policy.max_templates_per_target) {
   312:                 gallery_.Remove(worst->template_id);
   313:                 entries.erase(worst);
   314:             }
   315:             gallery_.Add({template_id, target, o.feature_space, o.embedding});
   316:             entries.push_back({o.observation_id, template_id, quality});
   317:             result.template_added = true;
   318:         }
   319:     }
   320:     if (result.target_id && *result.target_id != target) {
   321:         const auto old = *result.target_id;
   322:         if(!state_)target_observations_[old].erase(o.observation_id);
   323:         ForgetTemplate(o.observation_id, old);
   324:         result.affected_target_ids.push_back(old);
   325:     }
   326:     result.target_id = target;
   327:     result.sighting = SightingEvidence{o.observation_id, target, o.camera_id, evidence,
   328:         o.captured_at_unix_ms, o.clock_uncertainty_ms, TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed,
   329:         o.time_source, o.source_id, o.clock_domain, o.reentry_evidence_id};
   330:     if(!state_) {
   331:         target_observations_[target].insert(o.observation_id);
   332:         if (!o.local_track_id.empty()) track_observations_[Track(o)].insert(o.observation_id);
   333:     }
   334:     templates_.insert_or_assign(target,std::move(entries));
   335:     SaveTemplates(target);
   336:     if(state_)state_->Put("association_target",target,"1");
   337:     result.affected_target_ids.push_back(target);
   338:     // Read track identity from accepted records so corrections cannot leave stale bindings.
   339: }
   340: 
   341: AssociationResult AssociationStore::Observe(FaceObservation observation, const AssociationPolicy& input_policy,
   342:                                             const CameraGraph& input_graph, bool reconsider) {
   343:     last_append_.reset();
   344:     const auto policy = CheckedPolicy(input_policy);
   345:     const auto graph = NormalizeCameraGraph(input_graph);
   346:     const auto& o = observation;
   347:     if (o.observation_id.empty() || o.source_id.empty() || o.camera_id.empty() || o.frame_id.empty() ||
   348:         o.clock_domain.empty() || (o.local_track_id.empty() != o.track_session_id.empty()) ||
   349:         !std::isfinite(o.detection_score) || o.detection_score < 0 || o.detection_score > 1 ||
   350:         !std::isfinite(o.face_size_px) || o.face_size_px <= 0) {
   351:         throw std::invalid_argument("invalid face observation metadata");
   352:     }
   353:     const auto known_policy = policies_.find(policy.policy_id);
   354:     if (known_policy != policies_.end() && PolicyKey(known_policy->second) != PolicyKey(policy))
   355:         throw std::invalid_argument("association policy changed without a new policy_id");
   356:     const auto known_graph = graphs_.find(graph.version);
   357:     if (known_graph != graphs_.end() && !SameGraph(known_graph->second, graph))
   358:         throw std::invalid_argument("camera graph changed without a new version");
   359:     const auto previous = LoadRecord(o.observation_id);
   360:     if (previous) {
   361:         if (!SameObservation(previous->observation, o))
   362:             throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting duplicate observation_id");
   363:         if (!reconsider || previous->result.target_id) return previous->result;
   364:     }
   365:     std::optional<std::uint64_t> append_previous_target_revision;
   366:     // Search all persons in the feature space; a TopK cutoff can hide the runner-up
   367:     // after camera filtering. The gallery also validates the contract and vector.
   368:     Gallery::ValidateQuery(o.feature_space,o.embedding);
   369:     const auto hits = UsableTime(o,policy) && UsableFace(o,policy)
   370:         ? gallery_.Search(o.feature_space, o.embedding, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max())
   371:         : std::vector<PersonHit>{};
   372:     Record next{std::move(observation), {}};
   373:     auto& result = next.result;
   374:     result.observation_id = next.observation.observation_id;
   375:     result.policy_id = policy.policy_id;
   376:     result.graph_version = graph.version;
   377:     const auto& current = next.observation;
   378:     if (!UsableTime(current, policy)) {
   379:         result.decision = "UNASSIGNED";
   380:         result.reason = "capture time is not qualified UTC evidence";
   381:     } else if (!UsableFace(current, policy)) {
   382:         result.decision = "UNASSIGNED";
   383:         result.reason = "face does not pass configured detection and size gates";
   384:     } else {
   385:         std::vector<AssociationCandidate> eligible;
   386:         for (const auto& hit : hits) {
   387:             // Sorted lower scores cannot alter a decision once both feasible
   388:             // leaders are known and the visual Top8 has been classified.
   389:             if (result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.size()>=2) break;
   390:             if (result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.empty() && hit.similarity<policy.new_target_threshold) break;
   391:             if(result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.size()==1 &&
   392:                 (eligible[0].hit.similarity<policy.match_threshold ||
   393:                  eligible[0].hit.similarity-hit.similarity>=policy.min_margin)) {
   394:                 result.remaining_similarity_upper_bound=hit.similarity;
   395:                 break;
   396:             }
   397:             const auto compatibility = Compatible(current, hit.person_entity_id, policy, graph);
   398:             AssociationCandidate candidate{hit, compatibility};
   399:             if (result.candidates.size() < 8) result.candidates.push_back(candidate);
   400:             if (compatibility != CameraCompatibility::Conflict)
   401:                 eligible.push_back(candidate);
   402:         }
   403:         // Keep the visual Top8 and the decision's feasible winner/runner-up.
   404:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < std::min<std::size_t>(2, eligible.size()); ++i) {
   405:             if (std::none_of(result.candidates.begin(), result.candidates.end(), [&](const auto& c) {
   406:                     return c.hit.person_entity_id == eligible[i].hit.person_entity_id;
   407:                 })) result.candidates.push_back(eligible[i]);
   408:         }
   409:         std::set<std::string> track_targets;
   410:         if (!current.local_track_id.empty()) {
   411:             if(state_) {
   412:                 for (const auto& [target,count] : TrackTargetCounts(TrackIndexKey(current)))
   413:                     if (count) track_targets.insert(target);
   414:             } else {
   415:             const auto track = track_observations_.find(Track(current));
   416:             if (track != track_observations_.end()) {
   417:                 for (const auto& id : track->second) track_targets.insert(*records_.at(id).result.target_id);
   418:             }
   419:             }
   420:         }
   421:         if (!eligible.empty() && eligible[0].hit.similarity >= policy.match_threshold &&
   422:             (eligible.size() == 1 || eligible[0].hit.similarity - eligible[1].hit.similarity >= policy.min_margin)) {
   423:             const auto& best = eligible[0];
   424:             if ((!track_targets.empty() && (track_targets.size() != 1 || !track_targets.count(best.hit.person_entity_id)))) {
   425:                 result.decision = "CONFLICT";
   426:                 result.reason = "local track identity disagrees with face evidence";
   427:             } else if ((policy.require_topology || policy.topology_is_complete) && best.compatibility == CameraCompatibility::Unknown) {
   428:                 result.decision = "PROVISIONAL";
   429:                 result.reason = "joint capture feasibility could not be established from topology or within solve budget";
   430:             } else {
   431:                 result.decision = "MATCHED";
   432:                 result.reason = "face margin and available camera constraints passed";
   433:                 if (!previous) append_previous_target_revision=TargetRevision(best.hit.person_entity_id);
   434:                 Assign(next, best.hit.person_entity_id, "association:" + current.observation_id, policy,
   435:                        best.hit.similarity >= policy.template_update_threshold &&
   436:                        best.hit.similarity < policy.max_template_similarity);
   437:             }
   438:         } else if (hits.empty() || hits[0].similarity < policy.new_target_threshold) {
   439:             if (!track_targets.empty()) {
   440:                 result.decision = "CONFLICT";
   441:                 result.reason = "local track face no longer supports its accepted identity";
   442:             } else {
   443:                 result.decision = "CREATED";
   444:                 result.reason = "no similar identity in the compatible feature space";
   445:                 const auto target = "auto:" + ActivityStore::Digest(nlohmann::json::array({
   446:                     state_?state_->Scope():std::string{},current.source_id,current.observation_id}).dump());
   447:                 if (!previous) append_previous_target_revision=TargetRevision(target);
   448:                 Assign(next, target, "association:" + current.observation_id, policy, true);
   449:             }
   450:         } else {
   451:             const bool conflict = eligible.empty() || eligible[0].hit.similarity < policy.new_target_threshold;
   452:             result.decision = conflict ? "CONFLICT" : "PROVISIONAL";
   453:             result.reason = conflict ? "similar faces conflict with camera evidence"
   454:                                              : "face score or person margin is inconclusive";
   455:         }
   456:     }
   457:     result.version = ++version_;
   458:     const bool new_policy=policies_.emplace(policy.policy_id, policy).second;
   459:     const bool new_graph=graphs_.emplace(graph.version, graph).second;
   460:     if(state_){if(new_policy)state_->Put("policy",policy.policy_id,nlohmann::json(policy).dump());if(new_graph)state_->Put("association_graph",graph.version,nlohmann::json(graph).dump());}
   461:     const auto id = current.observation_id;
   462:     const bool append = !previous && append_previous_target_revision && result.sighting && result.target_id &&
   463:         result.affected_target_ids.size()==1 && result.affected_target_ids.front()==*result.target_id;
   464:     SaveRecord(next);
   465:     if (append) last_append_=AssociationAppend{*result.sighting,*append_previous_target_revision,TargetRevision(*result.target_id)};
   466:     return next.result;
   467: }
   468: 
   469: AssociationResult AssociationStore::Correct(const std::string& observation_id, const std::string& target,
   470:                                             const std::string& evidence) {
   471:     last_append_.reset();
   472:     if (target.empty() || evidence.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("target and correction evidence are required");
   473:     auto loaded=LoadRecord(observation_id);
   474:     if(!loaded)throw std::out_of_range("observation not found");
   475:     auto& record=*loaded;
   476:     const auto& policy = policies_.at(record.result.policy_id);
   477:     if (!UsableTime(record.observation, policy) || !UsableFace(record.observation, policy))
   478:         throw std::invalid_argument("correction cannot manufacture qualified face/capture evidence");
   479:     if (record.result.sighting && record.result.target_id == target &&
   480:         record.result.sighting->attribution_evidence_id == evidence) return record.result;
   481:     record.result.affected_target_ids.clear();
   482:     record.result.template_added = false;
   483:     if (record.result.target_id) ForgetTemplate(observation_id, *record.result.target_id);
   484:     Assign(record, target, evidence, policy, true);
   485:     record.result.decision = "CORRECTED";
   486:     record.result.reason = "external verified attribution correction";
   487:     record.result.version = ++version_;
   488:     SaveRecord(record);
   489:     return record.result;
   490: }
   491: 
   492: std::vector<SightingEvidence> AssociationStore::Sightings(const std::string& target) const {
   493:     std::vector<SightingEvidence> result;
   494:     if(state_){state_->Scan("observation",[&](const std::string&,const std::string& value){auto j=nlohmann::json::parse(value);if(!j.at("sighting").is_null())result.push_back(j.at("sighting").get<SightingEvidence>());},target,true);
   495:         if(result.empty() && !state_->Get("association_target",target))throw std::out_of_range("association target not found");return result;}
   496:     const auto history = target_observations_.find(target);
   497:     if (history == target_observations_.end()) throw std::out_of_range("association target not found");
   498:     for (const auto& id : history->second) result.push_back(*records_.at(id).result.sighting);
   499:     return result;
   500: }
   501: 
   502: std::uint64_t AssociationStore::TargetRevision(const std::string& target) const {
   503:     if (state_) {
   504:         const auto revision = state_->Get("association_target_revision", target);
   505:         if (revision) return std::stoull(*revision);
   506:         // Old databases have targets but no per-target binding. A stable legacy
   507:         // generation requires one rebuild, without invalidating unrelated targets.
   508:         return state_->Get("association_target", target) ? 1 : 0;
   509:     }
   510:     const auto found = target_revisions_.find(target);
   511:     return found == target_revisions_.end() ? 0 : found->second;

    33:     if ((b > 0 && a > Max - b) || (b < 0 && a < Min - b))

    51: // Proleptic Gregorian civil date to days since 1970-01-01. No host timezone or
    52: // time_t dependency; years before 1970 keep their signed millisecond value.
    53: Millis Days(int year, unsigned month, unsigned day) {
    54:     year -= month <= 2;
    55:     const auto era = year / 400;
    56:     const auto yoe = static_cast<unsigned>(year - era * 400);
    57:     const auto shifted_month = month > 2 ? month - 3 : month + 9;
    58:     const auto doy = (153 * shifted_month + 2) / 5 + day - 1;
    59:     const auto doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
    60:     return static_cast<Millis>(era) * 146097 + doe - 719468;
    61: }
    62: struct ParsedTime { Millis utc_ms; Millis resolution_ms; Millis timezone_offset_minutes; std::string timezone_source; };
    63: ParsedTime Parse(const std::string& text, const json& profile) {
    64:     if (text.size() < 19 || text.size() > 32 || text[4] != '-' || text[7] != '-' ||
    65:         (text[10] != 'T' && text[10] != ' ') || text[13] != ':' || text[16] != ':')
    66:         throw std::invalid_argument("expected ISO8601 timestamp with seconds");
    67:     auto digits = [&](std::size_t index, std::size_t count) {
    68:         int result = 0;
    69:         if (index + count > text.size()) throw std::invalid_argument("truncated capture time");
    70:         for (std::size_t i = index; i < index + count; ++i) {
    71:             if (text[i] < '0' || text[i] > '9') throw std::invalid_argument("invalid capture time digit");
    72:             result = result * 10 + text[i] - '0';
    73:         }
    74:         return result;
    75:     };
    76:     const auto year = digits(0, 4), month = digits(5, 2), day = digits(8, 2);
    77:     const auto hour = digits(11, 2), minute = digits(14, 2), second = digits(17, 2);
    78:     const bool leap = year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0);
    79:     const int month_days[] = {31, leap ? 29 : 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31};
    80:     if (year < 1 || month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > month_days[month - 1] ||
    81:         hour > 23 || minute > 59 || second > 59)
    82:         throw std::invalid_argument("invalid Gregorian capture date or time");
    83:     std::size_t cursor = 19;
    84:     Millis fraction = 0, resolution = 1000;
    85:     if (cursor < text.size() && text[cursor] == '.') {
    86:         const auto start = ++cursor;
    87:         while (cursor < text.size() && text[cursor] >= '0' && text[cursor] <= '9') ++cursor;
    88:         const auto count = cursor - start;
    89:         if (count < 1 || count > 3) throw std::invalid_argument("capture fraction must have 1 to 3 digits");
    90:         fraction = digits(start, count);
    91:         resolution = count == 1 ? 100 : count == 2 ? 10 : 1;
    92:         fraction *= resolution;
    93:     }
    94:     Millis offset_minutes = 0;
    95:     std::string timezone_source = "EXPLICIT_TIMESTAMP_OFFSET";
    96:     if (cursor == text.size()) {
    97:         if (!profile.contains("fixed_utc_offset_minutes")) throw std::invalid_argument("naive capture time requires configured fixed UTC offset");
    98:         offset_minutes = FixedOffset(profile);
    99:         timezone_source = "PROFILE_FIXED_OFFSET";
   100:     } else if (text[cursor] == 'Z' && cursor + 1 == text.size()) {
   101:         offset_minutes = 0;
   102:     } else {
   103:         if ((text[cursor] != '+' && text[cursor] != '-') || cursor + 6 != text.size() || text[cursor + 3] != ':')
   104:             throw std::invalid_argument("invalid timestamp UTC offset");
   105:         const auto oh = digits(cursor + 1, 2), om = digits(cursor + 4, 2);
   106:         if (om > 59 || oh > 14 || (oh == 14 && om != 0) ||
   107:             (text[cursor] == '-' && oh == 0 && om == 0))
   108:             throw std::invalid_argument("invalid or unknown timestamp UTC offset");
   109:         offset_minutes = (oh * 60 + om) * (text[cursor] == '-' ? -1 : 1);
   110:     }
   111:     return {Days(year, month, day) * 86400000 + hour * 3600000LL + minute * 60000LL +
   112:                 second * 1000LL + fraction - offset_minutes * 60000,
   113:             resolution, offset_minutes, timezone_source};
   114: }
   115: json Hold(const std::string& reason, const json& provenance) {

   120: void ClockAdapter::Put(const json& profile) {
   121:     const auto camera = Required(profile, "camera_id"), version = Required(profile, "profile_version");
   122:     Required(profile, "source_evidence_id");
   123:     if (!profile.at("verified").is_boolean()) throw std::invalid_argument("verified must be explicit boolean");
   124:     const auto semantics = Required(profile, "capture_semantics");
   125:     if (semantics != "DEVICE_CAPTURE" && semantics != "UNKNOWN")
   126:         throw std::invalid_argument("capture_semantics must be DEVICE_CAPTURE or UNKNOWN");
   127:     if (profile.at("verified") == true && semantics != "DEVICE_CAPTURE")
   128:         throw std::invalid_argument("verified profile requires device capture semantics");
   129:     if (profile.contains("fixed_utc_offset_minutes")) FixedOffset(profile);
   130:     const auto& calibrations = profile.at("calibrations");
   131:     if (!calibrations.is_array() || calibrations.size() > 10000 ||
   132:         (profile.at("verified") == true && calibrations.empty()))
   133:         throw std::invalid_argument("calibrations must be a bounded array; verified profile requires calibration");
   134:     std::set<std::string> identifiers;
   135:     std::vector<std::pair<Millis, Millis>> periods;
   136:     for (const auto& calibration : calibrations) {
   137:         if (!identifiers.insert(Required(calibration, "calibration_id")).second)
   138:             throw std::invalid_argument("duplicate calibration_id");
   139:         Required(calibration, "source_evidence_id");
   140:         const auto first = Integer(calibration, "valid_from_utc_ms"), last = Integer(calibration, "valid_until_utc_ms");
   141:         if (first >= last) throw std::invalid_argument("calibration validity must be nonempty [from,until)");
   142:         Integer(calibration, "offset_ms");
   143:         const auto uncertainty = Integer(calibration, "uncertainty_ms"), resolution = Integer(calibration, "time_resolution_ms");
   144:         if (uncertainty < 0 || resolution < 1 || resolution > 86400000)
   145:             throw std::invalid_argument("nonnegative uncertainty and resolution from 1ms to 1 day required");
   146:         Add(uncertainty, std::max<Millis>(resolution, 1000) - 1);
   147:         periods.emplace_back(first, last);
   148:     }
   149:     std::sort(periods.begin(), periods.end());
   150:     for (std::size_t i = 1; i < periods.size(); ++i)
   151:         if (periods[i].first < periods[i - 1].second) throw std::invalid_argument("overlapping calibration validity");
   152:     const auto key = Key(camera, version), encoded = profile.dump();
   153:     std::optional<std::string> old;
   154:     if (state_) old = state_->Get("clock_profile", key);
   155:     else if (const auto it = profiles_.find(key); it != profiles_.end()) old = it->second;
   156:     if (old && *old != encoded) throw std::invalid_argument("clock profile version is immutable");
   157:     if (old) return;
   158:     if (state_) state_->Put("clock_profile", key, encoded, camera);
   159:     else profiles_.emplace(key, encoded);
   160: }

   162: json ClockAdapter::Normalize(const json& request) const {
   163:     const auto camera = Required(request, "camera_id"), version = Required(request, "profile_version");
   164:     const auto raw = Required(request, "raw_time");
   165:     const auto policy = request.value("time_policy", std::string("CORRECTED_UTC"));
   166:     if (policy != "CORRECTED_UTC" && policy != "CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S")
   167:         throw std::invalid_argument("time_policy must be CORRECTED_UTC or CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S");
   168:     json provenance = {{"camera_id", camera}, {"profile_version", version}, {"raw_time", raw},
   169:                        {"offset_convention", "POSITIVE_CAMERA_AHEAD"}, {"time_policy", policy}};
   170:     if (policy == "CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S")
   171:         provenance["max_device_time_error_ms"] = CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs;
   172:     std::optional<std::string> encoded;
   173:     const auto key = Key(camera, version);
   174:     if (state_) encoded = state_->Get("clock_profile", key);
   175:     else if (const auto it = profiles_.find(key); it != profiles_.end()) encoded = it->second;
   176:     if (!encoded) return Hold("UNKNOWN_CLOCK_PROFILE", provenance);
   177:     const auto profile = json::parse(*encoded);
   178:     provenance["profile_source_evidence_id"] = profile.at("source_evidence_id");
   179:     provenance["profile_verified"] = profile.at("verified");
   180:     provenance["capture_semantics"] = profile.at("capture_semantics");
   181:     if (profile.at("verified") != true) return Hold("UNVERIFIED_CLOCK_PROFILE", provenance);
   182:     if (profile.at("capture_semantics") != "DEVICE_CAPTURE") return Hold("UNKNOWN_CAPTURE_SEMANTICS", provenance);
   183:     ParsedTime parsed{};
   184:     try { parsed = Parse(raw, profile); }
   185:     catch (const std::invalid_argument& error) {
   186:         provenance["parse_error"] = error.what();
   187:         return Hold("INVALID_CAPTURE_TIME", provenance);
   188:     }
   189:     provenance["timezone_source"] = parsed.timezone_source;
   190:     provenance["timezone_offset_minutes"] = parsed.timezone_offset_minutes;
   191:     provenance["device_utc_unix_ms"] = parsed.utc_ms;
   192:     provenance["text_resolution_ms"] = parsed.resolution_ms;
   193:     json selected;
   194:     Millis corrected = 0, uncertainty = 0;
   195:     std::size_t nominal_matches = 0;
   196:     bool boundary = false, overflow = false;
   197:     for (const auto& calibration : profile.at("calibrations")) {
   198:         try {
   199:             const auto candidate = Subtract(parsed.utc_ms, Integer(calibration, "offset_ms"));
   200:             const auto first = Integer(calibration, "valid_from_utc_ms"), last = Integer(calibration, "valid_until_utc_ms");
   201:             if (candidate < first || candidate >= last) continue;
   202:             ++nominal_matches;
   203:             const auto error = Add(Integer(calibration, "uncertainty_ms"),
   204:                                    std::max(Integer(calibration, "time_resolution_ms"), parsed.resolution_ms) - 1);
   205:             if (Subtract(candidate, error) < first || Add(candidate, error) >= last) { boundary = true; continue; }
   206:             selected = calibration;
   207:             corrected = candidate;
   208:             uncertainty = error;
   209:         } catch (const std::invalid_argument&) { overflow = true; }
   210:     }
   211:     if (nominal_matches > 1) return Hold("AMBIGUOUS_CLOCK_CALIBRATION", provenance);
   212:     if (selected.is_null()) {
   213:         if (overflow) return Hold("CLOCK_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW", provenance);
   214:         return Hold(boundary ? "CALIBRATION_BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN" : "OUTSIDE_CALIBRATION_VALIDITY", provenance);
   215:     }
   216:     provenance["calibration_id"] = selected.at("calibration_id");
   217:     provenance["calibration_source_evidence_id"] = selected.at("source_evidence_id");
   218:     provenance["offset_ms"] = selected.at("offset_ms");
   219:     provenance["calibration_uncertainty_ms"] = selected.at("uncertainty_ms");
   220:     provenance["configured_time_resolution_ms"] = selected.at("time_resolution_ms");
   221:     provenance["valid_from_utc_ms"] = selected.at("valid_from_utc_ms");
   222:     provenance["valid_until_utc_ms"] = selected.at("valid_until_utc_ms");
   223:     const auto offset = Integer(selected, "offset_ms");
   224:     provenance["applied_offset_ms"] = offset;
   225:     if (policy == "CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S") {
   226:         provenance["applied_offset_ms"] = 0;
   227:         // The calibration selects a verified true-time window, but the emitted
   228:         // nominal time stays on the camera clock. Include the entire offset,
   229:         // measurement/drift uncertainty and quantization in its error bound.
   230:         // Check before abs/add so INT64_MIN and large errors cannot overflow.
   231:         if (offset < -CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs || offset > CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs)
   232:             return Hold("CAMERA_CLOCK_ERROR_EXCEEDS_60S", provenance);
   233:         const auto magnitude = offset < 0 ? -offset : offset;
   234:         if (uncertainty > CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs - magnitude)
   235:             return Hold("CAMERA_CLOCK_ERROR_EXCEEDS_60S", provenance);
   236:         uncertainty += magnitude;
   237:         corrected = parsed.utc_ms;
   238:         provenance["device_time_error_bound_ms"] = uncertainty;
   239:     }
   240:     return {{"status", "NORMALIZED"}, {"reason_codes", json::array()},
   241:             {"captured_at_unix_ms", corrected}, {"clock_uncertainty_ms", uncertainty},
   242:             {"time_source", "UTC_CAPTURE"}, {"clock_domain", "UTC"}, {"provenance", provenance}};
   243: }
   244: }

    23: bool IsSha256(const std::string& value) {
    24:     return value.size() == 64 && std::all_of(value.begin(), value.end(), [](unsigned char c) {
    25:         return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F');
    26:     });

    29: void ValidateSpace(const FeatureSpaceContract& value) {
    30:     if (!IsSha256(value.recognition_model_sha256) ||
    31:         (!value.detector_model_sha256.empty() && !IsSha256(value.detector_model_sha256)) ||
    32:         (value.detector_model_sha256.empty() != value.detector_profile.empty()) ||

    39: FeatureSpaceContract CanonicalizeSpace(FeatureSpaceContract value) {
    40:     ValidateSpace(value);
    41:     const auto lower = [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); };
    42:     std::transform(value.recognition_model_sha256.begin(), value.recognition_model_sha256.end(),
    43:                    value.recognition_model_sha256.begin(), lower);

    49: void Normalize(Embedding& value) {
    50:     double squared_norm = 0;
    51:     for (float component : value) {
    52:         if (!std::isfinite(component)) {
    53:             throw std::invalid_argument("embedding must contain finite values");
    54:         }
    55:         squared_norm += static_cast<double>(component) * component;
    56:     }
    57:     if (!(squared_norm > 0) || !std::isfinite(squared_norm)) {
    58:         throw std::invalid_argument("embedding must have nonzero finite norm");
    59:     }
    60:     const double inverse_norm = 1.0 / std::sqrt(squared_norm);
    61:     for (float& component : value) {
    62:         component = static_cast<float>(component * inverse_norm);
    63:     }
    64: }
    65: 
    66: float Dot(const Embedding& left, const Embedding& right) {
    67: #if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__SSE2__)
    68:     // Float inputs, double products/accumulation. Do not lower precision near
    69:     // identity thresholds to obtain a faster benchmark.
    70:     __m128d a=_mm_setzero_pd(),b=a;
    71:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<kEmbeddingDim;i+=4){
    72:         const auto l=_mm_loadu_ps(left.data()+i),r=_mm_loadu_ps(right.data()+i);
    73:         a=_mm_add_pd(a,_mm_mul_pd(_mm_cvtps_pd(l),_mm_cvtps_pd(r)));
    74:         b=_mm_add_pd(b,_mm_mul_pd(_mm_cvtps_pd(_mm_movehl_ps(l,l)),_mm_cvtps_pd(_mm_movehl_ps(r,r))));
    75:     }
    76:     double lanes[2];_mm_storeu_pd(lanes,_mm_add_pd(a,b));
    77:     return static_cast<float>(lanes[0]+lanes[1]);
    78: #else
    79:     double sum = 0;
    80:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kEmbeddingDim; ++i) {
    81:         sum += static_cast<double>(left[i]) * right[i];
    82:     }
    83:     return static_cast<float>(sum);
    84: #endif
    85: }

   119: void Gallery::Add(FaceTemplate value) {
   120:     if (value.template_id.empty() || value.person_entity_id.empty()) {
   121:         throw std::invalid_argument("template and person IDs are required");
   122:     }
   123:     value.feature_space = CanonicalizeSpace(std::move(value.feature_space));
   124:     Normalize(value.embedding);
   125:     std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
   126:     if (template_spaces_.find(value.template_id) != template_spaces_.end()) {
   127:         throw std::invalid_argument("duplicate template_id");
   128:     }
   129:     if(template_spaces_.size()>=max_templates_)throw std::runtime_error("CAPACITY: gallery template limit reached");
   130:     const auto id = value.template_id;

   132:     if (state_) state_->Put("template",id,nlohmann::json(value).dump());

   134:     try {
   135:         auto& bucket=templates_by_space_[space];
   136:         auto person=bucket.person_slots.find(value.person_entity_id);
   137:         std::size_t slot;
   138:         if(person!=bucket.person_slots.end())slot=person->second;
   139:         else {

   142:             bucket.person_slots.emplace(value.person_entity_id,slot);
   143:         }
   144:         bucket.rows.push_back({value.template_id,slot,value.embedding});
   145:         ++bucket.persons[slot].count;
   146:         bucket.slots.emplace(id,bucket.rows.size()-1);
   147:     } catch (...) {

   149:         throw;
   150:     }
   151:     ++version_;

   161:     auto bucket = templates_by_space_.find(index->second);
   162:     auto& rows=bucket->second.rows;
   163:     const auto slot=bucket->second.slots.at(template_id);
   164:     auto& person=bucket->second.persons[rows[slot].person_slot];
   165:     if(--person.count==0){bucket->second.person_slots.erase(person.id);person.id.clear();bucket->second.free_person_slots.push_back(rows[slot].person_slot);}
   166:     if(slot+1!=rows.size()) { rows[slot]=std::move(rows.back());bucket->second.slots.at(rows[slot].template_id)=slot; }
   167:     rows.pop_back();bucket->second.slots.erase(template_id);
   168:     if (rows.empty()) templates_by_space_.erase(bucket);
   169:     template_spaces_.erase(index);
   170:     if(state_)state_->Erase("template",template_id);
   171:     ++version_;
   172:     if(state_)state_->Put("version","gallery",std::to_string(version_));
   173: }
   174: 
   175: std::vector<PersonHit> Gallery::Search(
   176:     const FeatureSpaceContract& feature_space, const Embedding& query, std::size_t top_k) const {
   177:     const auto normalized_space = CanonicalizeSpace(feature_space);
   178:     if (top_k == 0) throw std::invalid_argument("positive top_k is required");
   179:     Embedding normalized_query = query;
   180:     Normalize(normalized_query);
   181:     std::shared_lock lock(mutex_);
   182:     std::vector<PersonHit> hits;
   183:     const auto bucket = templates_by_space_.find(normalized_space);
   184:     if (bucket != templates_by_space_.end()) {
   185:         const auto& rows=bucket->second.rows;
   186:         std::vector<float> scores(rows.size());
   187: #ifdef _OPENMP
   188:         const int threads=std::max(1,std::min(8,omp_get_num_procs()));
   189: #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(threads) if(rows.size()>=10000)
   190: #endif
   191:         for(std::int64_t i=0;i<static_cast<std::int64_t>(rows.size());++i)
   192:             scores[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]=Dot(normalized_query,rows[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].embedding);
   193:         std::vector<std::optional<std::size_t>> best(bucket->second.persons.size());
   194:         for (std::size_t slot=0;slot<rows.size();++slot) {
   195:             const auto& value=rows[slot];
   196:             const auto& id=value.template_id;
   197:             const float score = scores[slot];
   198:             auto& winner=best[value.person_slot];
   199:             if (!winner || score > scores[*winner] ||
   200:                 (score == scores[*winner] && id < rows[*winner].template_id)) {
   201:                 winner=slot;
   202:             }
   203:         }
   204:         hits.reserve(bucket->second.person_slots.size());
   205:         for(std::size_t i=0;i<best.size();++i)if(best[i])
   206:             hits.push_back({bucket->second.persons[i].id,rows[*best[i]].template_id,scores[*best[i]]});
   207:     }
   208:     const auto better = [](const PersonHit& a, const PersonHit& b) {
   209:         if (a.similarity != b.similarity) return a.similarity > b.similarity;
   210:         return a.person_entity_id < b.person_entity_id;
   211:     };
   212:     if (hits.size() > top_k) {
   213:         std::nth_element(hits.begin(), hits.begin() + top_k, hits.end(), better);
   214:         hits.resize(top_k);
   215:     }
   216:     std::sort(hits.begin(), hits.end(), better);
   217:     return hits;
   218: }
   219: 
   220: std::size_t Gallery::Size() const {
   221:     std::shared_lock lock(mutex_);
   222:     return template_spaces_.size();
   223: }
   224: 
   225: std::uint64_t Gallery::Version() const {
   226:     std::shared_lock lock(mutex_);
   227:     return version_;
   228: }
