   221:         bound_gate|=json::parse(text).at("normalization").value("status","")=="NORMALIZED";
   222:     },{},false,sighting.observation_id);
   223:     if(stored && previous_association_revision && !bound_gate) {
   224:         auto cache=json::parse(*stored); auto& summary=cache["summary"];
   225:         const auto new_key=std::make_tuple(bounds.first,bounds.second,event_id);
   226:         const auto old_key=std::make_tuple(cache.at("last_lower").get<std::int64_t>(),
   227:             cache.at("last_upper").get<std::int64_t>(),cache.at("last_id").get<std::string>());
   228:         if(summary.at("association_revision")==*previous_association_revision &&
   229:            summary.at("gate_revision")==gate_revision && summary.at("status")=="ACTIVE" && new_key>=old_key) {
   230:             const auto group_upper=cache.at("group_upper").get<std::int64_t>();
   231:             if(bounds.first>group_upper) summary["event_group_count"]=summary.at("event_group_count").get<std::size_t>()+1;
   232:             cache["group_upper"]=std::max(group_upper,bounds.second);
   233:             cache["last_lower"]=bounds.first; cache["last_upper"]=bounds.second; cache["last_id"]=event_id;
   234:             const auto person=Person(target);
   235:             summary["category"]=person.at("category"); summary["person_revision"]=person.at("revision");
   236:             summary["association_revision"]=associations.TargetRevision(target);
   237:             state_->Put("monitoring_projection",target,cache.dump());
   238:             return summary;
   239:         }
   240:     }
   241:     const auto projection=Get(target,associations);
   242:     auto summary=Summary(projection);
   243:     const auto& groups=projection.at("event_groups");
   244:     if(!groups.empty()) {
   245:         const auto& group=groups.back(); const auto& event=group.at("events").back();
   246:         const json cache={{"summary",summary},{"group_upper",group.at("latest_unix_ms")},
   247:             {"last_lower",event.at("earliest_unix_ms")},{"last_upper",event.at("latest_unix_ms")},{"last_id",event.at("event_id")}};
   248:         state_->Put("monitoring_projection",target,cache.dump());
   249:     } else state_->Erase("monitoring_projection",target);
   250:     return summary;
   251: }
   252: 
   253: json MonitoringStore::Get(const std::string& target, const AssociationStore& associations,std::optional<std::int64_t> before) const {
   254:     RequireDurable();
   255:     if(target.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("target_id is required");
   256:     std::vector<Event> events; std::set<std::string> seen_gates;
   257:     auto ignored=json::array();
   258:     const auto sightings=associations.TargetRevision(target)>0 ? associations.Sightings(target) : std::vector<SightingEvidence>{};
   259:     for(const auto& sighting:sightings) {
   260:         const auto managed=state_->Get("monitoring_observation",sighting.observation_id);
   261:         if(!managed) continue; // Legacy bare UTC assertions cannot activate this clock-qualified intake.
   262:         const auto rec=ObservationRecord(state_,*managed,false);
   263:         if(!rec.at("response").value("time_admitted",false)) continue;
   264:         const auto face_bounds=Bounds(sighting.captured_at_unix_ms,sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
   265:         bool represented_by_gate=false;
   266:         state_->Scan("monitoring_gate",[&](const auto& id,const auto& text) {
   267:             const auto gate=json::parse(text);
   268:             if(gate.at("normalization").value("status","")!="NORMALIZED") { ignored.push_back(id); return; }
   269:             if(!seen_gates.insert(id).second) return;
   270:             const auto& n=gate.at("normalization");
   271:             const auto bounds=Bounds(n.at("captured_at_unix_ms"),n.at("clock_uncertainty_ms"));
   272:             events.push_back({"gate:"+id,gate.at("payload").at("direction"),bounds.first,bounds.second,
   273:                 {{"event_id",id},{"observation_id",sighting.observation_id},{"binding_evidence_id",gate.at("binding").at("evidence_id")}}});
   274:             // An explicit identity link does not erase an independently timed
   275:             // face sighting. Only overlapping intervals can represent the same
   276:             // passage evidence without fabricating an extra inside observation.
   277:             represented_by_gate |= bounds.first<=face_bounds.second && face_bounds.first<=bounds.second;
   278:         },{},false,sighting.observation_id);
   279:         if(!represented_by_gate) {
   280:             events.push_back({"face:"+sighting.observation_id,"SIGHTING",face_bounds.first,face_bounds.second,
   281:                 {{"observation_id",sighting.observation_id},{"camera_id",sighting.camera_id}}});
   282:         }
   283:     }
   284:     // Identity already established for this gate passage remains evidence of
   285:     // its own still-valid event. An expired face reference is not replayed.
   286:     state_->Scan("monitoring_gate",[&](const auto& id,const auto& text){
   287:         const auto gate=json::parse(text);
   288:         if(!gate.value("binding_history_pruned",false)||!gate.at("binding").is_null()||seen_gates.count(id)||gate.value("bound_target_id",std::string{})!=target||gate.at("normalization").value("status","")!="NORMALIZED")return;
   289:         const auto& n=gate.at("normalization");const auto bounds=Bounds(n.at("captured_at_unix_ms"),n.at("clock_uncertainty_ms"));
   290:         events.push_back({"gate:"+id,gate.at("payload").at("direction"),bounds.first,bounds.second,{{"event_id",id},{"binding_evidence_hash",gate.value("binding_evidence_hash",std::string{})}}});
   291:     });
   292:     if(before)events.erase(std::remove_if(events.begin(),events.end(),[&](const auto& e){return e.lower+(e.upper-e.lower)/2>=*before;}),events.end());
   293:     std::sort(events.begin(),events.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return std::tie(a.lower,a.upper,a.id)<std::tie(b.lower,b.upper,b.id);});
   294:     auto groups=json::array(), sessions=json::array();
   295:     std::string status="NOT_STARTED";
   296:     auto boundary_dependencies=json::array();
   297:     if(const auto seed=state_->Get("monitoring_runtime",target)) {
   298:         auto runtime=json::parse(*seed);status=runtime.at("status");
   299:         boundary_dependencies=runtime.value("boundary_dependencies",json::array());
   300:         if(runtime.contains("session_id") && !runtime.at("session_id").is_null())sessions.push_back({{"session_id",runtime.at("session_id")},{"entry_status",runtime.at("entry_status")},{"status",status},{"boundary_ambiguous",runtime.value("boundary_ambiguous",false)},{"event_ids",json::array()},{"history_pruned",true}});
   301:     }
   302:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<events.size();) {
   303:         std::size_t end=i+1; auto upper=events[i].upper;
   304:         while(end<events.size() && events[end].lower<=upper) { upper=std::max(upper,events[end].upper); ++end; }
   305:         bool positive=false, exits=false, entry=false;
   306:         auto ids=json::array(), members=json::array();
   307:         for(auto j=i;j<end;++j) {
   308:             positive|=events[j].kind!="EXIT"; exits|=events[j].kind=="EXIT"; entry|=events[j].kind=="ENTRY";
   309:             ids.push_back(events[j].id);
   310:             members.push_back({{"event_id",events[j].id},{"kind",events[j].kind},{"earliest_unix_ms",events[j].lower},
   311:                 {"latest_unix_ms",events[j].upper},{"evidence",events[j].evidence}});
   312:         }
   313:         bool pruned_positive=false,pruned_exit=false;
   314:         for(auto j=i;j<end;++j)for(const auto& dependency:boundary_dependencies)
   315:             if(dependency.at("event_hash")==ActivityStore::Digest(events[j].id)){
   316:                 pruned_positive|=dependency.at("pruned_positive").get<bool>();
   317:                 pruned_exit|=dependency.at("pruned_exit").get<bool>();
   318:             }
   319:         positive|=pruned_positive;exits|=pruned_exit;
   320:         const bool ambiguous=positive && exits;
   321:         groups.push_back({{"event_ids",ids},{"events",members},{"earliest_unix_ms",events[i].lower},
   322:             {"latest_unix_ms",upper},{"order_ambiguous",ambiguous},
   323:             {"pruned_positive",pruned_positive},{"pruned_exit",pruned_exit}});
   324:         if(sessions.empty() || (status=="CLOSED" && positive)) {
   325:             sessions.push_back({{"session_id","monitor:"+ActivityStore::Digest(json::array({state_->Scope(),target,events[i].id}).dump())},{"entry_status",entry&&!ambiguous?"CONFIRMED":"UNKNOWN"},
   326:                 {"status","ACTIVE"},{"boundary_ambiguous",ambiguous},{"event_ids",json::array()},
   327:                 {"first_earliest_unix_ms",events[i].lower},{"last_latest_unix_ms",upper}});
   328:         }
   329:         auto& session=sessions.back();
   330:         for(const auto& id:ids) session["event_ids"].push_back(id);
   331:         session["last_latest_unix_ms"]=upper;
   332:         if(ambiguous) session["boundary_ambiguous"]=true;
   333:         status=ambiguous?"AMBIGUOUS":(positive?"ACTIVE":"CLOSED");
   334:         session["status"]=status;
   335:         i=end;
   336:     }
   337:     const auto person=Person(target);
   338:     return {{"target_id",target},{"category",person.at("category")},{"person_revision",person.at("revision")},
   339:         {"entry_status",!sessions.empty() && sessions.back().at("entry_status")=="CONFIRMED"?"KNOWN":"UNKNOWN"},
   340:         {"association_revision",associations.TargetRevision(target)},
   341:         {"gate_revision",std::stoull(state_->Get("monitoring_meta","gate_revision").value_or("0"))},
   342:         {"status",status},{"continue_monitoring",status=="ACTIVE" || status=="AMBIGUOUS"},
   343:         {"possible_statuses",status=="AMBIGUOUS"?json::array({"ACTIVE","CLOSED"}):json::array({status})},
   344:         {"sessions",sessions},{"event_groups",groups},{"ignored_unqualified_gate_events",ignored},
   345:         {"session_scope","CONSERVATIVE_REPLAY_OF_QUALIFIED_OBSERVATIONS_AND_EXPLICIT_GATE_BINDINGS"}};
   346: }
   347: void MonitoringStore::CheckpointRuntime(std::int64_t cutoff,const AssociationStore& associations) {
   348:     std::set<std::string> targets;
   349:     state_->Scan("association_target",[&](const auto& id,const auto&){targets.insert(id);});
   350:     state_->Scan("monitoring_runtime",[&](const auto& id,const auto&){targets.insert(id);});
   351:     for(const auto& target:targets) {
   352:         const auto complete=Get(target,associations);
   353:         auto p=Get(target,associations,cutoff);
   354:         auto dependencies=json::array();
   355:         for(const auto& group:complete.at("event_groups")) {
   356:             bool old_positive=group.value("pruned_positive",false),old_exit=group.value("pruned_exit",false);
   357:             for(const auto& event:group.at("events")) {
   358:                 const auto lower=event.at("earliest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),upper=event.at("latest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
   359:                 if(lower+(upper-lower)/2<cutoff){old_exit|=event.at("kind")=="EXIT";old_positive|=event.at("kind")!="EXIT";}
   360:             }
   361:             if(!old_positive&&!old_exit)continue;
   362:             for(const auto& event:group.at("events")) {
   363:                 const auto lower=event.at("earliest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),upper=event.at("latest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
   364:                 if(lower+(upper-lower)/2>=cutoff)dependencies.push_back({{"event_hash",ActivityStore::Digest(event.at("event_id").get<std::string>())},{"pruned_positive",old_positive},{"pruned_exit",old_exit}});
   365:             }
   366:         }
   367:         if(p.at("status")=="NOT_STARTED"&&dependencies.empty())continue;
   368:         json seed={{"status",p.at("status")},{"entry_status","UNKNOWN"},{"session_id",nullptr},{"boundary_ambiguous",false}};
   369:         seed["boundary_dependencies"]=dependencies;
   370:         if(!p.at("sessions").empty()){const auto& s=p.at("sessions").back();seed["session_id"]=s.at("session_id");seed["entry_status"]=s.at("entry_status");seed["boundary_ambiguous"]=s.at("boundary_ambiguous");}
   371:         // No historical time, camera, event key or passage sequence survives.
   372:         state_->Put("monitoring_runtime",target,seed.dump());
   373:     }
   374: }
   375: }

    57:     static std::string Uri(const std::string& path,const char* options) {
    58:         const char* digits="0123456789ABCDEF";std::string result="file:";
    59:         for(const auto character:path) {const auto c=static_cast<unsigned char>(character);
    60:             if(c=='%'||c=='?'||c=='#'){result+='%';result+=digits[c>>4];result+=digits[c&15];}

    65:     Database(const std::string& path,bool dry_run) {

    70:             const auto live=std::filesystem::exists(wal)&&std::filesystem::exists(shm);
    71: #ifdef _WIN32
    72:             // Existing live auxiliaries stay present while SQLite uses a read-
    73:             // only WAL index. Offline immutable mode is safe only after OS
    74:             // handles have denied concurrent writers to main and existing WAL.

    80: #endif

    82:             flags=SQLITE_OPEN_READONLY|SQLITE_OPEN_URI;

   101: struct Lease {

   129: struct PauseRequest {
   130:     std::filesystem::path path;
   131:     bool keep=false;
   132:     bool active=true;
   133:     explicit PauseRequest(const std::filesystem::path& database):path(database) {
   134:         path+=".maintenance.request";
   135:         // A previous committed sweep must not lose its pause barrier if this
   136:         // recovery attempt fails before reaching physical cleanup.
   137:         keep=std::filesystem::exists(path);
   138:         Set("REQUESTED");
   139:     }
   140: #ifdef _WIN32
   141:     template<class Operation>
   142:     static void RetryMarkerOperation(Operation operation,const std::string& context,bool allow_missing=false) {
   143:         const auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+std::chrono::seconds(1);
   144:         for(;;) {
   145:             if(operation())return;
   146:             const auto code=GetLastError();
   147:             if(allow_missing&&code==ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND)return;
   148:             // CPython's Windows stat/Path.exists briefly opens the marker
   149:             // without delete sharing. Retry the atomic operation itself;
   150:             // deleting the destination first would release P1 prematurely.
   151:             const bool transient=code==ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED||code==ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION||code==ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION;
   152:             if(!transient||std::chrono::steady_clock::now()>=deadline)
   153:                 throw std::runtime_error(context+"; win32_error="+std::to_string(code)+"; retry_limit_ms=1000");
   154:             std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
   155:         }
   156:     }
   157: #endif
   158:     void Set(const char* status) {
   159:         auto temporary=path;temporary+=".tmp";
   160:         {std::ofstream stream(temporary,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);
   161:          if(!stream)throw std::runtime_error("cannot publish P1 maintenance request");
   162:          stream<<json({{"protocol",1},{"status",status}}).dump();stream.flush();
   163:          if(!stream)throw std::runtime_error("cannot persist P1 maintenance request");}
   164: #ifdef _WIN32
   165:         RetryMarkerOperation([&]{return MoveFileExW(temporary.c_str(),path.c_str(),MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)!=0;},
   166:                              std::string("cannot replace P1 maintenance request; phase=")+status);
   167: #else
   168:         std::filesystem::rename(temporary,path);
   169: #endif
   170:     }
   171:     void Remove() {
   172: #ifdef _WIN32
   173:         RetryMarkerOperation([&]{return DeleteFileW(path.c_str())!=0;},"cannot clear P1 maintenance request; phase=RESUME",true);
   174: #else
   175:         std::filesystem::remove(path);
   176: #endif
   177:         active=false;
   178:     }
   179:     void Complete(){Remove();}
   180:     ~PauseRequest(){if(active&&!keep){try{Remove();}catch(...) {/* An incomplete run may stay paused for a later recovery. */}}}
   181: };

   196: void Qualify(Row& row,const ClockAdapter& clocks,std::int64_t now) {

   204:     if(!record.is_object())return;
   205:     if(observation.contains("camera_id")) {
   206:         if(record.contains("camera_id")&&record.at("camera_id")!=observation.at("camera_id"))return;
   207:         record["camera_id"]=observation.at("camera_id");
   208:     }
   209:     if(record.contains("source_id")&&observation.contains("source_id")&&record.at("source_id")!=observation.at("source_id"))return;
   210:     if(record.contains("time_policy")&&record.at("time_policy")!="CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S")return;
   211:     record["time_policy"]="CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S";
   212:     try {
   213:         auto normalized=clocks.Normalize(record);
   214:         if(normalized.at("status")!="NORMALIZED")return;
   215:         const auto capture=normalized.at("captured_at_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
   216:         // A future assertion must not grant a longer local lifetime.
   217:         if(capture>now&&capture-now>ClockAdapter::CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs)return;
   218:         row.known=true;row.expired=capture<now-ActivityStore::RetentionMs;
   219:     } catch(const std::exception&) { /* Unknown is deleted without a new window. */ }
   220: }
   221: std::vector<Row> Inventory(sqlite3* db,const ClockAdapter& clocks,std::int64_t now) {
   222:     std::vector<Row> rows;
   223:     for(const auto* name:{"captures","deliveries","frames","outbox"}) {
   224:         auto columns=Columns(db,name);if(!columns.count("id"))continue;
   225:         const auto hash=columns.count("hash")?"hash":columns.count("fingerprint")?"fingerprint":columns.count("payload_hash")?"payload_hash":"''";
   226:         const auto body=columns.count("metadata")?"metadata":columns.count("payload")?"payload":"NULL";
   227:         const auto route=columns.count("route")?"route":"''";
   228:         Statement s(db,std::string("SELECT id,")+hash+","+body+","+route+" FROM "+name+" ORDER BY id");
   229:         while(s.Step()==SQLITE_ROW) {
   230:             Row row{name,s.Text(0),s.Text(1),s.Text(3),Parse(s.Text(2))};
   231:             if(row.hash.size()!=64 || !std::all_of(row.hash.begin(),row.hash.end(),[](unsigned char c){return (c>='0'&&c<='9')||(c>='a'&&c<='f');}))
   232:                 row.hash=ActivityStore::Digest(row.hash.empty()?s.Text(2):row.hash);
   233:             try {Qualify(row,clocks,now);} catch(const std::exception&) {}
   234:             rows.push_back(std::move(row));
   235:         }
   236:     }
   237:     return rows;
   238: }
   239: std::string LogicalKey(const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event) {
   240:     return "observe:"+json::array({activity,source,event}).dump();
   241: }
   242: std::string ContextString(const json& value,const char* key,const std::string& fallback) {
   243:     return value.contains(key)&&value.at(key).is_string()?value.at(key).get<std::string>():fallback;
   244: }
   245: bool HasExpired(sqlite3* db,const std::set<std::string>& keys,const ExpiredReference& external,
   246:                 const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event) {
   247:     if(activity.empty()||source.empty()||event.empty())return false;
   248:     const auto identity=json::array({activity,source,event}).dump();
   249:     const auto has_tombstones=!Columns(db,"retention_tombstone").empty();
   250:     for(const auto* kind:{"observe:","gate:"}) {
   251:         const auto key=std::string(kind)+identity;if(keys.count(key))return true;
   252:         if(has_tombstones) {
   253:             Statement tombstone(db,"SELECT 1 FROM retention_tombstone WHERE key_hash=? AND table_name IN ('deliveries','outbox') LIMIT 1");
   254:             tombstone.Bind(1,ActivityStore::Digest(key));if(tombstone.Step()==SQLITE_ROW)return true;
   255:         }
   256:     }
   257:     return external&&external(activity,source,event);
   258: }
   259: bool ExternalExpired(const std::string& path,const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,
   260:                      const std::string& event,const ClockAdapter& clocks,std::int64_t now) {
   261:     if(!std::filesystem::is_regular_file(std::filesystem::u8path(path)))return false;
   262:     Database reader(path,true);auto db=reader.db;Sql(db,"BEGIN");
   263:     if(HasExpired(db,{}, {},activity,source,event))return true;
   264:     const auto key=LogicalKey(activity,source,event),gate=std::string("gate:")+json::array({activity,source,event}).dump();
   265:     for(const auto* table:{"deliveries","outbox"}) {
   266:         auto columns=Columns(db,table);if(!columns.count("payload"))continue;
   267:         const auto route=columns.count("route")?"route":"''";
   268:         Statement find(db,std::string("SELECT payload,")+route+" FROM "+table+" WHERE id IN (?,?)");find.Bind(1,key);find.Bind(2,gate);
   269:         while(find.Step()==SQLITE_ROW) {
   270:             Row row{table,key,{},find.Text(1),Parse(find.Text(0))};Qualify(row,clocks,now);
   271:             if(row.expired)return true;
   272:         }
   273:     }
   274:     return false;
   275: }
   276: bool ScrubReferences(json& value,const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,
   277:                      const std::function<bool(const std::string&,const std::string&,const std::string&)>& expired) {
   278:     bool changed=false;
   279:     if(value.is_array()) {for(auto& item:value)changed=ScrubReferences(item,activity,source,expired)||changed;return changed;}
   280:     if(!value.is_object())return false;
   281:     const auto own_activity=ContextString(value,"activity_id",activity),own_source=ContextString(value,"source_id",source);
   282:     if(value.contains("binding")&&value.at("binding").is_object()) {
   283:         const auto& binding=value.at("binding");
   284:         if(binding.contains("observation_id")&&binding.at("observation_id").is_string()&&
   285:            expired(ContextString(binding,"activity_id",own_activity),ContextString(binding,"source_id",own_source),binding.at("observation_id").get<std::string>())) {
   286:             value["binding"]=nullptr;changed=true;
   287:         }
   288:     }
   289:     for(auto it=value.begin();it!=value.end();++it) {
   290:         if(it.key()=="reentry_evidence_id"&&it.value().is_string()) {
   291:             auto id=it.value().get<std::string>();auto key=Parse(id);
   292:             const bool scoped=key.is_array()&&key.size()==2&&key[0].is_string()&&key[1].is_string();
   293:             if(expired(own_activity,scoped?key[0].get<std::string>():own_source,scoped?key[1].get<std::string>():id)) {it.value()="";changed=true;}
   294:         } else changed=ScrubReferences(it.value(),own_activity,own_source,expired)||changed;
   295:     }
   296:     return changed;
   297: }
   298: json One(const std::string& configured,std::int64_t now,bool dry_run,const ClockAdapter& clocks,const ExpiredReference& external) {
   299:     const auto path=std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::u8path(configured)));
   300:     json result={{"path",PathToUtf8(path)},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"status","ERROR"}};
   301:     if(!std::filesystem::is_regular_file(path)){result["reason"]="CONFIGURED_P1_FILE_MISSING";return result;}
   302:     // Read-only inventory never creates a lease file or a tombstone table.
   303:     std::unique_ptr<Lease> owner,lease;
   304:     std::unique_ptr<PauseRequest> pause;
   305:     if(!dry_run) {
   306:         owner=std::make_unique<Lease>(path,".maintenance.lock");
   307:         if(!owner->held){result["status"]="BLOCKED_OTHER_MAINTENANCE";return result;}
   308:         pause=std::make_unique<PauseRequest>(path);
   309:         const auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+std::chrono::seconds(20);
   310:         do {
   311:             lease=std::make_unique<Lease>(path);
   312:             if(lease->held)break;
   313:             lease.reset();std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
   314:         } while(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline);
   315:         if(!lease||!lease->held){result["status"]="BLOCKED_P1_QUIESCENCE";result["pause_wait_limit_ms"]=20000;return result;}
   316:         result["pause_handshake"]="QUIESCENT";
   317:         pause->Set("CLEANING");
   318:     }
   319:     Database database(PathToUtf8(path),dry_run);auto db=database.db;
   320:     if(!dry_run)Sql(db,"PRAGMA secure_delete=ON");
   321:     Sql(db,dry_run?"BEGIN":"BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
   322:     try {
   323:         result["before"]=Stats(db,path);
   324:         auto rows=Inventory(db,clocks,now);json tables=json::object();
   325:         std::set<std::string> expired_keys;
   326:         for(const auto& row:rows)if(row.expired&&(row.table=="deliveries"||row.table=="outbox"))expired_keys.insert(row.key);
   327:         std::uint64_t expired=0,known=0,unknown=0,enrolled=0,retained=0;
   328:         for(const auto& row:rows) {
   329:             auto& stats=tables[row.table];if(stats.is_null())stats={{"before_rows",0},{"retained_rows",0},{"expired_known_rows",0},{"expired_unknown_rows",0},{"excluded_enrollment_rows",0}};
   330:             stats["before_rows"]=stats.at("before_rows").get<std::uint64_t>()+1;
   331:             const auto field=row.enrolled?"excluded_enrollment_rows":!row.expired?"retained_rows":row.known?"expired_known_rows":"expired_unknown_rows";
   332:             stats[field]=stats.at(field).get<std::uint64_t>()+1;
   333:             if(row.enrolled)++enrolled;else if(!row.expired)++retained;else {++expired;if(row.known)++known;else ++unknown;}
   334:         }
   335:         result["tables"]=tables;result["expired_rows"]=expired;result["expired_known_rows"]=known;
   336:         result["expired_unknown_rows"]=unknown;result["retained_window_rows"]=retained;result["excluded_enrollment_rows"]=enrolled;
   337:         result["unknown_policy"]="IMMEDIATE_EXPIRY_WITH_HASH_TOMBSTONE_NO_NEW_WINDOW";
   338:         std::uint64_t dependencies=0;
   339:         for(auto& row:rows)if(!row.expired&&!row.enrolled&&row.data.is_object()) {
   340:             auto expired_reference=[&](const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event){return HasExpired(db,expired_keys,external,activity,source,event);};
   341:             if(!ScrubReferences(row.data,ContextString(row.data,"activity_id",{}),ContextString(row.data,"source_id",{}),expired_reference))continue;
   342:             ++dependencies;
   343:             if(!dry_run) {
   344:                 const auto column=row.table=="captures"||row.table=="frames"?"metadata":"payload";
   345:                 // Preserve the original content hash for identical retry/conflict.
   346:                 // A changed pending body cannot be resent under the original ID.
   347:                 const auto status=Columns(db,row.table).count("status")?",status=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 'QUARANTINED' ELSE status END":"";
   348:                 Statement update(db,"UPDATE "+row.table+" SET "+column+"=?"+status+" WHERE id=?");
   349:                 update.Bind(1,row.data.dump());update.Bind(2,row.key);update.Step();
   350:             }
   351:         }
   352:         result["scrubbed_expired_dependency_rows"]=dependencies;
   353:         if(!dry_run) {
   354:             Sql(db,"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS retention_tombstone(table_name TEXT NOT NULL,key_hash TEXT NOT NULL,content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(table_name,key_hash)) WITHOUT ROWID");
   355:             for(const auto& row:rows)if(row.expired) {
   356:                 Statement tombstone(db,"INSERT INTO retention_tombstone(table_name,key_hash,content_hash) VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(table_name,key_hash) DO NOTHING");
   357:                 tombstone.Bind(1,row.table);tombstone.Bind(2,ActivityStore::Digest(row.key));tombstone.Bind(3,row.hash);tombstone.Step();
   358:                 Statement erase(db,"DELETE FROM "+row.table+" WHERE id=?");erase.Bind(1,row.key);erase.Step();
   359:             }
   360:             // Receipts are historical transaction snapshots. Canonical current
   361:             // state is queried from P2; retaining an old receipt can retain points
   362:             // from before this delivery's own capture. Enrollment is excluded.
   363:             std::uint64_t scrubbed=0;
   364:             for(const auto* table:{"deliveries","outbox"}) {
   365:                 auto columns=Columns(db,table);if(!columns.count("receipt"))continue;
   366:                 const auto predicate=columns.count("route")?" AND route<>'/v1/monitoring/persons'":"";
   367:                 Sql(db,std::string("UPDATE ")+table+" SET receipt=NULL WHERE receipt IS NOT NULL"+predicate);
   368:                 scrubbed+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_changes(db));
   369:             }
   370:             // A processed capture report may refer to a deleted observation or
   371:             // contain a legacy embedded result. Images and metadata in the valid
   372:             // capture window remain intact; current results come from P2.
   373:             auto columns=Columns(db,"captures");
   374:             if(columns.count("result")) {
   375:                 const auto predicate=columns.count("status")?"status='PROCESSED' AND ":"";
   376:                 Sql(db,std::string("UPDATE captures SET result=NULL WHERE ")+predicate+"result IS NOT NULL");
   377:                 scrubbed+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_changes(db));
   378:             }
   379:             result["scrubbed_historical_receipts"]=scrubbed;
   380:             result["tombstones"]=Scalar(db,"SELECT count(*) FROM retention_tombstone");
   381:         }
   382:         // Once committing starts, any later error must leave P1 paused until
   383:         // another run verifies both physical cleanup and marker removal.
   384:         if(!dry_run)pause->keep=true;
   385:         Sql(db,"COMMIT");
   386:         if(!dry_run) {
   387:             result["after_logical"]=Stats(db,path);
   388:             // A crash after commit must remain paused until another maintenance
   389:             // run completes the physical sweep; stale pages may still exist.
   390:             pause->Set("PHYSICAL_CLEANUP_PENDING");
   391:             // secure_delete only zeros pages freed by this connection. Earlier
   392:             // image/result updates may have freed pages before it was enabled.
   393:             // VACUUM rebuilds only reachable rows and removes those old bytes.
   394:             bool compacted=true;
   395:             try {Sql(db,"VACUUM");result["vacuum_status"]="COMPLETE";}
   396:             catch(const std::exception& error){compacted=false;result["vacuum_status"]="PENDING_READERS_OR_WRITER";result["vacuum_error"]=error.what();}
   397:             int log=0,checkpointed=0;const auto checkpoint=sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2(db,nullptr,SQLITE_CHECKPOINT_TRUNCATE,&log,&checkpointed);
   398:             result["checkpoint_status"]=checkpoint==SQLITE_OK?"COMPLETE":"PENDING_READERS";
   399:             result["checkpoint_log_frames"]=log;result["checkpointed_frames"]=checkpointed;
   400:             result["status"]=checkpoint==SQLITE_OK&&compacted?"CLEANED":"PHYSICAL_CLEANUP_PENDING";
   401:         } else result["status"]="DRY_RUN";
   402:         result["after"]=Stats(db,path);
   403:         if(!dry_run&&result.at("status")=="CLEANED") {
   404:             // Do not report COMPLETE while an ignored DeleteFile failure can
   405:             // still keep the Python runtime paused. Both leases remain held.
   406:             pause->Complete();result["maintenance_request_status"]="CLEARED";
   407:         }
   408:         return result;
   409:     } catch(...) {sqlite3_exec(db,"ROLLBACK",nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);throw;}
   410: }
   411: }
   412: json PruneP1(const std::vector<std::string>& paths,std::int64_t now,bool dry_run,const ClockAdapter& clocks,const ExpiredReference& expired_reference) {
   413:     if(now<ActivityStore::RetentionMs)throw std::invalid_argument("trusted UTC is required for P1 retention");
   414:     json databases=json::array();std::set<std::string> seen;bool complete=true;
   415:     std::vector<std::string> resolved_paths;
   416:     for(const auto& path:paths)resolved_paths.push_back(PathToUtf8(std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::u8path(path)))));
   417:     for(const auto& resolved:resolved_paths) {
   418:         if(!seen.insert(resolved).second)continue;
   419:         const auto lookup=[&](const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event){
   420:             if(expired_reference&&expired_reference(activity,source,event))return true;
   421:             for(const auto& other:resolved_paths)if(other!=resolved&&ExternalExpired(other,activity,source,event,clocks,now))return true;
   422:             return false;
   423:         };
   424:         try {auto result=One(resolved,now,dry_run,clocks,lookup);complete=complete&&(result.at("status")=="CLEANED"||result.at("status")=="DRY_RUN");databases.push_back(std::move(result));}
   425:         catch(const std::exception& error){complete=false;databases.push_back({{"path",resolved},{"status","ERROR"},{"reason",error.what()}});}
   426:     }
   427:     return {{"status",complete?"COMPLETE":"INCOMPLETE"},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"databases",databases}};
   428: }
   429: }

    13: std::vector<Point> Waypoints(const json& edge) {
    14:     const char* field=edge.contains("waypoints")?"waypoints":"route_points";
    15:     if(!edge.contains(field))return {};
    16:     const auto& value=edge.at(field);
    17:     if(!value.is_array()||value.size()<2||value.size()>4096)throw std::invalid_argument("bounded route waypoints array required");
    18:     std::vector<Point> points;
    19:     for(const auto& p:value) {
    20:         Point point{};
    21:         for(int i=0;i<3;++i) {
    22:             const auto& v=p.is_object()?p.at(i==0?"x":i==1?"y":"z"):p.at(i);
    23:             if(!v.is_number()||!std::isfinite(v.get<double>()))throw std::invalid_argument("finite route XYZ required");
    24:             point[i]=v.get<double>();
    25:         }
    26:         if((!p.is_object()&&!p.is_array())||(p.is_array()&&p.size()!=3))throw std::invalid_argument("route point must be XYZ");
    27:         points.push_back(point);
    28:     }
    29:     if(edge.contains("waypoints")&&edge.contains("route_points")&&edge.at("waypoints")!=edge.at("route_points"))
    30:         throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting route geometry aliases");
    31:     return points;
    32: }
    33: struct RouteEdge {std::string from,to,id;double cost;std::vector<Point> points;};
    34: using Routes=std::map<std::string,std::vector<RouteEdge>>;
    35: Routes RouteIndex(const json& packet) {
    36:     Routes routes;
    37:     if(!packet.contains("edges"))return routes;
    38:     if(packet.at("edges").size()>100000)throw std::invalid_argument("point graph route edge limit exceeded");
    39:     for(const auto& e:packet.at("edges")) {
    40:         RouteEdge edge{e.at("from_camera"),e.at("to_camera"),e.at("edge_id"),e.at("cost"),Waypoints(e)};
    41:         if(!std::isfinite(edge.cost)||edge.cost<0)throw std::invalid_argument("invalid route cost");
    42:         routes[edge.from].push_back(std::move(edge));
    43:     }
    44:     for(auto& [camera,edges]:routes)std::sort(edges.begin(),edges.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return a.id<b.id;});
    45:     return routes;
    46: }
    47: struct RouteResult {std::string status="UNKNOWN_NOT_IMPOSSIBLE";CameraLink link;};
    48: RouteResult Route(const Routes& routes,const std::string& from,const std::string& to,bool complete) {
    49:     using Entry=std::pair<double,std::string>;
    50:     std::priority_queue<Entry,std::vector<Entry>,std::greater<Entry>> queue;
    51:     std::map<std::string,double> costs{{from,0}};
    52:     std::map<std::string,const RouteEdge*> previous;
    53:     queue.emplace(0,from);std::size_t expansions=0;
    54:     while(!queue.empty()) {
    55:         const auto [cost,camera]=queue.top();queue.pop();
    56:         if(cost!=costs.at(camera))continue;
    57:         if(++expansions>10000)return {"SEARCH_LIMIT",{}};
    58:         if(camera==to)break;
    59:         const auto found=routes.find(camera);if(found==routes.end())continue;
    60:         for(const auto& edge:found->second) {
    61:             const auto next=cost+edge.cost;if(!std::isfinite(next))continue;
    62:             const auto old=costs.find(edge.to);
    63:             if(old!=costs.end()&&old->second<=next)continue;
    64:             costs[edge.to]=next;previous[edge.to]=&edge;queue.emplace(next,edge.to);
    65:         }
    66:     }
    67:     if(!previous.count(to))return {complete?"UNREACHABLE":"UNKNOWN_NOT_IMPOSSIBLE",{}};
    68:     std::vector<const RouteEdge*> path;
    69:     for(auto camera=to;camera!=from;) {
    70:         if(path.size()>=10000)return {"SEARCH_LIMIT",{}};
    71:         const auto* edge=previous.at(camera);path.push_back(edge);camera=edge->from;
    72:     }
    73:     std::reverse(path.begin(),path.end());CameraLink link;
    74:     for(const auto* edge:path) {
    75:         if(edge->points.empty())return {"GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE",{}};
    76:         // A gap between separately projected surfaces is not a known corridor.
    77:         if(!link.route_waypoints.empty()&&link.route_waypoints.back()!=edge->points.front())return {"DISCONNECTED_GEOMETRY",{}};
    78:         const auto skip=link.route_waypoints.empty()?0:1;
    79:         if(link.route_waypoints.size()+edge->points.size()-skip>4096)return {"SEARCH_LIMIT",{}};
    80:         link.route_waypoints.insert(link.route_waypoints.end(),edge->points.begin()+skip,edge->points.end());
    81:         link.route_edge_ids.push_back(edge->id);
    82:     }
    83:     return {"AVAILABLE",std::move(link)};
    84: }
    85: std::int64_t Integer(const json& v) {
    86:     if (!v.is_number_integer() || (v.is_number_unsigned() && v.get<std::uint64_t>() >
    87:         static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max())))
    88:         throw std::invalid_argument("point graph integer is outside int64 range");
    89:     return v.get<std::int64_t>();
    90: }
    91: CameraGraph Decode(const json& p) {

   104: bool Accepted(const SightingEvidence& e, const TrajectorySnapshot& s, const std::set<std::string>& rejected) {
   105:     return !rejected.count(e.observation_id) && e.target_id == s.target_id &&
   106:         e.link_status == TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed && e.time_source == TimeSource::UtcCapture &&
   107:         e.clock_domain == "UTC" && e.clock_uncertainty_ms >= 0 &&
   108:         e.clock_uncertainty_ms <= s.options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms;
   109: }
   110: // A third camera's overlapping time interval can make nominal neighbours
   111: // ambiguous too. Preserve the entire connected interval group's uncertainty.
   112: std::set<std::string> AmbiguousOrder(const std::vector<const SightingEvidence*>& evidence) {
   113:     const auto lower = [](const auto* e) {
   114:         return e->captured_at_unix_ms < std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() + e->clock_uncertainty_ms
   115:             ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() : e->captured_at_unix_ms - e->clock_uncertainty_ms;
   116:     };
   117:     const auto upper = [](const auto* e) {
   118:         return e->captured_at_unix_ms > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - e->clock_uncertainty_ms
   119:             ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() : e->captured_at_unix_ms + e->clock_uncertainty_ms;
   120:     };
   121:     auto intervals = evidence;
   122:     std::sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end(), [&](auto a, auto b) {
   123:         if (lower(a) != lower(b)) return lower(a) < lower(b);
   124:         return a->observation_id < b->observation_id;
   125:     });
   126:     std::set<std::string> ambiguous;
   127:     for (std::size_t begin = 0; begin < intervals.size();) {
   128:         auto end = begin + 1;
   129:         auto latest = upper(intervals[begin]);
   130:         std::set<std::string> cameras{intervals[begin]->camera_id};
   131:         while (end < intervals.size() && lower(intervals[end]) <= latest) {
   132:             latest = std::max(latest, upper(intervals[end]));
   133:             cameras.insert(intervals[end++]->camera_id);
   134:         }
   135:         if (cameras.size() > 1)
   136:             for (auto i = begin; i < end; ++i) ambiguous.insert(intervals[i]->observation_id);
   137:         begin = end;
   138:     }
   139:     return ambiguous;
   140: }
   141: void ValidateSceneBinding(const json& packet, const json& site) {
   142:     const bool model_packet = packet.value("schema", "") == "camera-point-candidate-graph@1";
   143:     for (auto key : {"unit", "to_world_matrix", "cameras"})
   144:         if (model_packet && !packet.contains(key))
   145:             throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("model candidate graph requires ") + key);
   146:     if (model_packet && site.contains("model_revision") && !packet.contains("model_binding"))
   147:         throw std::invalid_argument("model candidate graph requires model_binding for a scene with model_revision");
   148:     for (auto key : {"coordinate_frame", "unit", "to_world_matrix", "model_id", "scene_url",
   149:                      "tileset_id", "calibration_profile", "model_revision"})
   150:         if (packet.contains(key) && (!site.contains(key) || packet.at(key) != site.at(key)))
   151:             throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("point graph differs from scene: ") + key);
   152:     if (packet.contains("model_binding")) {
   153:         const auto& binding = packet.at("model_binding");
   154:         if (!binding.is_object()) throw std::invalid_argument("model_binding must be an object");
   155:         for (auto key : {"model_id", "scene_url", "tileset_id", "calibration_profile"})
   156:             if (!binding.contains(key) || binding.at(key) != site.at(key))
   157:                 throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("point graph model_binding differs from scene: ") + key);
   158:         if (binding.contains("model_revision") != site.contains("model_revision") ||
   159:             (site.contains("model_revision") && binding.at("model_revision") != site.at("model_revision")))
   160:             throw std::invalid_argument("point graph model_binding differs from scene: model_revision");
   161:     }
   162:     // Legacy hand-authored graphs may omit model provenance. Supplied spatial
   163:     // assertions must still agree with the immutable scene they reference.
   164:     std::map<std::string, const json*> catalog, annotations;
   165:     std::map<std::string, std::set<std::string>> bound;
   166:     for (const auto& c : site.at("cameras")) catalog.emplace(c.at("camera_id"), &c);
   167:     for (const auto& a : site.at("annotations")) {
   168:         const auto id = a.at("annotation_id").get<std::string>();
   169:         annotations.emplace(id, &a);
   170:         const auto camera = a.at("camera_id").get<std::string>();
   171:         if (a.at("role") == "CAMERA" && catalog.count(camera)) bound[camera].insert(id);
   172:     }
   173:     auto marker = [&](const std::string& id, const std::string& camera) -> const json& {
   174:         const auto found = annotations.find(id);
   175:         if (found == annotations.end() || found->second->at("role") != "CAMERA" ||
   176:             found->second->at("camera_id") != camera)
   177:             throw std::invalid_argument("point graph annotation differs from scene camera binding");
   178:         return *found->second;
   179:     };
   180:     if (packet.contains("cameras")) {
   181:         if (!packet.at("cameras").is_array()) throw std::invalid_argument("point graph cameras must be an array");
   182:         std::set<std::string> camera_ids;
   183:         for (const auto& camera : packet.at("cameras")) {
   184:             const auto id = camera.at("camera_id").get<std::string>();
   185:             if (!catalog.count(id) || !camera_ids.insert(id).second)
   186:                 throw std::invalid_argument("point graph has unknown or duplicate camera_id");
   187:             if (camera.contains("vcl_channel_id") && camera.at("vcl_channel_id") != catalog.at(id)->at("vcl_channel_id"))
   188:                 throw std::invalid_argument("point graph camera channel differs from scene");
   189:             if (!camera.contains("position_candidates")) {
   190:                 if (model_packet) throw std::invalid_argument("model candidate camera requires position_candidates");
   191:                 continue;
   192:             }
   193:             const auto& positions = camera.at("position_candidates");
   194:             if (!positions.is_array()) throw std::invalid_argument("position_candidates must be an array");
   195:             std::set<std::string> marker_ids;
   196:             for (const auto& p : positions) {
   197:                 const auto annotation_id = p.at("annotation_id").get<std::string>();
   198:                 const auto& a = marker(annotation_id, id);
   199:                 if (!marker_ids.insert(annotation_id).second)
   200:                     throw std::invalid_argument("duplicate point graph camera annotation");
   201:                 if (!p.contains("points") && !p.contains("local_xyz"))
   202:                     throw std::invalid_argument("point graph camera candidate requires source coordinates");
   203:                 for (auto key : {"source_scene_id", "camera_id", "role", "shape", "visible", "points"}) {
   204:                     if (model_packet && !p.contains(key))
   205:                         throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("model camera candidate requires ") + key);
   206:                     if (p.contains(key) && p.at(key) != a.at(key))
   207:                         throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("point graph camera candidate differs from scene: ") + key);
   208:                 }
   209:                 if (p.contains("local_xyz") && p.at("local_xyz") != a.at("points").at(0))
   210:                     throw std::invalid_argument("point graph camera coordinates differ from scene");
   211:                 if (p.contains("model_diagnostic")) {
   212:                     const auto& d = p.at("model_diagnostic");
   213:                     for (auto key : {"annotation_id", "camera_id"})
   214:                         if (d.contains(key) && d.at(key) != a.at(key))
   215:                             throw std::invalid_argument("point graph model diagnostic has stale camera binding");
   216:                     if (d.contains("marker_local_xyz") && d.at("marker_local_xyz") != a.at("points").at(0))
   217:                         throw std::invalid_argument("point graph model diagnostic has stale camera coordinates");
   218:                 }
   219:             }
   220:             if (model_packet && marker_ids != bound[id])
   221:                 throw std::invalid_argument("model candidate graph must preserve all scene camera positions");
   222:         }
   223:         if (model_packet) {
   224:             std::set<std::string> expected;
   225:             for (const auto& [id, positions] : bound) expected.insert(id);
   226:             if (camera_ids != expected)
   227:                 throw std::invalid_argument("model candidate graph must preserve all bound scene cameras");
   228:         }
   229:     }
   230:     for (const auto& e : packet.at("edges")) {
   231:         (void)Waypoints(e);
   232:         if(e.contains("route_coordinate_frame")&&e.at("route_coordinate_frame")!=packet.at("coordinate_frame"))
   233:             throw std::invalid_argument("route coordinate frame differs from point graph");
   234:         if(e.contains("route_geometry_kind")&&e.at("route_geometry_kind")!="TOPOLOGY_INFERRED_PATH")
   235:             throw std::invalid_argument("route geometry must remain topology inferred");
   236:         for (const auto& endpoint : {std::pair{"from_annotation_id", "from_camera"},
   237:                                      std::pair{"to_annotation_id", "to_camera"}}) {
   238:             if (model_packet && !e.contains(endpoint.first))
   239:                 throw std::invalid_argument("model candidate edge requires source annotation IDs");
   240:             if (e.contains(endpoint.first)) marker(e.at(endpoint.first), e.at(endpoint.second));
   241:         }
   242:     }
   243: }
   244: }
   245: void PointGraphStore::Put(json packet, const SiteContextStore& sites) {
   246:     for (auto key : {"graph_version", "scene_version", "source_evidence_id", "coordinate_frame"})
   247:         if (packet.at(key).get<std::string>().empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("point graph metadata is required");
   248:     for (auto key : {"topology_verified", "topology_is_complete"})
   249:         if (!packet.at(key).is_boolean()) throw std::invalid_argument("explicit topology qualification required");
   250:     ValidateSceneBinding(packet, sites.Get(packet.at("scene_version")));
   251:     for (const auto& e : packet.at("edges")) {
   252:         if (e.at("edge_id").get<std::string>().empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("point edge requires stable edge_id");
   253:         if (packet.at("topology_verified") == true && !e.value("travel_time_bound_verified", false))
   254:             throw std::invalid_argument("verified topology requires verified edge time bounds");
   255:     }
   256:     const auto graph = Decode(packet);
   257:     std::map<std::string, json> contexts;
   258:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) for (const auto& id : {edge.from_camera, edge.to_camera}) {
   259:         if (!contexts.count(id)) contexts[id] = sites.CameraContext(packet.at("scene_version"), id, "CAMERA_ID", 0);
   260:         const auto& c = contexts.at(id);
   261:         if (c.at("coordinate_frame") != packet.at("coordinate_frame"))
   262:             throw std::invalid_argument("point graph coordinate frame differs from scene");
   263:         if (c.at("status") != "BOUND_MARKER")
   264:             throw std::invalid_argument("operational point graph edge requires one bound camera position; preserve conflicting candidates separately");
   265:     }
   266:     std::sort(packet["edges"].begin(), packet["edges"].end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
   267:         return a.at("edge_id") < b.at("edge_id");
   268:     });
   269:     const auto version = graph.version, encoded = packet.dump();
   270:     auto old = state_ ? state_->Get("point_graph", version) : std::optional<std::string>{};
   271:     if (!state_) { auto it = packets_.find(version); if (it != packets_.end()) old = it->second; }
   272:     if (old && *old != encoded) throw std::invalid_argument("point graph changed without a new version");
   273:     if (state_) state_->Put("point_graph", version, encoded); else packets_[version] = encoded;
   274: }
   275: nlohmann::json PointGraphStore::Get(const std::string& version) const {
   276:     auto value = state_ ? state_->Get("point_graph", version) : std::optional<std::string>{};
   277:     if (!state_) { auto it = packets_.find(version); if (it != packets_.end()) value = it->second; }
   278:     if (!value) throw std::out_of_range("point graph version not found");
   279:     return json::parse(*value);
   280: }
   281: CameraGraph PointGraphStore::Graph(const std::string& version) const { return Decode(Get(version)); }
   282: nlohmann::json CameraPointTrace(const TrajectorySnapshot& s, const nlohmann::json& p, const SiteContextStore& sites) {
   283:     if (s.graph.version != p.at("graph_version").get<std::string>()) throw std::invalid_argument("point trace graph version mismatch");
   284:     const std::set<std::string> rejected(s.rejected_observation_ids.begin(), s.rejected_observation_ids.end());
   285:     std::vector<const SightingEvidence*> evidence;
   286:     for (const auto& e : s.evidence) if (Accepted(e, s, rejected)) evidence.push_back(&e);
   287:     std::sort(evidence.begin(), evidence.end(), [](auto a, auto b) {
   288:         return std::tie(a->captured_at_unix_ms, a->observation_id) < std::tie(b->captured_at_unix_ms, b->observation_id);
   289:     });
   290:     json observations = json::array(), order = json::array(), connections = json::array();
   291:     const auto ambiguous_order = AmbiguousOrder(evidence);
   292:     const auto routes=RouteIndex(p);
   293:     std::map<std::pair<std::string,std::string>,RouteResult> route_cache;
   294:     std::map<std::string, std::string> visit_sessions, observation_sessions, anchor_visits;
   295:     for (const auto& a : s.anchors) anchor_visits[a.anchor_id] = a.visit_id;
   296:     for (const auto& session : s.sessions) for (const auto& id : session.anchor_ids) {
   297:         const auto found = anchor_visits.find(id);
   298:         if (found != anchor_visits.end()) visit_sessions[found->second] = session.session_id;
   299:     }
   300:     for (const auto& visit : s.visits) {
   301:         const auto found = visit_sessions.find(visit.visit_id);
   302:         if (found != visit_sessions.end())
   303:             for (const auto& id : visit.observation_ids) observation_sessions[id] = found->second;
   304:     }
   305:     std::map<std::string, json> contexts;
   306:     const SightingEvidence* previous = nullptr;
   307:     for (const auto* e : evidence) {
   308:         if (!contexts.count(e->camera_id)) contexts[e->camera_id] = sites.CameraContext(p.at("scene_version"), e->camera_id, "CAMERA_ID", 0);
   309:         const auto& context = contexts.at(e->camera_id);
   310:         json positions = json::array();
   311:         for (const auto& marker : context.at("candidate_markers")) positions.push_back({
   312:             {"annotation_id", marker.at("annotation_id")}, {"source_scene_id", marker.at("source_scene_id")},
   313:             {"name", marker.at("name")}, {"local_xyz", marker.at("local_xyz")}});
   314:         observations.push_back({{"observation_id", e->observation_id}, {"camera_id", e->camera_id},
   315:             {"source_id", e->source_id},
   316:             {"captured_at_unix_ms", e->captured_at_unix_ms}, {"clock_uncertainty_ms", e->clock_uncertainty_ms},
   317:             {"attribution_evidence_id", e->attribution_evidence_id}, {"status", "OBSERVED"},
   318:             {"position_status", context.at("status")}, {"position_candidates", positions},
   319:             {"position_semantics", "CAMERA_MARKER_NOT_PERSON_FOOTPOINT"}});
   320:         if (previous) {
   321:             const auto gap = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(e->captured_at_unix_ms) -
   322:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(previous->captured_at_unix_ms);
   323:             const auto errors = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(e->clock_uncertainty_ms) +
   324:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(previous->clock_uncertainty_ms);
   325:             order.push_back({{"from_observation_id", previous->observation_id}, {"to_observation_id", e->observation_id},
   326:                 {"order_status", gap > errors ? "ORDERED" : "UNCERTAIN_CLOCK_ORDER"},
   327:                 {"physical_path_observed", false}, {"meaning", "OBSERVATION_SEQUENCE_ONLY"}});
   328:             if (previous->camera_id != e->camera_id) {
   329:                 const auto& from = observations[observations.size() - 2];
   330:                 const auto& to = observations.back();
   331:                 const auto from_session = observation_sessions.find(previous->observation_id);
   332:                 const auto to_session = observation_sessions.find(e->observation_id);
   333:                 const bool same_session = from_session != observation_sessions.end() &&
   334:                     to_session != observation_sessions.end() && from_session->second == to_session->second;
   335:                 const bool unique_positions = from.at("position_status") == "BOUND_MARKER" &&
   336:                     to.at("position_status") == "BOUND_MARKER" &&
   337:                     from.at("position_candidates").size() == 1 && to.at("position_candidates").size() == 1;
   338:                 json coordinates = json::array();
   339:                 if (same_session && unique_positions) {
   340:                     coordinates.push_back(from.at("position_candidates")[0].at("local_xyz"));
   341:                     coordinates.push_back(to.at("position_candidates")[0].at("local_xyz"));
   342:                 }
   343:                 connections.push_back({
   344:                     {"from_observation_id", previous->observation_id}, {"to_observation_id", e->observation_id},
   345:                     {"from_source_id", previous->source_id}, {"to_source_id", e->source_id},
   346:                     {"from_camera_id", previous->camera_id}, {"to_camera_id", e->camera_id},
   347:                     {"order_status", gap > errors && !ambiguous_order.count(previous->observation_id) &&
   348:                         !ambiguous_order.count(e->observation_id) ? "ORDERED" : "UNCERTAIN_CLOCK_ORDER"},
   349:                     {"drawing_status", !same_session ? "SESSION_BREAK" :
   350:                         (unique_positions ? "DRAWABLE" : "UNRESOLVED_POSITION")},
   351:                     {"coordinates", coordinates}, {"physical_path_observed", false},
   352:                     {"meaning", "DIRECT_CAMERA_POINT_CONNECTION"}});
   353:                 auto& connection=connections.back();
   354:                 connection["geometry_kind"]="CAMERA_CHORD";
   355:                 const bool ordered=connection.at("order_status")=="ORDERED";
   356:                 connection["direction_status"]=ordered?"CONFIRMED":"ORDER_UNCERTAIN";
   357:                 connection["order_confirmed"]=ordered;
   358:                 if(!coordinates.empty()) {
   359:                     connection["from_position"]=coordinates[0];connection["to_position"]=coordinates[1];
   360:                     const auto a=coordinates[0].get<Point>(),b=coordinates[1].get<Point>();
   361:                     connection["chord_distance_m"]=std::hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2]);
   362:                     const auto pair=std::make_pair(previous->camera_id,e->camera_id);
   363:                     auto found=route_cache.find(pair);
   364:                     if(found==route_cache.end())found=route_cache.emplace(pair,Route(routes,pair.first,pair.second,
   365:                         p.at("topology_verified")==true&&p.at("topology_is_complete")==true)).first;
   366:                     const auto& route=found->second;
   367:                     connection["route_status"]=route.status;
   368:                     if(route.status=="AVAILABLE") {
   369:                         auto points=json::array();for(const auto& q:route.link.route_waypoints)points.push_back({{"x",q[0]},{"y",q[1]},{"z",q[2]}});
   370:                         connection["route_waypoints"]=points;
   371:                         connection["route_edge_ids"]=route.link.route_edge_ids;
   372:                         connection["route_geometry_kind"]="TOPOLOGY_INFERRED_PATH";
   373:                     }
   374:                 }
   375:             }
   376:         }
   377:         previous = e;
   378:     }
   379:     return {{"target_id", s.target_id}, {"version", s.version}, {"scene_version", p.at("scene_version")},
   380:         {"graph_version", s.graph.version}, {"coordinate_frame", p.at("coordinate_frame")},
   381:         {"topology_verified", p.at("topology_verified")}, {"topology_is_complete", p.at("topology_is_complete")},
   382:         {"observations", observations}, {"observation_order", order},
   383:         {"drawing_mode", "CAMERA_POINT_CONNECTIONS"}, {"connections", connections},
   384:         {"detailed_walk_path_observed", false}};
   385: }
   386: }

    19: constexpr auto kMinTime = std::numeric_limits<Time>::min();
    20: constexpr auto kMaxTime = std::numeric_limits<Time>::max();
    21: 
    22: Time Integer(const json& value) {
    23:     if (value.is_number_unsigned()) {
    24:         const auto number = value.get<std::uint64_t>();
    25:         if (number > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(kMaxTime))
    26:             throw std::invalid_argument("reachability integer is outside int64 range");
    27:         return static_cast<Time>(number);
    28:     }
    29:     if (!value.is_number_integer())
    30:         throw std::invalid_argument("reachability times and limits must be integers");
    31:     return value.get<Time>();
    32: }
    33: 
    34: Time Limit(const json& options, const char* key, Time fallback, Time maximum) {
    35:     const auto value = options.contains(key) ? Integer(options.at(key)) : fallback;
    36:     if (value <= 0 || value > maximum)
    37:         throw std::invalid_argument(std::string(key) + " is outside its supported positive range");
    38:     return value;
    39: }
    40: 
    41: Time Lower(Time time, Time uncertainty) {
    42:     return time < kMinTime + uncertainty ? kMinTime : time - uncertainty;
    43: }
    44: 
    45: Time Upper(Time time, Time uncertainty) {
    46:     return time > kMaxTime - uncertainty ? kMaxTime : time + uncertainty;
    47: }
    48: 
    49: std::uint64_t Difference(Time later, Time earlier) {
    50:     // Unsigned subtraction is exact over the full int64 range when later >= earlier.
    51:     return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(later) - static_cast<std::uint64_t>(earlier);
    52: }
    53: 
    54: bool Accepted(const SightingEvidence& event, const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
    55:     return event.target_id == snapshot.target_id && !event.observation_id.empty() &&
    56:            !event.camera_id.empty() && !event.attribution_evidence_id.empty() &&
    57:            !event.source_id.empty() && event.link_status == TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed &&
    58:            event.time_source == TimeSource::UtcCapture && event.clock_domain == "UTC" &&
    59:            event.clock_uncertainty_ms >= 0 &&
    60:            event.clock_uncertainty_ms <= snapshot.options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms;
    61: }

    64: nlohmann::json PredictReachable(const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot, const json& options) {
    65:     if (!options.is_object()) throw std::invalid_argument("reachability options must be an object");
    66:     const auto as_of = Integer(options.at("as_of_unix_ms"));
    67:     const auto at = Integer(options.at("at_unix_ms"));
    68:     if (at < as_of) throw std::invalid_argument("at_unix_ms must be at or after as_of_unix_ms");
    69:     const auto horizon = Limit(options, "max_horizon_ms", 300000, 86400000);
    70:     const auto max_expansions = static_cast<std::size_t>(Limit(options, "max_expansions", 10000, 1000000));
    71:     const auto max_candidates = static_cast<std::size_t>(Limit(options, "max_candidates", 10000, 100000));
    72:     const auto max_edges = static_cast<std::size_t>(Limit(options, "max_graph_edges", 100000, 1000000));
    73:     const auto max_evidence = static_cast<std::size_t>(Limit(options, "max_evidence", 100000, 1000000));
    74:     const auto verified = options.value("topology_verified", false);
    75:     const auto complete = options.value("topology_is_complete", false);
    76:     const auto edge_wait = options.value("allow_edge_wait", true);
    77:     json result = {{"target_id", snapshot.target_id}, {"version", snapshot.version},
    78:         {"graph_version", snapshot.graph.version}, {"as_of_unix_ms", as_of}, {"at_unix_ms", at},
    79:         {"status", "UNKNOWN"}, {"reason", "NO_ACCEPTED_OBSERVATIONS"},
    80:         {"search_complete", false}, {"coverage_complete", false},
    81:         {"topology_verified", verified}, {"topology_is_complete", complete},
    82:         {"waiting_at_camera_allowed", true}, {"allow_edge_wait", edge_wait},
    83:         {"has_calibrated_probabilities", false}, {"point_position_estimated", false},
    84:         {"max_horizon_ms", horizon}, {"expansions", 0},
    85:         {"knowledge_basis", "SNAPSHOT_VERSION_AND_NOMINAL_CAPTURE_CUTOFF"},
    86:         {"ingestion_time_history_available", false},
    87:         {"candidate_cameras", json::array()}, {"candidate_edges", json::array()},
    88:         {"based_on_observation_ids", json::array()}, {"latest_observation_candidates", json::array()},
    89:         {"origins_without_graph_edges", json::array()}, {"excluded_future_observation_count", 0}};
    90:     if (snapshot.evidence.size() > max_evidence || snapshot.graph.edges.size() > max_edges) {
    91:         result["status"] = "TRUNCATED";
    92:         result["reason"] = "INPUT_RESOURCE_LIMIT";
    93:         return result;
    94:     }
    95: 
    96:     std::vector<const SightingEvidence*> accepted;
    97:     Time latest_lower = kMinTime;
    98:     Time latest_upper = kMinTime;
    99:     Time latest_nominal = kMinTime;
   100:     std::size_t future_count = 0;
   101:     const std::set<std::string> rejected(snapshot.rejected_observation_ids.begin(),
   102:                                          snapshot.rejected_observation_ids.end());
   103:     for (const auto& event : snapshot.evidence) {
   104:         if (rejected.count(event.observation_id) || !Accepted(event, snapshot)) continue;
   105:         if (event.captured_at_unix_ms > as_of) { ++future_count; continue; }
   106:         accepted.push_back(&event);
   107:         latest_lower = std::max(latest_lower, Lower(event.captured_at_unix_ms, event.clock_uncertainty_ms));
   108:         latest_upper = std::max(latest_upper, Upper(event.captured_at_unix_ms, event.clock_uncertainty_ms));
   109:         latest_nominal = std::max(latest_nominal, event.captured_at_unix_ms);
   110:     }
   111:     result["excluded_future_observation_count"] = future_count;
   112:     if (accepted.empty()) return result;
   113:     std::sort(accepted.begin(), accepted.end(), [](auto a, auto b) {
   114:         return a->observation_id < b->observation_id;
   115:     });
   116:     std::set<std::string> origin_cameras;
   117:     for (const auto* event : accepted) {
   118:         // Any event whose upper bound reaches the greatest lower bound can be last.
   119:         // Starting it before that lower bound would contradict another known event.
   120:         result["based_on_observation_ids"].push_back(event->observation_id);
   121:         const auto upper = Upper(event->captured_at_unix_ms, event->clock_uncertainty_ms);
   122:         if (upper < latest_lower) continue;
   123:         origin_cameras.insert(event->camera_id);
   124:         result["latest_observation_candidates"].push_back({
   125:             {"observation_id", event->observation_id}, {"camera_id", event->camera_id},
   126:             {"captured_at_unix_ms", event->captured_at_unix_ms},
   127:             {"earliest_unix_ms", latest_lower}, {"latest_unix_ms", upper}});
   128:     }
   129:     result["last_observation_at_unix_ms"] = latest_nominal;
   130:     result["latest_capture_bounds"] = {{"earliest_unix_ms", latest_lower}, {"latest_unix_ms", latest_upper}};
   131:     result["observation_age_ms"] = Difference(as_of, latest_nominal);
   132:     result["forecast_horizon_ms"] = Difference(at, latest_lower);
   133:     result["latest_camera_is_ambiguous"] = origin_cameras.size() > 1;
   134:     if (at < latest_upper) {
   135:         result["reason"] = "CAPTURE_TIME_OVERLAPS_QUERY";
   136:         return result;
   137:     }
   138:     if (Difference(at, latest_lower) > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(horizon)) {
   139:         result["reason"] = "OBSERVATION_TOO_OLD_FOR_HORIZON";
   140:         return result;
   141:     }
   142: 
   143:     // The snapshot graph was already normalized on rebuild. Normalize here too
   144:     // because this function is also a public library entry point.
   145:     const auto graph = NormalizeCameraGraph(snapshot.graph);
   146:     std::map<std::string, std::vector<const CameraEdge*>> outgoing;
   147:     std::set<std::string> graph_cameras;
   148:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) {
   149:         if (edge.edge_id.empty())
   150:             throw std::invalid_argument("reachability requires a stable nonempty edge_id on every edge");
   151:         outgoing[edge.from_camera].push_back(&edge);
   152:         graph_cameras.insert(edge.from_camera);
   153:         graph_cameras.insert(edge.to_camera);
   154:     }
   155:     using Pending = std::pair<Time, std::string>;
   156:     std::priority_queue<Pending, std::vector<Pending>, std::greater<Pending>> pending;
   157:     std::map<std::string, Time> arrival;
   158:     std::map<std::string, json> channels;
   159:     bool truncated = false;
   160:     for (const auto& origin : origin_cameras) {
   161:         if (!graph_cameras.count(origin)) result["origins_without_graph_edges"].push_back(origin);
   162:         if (arrival.size() == max_candidates) { truncated = true; break; }
   163:         arrival.emplace(origin, latest_lower);
   164:         pending.emplace(latest_lower, origin);
   165:     }
   166:     std::size_t expansions = 0;
   167:     while (!pending.empty() && !truncated) {
   168:         auto [time, camera] = pending.top();
   169:         pending.pop();
   170:         if (time != arrival.at(camera)) continue;
   171:         const auto edges = outgoing.find(camera);
   172:         if (edges == outgoing.end()) continue;
   173:         for (const auto* edge : edges->second) {
   174:             if (expansions == max_expansions) { truncated = true; break; }
   175:             ++expansions;
   176:             const auto departure = std::max(time, edge->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(kMinTime));
   177:             const auto last_departure = std::min(at, edge->open_until_unix_ms.value_or(kMaxTime));
   178:             if (departure > last_departure) continue;
   179: 
   180:             const auto occupancy_from = edge_wait ? departure
   181:                 : std::max(departure, Lower(at, edge->max_travel_ms));
   182:             if (occupancy_from <= last_departure) {
   183:                 if (!channels.count(edge->edge_id) && arrival.size() + channels.size() == max_candidates) {
   184:                     truncated = true; break;
   185:                 }
   186:                 channels[edge->edge_id] = {{"edge_id", edge->edge_id},
   187:                     {"from_camera", edge->from_camera}, {"to_camera", edge->to_camera},
   188:                     {"earliest_departure_unix_ms", occupancy_from},
   189:                     {"latest_departure_unix_ms", last_departure},
   190:                     {"possible_at_unix_ms", at}};
   191:             }
   192:             if (departure > kMaxTime - edge->min_travel_ms) continue;
   193:             const auto next = departure + edge->min_travel_ms;
   194:             if (next > at) continue;
   195:             const auto old = arrival.find(edge->to_camera);
   196:             if (old == arrival.end()) {
   197:                 if (arrival.size() + channels.size() == max_candidates) { truncated = true; break; }
   198:                 arrival.emplace(edge->to_camera, next);
   199:                 pending.emplace(next, edge->to_camera);
   200:             } else if (next < old->second) {
   201:                 old->second = next;
   202:                 pending.emplace(next, edge->to_camera);
   203:             }
   204:         }
   205:     }
   206:     for (const auto& [camera, time] : arrival)
   207:         result["candidate_cameras"].push_back({{"camera_id", camera}, {"earliest_arrival_unix_ms", time}});
   208:     for (const auto& [id, channel] : channels) result["candidate_edges"].push_back(channel);
   209:     const bool missing_origins = !result["origins_without_graph_edges"].empty();
   210:     result["expansions"] = expansions;
   211:     result["search_complete"] = !truncated;
   212:     result["coverage_complete"] = !truncated && verified && complete && !missing_origins;
   213:     result["status"] = truncated ? "TRUNCATED"
   214:         : verified && complete && !missing_origins ? "CANDIDATE" : "CONDITIONAL_CANDIDATE";
   215:     result["reason"] = truncated ? "SEARCH_RESOURCE_LIMIT"
   216:         : missing_origins ? "ORIGIN_NOT_REPRESENTED_IN_GRAPH"
   217:         : verified && complete ? "REACHABLE_UNDER_DECLARED_ASSUMPTIONS" : "UNVERIFIED_OR_INCOMPLETE_TOPOLOGY";
   218:     return result;
   219: }
   220: 
   221: }  // namespace face_trajectory

    17: Point ReadPoint(const json& j) {
    18:     if (!j.is_array() || j.size() != 3) throw std::invalid_argument("site point must be xyz");
    19:     Point p{};
    20:     for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
    21:         if (!j[i].is_number() || !std::isfinite(j[i].get<double>())) throw std::invalid_argument("finite site coordinates required");
    22:         p[i] = j[i].get<double>();
    23:     }
    24:     return p;
    25: }
    26: double Distance(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    27:     return std::hypot(std::hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]), a[2] - b[2]);
    28: }
    29: Point World(const json& matrix, const Point& p) {
    30:     Point out{};
    31:     for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
    32:         out[r] = matrix[12 + r].get<double>();
    33:         for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) out[r] += matrix[c * 4 + r].get<double>() * p[c];
    34:         if (!std::isfinite(out[r])) throw std::invalid_argument("site world transform overflow");
    35:     }
    36:     return out;
    37: }
    38: // A segment projection preserves heights; it is never interpreted as a walkable edge.
    39: std::pair<double, Point> Closest(const Point& p, const json& annotation) {
    40:     const auto& points = annotation.at("points");
    41:     Point best = ReadPoint(points[0]);
    42:     double distance = Distance(p, best);
    43:     const bool closed = annotation.at("shape") == "polygon";
    44:     for (std::size_t i = 1; i < points.size() + (closed ? 1 : 0); ++i) {
    45:         auto a = ReadPoint(points[i - 1]), b = ReadPoint(points[i % points.size()]);
    46:         double dot = 0, norm = 0;
    47:         for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {dot += (p[d] - a[d]) * (b[d] - a[d]); norm += (b[d] - a[d]) * (b[d] - a[d]);}
    48:         const double t = norm > 0 ? std::clamp(dot / norm, 0.0, 1.0) : 0;
    49:         Point q{}; for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) q[d] = a[d] + t * (b[d] - a[d]);
    50:         const double candidate = Distance(p, q);
    51:         if (candidate < distance) {distance = candidate; best = q;}
    52:     }
    53:     return {distance, best};
    54: }
