   115: json SiteContextStore::CameraContext(const std::string& version, const std::string& camera_ref,
   116:                                      const std::string& id_namespace, double radius_m) const {
   117:     if (camera_ref.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("camera_ref is required");
   118:     if (id_namespace != "CAMERA_ID" && id_namespace != "VCL_CHANNEL_ID") throw std::invalid_argument("explicit CAMERA_ID or VCL_CHANNEL_ID namespace required");
   119:     if (!std::isfinite(radius_m) || radius_m < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("finite nonnegative context radius required");
   120:     const auto site = Get(version);
   121:     json result = {{"scene_version", version}, {"model_id", site.at("model_id")}, {"scene_url", site.at("scene_url")},
   122:         {"calibration_profile", site.at("calibration_profile")}, {"coordinate_frame", site.at("coordinate_frame")},
   123:         {"world_coordinate_frame", site.at("world_coordinate_frame")}, {"unit", "m"},
   124:         {"source_evidence_id", site.at("source_evidence_id")}, {"camera_ref", camera_ref}, {"id_namespace", id_namespace},
   125:         {"person_position_observed", false}, {"navigation_verified", false}, {"candidate_markers", json::array()}, {"status", "UNKNOWN_CAMERA"}};
   126:     std::set<std::string> matches;
   127:     for (const auto& c : site.at("cameras")) {
   128:         const auto& ref = c.at(id_namespace == "CAMERA_ID" ? "camera_id" : "vcl_channel_id");
   129:         if (ref.is_string() && ref == camera_ref) matches.insert(c.at("camera_id").get<std::string>());
   130:     }
   131:     if (matches.empty()) return result;
   132:     if (matches.size() > 1) {result["status"] = "AMBIGUOUS_DEVICE"; result["camera_candidates"] = matches; return result;}
   133:     const auto camera_id = *matches.begin(); result["camera_id"] = camera_id;
   134:     result["status"] = "NO_PUBLISHED_CAMERA_MARKER";
   135:     std::vector<Point> positions;
   136:     for (const auto& a : site.at("annotations")) {
   137:         if (a.at("role") != "CAMERA" || a.at("camera_id") != camera_id || !a.at("visible").get<bool>()) continue;
   138:         const auto p = ReadPoint(a.at("points")[0]); positions.push_back(p);
   139:         json marker = a; marker["local_xyz"] = p; marker["world_ecef_xyz"] = World(site.at("to_world_matrix"), p);
   140:         marker["nearby_annotations"] = json::array();
   141:         for (const auto& other : site.at("annotations")) {
   142:             if (other.at("role") == "CAMERA" || !other.at("visible").get<bool>()) continue;
   143:             const auto nearest = Closest(p, other);
   144:             if (nearest.first > radius_m) continue;
   145:             json nearby = other; nearby["distance_to_geometry_m"] = nearest.first;
   146:             nearby["nearest_local_xyz"] = nearest.second;
   147:             marker["nearby_annotations"].push_back(std::move(nearby));
   148:         }
   149:         auto& nearby = marker["nearby_annotations"];
   150:         std::sort(nearby.begin(), nearby.end(), [](const auto& x, const auto& y) {
   151:             if (x.at("distance_to_geometry_m") != y.at("distance_to_geometry_m")) return x.at("distance_to_geometry_m") < y.at("distance_to_geometry_m");
   152:             return x.at("annotation_id") < y.at("annotation_id");
   153:         });
   154:         result["candidate_markers"].push_back(std::move(marker));
   155:     }
   156:     if (positions.empty()) return result;
   157:     double separation = 0;
   158:     for (const auto& a : positions) for (const auto& b : positions) separation = std::max(separation, Distance(a, b));
   159:     result["max_marker_separation_m"] = separation;
   160:     result["status"] = separation > site.at("duplicate_tolerance_m").get<double>() ? "AMBIGUOUS_POSITION" : "BOUND_MARKER";
   161:     // Never average conflicting annotations or turn a nearby landmark into a
   162:     // confirmed observation region. The caller retains all source candidates.
   163:     return result;
   164: }

   198: State::StorageStats State::Stats() const {
   199:     RequireOwner();
   200:     StorageStats stats;
   201:     auto pragma=[&](const char* sql) {
   202:         Statement s(db_,sql);s.Step();
   203:         return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_column_int64(s.value,0));
   204:     };
   205:     stats.page_size=pragma("PRAGMA page_size");
   206:     stats.page_count=pragma("PRAGMA page_count");
   207:     stats.freelist_count=pragma("PRAGMA freelist_count");
   208:     stats.reusable_bytes=stats.page_size*stats.freelist_count;
   209:     auto file_bytes=[](const std::string& path) {
   210:         if(path.empty()||path=="-wal"||path=="-shm")return std::uint64_t{0};
   211:         const auto p=std::filesystem::u8path(path);
   212:         // Sidecars are legitimately absent before/after checkpointing. Other
   213:         // failures must be reported rather than claiming a zero-byte file.
   214:         if(!std::filesystem::exists(p))return std::uint64_t{0};
   215:         return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::filesystem::file_size(p));
   216:     };
   217:     stats.main_bytes=file_bytes(path_);
   218:     stats.wal_bytes=file_bytes(path_+"-wal");
   219:     stats.shm_bytes=file_bytes(path_+"-shm");
   220:     Statement s(db_,"SELECT ns,count(*),sum(length(CAST(ns AS BLOB))+length(CAST(key AS BLOB))+length(CAST(value AS BLOB))+length(CAST(ref AS BLOB))+length(CAST(track AS BLOB))+length(CAST(meta AS BLOB))) FROM state GROUP BY ns ORDER BY ns");
   221:     while(s.Step()==SQLITE_ROW) {
   222:         NamespaceStats entry;
   223:         entry.rows=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_column_int64(s.value,1));
   224:         entry.logical_bytes=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_column_int64(s.value,2));
   225:         stats.rows+=entry.rows;
   226:         stats.logical_bytes+=entry.logical_bytes;
   227:         stats.namespaces.emplace(s.Text(0),entry);
   228:     }
   229:     return stats;
   230: }
   231: State::StorageStats State::Maintenance(bool compact) {
   232:     RequireOwner();
   233:     if(transaction_)throw std::logic_error("state maintenance requires a committed transaction");
   234:     auto checkpoint=[&]() {
   235:         int log_frames=0, checkpointed_frames=0;
   236:         const auto result=sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2(db_,nullptr,SQLITE_CHECKPOINT_TRUNCATE,
   237:                                                   &log_frames,&checkpointed_frames);
   238:         if(result!=SQLITE_OK)throw std::runtime_error(std::string("state WAL checkpoint failed: ")+sqlite3_errmsg(db_));
   239:     };
   240:     checkpoint();
   241:     if(compact) {
   242:         Sql("VACUUM");
   243:         checkpoint();
   244:     }
   245:     return Stats();
   246: }
   247: }

     8: ChainFeasibility CheckCaptureChain(std::vector<CaptureInterval> captures,
     9:     const CameraGraph& graph, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>>& overlaps,
    10:     bool complete, std::size_t budget) {
    11:     if (captures.empty()) return ChainFeasibility::Feasible;
    12:     std::sort(captures.begin(),captures.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b) {
    13:         return std::tie(a.lower,a.upper,a.camera_id)<std::tie(b.lower,b.upper,b.camera_id);
    14:     });
    15:     if (std::all_of(captures.begin(),captures.end(),[&](const auto& c){return c.camera_id==captures[0].camera_id;}))
    16:         return ChainFeasibility::Feasible;
    17:     std::map<std::string,std::vector<CameraEdge>> adjacency;
    18:     std::set<std::string> cameras;
    19:     for (const auto& e:graph.edges) { adjacency[e.from_camera].push_back(e); cameras.insert(e.from_camera); cameras.insert(e.to_camera); }
    20:     for (const auto& pair:overlaps) {
    21:         cameras.insert(pair.first); cameras.insert(pair.second);
    22:         adjacency[pair.first].push_back({pair.first,pair.second,0,0,0,{},{},""});
    23:         adjacency[pair.second].push_back({pair.second,pair.first,0,0,0,{},{},""});
    24:     }
    25:     for (const auto& c:captures) if (!cameras.count(c.camera_id)) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
    26:     bool exhausted=false;
    27:     const auto arrive=[&](const std::string& from,const std::string& to,std::int64_t start,std::int64_t end)
    28:         ->std::optional<std::int64_t> {
    29:         if (start>end) return {};
    30:         using Entry=std::pair<std::int64_t,std::string>;
    31:         std::priority_queue<Entry,std::vector<Entry>,std::greater<Entry>> queue;
    32:         std::map<std::string,std::int64_t> earliest{{from,start}}; queue.push({start,from});
    33:         while (!queue.empty()) {
    34:             auto [at,camera]=queue.top(); queue.pop();
    35:             if (earliest.at(camera)!=at) continue;
    36:             if (camera==to) return at;
    37:             for (const auto& e:adjacency[camera]) {
    38:                 if (!budget) {exhausted=true;return {}; } --budget;
    39:                 auto depart=std::max(at,e.open_from_unix_ms.value_or(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
    40:                 if (depart>e.open_until_unix_ms.value_or(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
    41:                     depart>std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()-e.min_travel_ms) continue;
    42:                 auto next=depart+e.min_travel_ms;
    43:                 if (next>end) continue;
    44:                 auto it=earliest.find(e.to_camera);
    45:                 if (it==earliest.end() || next<it->second) {earliest[e.to_camera]=next;queue.push({next,e.to_camera});}
    46:             }
    47:         }
    48:         return {};
    49:     };
    50:     std::map<std::string,std::int64_t> frontier;
    51:     for (std::size_t begin=0;begin<captures.size();) {
    52:         auto end=begin+1; auto upper=captures[begin].upper;
    53:         while (end<captures.size() && captures[end].lower<=upper) {upper=std::max(upper,captures[end].upper);++end;}
    54:         auto n=end-begin;
    55:         const bool same=std::all_of(captures.begin()+begin,captures.begin()+end,[&](const auto& c){return c.camera_id==captures[begin].camera_id;});
    56:         if (same) {
    57:             std::optional<std::int64_t> at;
    58:             if (frontier.empty()) at=captures[begin].lower;
    59:             for (const auto& [camera,time]:frontier) {
    60:                 auto t=arrive(camera,captures[begin].camera_id,time,captures[begin].upper);
    61:                 if (t && (!at || *t<*at)) at=t;
    62:             }
    63:             for (auto i=begin;at && i<end;++i) {at=std::max(*at,captures[i].lower);if (*at>captures[i].upper) at.reset();}
    64:             if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
    65:             if (!at) return complete?ChainFeasibility::Infeasible:ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
    66:             frontier={{captures[begin].camera_id,*at}};begin=end;continue;
    67:         }
    68:         if (n>12) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
    69:         const std::size_t full=(std::size_t{1}<<n)-1;
    70:         std::vector<std::optional<std::int64_t>> times((full+1)*n);
    71:         for (std::size_t i=0;i<n;++i) {
    72:             const auto& c=captures[begin+i]; auto& at=times[(std::size_t{1}<<i)*n+i];
    73:             if (frontier.empty()) at=c.lower;
    74:             for (const auto& [camera,time]:frontier) {
    75:                 auto t=arrive(camera,c.camera_id,time,c.upper);
    76:                 if (t) {t=std::max(*t,c.lower);if (!at || *t<*at) at=t;}
    77:             }
    78:         }
    79:         for (std::size_t mask=1;mask<=full;++mask) for (std::size_t last=0;last<n;++last) {
    80:             const auto at=times[mask*n+last]; if (!at) continue;
    81:             for (std::size_t next=0;next<n;++next) if (!(mask&(std::size_t{1}<<next))) {
    82:                 if (!budget) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown; --budget;
    83:                 const auto& c=captures[begin+next];
    84:                 auto t=arrive(captures[begin+last].camera_id,c.camera_id,*at,c.upper);
    85:                 if (t) {t=std::max(*t,c.lower);auto& cell=times[(mask|(std::size_t{1}<<next))*n+next];if (!cell || *t<*cell) cell=t;}
    86:                 if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
    87:             }
    88:         }
    89:         frontier.clear();
    90:         for (std::size_t last=0;last<n;++last) if (times[full*n+last]) {
    91:             const auto& camera=captures[begin+last].camera_id; const auto at=*times[full*n+last];
    92:             auto it=frontier.find(camera);if (it==frontier.end() || at<it->second) frontier[camera]=at;
    93:         }
    94:         if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
    95:         if (frontier.empty()) return complete?ChainFeasibility::Infeasible:ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
    96:         begin=end;
    97:     }
    98:     return ChainFeasibility::Feasible;
    99: }
   100: }

    19: std::vector<SightingEvidence> CanonicalSightings(
    20:     const std::string& target_id, const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings) {
    21:     std::map<std::string, SightingEvidence> by_id;
    22:     for (const auto& sighting : sightings) {
    23:         if (sighting.target_id != target_id) {
    24:             throw std::invalid_argument("all sightings must belong to target_id");
    25:         }

    27:         if (!inserted && !SameSighting(it->second, sighting)) {

    29:         }
    30:     }
    31:     std::vector<SightingEvidence> result;
    32:     result.reserve(by_id.size());
    33:     for (const auto& [id, sighting] : by_id) result.push_back(sighting);
    34:     return result;
    35: }

    46: auto EdgeKey(const CameraEdge& edge) {
    47:     return std::tie(edge.from_camera, edge.to_camera, edge.min_travel_ms,
    48:                     edge.max_travel_ms, edge.cost, edge.open_from_unix_ms,
    49:                     edge.open_until_unix_ms, edge.edge_id);

    52: CameraGraph CanonicalGraph(CameraGraph graph) {
    53:     if (graph.version.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("graph version is required");
    54:     std::set<std::string> edge_ids;
    55:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) {
    56:         if (edge.from_camera.empty() || edge.to_camera.empty() ||
    57:             edge.min_travel_ms < 0 || edge.max_travel_ms < edge.min_travel_ms ||
    58:             !std::isfinite(edge.cost) || edge.cost < 0 ||
    59:             (edge.open_from_unix_ms && edge.open_until_unix_ms &&
    60:              *edge.open_from_unix_ms > *edge.open_until_unix_ms)) {
    61:             throw std::invalid_argument("invalid camera edge");
    62:         }
    63:         if (!edge.edge_id.empty() && !edge_ids.insert(edge.edge_id).second) {
    64:             throw std::invalid_argument("duplicate camera edge_id");
    65:         }
    66:     }
    67:     std::sort(graph.edges.begin(), graph.edges.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
    68:         return EdgeKey(a) < EdgeKey(b);
    69:     });
    70:     graph.edges.erase(std::unique(graph.edges.begin(), graph.edges.end(),
    71:                                   [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
    72:                                       return EdgeKey(a) == EdgeKey(b);
    73:                                   }), graph.edges.end());
    74:     return graph;
    75: }

   119: std::optional<PathCandidate> EvaluatePath(const std::vector<const CameraEdge*>& path,
   120:                                           const Anchor& from, const Anchor& to,
   121:                                           double time_weight) {
   122:     // Search gates the route with conservative endpoints. Timing uses the outer
   123:     // feasible endpoints so actual traversals are not excluded from the output.
   124:     const auto start = from.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms;
   125:     const auto end = to.time_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms;
   126:     if (end < start) return std::nullopt;
   127: 
   128:     std::vector<std::int64_t> earliest(path.size() + 1);
   129:     std::vector<std::int64_t> latest(path.size() + 1);
   130:     earliest[0] = start;
   131:     double edge_cost = 0;
   132:     long double max_travel = 0;
   133:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.size(); ++i) {
   134:         const auto& edge = *path[i];
   135:         const auto depart = std::max(earliest[i], edge.open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
   136:             std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
   137:         if (depart > edge.open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
   138:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
   139:             !Add(depart, edge.min_travel_ms, earliest[i + 1]) || earliest[i + 1] > end) {
   140:             return std::nullopt;
   141:         }
   142:         edge_cost += edge.cost;
   143:         max_travel += edge.max_travel_ms;
   144:     }
   145:     latest.back() = end;
   146:     for (std::size_t i = path.size(); i-- > 0;) {
   147:         std::int64_t depart;
   148:         if (!Subtract(latest[i + 1], path[i]->min_travel_ms, depart)) return std::nullopt;
   149:         latest[i] = std::min(depart, path[i]->open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
   150:             std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()));
   151:         if (latest[i] < path[i]->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
   152:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()) || latest[i] < earliest[i]) {
   153:             return std::nullopt;
   154:         }
   155:     }
   156: 
   157:     PathCandidate candidate;
   158:     candidate.nodes.push_back({from.camera_id, NodeStatus::Observed,
   159:                                from.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms,
   160:                                from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms});
   161:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.size(); ++i) {
   162:         candidate.edge_ids.push_back(path[i]->edge_id);
   163:         candidate.edge_time_bounds.push_back({
   164:             std::max(earliest[i], path[i]->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
   165:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min())), latest[i + 1]});
   166:         if (i + 1 == path.size()) {
   167:             candidate.nodes.push_back({to.camera_id, NodeStatus::Observed,
   168:                                        to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms,
   169:                                        to.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms});
   170:         } else {
   171:             candidate.nodes.push_back({path[i]->to_camera, NodeStatus::Inferred,
   172:                                        earliest[i + 1], latest[i + 1]});
   173:         }
   174:     }
   175:     const auto available = static_cast<long double>(to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms) -
   176:                            static_cast<long double>(from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms);
   177:     candidate.edge_cost = edge_cost;
   178:     candidate.time_penalty = static_cast<double>(
   179:         std::max(0.0L, available - max_travel) / 1000.0L * time_weight);
   180:     candidate.score = -candidate.edge_cost - candidate.time_penalty;
   181:     return candidate;
   182: }
   183: 
   184: using RouteIdentity = std::vector<std::tuple<std::string, std::string, std::string>>;
   185: 
   186: RouteIdentity PathIdentity(const PathCandidate& candidate) {
   187:     RouteIdentity result;
   188:     result.reserve(candidate.edge_ids.size());
   189:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < candidate.edge_ids.size(); ++i) {
   190:         result.emplace_back(candidate.nodes[i].camera_id, candidate.nodes[i + 1].camera_id,
   191:                             candidate.edge_ids[i]);
   192:     }
   193:     return result;
   194: }
   195: 
   196: using CameraAdjacency = std::map<std::string, std::vector<const CameraEdge*>>;
   197: 
   198: CameraAdjacency BuildAdjacency(const CameraGraph& graph) {
   199:     CameraAdjacency adjacency;
   200:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) adjacency[edge.from_camera].push_back(&edge);
   201:     return adjacency;
   202: }
   203: 
   204: // Reverse Dijkstra gives a lower bound without coordinates or opening windows.
   205: // Ignoring windows makes the bound optimistic, so pruning cannot remove a route.
   206: std::map<std::string, std::int64_t> MinimumRemainingTravel(
   207:     const CameraGraph& graph, const std::string& destination) {
   208:     CameraAdjacency incoming;
   209:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) incoming[edge.to_camera].push_back(&edge);
   210:     using Entry = std::pair<std::int64_t, std::string>;
   211:     std::priority_queue<Entry, std::vector<Entry>, std::greater<Entry>> pending;
   212:     std::map<std::string, std::int64_t> minimum{{destination, 0}};
   213:     pending.push({0, destination});
   214:     while (!pending.empty()) {
   215:         const auto [distance, camera] = pending.top();
   216:         pending.pop();
   217:         if (distance != minimum.at(camera)) continue;
   218:         for (const auto* edge : incoming[camera]) {
   219:             std::int64_t next;
   220:             if (!Add(distance, edge->min_travel_ms, next)) continue;
   221:             const auto found = minimum.find(edge->from_camera);
   222:             if (found == minimum.end() || next < found->second) {
   223:                 minimum[edge->from_camera] = next;
   224:                 pending.push({next, edge->from_camera});
   225:             }
   226:         }
   227:     }
   228:     return minimum;
   229: }
   230: 
   231: TrajectorySegment BuildSegment(const Anchor& from, const Anchor& to,
   232:                                const CameraGraph& graph, const CameraAdjacency& adjacency,
   233:                                const TrajectoryOptions& options) {
   234:     const auto from_earliest = from.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms;
   235:     const auto from_latest = from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
   236:     const auto to_earliest = to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms;
   237:     const auto to_latest = to.time_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms;
   238:     const bool overlapping = to_earliest <= from_latest;
   239:     TrajectorySegment segment{"segment:" + from.anchor_id + ":" + to.anchor_id,
   240:                               graph.version,
   241:                               from.anchor_id, to.anchor_id,
   242:                               std::min(from_earliest, to_earliest),
   243:                               std::max(from_latest, to_latest),
   244:                               NodeStatus::Unknown, true, false, std::nullopt, {}};
   245:     // Clock-overlapping observation intervals do not establish a movement order.
   246:     if (overlapping) return segment;
   247:     const auto minimum_remaining = MinimumRemainingTravel(graph, to.camera_id);
   248:     std::vector<PathCandidate> found;
   249:     std::vector<const CameraEdge*> path;
   250:     std::set<std::string> visited{from.camera_id};
   251:     std::size_t expansions = 0;
   252:     bool expansion_limit = false;
   253:     std::function<void(const std::string&, std::int64_t)> search =
   254:         [&](const std::string& current, std::int64_t earliest) {
   255:         auto it = adjacency.find(current);
   256:         if (it == adjacency.end()) return;
   257:         for (const auto* edge : it->second) {
   258:             const bool at_destination = edge->to_camera == to.camera_id;
   259:             if (!at_destination && visited.count(edge->to_camera)) continue;
   260:             if (at_destination && edge->to_camera != from.camera_id &&
   261:                 visited.count(edge->to_camera)) continue;
   262:             const auto depart = std::max(earliest, edge->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
   263:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
   264:             std::int64_t arrival;
   265:             if (depart > edge->open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
   266:                     std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
   267:                 !Add(depart, edge->min_travel_ms, arrival) || arrival > to_earliest) {
   268:                 continue;
   269:             }
   270:             const auto remaining = minimum_remaining.find(edge->to_camera);
   271:             std::int64_t earliest_finish;
   272:             if (remaining == minimum_remaining.end() ||
   273:                 !Add(arrival, remaining->second, earliest_finish) || earliest_finish > to_earliest) {
   274:                 continue;
   275:             }
   276:             if (expansions == options.max_expansions) {
   277:                 segment.search_complete = false;
   278:                 expansion_limit = true;
   279:                 return;
   280:             }
   281:             ++expansions;
   282:             if (path.size() >= options.max_hops) {
   283:                 // The hop cap is a resource limit, never evidence of uniqueness.
   284:                 segment.search_complete = false;
   285:                 continue;
   286:             }
   287:             path.push_back(edge);
   288:             if (at_destination) {
   289:                 auto candidate = EvaluatePath(path, from, to,
   290:                                               options.travel_time_weight_per_second);
   291:                 if (candidate) found.push_back(std::move(*candidate));
   292:             } else {
   293:                 visited.insert(edge->to_camera);
   294:                 search(edge->to_camera, arrival);
   295:                 visited.erase(edge->to_camera);
   296:             }
   297:             path.pop_back();
   298:             if (expansion_limit) return;
   299:         }
   300:     };
   301:     search(from.camera_id, from_latest);
   302: 
   303:     std::sort(found.begin(), found.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
   304:         if (a.score != b.score) return a.score > b.score;
   305:         return PathIdentity(a) < PathIdentity(b);
   306:     });
   307:     std::set<RouteIdentity> seen_paths;
   308:     std::vector<PathCandidate> ranked;
   309:     for (auto& candidate : found) {
   310:         if (seen_paths.insert(PathIdentity(candidate)).second) {
   311:             ranked.push_back(std::move(candidate));
   312:         }
   313:     }
   314:     segment.unique_path = ranked.size() == 1 && segment.search_complete;
   315:     if (!ranked.empty()) {
   316:         segment.status = NodeStatus::Inferred;
   317:         segment.primary = std::move(ranked[0]);
   318:         for (std::size_t i = 1; i < ranked.size() &&
   319:                                 i < options.max_candidates; ++i) {
   320:             if (segment.primary->score - ranked[i].score > options.backup_score_margin) break;
   321:             segment.backups.push_back(std::move(ranked[i]));
   322:         }
   323:     }
   324:     return segment;
   325: }
   326: 
   327: TrajectorySnapshot BuildSnapshot(const std::string& target_id,
   328:                                  const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
   329:                                  const CameraGraph& graph,
   330:                                  const TrajectoryOptions& options,
   331:                                  std::uint64_t version) {
   332:     auto built = BuildCameraVisits(sightings, options.max_visit_gap_ms,
   333:                                    options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms, options.non_overlapping_cameras);
   334:     TrajectorySnapshot result{target_id, version, graph, options, sightings,
   335:                               std::move(built.visits), {}, {}, {},
   336:                               std::move(built.rejected_observation_ids)};
   337:     const auto adjacency = BuildAdjacency(graph);
   338:     std::sort(result.visits.begin(), result.visits.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
   339:         return std::tie(a.first_seen_unix_ms, a.last_seen_unix_ms, a.camera_id, a.visit_id) <
   340:                std::tie(b.first_seen_unix_ms, b.last_seen_unix_ms, b.camera_id, b.visit_id);
   341:     });
   342:     for (const auto& visit : result.visits) {
   343:         result.anchors.push_back({"anchor:" + visit.visit_id, visit.visit_id,
   344:                                   visit.camera_id, visit.first_seen_unix_ms,
   345:                                   visit.last_seen_unix_ms,
   346:                                   visit.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
   347:                                   visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms, visit.time_bounds});
   348:     }
   349:     std::size_t frontier = 0;
   350:     std::vector<std::size_t> tied_frontiers;
   351:     const auto refresh_frontiers = [&](std::size_t index) {
   352:         tied_frontiers.push_back(index);
   353:         std::int64_t latest_lower = std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min();
   354:         for (const auto candidate : tied_frontiers) {
   355:             const auto& anchor = result.anchors[candidate];
   356:             latest_lower = std::max(latest_lower, anchor.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms);
   357:         }
   358:         tied_frontiers.erase(std::remove_if(tied_frontiers.begin(), tied_frontiers.end(),
   359:             [&](std::size_t candidate) {
   360:                 const auto& anchor = result.anchors[candidate];
   361:                 return anchor.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms < latest_lower;
   362:             }), tied_frontiers.end());
   363:         frontier = tied_frontiers.front();
   364:     };
   365:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < result.anchors.size(); ++i) {
   366:         const auto& anchor = result.anchors[i];
   367:         bool new_session = result.sessions.empty();
   368:         if (!new_session) {
   369:             const auto& session = result.sessions.back();
   370:             const auto anchor_earliest = anchor.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms;
   371:             const auto session_latest = session.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
   372:             if (anchor_earliest > session_latest) {
   373:                 const auto difference = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(anchor_earliest) -
   374:                                         static_cast<std::uint64_t>(session_latest);
   375:                 new_session = difference > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(options.session_gap_ms);
   376:             }
   377:         }
   378:         if (new_session) {
   379:             frontier = i;
   380:             tied_frontiers = {i};
   381:             result.sessions.push_back({"session:" + anchor.anchor_id,
   382:                                        anchor.first_seen_unix_ms, anchor.last_seen_unix_ms,
   383:                                        anchor.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
   384:                                        anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
   385:                                        {anchor.anchor_id}, {}, anchor.time_bounds});
   386:             continue;
   387:         }
   388:         auto& session = result.sessions.back();
   389:         MergeCaptureTimeBounds(session.time_bounds, anchor.time_bounds);
   390:         auto segment = BuildSegment(result.anchors[frontier], anchor, graph, adjacency, options);
   391:         if (tied_frontiers.size() > 1) {
   392:             std::optional<TrajectorySegment> sole_feasible;
   393:             bool all_complete = true;
   394:             std::size_t feasible_origins = 0;
   395:             for (const auto index : tied_frontiers) {
   396:                 const auto& origin = result.anchors[index];
   397:                 auto candidate = index == frontier ? segment
   398:                                                     : BuildSegment(origin, anchor, graph, adjacency, options);
   399:                 all_complete &= candidate.search_complete;
   400:                 if (candidate.primary) {
   401:                     ++feasible_origins;
   402:                     if (feasible_origins == 1) sole_feasible = std::move(candidate);
   403:                 }
   404:             }
   405:             if (feasible_origins == 1) {
   406:                 segment = std::move(*sole_feasible);
   407:                 segment.search_complete = all_complete;
   408:                 segment.unique_path &= all_complete;
   409:             } else {
   410:                 // Clock-overlapping last observations give no supported departure camera.
   411:                 segment.status = NodeStatus::Unknown;
   412:                 segment.search_complete = all_complete;
   413:                 segment.unique_path = false;
   414:                 segment.primary.reset();
   415:                 segment.backups.clear();
   416:             }
   417:         }
   418:         session.segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
   419:         result.segments.push_back(std::move(segment));
   420:         session.anchor_ids.push_back(anchor.anchor_id);
   421:         if (anchor.last_seen_unix_ms > session.last_seen_unix_ms) {
   422:             session.last_seen_unix_ms = anchor.last_seen_unix_ms;
   423:             session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms;
   424:         } else if (anchor.last_seen_unix_ms == session.last_seen_unix_ms) {
   425:             session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(
   426:                 session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
   427:                 anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms);
   428:         }
   429:         refresh_frontiers(i);
   430:     }
   431:     return result;
   432: }
   433: 
   434: bool SamePath(const PathCandidate& a, const PathCandidate& b) {
   435:     if (a.score != b.score || a.edge_cost != b.edge_cost ||
   436:         a.time_penalty != b.time_penalty || a.edge_ids != b.edge_ids ||
   437:         a.edge_time_bounds != b.edge_time_bounds ||
   438:         a.nodes.size() != b.nodes.size()) return false;
   439:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.nodes.size(); ++i) {
   440:         if (std::tie(a.nodes[i].camera_id, a.nodes[i].status,
   441:                      a.nodes[i].earliest_unix_ms, a.nodes[i].latest_unix_ms) !=
   442:             std::tie(b.nodes[i].camera_id, b.nodes[i].status,
   443:                      b.nodes[i].earliest_unix_ms, b.nodes[i].latest_unix_ms)) return false;
   444:     }
   445:     return true;
   446: }
   447: 
   448: bool SameSegment(const TrajectorySegment& a, const TrajectorySegment& b) {
   449:     if (std::tie(a.graph_version, a.from_unix_ms, a.to_unix_ms, a.status, a.search_complete,
   450:                  a.unique_path) !=
   451:         std::tie(b.graph_version, b.from_unix_ms, b.to_unix_ms, b.status, b.search_complete,
   452:                  b.unique_path) || a.primary.has_value() != b.primary.has_value() ||
   453:         a.backups.size() != b.backups.size()) return false;
   454:     if (a.primary && !SamePath(*a.primary, *b.primary)) return false;
   455:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.backups.size(); ++i) {
   456:         if (!SamePath(a.backups[i], b.backups[i])) return false;
   457:     }
   458:     return true;
   459: }
   460: 
   461: std::vector<std::string> ChangedSegments(const TrajectorySnapshot* previous,
   462:                                          const TrajectorySnapshot& next) {
   463:     std::map<std::string, const TrajectorySegment*> old;
   464:     if (previous) {
   465:         for (const auto& segment : previous->segments) old[segment.segment_id] = &segment;
   466:     }
   467:     std::set<std::string> changed;
   468:     for (const auto& segment : next.segments) {
   469:         auto it = old.find(segment.segment_id);
   470:         if (it == old.end() || !SameSegment(*it->second, segment)) {
   471:             changed.insert(segment.segment_id);
   472:         }
   473:         old.erase(segment.segment_id);
   474:     }
   475:     for (const auto& [id, segment] : old) changed.insert(id);
   476:     return {changed.begin(), changed.end()};
   477: }
   478: 
   479: nlohmann::json AppendTailProof(const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
   480:     if(snapshot.visits.empty() || !snapshot.rejected_observation_ids.empty() ||
   481:        snapshot.visits.size()!=snapshot.anchors.size() || snapshot.sessions.empty()) return nullptr;
   482:     const auto index=snapshot.anchors.size()-1;
   483:     const auto& tail=snapshot.anchors.back();
   484:     // A strictly later observation region excludes old interleaving evidence
   485:     // that could split/merge the visit or change the incoming frontier.
   486:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<index;++i)
   487:         if(snapshot.anchors[i].time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms>=tail.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms) return nullptr;
   488:     if(snapshot.sessions.back().anchor_ids.empty() || snapshot.sessions.back().anchor_ids.back()!=tail.anchor_id) return nullptr;
   489:     nlohmann::json incoming=nullptr;
   490:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<snapshot.segments.size();++i) {
   491:         const auto& segment=snapshot.segments[i];
   492:         if(segment.from_anchor_id==tail.anchor_id) return nullptr;
   493:         if(segment.to_anchor_id==tail.anchor_id) { if(!incoming.is_null()) return nullptr; incoming=i; }
   494:     }
   495:     return {{"visit_index",index},{"anchor_index",index},{"session_index",snapshot.sessions.size()-1},{"incoming_segment_index",incoming}};
   496: }

   498: }  // namespace
   499: 
   500: CameraGraph NormalizeCameraGraph(CameraGraph graph) {
   501:     return CanonicalGraph(std::move(graph));
   502: }
   503: 
   504: std::vector<TrajectoryStore::TimedAnchor> TrajectoryStore::BuildTimelineIndex(
   505:     const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
   506:     std::map<std::string, std::size_t> observation_anchors;
   507:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < snapshot.visits.size(); ++i) {
   508:         for (const auto& id : snapshot.visits[i].observation_ids) {
   509:             observation_anchors.emplace(id, i);
   510:         }
   511:     }
   512:     std::vector<TimedAnchor> timed;
   513:     timed.reserve(observation_anchors.size());
   514:     // Evidence is in observation-ID order. Stable sorting retains its tie rule.
   515:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < snapshot.evidence.size(); ++i) {
   516:         const auto& sighting = snapshot.evidence[i];
   517:         const auto it = observation_anchors.find(sighting.observation_id);
   518:         if (it != observation_anchors.end()) {
   519:             timed.push_back({sighting.captured_at_unix_ms, it->second, i});
   520:         }
   521:     }
   522:     std::stable_sort(timed.begin(), timed.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
   523:         return a.time < b.time;
   524:     });
   525:     return timed;
   526: }
   527: 
   528: TrajectoryRevision TrajectoryStore::Rebuild(
   529:     const std::string& target_id, const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
   530:     const CameraGraph& graph, const TrajectoryOptions& input_options,
   531:     const std::string& reason, std::optional<std::uint64_t> expected_version) {
   532:     if (target_id.empty() || reason.empty()) {
   533:         throw std::invalid_argument("target_id and revision reason are required");
   534:     }
   535:     auto options=input_options;
   536:     for(auto& pair:options.non_overlapping_cameras)if(pair.second<pair.first)std::swap(pair.first,pair.second);
   537:     std::sort(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
   538:     options.non_overlapping_cameras.erase(std::unique(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end()),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
   539:     ValidateOptions(options);
   540:     auto canonical_input = CanonicalSightings(target_id, sightings);
   541:     auto canonical_graph = NormalizeCameraGraph(graph);
   542:     const auto association_revision = association_revision_reader_ ? association_revision_reader_(target_id) : 0;
   543:     const auto check_version = [&](std::uint64_t current, bool identical) {
   544:         if (expected_version && *expected_version > current)
   545:             throw std::runtime_error("VERSION_CONFLICT: expected_version is ahead of current trajectory version");
   546:         // Same current input/binding is a safe retry after an acknowledgement loss.
   547:         if (identical) return;
   548:         if ((!expected_version && current != 0) || (expected_version && *expected_version != current))
   549:             throw std::runtime_error("VERSION_CONFLICT: rebuild requires current expected_version=" + std::to_string(current));
   550:     };
   551:     if(state_) {
   552:         auto known=state_->Get("trajectory_graph",canonical_graph.version);
   553:         if(known && !SameGraph(nlohmann::json::parse(*known).get<CameraGraph>(),canonical_graph))
   554:             throw std::invalid_argument("graph edges changed without a new graph version");
   555:         auto head=state_->Get("trajectory_head",target_id);
   556:         std::optional<TrajectorySnapshot> previous;
   557:         if(head)previous=Get(target_id,std::stoull(*head));
   558:         const bool identical = previous && previous->association_revision == association_revision &&
   559:             SameSightings(previous->evidence,canonical_input) && SameGraph(previous->graph,canonical_graph) && SameOptions(previous->options,options);
   560:         check_version(previous ? previous->version : 0, identical);
   561:         if(identical)
   562:             return {target_id,previous->version,previous->version,reason,{}};
   563:         auto version=previous?previous->version+1:1;
   564:         auto next=BuildSnapshot(target_id,canonical_input,canonical_graph,options,version);
   565:         next.association_revision = association_revision;
   566:         TrajectoryRevision revision{target_id,version-1,version,reason,ChangedSegments(previous?&*previous:nullptr,next)};
   567:         next.revision=revision;
   568:         const auto key=nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump();
   569:         SharedJson shared(*state_);
   570:         std::optional<nlohmann::json> shared_previous;
   571:         if(previous) {
   572:             const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,previous->version}).dump());
   573:             if(text) { auto encoded=nlohmann::json::parse(*text); if(encoded.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") shared_previous=std::move(encoded); }
   574:         }
   575:         auto payload=shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(next),false,shared_previous);
   576:         payload["storage_format"]="refs-v2";
   577:         payload["append_tail"]=AppendTailProof(next);
   578:         state_->Put("trajectory",key,payload.dump(),target_id);
   579:         state_->Put("trajectory_head",target_id,std::to_string(version));
   580:         state_->Put("trajectory_graph",canonical_graph.version,nlohmann::json(canonical_graph).dump());
   581:         auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(next);
   582:         cold_cache_=StoredSnapshot{std::move(next),std::move(timed)};
   583:         return revision;
   584:     }
   585:     auto it = histories_.find(target_id);
   586:     if (it != histories_.end()) {
   587:         for (const auto& stored : it->second.snapshots) {
   588:             const auto& snapshot = stored.snapshot;
   589:             if (snapshot.graph.version == canonical_graph.version &&
   590:                 !SameGraph(snapshot.graph, canonical_graph)) {
   591:                 throw std::invalid_argument("graph edges changed without a new graph version");
   592:             }
   593:         }
   594:     }
   595:     const bool identical = it != histories_.end() &&
   596:         it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.association_revision == association_revision &&
   597:         SameSightings(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.evidence, canonical_input) &&
   598:         SameGraph(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.graph, canonical_graph) &&
   599:         SameOptions(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.options, options);
   600:     const auto previous_version = it == histories_.end() ? 0 : it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
   601:     check_version(previous_version, identical);
   602:     if (identical) {
   603:         const auto version = it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
   604:         return {target_id, version, version, reason, {}};
   605:     }
   606:     auto next = BuildSnapshot(target_id, canonical_input, canonical_graph, options,
   607:                               previous_version + 1);
   608:     next.association_revision = association_revision;
   609:     const auto previous = it == histories_.end() ? nullptr : &it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot;
   610:     auto affected = ChangedSegments(previous, next);
   611:     TrajectoryRevision revision{target_id, previous_version, previous_version + 1, reason,
   612:                                 std::move(affected)};
   613:     next.revision = revision;
   614:     auto timed = BuildTimelineIndex(next);
   615:     auto& history = histories_[target_id];
   616:     history.snapshots.push_back({std::move(next), std::move(timed)});
   617:     return revision;
   618: }
   619: 
   620: std::optional<TrajectoryRevision> TrajectoryStore::TryAppend(
   621:     const SightingEvidence& sighting, std::uint64_t previous_association_revision,
   622:     const CameraGraph& graph, const TrajectoryOptions& input_options,
   623:     const std::string& reason, std::uint64_t expected_version) {
   624:     if(!state_ || expected_version==0 || reason.empty() ||
   625:        LatestVersion(sighting.target_id)!=expected_version) return {};
   626:     const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({sighting.target_id,expected_version}).dump());
   627:     if(!text) return {};
   628:     auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
   629:     if(payload.value("storage_format","")!="refs-v2" ||
   630:        payload.at("association_revision").get<std::uint64_t>()!=previous_association_revision) return {};
   631:     auto options=input_options;
   632:     for(auto& pair:options.non_overlapping_cameras) if(pair.second<pair.first) std::swap(pair.first,pair.second);
   633:     std::sort(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
   634:     options.non_overlapping_cameras.erase(std::unique(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end()),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
   635:     ValidateOptions(options);
   636:     SharedJson shared(*state_);
   637:     if(!SameGraph(shared.Decode(payload.at("graph")).get<CameraGraph>(),NormalizeCameraGraph(graph)) ||
   638:        !SameOptions(shared.Decode(payload.at("options")).get<TrajectoryOptions>(),options)) return {};
   639:     // The complete builder certifies the last visit as strictly later than
   640:     // every other anchor. Missing/ambiguous certificates use the complete core.
   641:     if(!payload.contains("append_tail") || payload.at("append_tail").is_null() ||
   642:        SharedJson::Count(payload.at("rejected_observation_ids"))!=0 || !sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty()) return {};
   643:     const auto& proof=payload.at("append_tail");
   644:     const auto visit_index=proof.at("visit_index").get<std::size_t>();
   645:     const auto anchor_index=proof.at("anchor_index").get<std::size_t>();
   646:     const auto session_index=proof.at("session_index").get<std::size_t>();
   647:     auto visit=shared.At(payload.at("visits"),visit_index);
   648:     const auto last=visit.at("last_seen_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
   649:     if(visit.at("camera_id")!=sighting.camera_id || sighting.captured_at_unix_ms<=last ||
   650:        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sighting.captured_at_unix_ms)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(last)>
   651:          static_cast<std::uint64_t>(options.max_visit_gap_ms)) return {};
   652:     const auto admitted=BuildCameraVisits({sighting},options.max_visit_gap_ms,options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms,options.non_overlapping_cameras);
   653:     if(admitted.visits.size()!=1 || !admitted.rejected_observation_ids.empty()) return {};
   654:     const auto association_revision=association_revision_reader_?association_revision_reader_(sighting.target_id):0;
   655:     if(association_revision<=previous_association_revision) return {};
   656:     const auto old_bounds=visit.at("time_bounds").get<CaptureTimeBounds>();
   657:     auto bounds=old_bounds;
   658:     MergeCaptureTimeBounds(bounds,admitted.visits.front().time_bounds);
   659:     // First bounds drive incoming travel feasibility, edge windows, scores and
   660:     // session partitioning. Changing either requires full reconstruction.
   661:     if(visit_index!=0 && (bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms!=old_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms ||
   662:         bounds.first_latest_unix_ms!=old_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms)) return {};
   663:     visit["time_bounds"]=bounds;
   664:     visit["last_seen_unix_ms"]=sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
   665:     visit["last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
   666:     visit["max_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=std::max(visit.at("max_clock_uncertainty_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
   667:     shared.Append(visit["observation_ids"],sighting.observation_id);
   668:     shared.Append(visit["attribution_evidence_ids"],sighting.attribution_evidence_id);
   669:     shared.Append(visit["source_ids"],sighting.source_id);
   670:     shared.Set(payload["visits"],visit_index,visit);
   671:     auto anchor=shared.At(payload.at("anchors"),anchor_index), session=shared.At(payload.at("sessions"),session_index);
   672:     auto session_bounds=session.at("time_bounds").get<CaptureTimeBounds>();
   673:     MergeCaptureTimeBounds(session_bounds,bounds);
   674:     for(auto* item:{&anchor,&session}) {
   675:         (*item)["last_seen_unix_ms"]=sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
   676:         (*item)["last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
   677:     }
   678:     anchor["time_bounds"]=bounds; session["time_bounds"]=session_bounds;
   679:     shared.Set(payload["anchors"],anchor_index,anchor); shared.Set(payload["sessions"],session_index,session);
   680:     shared.InsertEvidence(payload["evidence"],nlohmann::json(sighting));
   681:     TrajectoryRevision revision{sighting.target_id,expected_version,expected_version+1,reason,{}};
   682:     if(!proof.at("incoming_segment_index").is_null()) {
   683:         const auto segment_index=proof.at("incoming_segment_index").get<std::size_t>();
   684:         const auto encoded=shared.At(payload.at("segments"),segment_index);
   685:         const auto old_segment=shared.Decode(encoded).get<TrajectorySegment>();
   686:         auto segment=old_segment;
   687:         const auto extend=[&](PathCandidate& candidate) {
   688:             if(candidate.nodes.empty() || candidate.nodes.back().camera_id!=sighting.camera_id)
   689:                 throw std::logic_error("invalid certified incoming trajectory endpoint");
   690:             candidate.nodes.back().latest_unix_ms=bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
   691:         };
   692:         if(segment.primary) extend(*segment.primary);
   693:         for(auto& candidate:segment.backups) extend(candidate);
   694:         if(!SameSegment(old_segment,segment)) {
   695:             revision.affected_segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
   696:             shared.Set(payload["segments"],segment_index,shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(segment),false,std::optional<nlohmann::json>(encoded)));
   697:         }
   698:     }
   699:     payload["revision"]=shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(revision));
   700:     payload["version"]=revision.version; payload["association_revision"]=association_revision;
   701:     state_->Put("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({sighting.target_id,revision.version}).dump(),payload.dump(),sighting.target_id);
   702:     state_->Put("trajectory_head",sighting.target_id,std::to_string(revision.version));
   703:     cold_cache_.reset();
   704:     return revision;
   705: }
   706: 
   707: TrajectoryReference TrajectoryStore::Reference(const std::string& target_id,std::uint64_t version) const {
   708:     if(state_) {
   709:         if(version==0) version=LatestVersion(target_id);
   710:         const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump());
   711:         if(!text) throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
   712:         const auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
   713:         if(payload.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") return {version,payload.at("association_revision"),
   714:             SharedJson::Count(payload.at("evidence")),SharedJson::Count(payload.at("anchors")),payload.at("graph").at("version")};
   715:     }
   716:     const auto& snapshot=Get(target_id,version);
   717:     return {snapshot.version,snapshot.association_revision,snapshot.evidence.size(),snapshot.anchors.size(),snapshot.graph.version};
   718: }
   719: 
   720: const TrajectorySnapshot& TrajectoryStore::Get(const std::string& target_id,
   721:                                                 std::uint64_t version) const {
   722:     if (version == 0 && association_revision_reader_) {
   723:         const auto source_revision = association_revision_reader_(target_id);
   724:         if (source_revision != 0 && LatestVersion(target_id) == 0)
   725:             throw std::runtime_error("REBUILD_REQUIRED: no trajectory for current association; target=" + target_id);
   726:         const auto& snapshot = Find(target_id, 0).snapshot;
   727:         if (snapshot.association_revision != source_revision)
   728:             throw std::runtime_error("REBUILD_REQUIRED: association revision changed; target=" + target_id +
   729:                 "; current trajectory version=" + std::to_string(snapshot.version));
   730:         return snapshot;
   731:     }
   732:     return Find(target_id, version).snapshot;
   733: }
   734: 
   735: std::uint64_t TrajectoryStore::LatestVersion(const std::string& target) const {
   736:     if (state_) return std::stoull(state_->Get("trajectory_head", target).value_or("0"));
   737:     const auto found = histories_.find(target);
   738:     return found == histories_.end() ? 0 : found->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
   739: }
   740: 
   741: nlohmann::json TrajectoryStore::Prune(std::int64_t cutoff_unix_ms, bool dry_run,
   742:                                     const std::vector<std::string>& expired_observation_ids) {
   743:     using J=nlohmann::json;
   744:     // Snapshot versions are immutable to writers, but retention redacts all
   745:     // of them. Removing only the head would leave queryable historical points.
   746:     struct Candidate {
   747:         std::string key;
   748:         TrajectorySnapshot before;
   749:         std::vector<SightingEvidence> retained;
   750:     };
   751:     std::vector<Candidate> candidates;
   752:     if(state_) {
   753:         std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> keys;
   754:         state_->Scan("trajectory",[&](const std::string& key,const std::string& value){keys.emplace_back(key,value);});
   755:         for(const auto& item:keys) {
   756:             const auto key=J::parse(item.first);
   757:             if(!key.is_array() || key.size()!=2)throw std::runtime_error("invalid persisted trajectory key");
   758:             // Explicit versions avoid the association current-head assertion.
   759:             candidates.push_back({item.first,Get(key.at(0).get<std::string>(),key.at(1).get<std::uint64_t>()),{}});
   760:         }
   761:     } else {
   762:         for(const auto& target:histories_)for(const auto& stored:target.second.snapshots)
   763:             candidates.push_back({J::array({target.first,stored.snapshot.version}).dump(),stored.snapshot,{}});
   764:     }
   765:     std::set<std::string> removed(expired_observation_ids.begin(),expired_observation_ids.end());
   766:     std::set<std::string> removed_from_snapshots;
   767:     std::uint64_t evidence_before=0,evidence_after=0,unknown_removed=0;
   768:     for(auto& item:candidates) {
   769:         for(const auto& sighting:item.before.evidence) {
   770:             ++evidence_before;
   771:             const bool qualified=sighting.time_source==TimeSource::UtcCapture && sighting.clock_domain=="UTC" &&
   772:                 sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms>=0 && sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms<=60000;
   773:             // An old snapshot has no first-quarantine provenance. Unqualified
   774:             // evidence was never usable as a point, so remove it immediately
   775:             // rather than inventing a fresh retention lease during migration.
   776:             if(!qualified || removed.count(sighting.observation_id) || sighting.captured_at_unix_ms<cutoff_unix_ms) {
   777:                 removed.insert(sighting.observation_id);
   778:                 removed_from_snapshots.insert(sighting.observation_id);
   779:                 if(!qualified)++unknown_removed;
   780:             } else {
   781:                 item.retained.push_back(sighting);
   782:                 ++evidence_after;
   783:             }
   784:         }
   785:     }
   786:     std::uint64_t rewritten=0,deleted=0,empty_versions=0,rejected_removed=0,revision_ids_removed=0,reentry_removed=0;
   787:     auto earliest=std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max();
   788:     for(auto& item:candidates) {
   789:         // A removal discovered in another historical version is authoritative
   790:         // for the same immutable observation ID throughout this scope.
   791:         item.retained.erase(std::remove_if(item.retained.begin(),item.retained.end(),[&](const auto& sighting){
   792:             if(!removed.count(sighting.observation_id))return false;
   793:             --evidence_after;
   794:             return true;
   795:         }),item.retained.end());
   796:         bool scrubbed_reentry=false;
   797:         for(auto& sighting:item.retained) {
   798:             earliest=std::min(earliest,sighting.captured_at_unix_ms);
   799:             if(!sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty() && removed.count(sighting.reentry_evidence_id)) {
   800:                 sighting.reentry_evidence_id.clear();scrubbed_reentry=true;++reentry_removed;
   801:             }
   802:         }
   803:         auto next=BuildSnapshot(item.before.target_id,item.retained,item.before.graph,item.before.options,item.before.version);
   804:         next.association_revision=item.before.association_revision;
   805:         next.revision=item.before.revision;
   806:         std::set<std::string> surviving_segments;
   807:         for(const auto& segment:next.segments)surviving_segments.insert(segment.segment_id);
   808:         auto& affected=next.revision.affected_segment_ids;
   809:         const auto affected_before=affected.size();
   810:         affected.erase(std::remove_if(affected.begin(),affected.end(),[&](const auto& id){return !surviving_segments.count(id);}),affected.end());
   811:         revision_ids_removed+=affected_before-affected.size();
   812:         std::set<std::string> surviving_rejected(next.rejected_observation_ids.begin(),next.rejected_observation_ids.end());
   813:         std::uint64_t dropped_rejected=0;
   814:         for(const auto& id:item.before.rejected_observation_ids)if(!surviving_rejected.count(id))++dropped_rejected;
   815:         rejected_removed+=dropped_rejected;
   816:         bool expired_reason=false;
   817:         for(const auto& id:removed)if(!id.empty() && next.revision.reason.find(id)!=std::string::npos){expired_reason=true;break;}
   818:         const bool changed=item.retained.size()!=item.before.evidence.size() || scrubbed_reentry ||
   819:             dropped_rejected!=0 || affected_before!=affected.size() || expired_reason;
   820:         if(next.evidence.empty()) {
   821:             ++empty_versions;
   822:             if(next.version!=LatestVersion(next.target_id)) {
   823:                 ++deleted;
   824:                 if(!dry_run) {
   825:                     if(state_)state_->Erase("trajectory",item.key);
   826:                     else {
   827:                         auto& snapshots=histories_.at(next.target_id).snapshots;
   828:                         snapshots.erase(std::remove_if(snapshots.begin(),snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){
   829:                             return stored.snapshot.version==next.version;
   830:                         }),snapshots.end());
   831:                     }
   832:                 }
   833:                 continue;
   834:             }
   835:         }
   836:         if(!changed)continue;
   837:         ++rewritten;
   838:         // Historical revision free text can embed raw observation IDs. A
   839:         // stable reason replaces it rather than retaining expired provenance.
   840:         next.revision.reason="RETENTION_PRUNE";
   841:         if(dry_run)continue;
   842:         if(state_) {
   843:             SharedJson shared(*state_);
   844:             auto payload=shared.Encode(J(next));
   845:             payload["storage_format"]="refs-v2";
   846:             payload["append_tail"]=AppendTailProof(next);
   847:             state_->Put("trajectory",item.key,payload.dump(),next.target_id);
   848:         } else {
   849:             auto& snapshots=histories_.at(next.target_id).snapshots;
   850:             const auto found=std::find_if(snapshots.begin(),snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){return stored.snapshot.version==next.version;});
   851:             if(found==snapshots.end())throw std::logic_error("trajectory history disappeared during retention");
   852:             auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(next);
   853:             *found=StoredSnapshot{std::move(next),std::move(timed)};
   854:         }
   855:     }
   856:     if(!dry_run)cold_cache_.reset();
   857:     return {{"cutoff_unix_ms",cutoff_unix_ms},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"versions_scanned",candidates.size()},
   858:         {"earliest_retained_capture_unix_ms",earliest},
   859:         {"versions_rewritten",rewritten},{"versions_deleted",deleted},{"empty_versions",empty_versions},{"evidence_before",evidence_before},
   860:         {"evidence_after",evidence_after},{"evidence_removed",evidence_before-evidence_after},
   861:         {"distinct_removed_observations",removed_from_snapshots.size()},{"unknown_time_evidence_removed",unknown_removed},
   862:         {"rejected_ids_removed",rejected_removed},{"revision_ids_removed",revision_ids_removed},{"reentry_ids_removed",reentry_removed}};
   863: }
   864: 
   865: const TrajectoryStore::StoredSnapshot& TrajectoryStore::Find(
   866:     const std::string& target_id, std::uint64_t version) const {
   867:     if(state_) {
   868:         if(version==0){auto head=state_->Get("trajectory_head",target_id);if(!head)throw std::out_of_range("target trajectory not found");version=std::stoull(*head);}
   869:         if(cold_cache_ && cold_cache_->snapshot.target_id==target_id && cold_cache_->snapshot.version==version)return *cold_cache_;
   870:         auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump());
   871:         if(!text)throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
   872:         auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
   873:         if(payload.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") {
   874:             SharedJson shared(*state_); payload=shared.Decode(payload);
   875:         } else if(payload.contains("storage_format")) {
   876:             if(payload.at("storage_format")!="refs-v1")throw std::runtime_error("unsupported trajectory storage format");
   877:             auto object=[&](const std::string& key){auto value=state_->Get("object",key);if(!value)throw std::runtime_error("missing immutable trajectory object");return nlohmann::json::parse(*value);};
   878:             payload["graph"]=object(payload.at("graph_ref").get<std::string>());
   879:             payload["evidence"]=nlohmann::json::array();
   880:             for(const auto& key:payload.at("evidence_refs"))payload["evidence"].push_back(object(key.get<std::string>()));
   881:         }
   882:         if (!payload.contains("association_revision")) payload["association_revision"] = 0;
   883:         auto snapshot=payload.get<TrajectorySnapshot>();
   884:         auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(snapshot);cold_cache_=StoredSnapshot{std::move(snapshot),std::move(timed)};
   885:         return *cold_cache_;
   886:     }
   887:     auto it = histories_.find(target_id);
   888:     if (it == histories_.end() || it->second.snapshots.empty()) {
   889:         throw std::out_of_range("target trajectory not found");
   890:     }
   891:     if (version == 0) return it->second.snapshots.back();
   892:     const auto found=std::find_if(it->second.snapshots.begin(),it->second.snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){
   893:         return stored.snapshot.version==version;
   894:     });
   895:     if(found==it->second.snapshots.end())throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
   896:     return *found;
   897: }
   898: 
   899: TimelineResult TrajectoryStore::Query(const std::string& target_id,
   900:                                       std::uint64_t version, std::int64_t at_unix_ms,
   901:                                       std::int64_t from_unix_ms,
   902:                                       std::int64_t to_unix_ms) const {
   903:     if (from_unix_ms > at_unix_ms || at_unix_ms > to_unix_ms) {
   904:         throw std::invalid_argument("timeline range must contain at_unix_ms");
   905:     }
   906:     if (version == 0) (void)Get(target_id, 0); // current reads must use current identity evidence
   907:     const auto& stored = Find(target_id, version);
   908:     const auto& snapshot = stored.snapshot;
   909:     TimelineResult result{target_id, snapshot.version, at_unix_ms, NodeStatus::Unknown,
   910:                           {}, {}, std::nullopt, std::nullopt, std::nullopt, {}, {}};
   911:     for (const auto& anchor : snapshot.anchors) {
   912:         if (anchor.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms <= to_unix_ms &&
   913:             anchor.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms >= from_unix_ms) result.anchors_in_range.push_back(anchor);
   914:     }
   915:     const auto& timed = stored.timed_anchors;
   916:     const auto error=snapshot.options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms;
   917:     const auto lower=at_unix_ms<std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()+error
   918:         ?std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min():at_unix_ms-error;
   919:     const auto upper=at_unix_ms>std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()-error
   920:         ?std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max():at_unix_ms+error;
   921:     auto possible_begin=std::lower_bound(timed.begin(),timed.end(),lower,
   922:         [](const TimedAnchor& item,std::int64_t time){return item.time<time;});
   923:     auto possible_end=std::upper_bound(possible_begin,timed.end(),upper,
   924:         [](std::int64_t time,const TimedAnchor& item){return time<item.time;});
   925:     std::set<std::string> possible;
   926:     for(auto it=possible_begin;it!=possible_end;++it){
   927:         const auto& capture=snapshot.evidence[it->evidence_index];
   928:         const auto distance=it->time<=at_unix_ms
   929:             ?static_cast<std::uint64_t>(at_unix_ms)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(it->time)
   930:             :static_cast<std::uint64_t>(it->time)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(at_unix_ms);
   931:         if(distance<=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(capture.clock_uncertainty_ms))
   932:             possible.insert(snapshot.anchors[it->anchor_index].anchor_id);
   933:     }
   934:     for(const auto& anchor:snapshot.anchors)if(possible.count(anchor.anchor_id))
   935:         result.possible_observed_anchor_ids.push_back(anchor.anchor_id);
   936:     const auto after = std::upper_bound(timed.begin(), timed.end(), at_unix_ms,
   937:         [](std::int64_t time, const TimedAnchor& item) { return time < item.time; });
   938:     const auto exact = std::lower_bound(timed.begin(),after,at_unix_ms,
   939:         [](const TimedAnchor& item,std::int64_t time){return item.time<time;});
   940:     for (auto it=exact;it!=after;++it) {
   941:         const auto& id=snapshot.anchors[it->anchor_index].anchor_id;
   942:         if (std::find(result.observed_anchor_ids.begin(),result.observed_anchor_ids.end(),id)==result.observed_anchor_ids.end())
   943:             result.observed_anchor_ids.push_back(id);
   944:     }
   945:     if (after != timed.end()) {
   946:         result.next_anchor_id = snapshot.anchors[after->anchor_index].anchor_id;
   947:         result.next_observation = TimelineObservation{
   948:             *result.next_anchor_id, snapshot.evidence[after->evidence_index]};
   949:     }
   950:     if (after != timed.begin()) {
   951:         const auto previous_time = (after - 1)->time;
   952:         const auto first_at_time = std::lower_bound(timed.begin(), after, previous_time,
   953:             [](const TimedAnchor& item, std::int64_t time) { return item.time < time; });
   954:         result.previous_anchor_id = snapshot.anchors[first_at_time->anchor_index].anchor_id;
   955:         result.previous_observation = TimelineObservation{
   956:             *result.previous_anchor_id, snapshot.evidence[first_at_time->evidence_index]};
   957:     }
   958:     const auto locate = [&](const TrajectorySegment& segment, const PathCandidate& path,
   959:                             std::size_t route_index) {
   960:         TimelinePathLocation location{segment.segment_id, route_index, {}, {}};
   961:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.nodes.size(); ++i) {
   962:             const auto& node = path.nodes[i];
   963:             if (node.earliest_unix_ms <= at_unix_ms && at_unix_ms <= node.latest_unix_ms) {
   964:                 location.node_indices.push_back(i);
   965:             }
   966:         }
   967:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.edge_time_bounds.size(); ++i) {
   968:             const auto& bound = path.edge_time_bounds[i];
   969:             if (bound.earliest_unix_ms <= at_unix_ms && at_unix_ms <= bound.latest_unix_ms) {
   970:                 location.edge_indices.push_back(i);
   971:             }
   972:         }
   973:         if (!location.node_indices.empty() || !location.edge_indices.empty()) {
   974:             result.path_locations.push_back(std::move(location));
   975:         }
   976:     };
   977:     for (const auto& segment : snapshot.segments) {
   978:         const auto start = std::min(segment.from_unix_ms, segment.to_unix_ms);
   979:         const auto end = std::max(segment.from_unix_ms, segment.to_unix_ms);
   980:         if (start <= to_unix_ms && end >= from_unix_ms) {
   981:             result.segments_in_range.push_back(segment);
   982:         }
   983:         if (start <= at_unix_ms && end >= at_unix_ms) {
   984:             result.active_segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
   985:             if (segment.primary) locate(segment, *segment.primary, 0);
   986:             for (std::size_t i = 0; i < segment.backups.size(); ++i) {
   987:                 locate(segment, segment.backups[i], i + 1);
   988:             }
   989:         }
   990:     }
   991:     if (result.active_segment_ids.size() == 1) {
   992:         result.segment_id = result.active_segment_ids[0];
   993:         const bool primary_located = std::any_of(result.path_locations.begin(), result.path_locations.end(),
   994:             [](const auto& location) { return location.route_index == 0; });
   995:         if (primary_located) result.status = NodeStatus::Inferred;
   996:     }
   997:     if (!result.observed_anchor_ids.empty()) result.status = NodeStatus::Observed;
   998:     else if (!result.possible_observed_anchor_ids.empty()) result.status = NodeStatus::Unknown;
   999:     return result;
  1000: }

    13: void MergeCaptureTimeBounds(CaptureTimeBounds& into, const CaptureTimeBounds& other) {
    14:     into.first_earliest_unix_ms = std::min(into.first_earliest_unix_ms, other.first_earliest_unix_ms);
    15:     into.first_latest_unix_ms = std::min(into.first_latest_unix_ms, other.first_latest_unix_ms);
    16:     into.last_earliest_unix_ms = std::max(into.last_earliest_unix_ms, other.last_earliest_unix_ms);
    17:     into.last_latest_unix_ms = std::max(into.last_latest_unix_ms, other.last_latest_unix_ms);
    18: }

    20: bool SameSighting(const SightingEvidence& a, const SightingEvidence& b) {
    21:     return a.observation_id == b.observation_id && a.target_id == b.target_id &&
    22:            a.camera_id == b.camera_id && a.captured_at_unix_ms == b.captured_at_unix_ms &&
    23:            a.clock_uncertainty_ms == b.clock_uncertainty_ms &&
    24:            a.attribution_evidence_id == b.attribution_evidence_id &&
    25:            a.link_status == b.link_status && a.time_source == b.time_source &&
    26:            a.source_id == b.source_id && a.clock_domain == b.clock_domain &&
    27:            a.reentry_evidence_id == b.reentry_evidence_id;
    28: }

    37: CaptureTimeBounds TimeBounds(const SightingEvidence& sighting) {
    38:     const auto time = sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
    39:     const auto error = sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
    40:     const auto lower = time < std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() + error
    41:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() : time - error;
    42:     const auto upper = time > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - error
    43:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() : time + error;
    44:     return {lower, upper, lower, upper};
    45: }
