    49: VisitBuildResult BuildCameraVisits(
    50:     const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
    51:     std::int64_t max_gap_ms,
    52:     std::int64_t max_clock_uncertainty_ms,
    53:     const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>& non_overlapping_cameras) {
    54:     if (max_gap_ms < 0 || max_clock_uncertainty_ms < 0) {
    55:         throw std::invalid_argument("time limits must be nonnegative");
    56:     }
    57:     std::unordered_map<std::string, SightingEvidence> unique;
    58:     VisitBuildResult output;
    59:     for (const auto& sighting : sightings) {
    60:         if (sighting.observation_id.empty() || sighting.target_id.empty() ||
    61:             sighting.camera_id.empty() || sighting.attribution_evidence_id.empty() ||
    62:             sighting.source_id.empty() || sighting.clock_domain.empty()) {
    63:             throw std::invalid_argument("observation, target, camera, source, clock domain and attribution evidence IDs are required");
    64:         }
    65:         auto [found, inserted] = unique.emplace(sighting.observation_id, sighting);
    66:         if (!inserted && !SameSighting(found->second, sighting)) {
    67:             throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting duplicate observation_id");
    68:         }
    69:     }
    70:     std::vector<SightingEvidence> ordered;
    71:     std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> disjoint;
    72:     for (auto pair : non_overlapping_cameras) {
    73:         if (pair.first.empty() || pair.second.empty() || pair.first == pair.second)
    74:             throw std::invalid_argument("non-overlapping camera pair must contain distinct IDs");
    75:         if (pair.second < pair.first) std::swap(pair.first, pair.second);
    76:         disjoint.insert(std::move(pair));
    77:     }
    78:     ordered.reserve(unique.size());
    79:     for (const auto& [id, sighting] : unique) {
    80:         if (sighting.link_status != TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed ||
    81:             sighting.time_source != TimeSource::UtcCapture ||
    82:             sighting.clock_domain != "UTC" ||
    83:             sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms < 0 ||
    84:             sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms > max_clock_uncertainty_ms) {
    85:             output.rejected_observation_ids.push_back(id);
    86:         } else {
    87:             ordered.push_back(sighting);
    88:         }
    89:     }
    90:     std::sort(output.rejected_observation_ids.begin(), output.rejected_observation_ids.end());
    91:     std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
    92:         if (a.target_id != b.target_id) return a.target_id < b.target_id;
    93:         if (a.camera_id != b.camera_id) return a.camera_id < b.camera_id;
    94:         if (a.captured_at_unix_ms != b.captured_at_unix_ms) return a.captured_at_unix_ms < b.captured_at_unix_ms;
    95:         return a.observation_id < b.observation_id;
    96:     });
    97:     std::map<std::string, std::vector<const SightingEvidence*>> target_evidence;
    98:     if (!disjoint.empty()) {
    99:         for (const auto& sighting : ordered) target_evidence[sighting.target_id].push_back(&sighting);
   100:         for (auto& [id, evidence] : target_evidence)
   101:             std::sort(evidence.begin(), evidence.end(), [](auto a, auto b) {
   102:                 return std::tie(a->captured_at_unix_ms, a->observation_id) <
   103:                        std::tie(b->captured_at_unix_ms, b->observation_id);
   104:             });
   105:     }
   106:     for (const auto& sighting : ordered) {
   107:         bool join = !output.visits.empty() &&
   108:             output.visits.back().target_id == sighting.target_id &&
   109:             output.visits.back().camera_id == sighting.camera_id &&
   110:             sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty() &&
   111:             static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sighting.captured_at_unix_ms) -
   112:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(output.visits.back().last_seen_unix_ms) <=
   113:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(max_gap_ms);
   114:         std::string boundary;
   115:         if (join && !disjoint.empty()) {
   116:             const auto lower = output.visits.back().time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
   117:             const auto upper = TimeBounds(sighting).first_earliest_unix_ms;
   118:             const auto& evidence = target_evidence.at(sighting.target_id);
   119:             auto begin = std::upper_bound(evidence.begin(), evidence.end(), lower,
   120:                 [](auto time, auto item) { return time < item->captured_at_unix_ms; });
   121:             for (auto it = begin; it != evidence.end() && (*it)->captured_at_unix_ms < upper; ++it) {
   122:                 const auto& other = **it;
   123:                 auto pair = std::minmax(sighting.camera_id, other.camera_id);
   124:                 const auto bounds = TimeBounds(other);
   125:                 if (disjoint.count({pair.first, pair.second}) &&
   126:                     bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms > lower && bounds.last_latest_unix_ms < upper) {
   127:                     join = false;
   128:                     boundary = other.observation_id;
   129:                     break;
   130:                 }
   131:             }
   132:         }
   133:         if (join) {
   134:             auto& visit = output.visits.back();
   135:             MergeCaptureTimeBounds(visit.time_bounds, TimeBounds(sighting));
   136:             if (sighting.captured_at_unix_ms == visit.first_seen_unix_ms) {
   137:                 visit.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(
   138:                     visit.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms, sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
   139:             }
   140:             if (sighting.captured_at_unix_ms > visit.last_seen_unix_ms) {
   141:                 visit.last_seen_unix_ms = sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
   142:                 visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
   143:             } else {
   144:                 visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(
   145:                     visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms, sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
   146:             }
   147:             visit.max_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(visit.max_clock_uncertainty_ms,
   148:                                                      sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
   149:             visit.observation_ids.push_back(sighting.observation_id);
   150:             visit.attribution_evidence_ids.push_back(sighting.attribution_evidence_id);
   151:             visit.source_ids.push_back(sighting.source_id);
   152:         } else {
   153:             output.visits.push_back({VisitId(sighting), sighting.target_id, sighting.camera_id,
   154:                                      sighting.captured_at_unix_ms, sighting.captured_at_unix_ms,
   155:                                      sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms, sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms,
   156:                                      sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms,
   157:                                      {sighting.observation_id}, {sighting.attribution_evidence_id},
   158:                                      {sighting.source_id},
   159:                                      sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty()
   160:                                          ? std::vector<std::string>{}
   161:                                          : std::vector<std::string>{sighting.reentry_evidence_id},
   162:                                      TimeBounds(sighting)});
   163:             output.visits.back().boundary_observation_id = boundary;
   164:         }
   165:     }
   166:     return output;
   167: }
   168: 
   169: std::vector<CameraVisit> BuildRawTrajectory(
   170:     const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
   171:     std::int64_t max_gap_ms,
   172:     std::int64_t max_clock_uncertainty_ms,
   173:     const std::string& target_id) {
   174:     if (target_id.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("target_id is required");
   175:     std::vector<SightingEvidence> matching;
   176:     for (const auto& sighting : sightings) {
   177:         if (sighting.target_id == target_id) matching.push_back(sighting);
   178:     }
   179:     const auto built = BuildCameraVisits(matching, max_gap_ms, max_clock_uncertainty_ms);
   180:     std::vector<CameraVisit> trajectory;
   181:     for (const auto& visit : built.visits) {
   182:         if (visit.target_id != target_id) continue;
   183:         trajectory.push_back(visit);
   184:     }
   185:     std::sort(trajectory.begin(), trajectory.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
   186:         if (a.first_seen_unix_ms != b.first_seen_unix_ms) return a.first_seen_unix_ms < b.first_seen_unix_ms;
   187:         if (a.last_seen_unix_ms != b.last_seen_unix_ms) return a.last_seen_unix_ms < b.last_seen_unix_ms;
   188:         return a.camera_id < b.camera_id;
   189:     });
   190:     return trajectory;
   191: }

   124:             {"first_latest_unix_ms", bounds.first_latest_unix_ms},
   125:             {"last_earliest_unix_ms", bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms},
   126:             {"last_latest_unix_ms", bounds.last_latest_unix_ms}};
   127: }

   139:                           {"last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms", visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms},
   140:                           {"max_clock_uncertainty_ms", visit.max_clock_uncertainty_ms},
   141:                           {"time_bounds", TimeBoundsToJson(visit.time_bounds)},
   142:                           {"observation_ids", visit.observation_ids},
   143:                           {"attribution_evidence_ids", visit.attribution_evidence_ids},
   144:                           {"resolution_ids", visit.attribution_evidence_ids},
   145:                           {"source_ids", visit.source_ids},
   146:                           {"reentry_evidence_ids", visit.reentry_evidence_ids},
   147:                           {"boundary_observation_id", visit.boundary_observation_id}});
   148:     }
   149:     return result;
   150: }
   151: 
   152: std::size_t ReadSize(const json& value) {
   153:     const auto number = ReadInt64(value);
   154:     if (number < 1 || static_cast<std::uint64_t>(number) >
   155:             static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max())) {
   156:         throw std::invalid_argument("positive size is required");
   157:     }
   158:     return static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
   159: }
   160: 
   161: face_trajectory::TrajectoryOptions ReadOptions(const json& request) {
   162:     face_trajectory::TrajectoryOptions options;
   163:     if (!request.contains("options")) return options;
   164:     const auto& value = request.at("options");
   165:     if (value.contains("non_overlapping_cameras"))
   166:         options.non_overlapping_cameras = value.at("non_overlapping_cameras").get<std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>>();
   167:     if (value.contains("max_visit_gap_ms")) options.max_visit_gap_ms = ReadInt64(value.at("max_visit_gap_ms"));
   168:     if (value.contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms")) options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms = ReadInt64(value.at("max_clock_uncertainty_ms"));
   169:     if (value.contains("session_gap_ms")) options.session_gap_ms = ReadInt64(value.at("session_gap_ms"));
   170:     if (value.contains("max_hops")) options.max_hops = ReadSize(value.at("max_hops"));
   171:     if (value.contains("max_expansions")) options.max_expansions = ReadSize(value.at("max_expansions"));
   172:     if (value.contains("max_candidates")) options.max_candidates = ReadSize(value.at("max_candidates"));
   173:     if (value.contains("backup_score_margin")) options.backup_score_margin = value.at("backup_score_margin").get<double>();
   174:     if (value.contains("travel_time_weight_per_second")) {
   175:         options.travel_time_weight_per_second = value.at("travel_time_weight_per_second").get<double>();
   176:     }
   177:     return options;
   178: }
   179: 
   180: face_trajectory::CameraGraph ReadGraph(const json& value) {
   181:     face_trajectory::CameraGraph graph;
   182:     graph.version = value.at("version").get<std::string>();
   183:     for (const auto& item : value.at("edges")) {
   184:         face_trajectory::CameraEdge edge{
   185:             item.at("from_camera").get<std::string>(),
   186:             item.at("to_camera").get<std::string>(),
   187:             ReadInt64(item.at("min_travel_ms")), ReadInt64(item.at("max_travel_ms")),
   188:             item.at("cost").get<double>(), std::nullopt, std::nullopt,
   189:             item.value("edge_id", std::string{})};
   190:         if (item.contains("open_from_unix_ms")) edge.open_from_unix_ms = ReadInt64(item.at("open_from_unix_ms"));
   191:         if (item.contains("open_until_unix_ms")) edge.open_until_unix_ms = ReadInt64(item.at("open_until_unix_ms"));
   192:         graph.edges.push_back(std::move(edge));
   193:     }
   194:     return graph;
   195: }

   197: face_trajectory::FaceObservation ReadFaceObservation(const json& o) {
   198:     return {o.at("observation_id").get<std::string>(), o.at("source_id").get<std::string>(),
   199:         o.at("camera_id").get<std::string>(), o.at("frame_id").get<std::string>(),
   200:         ReadInt64(o.at("captured_at_unix_ms")), ReadInt64(o.at("clock_uncertainty_ms")),
   201:         ReadTimeSource(o.at("time_source").get<std::string>()), o.at("clock_domain").get<std::string>(),
   202:         ReadSpace(o.at("feature_space")), ReadEmbedding(o.at("embedding")),
   203:         o.at("detection_score").get<double>(), o.at("face_size_px").get<double>(),
   204:         o.value("local_track_id", std::string{}), o.value("track_session_id", std::string{}),
   205:         o.value("reentry_evidence_id", std::string{})};
   206: }

   208: face_trajectory::AssociationPolicy ReadAssociationPolicy(const json& p) {
   209:     face_trajectory::AssociationPolicy policy;
   210:     policy.policy_id = p.at("policy_id").get<std::string>();
   211:     policy.match_threshold = p.at("match_threshold").get<double>();
   212:     policy.new_target_threshold = p.at("new_target_threshold").get<double>();
   213:     policy.min_margin = p.at("min_margin").get<double>();
   214:     policy.template_update_threshold = p.at("template_update_threshold").get<double>();
   215:     policy.max_template_similarity = p.at("max_template_similarity").get<double>();
   216:     if (p.contains("min_detection_score")) policy.min_detection_score = p.at("min_detection_score").get<double>();
   217:     if (p.contains("min_face_size_px")) policy.min_face_size_px = p.at("min_face_size_px").get<double>();
   218:     if (p.contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms")) policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms = ReadInt64(p.at("max_clock_uncertainty_ms"));
   219:     if (p.contains("max_templates_per_target")) policy.max_templates_per_target = ReadSize(p.at("max_templates_per_target"));
   220:     policy.require_topology = p.value("require_topology", false);
   221:     policy.topology_is_complete = p.value("topology_is_complete", false);
   222:     if (p.contains("overlapping_cameras")) {
   223:         for (const auto& pair : p.at("overlapping_cameras")) {
   224:             if (!pair.is_array() || pair.size() != 2) throw std::invalid_argument("camera overlap must be a pair");
   225:             policy.overlapping_cameras.emplace_back(pair[0].get<std::string>(), pair[1].get<std::string>());
   226:         }
   227:     }
   228:     return policy;
   229: }

   281: json AssociationToJson(const face_trajectory::AssociationResult& result) {
   282:     json candidates = json::array();
   283:     for (const auto& candidate : result.candidates) {
   284:         candidates.push_back({{"target_id", candidate.hit.person_entity_id},
   285:             {"template_id", candidate.hit.template_id}, {"similarity", candidate.hit.similarity},
   286:             {"camera_compatibility", CompatibilityName(candidate.compatibility)}});
   287:     }
   288:     return {{"observation_id", result.observation_id}, {"decision", result.decision},
   289:         {"reason", result.reason}, {"version", result.version}, {"policy_id", result.policy_id},
   290:         {"graph_version", result.graph_version},
   291:         {"target_id", result.target_id ? json(*result.target_id) : json(nullptr)},
   292:         {"sighting", result.sighting ? EvidenceToJson(*result.sighting) : json(nullptr)},
   293:         {"candidates", candidates}, {"affected_target_ids", result.affected_target_ids},
   294:         {"template_added", result.template_added},
   295:         {"remaining_similarity_upper_bound", result.remaining_similarity_upper_bound ? json(*result.remaining_similarity_upper_bound) : json(nullptr)}};
   296: }

   304: json GraphToJson(const face_trajectory::CameraGraph& graph) {
   305:     json edges = json::array();
   306:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) {
   307:         json item = {{"from_camera", edge.from_camera}, {"to_camera", edge.to_camera},
   308:                      {"min_travel_ms", edge.min_travel_ms},
   309:                      {"max_travel_ms", edge.max_travel_ms}, {"cost", edge.cost}};
   310:         if (!edge.edge_id.empty()) item["edge_id"] = edge.edge_id;
   311:         if (edge.open_from_unix_ms) item["open_from_unix_ms"] = *edge.open_from_unix_ms;
   312:         if (edge.open_until_unix_ms) item["open_until_unix_ms"] = *edge.open_until_unix_ms;
   313:         edges.push_back(std::move(item));
   314:     }
   315:     return {{"version", graph.version}, {"edges", edges}};
   316: }

   340: json CandidateToJson(const face_trajectory::PathCandidate& candidate) {
   341:     json nodes = json::array();
   342:     for (const auto& node : candidate.nodes) {
   343:         nodes.push_back({{"camera_id", node.camera_id}, {"status", StatusName(node.status)},
   344:                          {"earliest_unix_ms", node.earliest_unix_ms},
   345:                          {"latest_unix_ms", node.latest_unix_ms}});
   346:     }
   347:     json bounds = json::array();
   348:     for (const auto& bound : candidate.edge_time_bounds) {
   349:         bounds.push_back({{"earliest_unix_ms", bound.earliest_unix_ms},
   350:                           {"latest_unix_ms", bound.latest_unix_ms}});
   351:     }
   352:     return {{"nodes", nodes}, {"edge_ids", candidate.edge_ids}, {"edge_time_bounds", bounds},
   353:             {"score", candidate.score},
   354:             {"edge_cost", candidate.edge_cost}, {"time_penalty", candidate.time_penalty}};
   355: }
   356: 
   357: json SegmentToJson(const face_trajectory::TrajectorySegment& segment) {
   358:     json backups = json::array();
   359:     for (const auto& backup : segment.backups) backups.push_back(CandidateToJson(backup));
   360:     return {{"segment_id", segment.segment_id},
   361:             {"graph_version", segment.graph_version},
   362:             {"from_anchor_id", segment.from_anchor_id},
   363:             {"to_anchor_id", segment.to_anchor_id},
   364:             {"from_unix_ms", segment.from_unix_ms},
   365:             {"to_unix_ms", segment.to_unix_ms},
   366:             {"status", StatusName(segment.status)},
   367:             {"search_complete", segment.search_complete},
   368:             {"unique_path", segment.unique_path},
   369:             {"primary", segment.primary ? CandidateToJson(*segment.primary) : json(nullptr)},
   370:             {"backups", backups}};
   371: }

   373: json TimelineObservationToJson(const std::optional<face_trajectory::TimelineObservation>& value) {
   374:     if (!value) return nullptr;

   378: json SnapshotToJson(const face_trajectory::TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
   379:     json evidence = json::array();
   380:     for (const auto& sighting : snapshot.evidence) evidence.push_back(EvidenceToJson(sighting));
   381:     json anchors = json::array();
   382:     for (const auto& anchor : snapshot.anchors) anchors.push_back(AnchorToJson(anchor));
   383:     json sessions = json::array();
   384:     for (const auto& session : snapshot.sessions) {
   385:         sessions.push_back({{"session_id", session.session_id},
   386:                             {"first_seen_unix_ms", session.first_seen_unix_ms},
   387:                             {"last_seen_unix_ms", session.last_seen_unix_ms},
   388:                             {"first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms", session.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms},
   389:                             {"last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms", session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms},
   390:                             {"time_bounds", TimeBoundsToJson(session.time_bounds)},
   391:                             {"anchor_ids", session.anchor_ids},
   392:                             {"segment_ids", session.segment_ids}});
   393:     }
   394:     json segments = json::array();
   395:     for (const auto& segment : snapshot.segments) segments.push_back(SegmentToJson(segment));
   396:     return {{"target_id", snapshot.target_id}, {"version", snapshot.version}, {"association_revision", snapshot.association_revision},
   397:             {"graph_version", snapshot.graph.version},
   398:             {"graph", GraphToJson(snapshot.graph)},
   399:             {"options", OptionsToJson(snapshot.options)},
   400:             {"revision", RevisionToJson(snapshot.revision)},
   401:             {"evidence", evidence}, {"visits", VisitsToJson(snapshot.visits)},
   402:             {"anchors", anchors},
   403:             {"sessions", sessions}, {"segments", segments},
   404:             {"rejected_observation_ids", snapshot.rejected_observation_ids}};
   405: }

   407: std::optional<std::uint64_t> ExpectedVersion(const json& request) {
   408:     if (!request.contains("expected_version")) return {};
   409:     const auto version = ReadInt64(request.at("expected_version"));
   410:     if (version < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("expected_version must be nonnegative");
   411:     return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(version);
   412: }
   413: 
   414: void ValidateAssociatedSightings(const std::string& target, const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& supplied,
   415:                                 const face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations) {
   416:     if (associations.TargetRevision(target) == 0) return;
   417:     const auto canonical = [](const auto& sightings) {
   418:         std::map<std::string, json> by_id;
   419:         for (const auto& sighting : sightings) {
   420:             const auto value = EvidenceToJson(sighting);
   421:             auto [it, inserted] = by_id.emplace(sighting.observation_id, value);
   422:             if (!inserted && it->second != value) throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting duplicate observation_id");
   423:         }
   424:         return by_id;
   425:     };
   426:     if (canonical(supplied) != canonical(associations.Sightings(target)))
   427:         throw std::runtime_error("SOURCE_CONFLICT: supplied set differs from current association; use association_rebuild");
   428: }
   429: 
   430: json SnapshotFreshness(const face_trajectory::TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot, TrajectoryStore& trajectories,
   431:                        const face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations, bool historical) {
   432:     const auto current_revision = associations.TargetRevision(snapshot.target_id);
   433:     const auto latest_version = trajectories.LatestVersion(snapshot.target_id);
   434:     const bool matches = snapshot.association_revision == current_revision;
   435:     return {{"snapshot_association_revision", snapshot.association_revision},
   436:         {"current_association_revision", current_revision}, {"latest_version", latest_version},
   437:         {"association_matches_current", matches}, {"requested_scope", historical ? "HISTORICAL" : "CURRENT"},
   438:         {"valid_for_current_use", matches && snapshot.version == latest_version},
   439:         {"status", !matches ? "STALE_ASSOCIATION" : snapshot.version != latest_version ? "HISTORICAL" : "CURRENT"}};
   440: }
   441: 
   442: void AddResultFreshness(json& response, const json& request, TrajectoryStore& trajectories,
   443:                         const face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations) {
   444:     const auto op = request.value("op", "");
   445:     if (op == "association_observe" || op == "association_correct") {
   446:         auto effects = json::array();
   447:         for (const auto& target_json : response.at("association").at("affected_target_ids")) {
   448:             const auto target = target_json.get<std::string>();
   449:             const auto head = trajectories.LatestVersion(target);
   450:             const auto revision = associations.TargetRevision(target);
   451:             const bool required = head == 0 || trajectories.Get(target, head).association_revision != revision;
   452:             effects.push_back({{"target_id", target}, {"current_association_revision", revision},
   453:                 {"latest_trajectory_version", head}, {"rebuild_required", required}});
   454:         }
   455:         response["association"]["trajectory_effects"] = effects;
   456:         return;
   457:     }
   458:     const bool rebuild = op == "association_rebuild" || op == "trajectory_rebuild" || op == "point_trajectory_rebuild";
   459:     if (!rebuild && !(op=="monitoring_get" && request.value("include_point_trace",false)) && op != "trajectory_get" && op != "point_trace" && op != "trajectory_predict" &&
   460:         op != "trajectory_geometry" && op != "timeline_query" && op != "point_prediction_compare") return;
   461:     const auto target = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
   462:     if(op=="monitoring_get" && trajectories.LatestVersion(target)==0)return;
   463:     const auto version = rebuild ? response.at("revision").at("version").get<std::uint64_t>()
   464:         : static_cast<std::uint64_t>(op!="monitoring_get" && request.contains("version") ? ReadInt64(request.at("version")) : 0);
   465:     const auto freshness = SnapshotFreshness(trajectories.Get(target, version), trajectories, associations, !rebuild && version != 0);
   466:     response["freshness"] = freshness;
   467:     for (const auto* key : {"trajectory", "point_trace", "prediction", "geometry", "timeline", "comparison", "monitoring"})
   468:         if (response.contains(key)) response[key]["freshness"] = freshness;
   469: }
   470: 
   471: json MonitoringTime(face_trajectory::ClockAdapter& clocks, const json& request,
   472:                     const std::string& camera = "", const std::string& source = "") {
   473:     const json unavailable={{"status","HOLD"},{"reason_codes",json::array({"CAPTURE_TIME_UNAVAILABLE"})},
   474:         {"provenance",{{"time_policy","CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S"},{"camera_id",camera},{"profile_version",""},
   475:             {"raw_time",""},{"offset_convention","POSITIVE_CAMERA_AHEAD"}}}};
   476:     if(!request.contains("time_record") || request.at("time_record").is_null()) return unavailable;
   477:     auto record=request.at("time_record");
   478:     if(!record.is_object()) throw std::invalid_argument("time_record must be an object or null");
   479:     if(!camera.empty()) {
   480:         if(record.contains("camera_id") && record.at("camera_id")!=camera)
   481:             throw std::invalid_argument("time_record camera differs from observation");
   482:         record["camera_id"]=camera;
   483:     }
   484:     if(!source.empty() && record.contains("source_id") && record.at("source_id")!=source)
   485:         throw std::invalid_argument("time_record source differs from observation");
   486:     if(record.contains("time_policy") && record.at("time_policy")!="CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S")
   487:         throw std::invalid_argument("monitoring time_policy is fixed to CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S");
   488:     for(const auto* field:{"profile_version","camera_id","raw_time"})
   489:         if(!record.contains(field) || record.at(field).is_null() || record.at(field)=="") return unavailable;
   490:     record["time_policy"]="CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S";
   491:     auto normalized=clocks.Normalize(record);
   492:     if(normalized.value("status","")=="NORMALIZED" && request.contains("_trusted_clock")) {
   493:         const auto capture=normalized.at("captured_at_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
   494:         const auto now=request.at("_trusted_clock").at("now_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
   495:         if(capture>now && capture-now>face_trajectory::ClockAdapter::CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs){
   496:             normalized["status"]="HOLD";normalized["reason_codes"]=json::array({"FUTURE_CAPTURE_TIME_OVER_60S"});
   497:         }
   498:     }
   499:     return normalized;
   500: }
   501: 
   502: json Execute(Gallery& gallery, TrajectoryStore& trajectories,
   503:              face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations, face_trajectory::GeometryStore& geometry,
   504:              face_trajectory::SiteContextStore& site_context, face_trajectory::ClockAdapter& clocks,
   505:              face_trajectory::PointGraphStore& point_graphs, face_trajectory::MonitoringStore& monitoring,
   506:              const json& request) {
   507:     const auto op = request.at("op").get<std::string>();
   508:     if(op=="monitoring_person_put") return monitoring.PutPerson(request,gallery);
   509:     if(op=="monitoring_get") {
   510:         auto result=monitoring.Get(request.at("target_id"),associations);
   511:         if(request.value("include_point_trace",false)) {
   512:             const auto target=request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
   513:             if(trajectories.LatestVersion(target)==0) {
   514:                 result["point_connections"]=json::array();result["point_geometry"]={{"status","NO_CONFIRMED_OBSERVATIONS"}};
   515:             } else {
   516:                 const auto snapshot=trajectories.Get(target,0);
   517:                 const auto packet=point_graphs.Get(snapshot.graph.version);
   518:                 const auto trace=face_trajectory::CameraPointTrace(snapshot,packet,site_context);
   519:                 result["point_connections"]=trace.at("connections");
   520:                 result["point_geometry"]={{"version",snapshot.version},{"scene_version",packet.at("scene_version")},
   521:                     {"graph_version",snapshot.graph.version},{"coordinate_frame",trace.at("coordinate_frame")},
   522:                     {"topology_verified",trace.at("topology_verified")},{"topology_is_complete",trace.at("topology_is_complete")},
   523:                     {"physical_path_observed",false}};
   524:             }
   525:         }
   526:         return {{"ok",true},{"monitoring",result}};
   527:     }
   528:     if(op=="monitoring_gate_event") {
   529:         monitoring.RequireDurable();
   530:         return monitoring.PutGate(request,MonitoringTime(clocks,request),associations);
   531:     }
   532:     if(op=="monitoring_observe") {
   533:         monitoring.RequireDurable();
   534:         if(const auto previous=monitoring.ObservationReceipt(request)) return *previous;
   535:         auto observation=request.at("observation");
   536:         if(request.contains("target_id") || observation.contains("target_id") || observation.contains("person_id"))
   537:             throw std::invalid_argument("monitoring observation cannot assert target identity");
   538:         const auto id=observation.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
   539:         const auto camera=observation.at("camera_id").get<std::string>();
   540:         const auto source=observation.at("source_id").get<std::string>();
   541:         if(id.empty() || camera.empty() || source.empty() || observation.at("frame_id").get<std::string>().empty())
   542:             throw std::invalid_argument("observation/source/camera/frame ID is required");
   543:         Gallery::ValidateQuery(ReadSpace(observation.at("feature_space")),ReadEmbedding(observation.at("embedding")));
   544:         auto policy=ReadAssociationPolicy(request.at("policy"));
   545:         if(!request.at("policy").contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms")) policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms=60000;
   546:         auto options=ReadOptions(request);
   547:         if(!request.contains("options") || !request.at("options").contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms"))
   548:             options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms=60000;
   549:         if(policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms<0 || policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms>60000 ||
   550:            options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms<0 || options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms>60000)
   551:             throw std::invalid_argument("monitoring clock policy must be within 0..60000");
   552:         const auto graph=ReadGraph(request.at("graph"));
   553:         auto normalized=MonitoringTime(clocks,request,camera,source);
   554:         auto reasons=normalized.at("reason_codes");
   555:         if(normalized.at("status")=="NORMALIZED" && ReadInt64(normalized.at("clock_uncertainty_ms"))>
   556:            std::min(policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms,options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms))
   557:             reasons.push_back("CLOCK_UNCERTAINTY_EXCEEDS_POLICY");
   558:         json response={{"ok",true},{"observation_id",id},{"status","HOLD"},{"normalization",normalized},
   559:             {"time_admitted",reasons.empty()},
   560:             {"receipt_scope","ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION"},
   561:             {"reason_codes",reasons},{"association",nullptr},{"monitoring",nullptr},{"trajectories",json::array()}};
   562:         if(!reasons.empty()) { monitoring.SaveObservation(request,response); return response; }
   563:         for(const auto* field:{"captured_at_unix_ms","clock_uncertainty_ms","time_source","clock_domain"})
   564:             observation[field]=normalized.at(field);
   565:         const auto result=associations.Observe(ReadFaceObservation(observation),policy,graph,false);
   566:         const auto append=associations.LastAppend();
   567:         response["association"]=AssociationToJson(result);
   568:         if(result.sighting) response["status"]="ACCEPTED";
   569:         else response["reason_codes"].push_back("FACE_"+result.decision);
   570:         monitoring.SaveObservation(request,response);
   571:         if(result.sighting) {
   572:             for(const auto& target:result.affected_target_ids) {
   573:                 const auto head=trajectories.LatestVersion(target);
   574:                 auto appended=append && append->sighting.target_id==target
   575:                     ? trajectories.TryAppend(append->sighting,append->previous_target_revision,graph,options,"MONITORING_OBSERVATION:"+id,head)
   576:                     : std::optional<face_trajectory::TrajectoryRevision>{};
   577:                 const auto revision=appended?*appended:trajectories.Rebuild(target,associations.Sightings(target),graph,options,
   578:                     "MONITORING_OBSERVATION:"+id,head);
   579:                 const auto snapshot=trajectories.Reference(target,revision.version);
   580:                 response["trajectories"].push_back({{"revision",RevisionToJson(revision)},{"target_id",target},
   581:                     {"version",revision.version},{"association_revision",snapshot.association_revision},
   582:                     {"observation_count",snapshot.observation_count},{"anchor_count",snapshot.anchor_count},
   583:                     {"graph_version",snapshot.graph_version},{"detail_query","POST /v1/trajectories/get"}});
   584:             }
   585:             response["monitoring"]=monitoring.ObserveSummary(*result.sighting,
   586:                 append?std::optional<std::uint64_t>(append->previous_target_revision):std::nullopt,associations);
   587:         }
   588:         monitoring.CompleteObservationReceipt(id,response);
   589:         return response;
   590:     }
   591:     if (op == "clock_profile_put") { clocks.Put(request.at("profile")); return {{"ok", true}}; }
   592:     if (op == "clock_normalize") return {{"ok", true}, {"normalization", clocks.Normalize(request)}};
   593:     if (op == "point_graph_put") {
   594:         point_graphs.Put(request.at("point_graph"), site_context);
   595:         return {{"ok", true}, {"graph_version", request.at("point_graph").at("graph_version")}};
   596:     }
   597:     if (op == "point_graph_get") return {{"ok", true}, {"point_graph", point_graphs.Get(request.at("graph_version"))}};
   598:     if (op == "point_trajectory_rebuild") {
   599:         const auto target = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
   600:         const auto graph_version = request.at("graph_version").get<std::string>();
   601:         const auto packet = point_graphs.Get(graph_version);
   602:         auto options = ReadOptions(request);
   603:         if (!request.contains("options") || !request.at("options").contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms"))
   604:             options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms = face_trajectory::ClockAdapter::CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs;
   605:         if (options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms < 0 ||
   606:             options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms > face_trajectory::ClockAdapter::CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs)
   607:             throw std::invalid_argument("point trajectory max_clock_uncertainty_ms must be within 0..60000");
   608:         json admissions = json::array(), sightings = json::array();
   609:         if (!request.at("records").is_array()) throw std::invalid_argument("records must be an array");
   610:         std::map<std::string, std::string> unique_records;
   611:         for (const auto& record : request.at("records")) {
   612:             const auto id = record.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
   613:             if (id.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("observation_id is required");
   614:             const auto encoded = record.dump();
   615:             const auto old = unique_records.find(id);
   616:             if (old != unique_records.end()) {
   617:                 if (old->second != encoded) throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting duplicate raw observation_id");
   618:                 continue;
   619:             }
   620:             unique_records[id] = encoded;
   621:             if (record.value("target_id", target) != target) throw std::invalid_argument("record target differs from rebuild target");
   622:             json admission = {{"observation_id", id}, {"status", "HOLD"}, {"reason_codes", json::array()}};
   623:             if (record.value("link_status", "UNASSIGNED") != "CONFIRMED" ||
   624:                 record.value("attribution_evidence_id", "").empty()) {
   625:                 admission["reason_codes"].push_back("EXISTING_IDENTITY_LINK_UNCONFIRMED");
   626:                 admissions.push_back(std::move(admission)); continue;
   627:             }
   628:             const auto camera = record.at("camera_id").get<std::string>();
   629:             const auto context = site_context.CameraContext(packet.at("scene_version"), camera, "CAMERA_ID", 0);
   630:             if (context.at("status") == "UNKNOWN_CAMERA" || context.at("status") == "AMBIGUOUS_DEVICE") {
   631:                 admission["reason_codes"].push_back("CAMERA_ID_UNRESOLVED");
   632:                 admissions.push_back(std::move(admission)); continue;
   633:             }
   634:             const auto normalized = clocks.Normalize({{"profile_version", record.at("clock_profile_version")},
   635:                 {"camera_id", camera}, {"raw_time", record.at("raw_time")}, {"time_policy", "CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S"}});
   636:             admission["normalization"] = normalized;
   637:             if (normalized.at("status") != "NORMALIZED") {
   638:                 admission["reason_codes"] = normalized.at("reason_codes");
   639:                 admissions.push_back(std::move(admission)); continue;
   640:             }
   641:             if (ReadInt64(normalized.at("clock_uncertainty_ms")) > options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms) {
   642:                 admission["reason_codes"].push_back("CLOCK_UNCERTAINTY_EXCEEDS_POLICY");
   643:                 admissions.push_back(std::move(admission)); continue;
   644:             }
   645:             json s = {{"observation_id", id}, {"target_id", target}, {"camera_id", camera},
   646:                 {"source_id", record.at("source_id")}, {"attribution_evidence_id", record.at("attribution_evidence_id")},
   647:                 {"link_status", "CONFIRMED"}, {"time_source", "UTC_CAPTURE"}, {"clock_domain", "UTC"},
   648:                 {"captured_at_unix_ms", normalized.at("captured_at_unix_ms")},
   649:                 {"clock_uncertainty_ms", normalized.at("clock_uncertainty_ms")}};
   650:             if (record.contains("reentry_evidence_id")) s["reentry_evidence_id"] = record.at("reentry_evidence_id");
   651:             admission["status"] = "ACCEPTED"; admission["sighting"] = s;
   652:             admissions.push_back(std::move(admission)); sightings.push_back(std::move(s));
   653:         }
   654:         const auto admitted = ReadSightings(sightings);
   655:         ValidateAssociatedSightings(target, admitted, associations);
   656:         const auto revision = trajectories.Rebuild(target, admitted, point_graphs.Graph(graph_version),
   657:             options, request.at("reason").get<std::string>(), ExpectedVersion(request));
   658:         const auto& snapshot = trajectories.Get(target, revision.version);
   659:         auto serialized = SnapshotToJson(snapshot);
   660:         serialized["inference_scope"] = "CONDITIONAL_ON_REGISTERED_POINT_GRAPH";
   661:         serialized["topology_verified"] = packet.at("topology_verified");
   662:         serialized["topology_is_complete"] = packet.at("topology_is_complete");
   663:         for (auto& segment : serialized["segments"]) {
   664:             segment["unique_path_scope"] = "SUPPLIED_GRAPH_ONLY";
   665:             segment["physical_path_observed"] = false;
   666:         }
   667:         return {{"ok", true}, {"admissions", admissions}, {"revision", RevisionToJson(revision)},
   668:             {"trajectory", serialized}, {"point_trace", face_trajectory::CameraPointTrace(snapshot, packet, site_context)}};
   669:     }
   670:     if (op == "point_trace" || op == "trajectory_predict") {
   671:         const auto version = request.contains("version") ? ReadInt64(request.at("version")) : 0;
   672:         if (version < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("version must be nonnegative");
   673:         const auto& snapshot = trajectories.Get(request.at("target_id"), static_cast<std::uint64_t>(version));
   674:         const auto packet = point_graphs.Get(snapshot.graph.version);
   675:         if (GraphToJson(point_graphs.Graph(snapshot.graph.version)) != GraphToJson(snapshot.graph))
   676:             throw std::invalid_argument("snapshot graph differs from registered point graph");
   677:         if (op == "point_trace") return {{"ok", true}, {"point_trace", face_trajectory::CameraPointTrace(snapshot, packet, site_context)}};
   678:         auto prediction_options = request.at("prediction");
   679:         prediction_options["topology_verified"] = packet.at("topology_verified");
   680:         prediction_options["topology_is_complete"] = packet.at("topology_is_complete");
   681:         return {{"ok", true}, {"prediction", face_trajectory::PredictReachable(snapshot, prediction_options)}};
   682:     }
   683:     if (op == "point_prediction_compare") {
   684:         const auto target = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
   685:         const auto old_version = ReadInt64(request.at("previous_version"));
   686:         const auto new_version = ReadInt64(request.at("version"));
   687:         if (old_version < 1 || new_version <= old_version) throw std::invalid_argument("explicit increasing snapshot versions required");
   688:         // Durable Get has one cold cache: retain independent copies across calls.
   689:         const auto previous = trajectories.Get(target, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(old_version));
   690:         const auto current = trajectories.Get(target, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(new_version));
   691:         if (current.association_revision != associations.TargetRevision(target))
   692:             throw std::runtime_error("REBUILD_REQUIRED: comparison current version uses outdated association");
   693:         const auto id = request.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
   694:         const auto accepted = [](const auto& e, const auto& s) { return e.link_status == TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed &&
   695:             e.time_source == TimeSource::UtcCapture && e.clock_domain == "UTC" && e.clock_uncertainty_ms >= 0 &&
   696:             e.clock_uncertainty_ms <= s.options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms &&
   697:             std::find(s.rejected_observation_ids.begin(), s.rejected_observation_ids.end(), e.observation_id) == s.rejected_observation_ids.end(); };
   698:         const SightingEvidence* next = nullptr;
   699:         for (const auto& e : current.evidence) if (e.observation_id == id && accepted(e, current)) next = &e;
   700:         if (!next) throw std::invalid_argument("new observation is not accepted in current snapshot");
   701:         for (const auto& e : previous.evidence) if (e.observation_id == id) throw std::invalid_argument("observation already present in previous snapshot");
   702:         json result = {{"previous_version", old_version}, {"version", new_version}, {"observation_id", id},
   703:             {"observed_camera_id", next->camera_id}, {"status", "UNRESOLVED"}, {"observation_discarded", false}};
   704:         bool any = false; std::int64_t cutoff = std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min();
   705:         bool changed_basis = false;
   706:         for (const auto& e : previous.evidence) if (accepted(e, previous)) {
   707:             any = true; cutoff = std::max(cutoff, e.captured_at_unix_ms);
   708:             const auto found = std::find_if(current.evidence.begin(), current.evidence.end(), [&](const auto& c) {
   709:                 return c.observation_id == e.observation_id && accepted(c, current) && face_trajectory::SameSighting(c, e);
   710:             });
   711:             if (found == current.evidence.end()) changed_basis = true;
   712:         }
   713:         for (const auto& e : current.evidence) if (e.observation_id != id && accepted(e, current) && e.captured_at_unix_ms <= cutoff) {
   714:             if (std::none_of(previous.evidence.begin(), previous.evidence.end(), [&](const auto& old) {
   715:                 return old.observation_id == e.observation_id && accepted(old, previous);
   716:             })) changed_basis = true;
   717:         }
   718:         if (!any) result["reason"] = "NO_PREVIOUS_ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION";
   719:         else if (changed_basis) result["reason"] = "PRIOR_EVIDENCE_CHANGED_OR_RETRACTED";
   720:         else if (previous.graph.version != current.graph.version) result["reason"] = "GRAPH_CHANGED_REBUILD_REQUIRED";
   721:         else if (next->captured_at_unix_ms < cutoff) result["reason"] = "LATE_OBSERVATION_HISTORY_REBUILT";
   722:         else {
   723:             if (next->captured_at_unix_ms > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - next->clock_uncertainty_ms)
   724:                 throw std::invalid_argument("capture uncertainty overflows query time");
   725:             const auto packet = point_graphs.Get(previous.graph.version);
   726:             if (GraphToJson(point_graphs.Graph(previous.graph.version)) != GraphToJson(previous.graph) ||
   727:                 GraphToJson(point_graphs.Graph(current.graph.version)) != GraphToJson(current.graph))
   728:                 throw std::invalid_argument("snapshot graph differs from registered point graph");
   729:             auto o = request.value("prediction", json::object());
   730:             o["as_of_unix_ms"] = cutoff;
   731:             o["at_unix_ms"] = next->captured_at_unix_ms + next->clock_uncertainty_ms;
   732:             o["topology_verified"] = packet.at("topology_verified"); o["topology_is_complete"] = packet.at("topology_is_complete");
   733:             const auto prediction = face_trajectory::PredictReachable(previous, o);
   734:             result["prior_prediction"] = prediction;
   735:             bool included = false;
   736:             for (const auto& c : prediction.at("candidate_cameras")) if (c.at("camera_id") == next->camera_id) included = true;
   737:             if (included) result["status"] = "CONSISTENT_WITH_PRIOR_CANDIDATES";
   738:             else if (prediction.at("status") == "CANDIDATE" && prediction.at("search_complete") == true &&
   739:                      packet.at("topology_verified") == true && packet.at("topology_is_complete") == true)
   740:                 result["status"] = "INCONSISTENT_WITH_PRIOR_MODEL";
   741:             else result["reason"] = "INCOMPLETE_UNVERIFIED_OR_EXPIRED_PREDICTION";
   742:         }
   743:         return {{"ok", true}, {"comparison", result}};
   744:     }
   745:     if(op=="geometry_put"){geometry.Put(request.at("geometry"));return {{"ok",true}};}
   746:     if (op == "site_scene_put") {
   747:         site_context.Put(request.at("site"));
   748:         return {{"ok", true}, {"scene_version", request.at("site").at("scene_version")}};
   749:     }
   750:     if (op == "site_camera_context") {
   751:         return {{"ok", true}, {"context", site_context.CameraContext(
   752:             request.at("scene_version").get<std::string>(), request.at("camera_ref").get<std::string>(),
   753:             request.at("id_namespace").get<std::string>(), request.at("radius_m").get<double>())}};
   754:     }
   755:     if(op=="trajectory_geometry") {
   756:         const auto version=request.contains("version")?ReadInt64(request.at("version")):0;
   757:         if(version<0)throw std::invalid_argument("version must be nonnegative");
   758:         return {{"ok",true},{"geometry",geometry.Render(trajectories.Get(request.at("target_id").get<std::string>(),static_cast<std::uint64_t>(version)),request.at("geometry_version").get<std::string>())}};
   759:     }
   760:     if (op == "health") return {{"ok", true}, {"template_count", gallery.Size()},
   761:                                  {"gallery_version", gallery.Version()}};
   762:     if (op == "add_template") {
   763:         const auto id = request.at("template_id").get<std::string>();
   764:         const auto target = request.at("person_entity_id").get<std::string>();
   765:         if (id.rfind("assoc-template:", 0) == 0 || target.rfind("auto:", 0) == 0)
   766:             throw std::invalid_argument("association template/target namespace is reserved");
   767:         gallery.Add({id, target,
   768:                      ReadSpace(request.at("feature_space")),
   769:                      ReadEmbedding(request.at("embedding"))});
   770:         return {{"ok", true}, {"gallery_version", gallery.Version()}};
   771:     }
   772:     if (op == "remove_template") {
   773:         const auto id = request.at("template_id").get<std::string>();
   774:         if (id.rfind("assoc-template:", 0) == 0)
   775:             throw std::invalid_argument("association templates are managed by attribution correction");
   776:         gallery.Remove(id);
   777:         return {{"ok", true}, {"gallery_version", gallery.Version()}};
   778:     }
   779:     if (op == "association_observe") {
   780:         return {{"ok", true}, {"association", AssociationToJson(associations.Observe(
   781:             ReadFaceObservation(request.at("observation")), ReadAssociationPolicy(request.at("policy")),
   782:             ReadGraph(request.at("graph")), request.value("reconsider", false)))},
   783:             {"gallery_version", gallery.Version()}};
   784:     }
   785:     if (op == "association_correct") {
   786:         return {{"ok", true}, {"association", AssociationToJson(associations.Correct(
   787:             request.at("observation_id").get<std::string>(), request.at("target_id").get<std::string>(),
   788:             request.at("evidence_id").get<std::string>()))}, {"gallery_version", gallery.Version()}};
   789:     }
   790:     if (op == "search") {
   791:         const auto top_k = ReadInt64(request.at("top_k"));
   792:         if (top_k < 1 || top_k > 100) throw std::invalid_argument("top_k must be between 1 and 100");
   793:         json hits = json::array();
   794:         for (const auto& hit : gallery.Search(ReadSpace(request.at("feature_space")),
   795:                                               ReadEmbedding(request.at("embedding")), top_k)) {
   796:             hits.push_back({{"person_entity_id", hit.person_entity_id},
   797:                             {"template_id", hit.template_id}, {"similarity", hit.similarity}});
   798:         }
   799:         return {{"ok", true}, {"hits", hits}, {"gallery_version", gallery.Version()}};
   800:     }
   801:     if (op == "build_visits" || op == "raw_trajectory") {
   802:         const auto sightings = ReadSightings(request.at("sightings"), true);
   803:         const auto max_gap_ms = ReadInt64(request.at("max_gap_ms"));
   804:         const auto max_uncertainty_ms = ReadInt64(request.at("max_clock_uncertainty_ms"));
   805:         if (op == "build_visits") {
   806:             const auto result = face_trajectory::BuildCameraVisits(sightings, max_gap_ms, max_uncertainty_ms);
   807:             return {{"ok", true}, {"visits", VisitsToJson(result.visits)},
   808:                     {"rejected_observation_ids", result.rejected_observation_ids}};
   809:         }
   810:         const auto person_id = request.contains("target_id")
   811:             ? request.at("target_id").get<std::string>()
   812:             : request.at("person_entity_id").get<std::string>();
   813:         return {{"ok", true}, {"visits", VisitsToJson(face_trajectory::BuildRawTrajectory(
   814:                                      sightings, max_gap_ms, max_uncertainty_ms, person_id))}};
   815:     }
   816:     if (op == "trajectory_rebuild" || op == "association_rebuild") {
   817:         const auto target_id = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
   818:         const auto sightings = op == "association_rebuild" ? associations.Sightings(target_id)
   819:                                                          : ReadSightings(request.at("sightings"));
   820:         ValidateAssociatedSightings(target_id, sightings, associations);
   821:         const auto revision = trajectories.Rebuild(
   822:             target_id, sightings,
   823:             ReadGraph(request.at("graph")), ReadOptions(request),
   824:             request.at("reason").get<std::string>(), ExpectedVersion(request));
   825:         return {{"ok", true},
   826:                 {"revision", RevisionToJson(revision)},
   827:                 {"trajectory", SnapshotToJson(trajectories.Get(target_id, revision.version))}};
   828:     }
   829:     if (op == "trajectory_get") {
   830:         const auto target_id = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
   831:         const auto version = request.contains("version") ? ReadInt64(request.at("version")) : 0;
   832:         if (version < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("version must be nonnegative");
   833:         return {{"ok", true}, {"trajectory", SnapshotToJson(
   834:             trajectories.Get(target_id, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(version)))}};
   835:     }
   836:     if (op == "timeline_query") {
   837:         const auto target_id = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
   838:         const auto version = request.contains("version") ? ReadInt64(request.at("version")) : 0;
   839:         if (version < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("version must be nonnegative");
   840:         const auto at = ReadInt64(request.at("at_unix_ms"));
   841:         const auto from = request.contains("from_unix_ms") ? ReadInt64(request.at("from_unix_ms")) : at;
   842:         const auto to = request.contains("to_unix_ms") ? ReadInt64(request.at("to_unix_ms")) : at;
   843:         const auto result = trajectories.Query(target_id, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(version),
   844:                                                at, from, to);
   845:         json anchors = json::array();
   846:         for (const auto& anchor : result.anchors_in_range) anchors.push_back(AnchorToJson(anchor));
   847:         json segments = json::array();
   848:         for (const auto& segment : result.segments_in_range) segments.push_back(SegmentToJson(segment));
   849:         json locations = json::array();
   850:         for (const auto& location : result.path_locations) {
   851:             locations.push_back({{"segment_id", location.segment_id}, {"route_index", location.route_index},
   852:                                  {"node_indices", location.node_indices}, {"edge_indices", location.edge_indices}});
   853:         }
   854:         return {{"ok", true}, {"timeline", {{"target_id", result.target_id},
   855:                              {"version", result.version}, {"at_unix_ms", result.at_unix_ms},
   856:                              {"status", StatusName(result.status)},
   857:                              {"observed_anchor_ids", result.observed_anchor_ids},
   858:                              {"possible_observed_anchor_ids", result.possible_observed_anchor_ids},
   859:                              {"previous_anchor_id", result.previous_anchor_id},
   860:                              {"next_anchor_id", result.next_anchor_id},
   861:                              {"segment_id", result.segment_id},
   862:                              {"previous_observation", TimelineObservationToJson(result.previous_observation)},
   863:                              {"next_observation", TimelineObservationToJson(result.next_observation)},
   864:                              {"active_segment_ids", result.active_segment_ids},
   865:                              {"path_locations", locations},
   866:                              {"anchors_in_range", anchors},
   867:                              {"segments_in_range", segments}}}};
   868:     }
   869:     throw std::invalid_argument("unsupported operation");
   870: }
   871: 
   872: bool ReadBoundedLine(std::string& line, bool& too_large) {
   873:     constexpr std::size_t kMaxLine = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
   874:     line.clear();
   875:     too_large = false;
   876:     bool saw_input = false;
   877:     for (;;) {
   878:         const int next = std::cin.get();
   879:         if (next == EOF) return saw_input;
   880:         saw_input = true;
   881:         if (next == '\n') return true;
   882:         if (line.size() < kMaxLine && !too_large) {
   883:             line.push_back(static_cast<char>(next));
   884:         } else {
   885:             too_large = true;
   886:         }
   887:     }
   888: }

   890: bool PushOperation(const std::string& op) {
   891:     return op == "association_observe" || op == "association_correct" ||
   892:         op == "association_rebuild" || op == "trajectory_rebuild" || op == "point_trajectory_rebuild" ||
   893:         op == "monitoring_observe" || op == "monitoring_gate_event" || op == "monitoring_person_put";
   894: }
   895: 
   896: std::uint64_t PushCounter(face_trajectory::State& state, const std::string& key) {
   897:     return std::stoull(state.Get("push_meta", key).value_or("0"));
   898: }
   899: 
   900: json PushControl(face_trajectory::State* state, bool enabled, const json& request) {
   901:     const auto op = request.at("op").get<std::string>();
   902:     if (op == "push_status") return {{"ok", true}, {"push", {{"enabled", enabled},
   903:         {"durable", bool(state)}, {"pending", state ? PushCounter(*state, "pending") : 0},
   904:         {"max_pending", 10000}, {"max_pending_per_activity", 256}}}};
   905:     if (!state) throw std::invalid_argument("push requires durable state");
   906:     if (op == "push_next") {
   907:         std::map<std::string,json> heads;
   908:         const auto excluded=request.value("exclude_activity_ids",std::vector<std::string>{});
   909:         for(const auto& activity:state->References("push_outbox")) {
   910:             if(std::find(excluded.begin(),excluded.end(),activity)!=excluded.end())continue;
   911:             state->ScanAfter("push_outbox","",1,[&](const std::string&,const std::string& text){
   912:                 heads.emplace(activity,json::parse(text));
   913:             },activity);
   914:         }
   915:         auto next=heads.upper_bound(state->Get("push_meta","last_activity").value_or(""));
   916:         if(next==heads.end())next=heads.begin();
   917:         if(next==heads.end())return {{"ok",true},{"event",nullptr}};
   918:         state->Put("push_meta","last_activity",next->first);
   919:         return {{"ok",true},{"event",next->second}};
   920:     }
   921:     if (op == "push_ack") {
   922:         std::optional<std::string> selected;
   923:         state->Scan("push_outbox",[&](const std::string& key,const std::string& text){
   924:             const auto event=json::parse(text);const auto activity=event.at("activity_id").get<std::string>();
   925:             state->ScanAfter("push_outbox","",1,[&](const std::string& first,const std::string&){
   926:                 if(first==key)selected=key;
   927:             },activity);
   928:         },{},false,request.at("event_id").get<std::string>());
   929:         if(!selected)throw std::invalid_argument("push acknowledgement must match oldest pending event in its activity");
   930:         state->Erase("push_outbox",*selected);
   931:         state->Put("push_meta", "pending", std::to_string(PushCounter(*state, "pending") - 1));
   932:         return {{"ok", true}};
   933:     }
   934:     throw std::invalid_argument("unsupported push operation");
   935: }
   936: 
   937: void EnqueuePush(face_trajectory::State& state, const std::string& op, const json& response,const json& request) {
   938:     const auto activity=response.at("activity_id").get<std::string>();
   939:     const auto activity_pending=state.Count("push_outbox",activity,true);
   940:     if(activity_pending>=256||PushCounter(state,"pending")>=10000)
   941:         throw std::runtime_error("CAPACITY: backend push quota exhausted; retry after delivery");
   942:     auto stream = state.Get("push_meta", "stream_id");
   943:     if (!stream) {
   944:         std::random_device rng;
   945:         const char* hex = "0123456789abcdef";
   946:         std::string id;
   947:         for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) id += hex[rng() & 15];
   948:         state.Put("push_meta", "stream_id", id);
   949:         stream = id;
   950:     }
   951:     const auto sequence = PushCounter(state, "sequence") + 1;
   952:     if (sequence == 0) throw std::runtime_error("push sequence exhausted");
   953:     const auto number = std::to_string(sequence);
   954:     const auto key = std::string(20 - number.size(), '0') + number;
   955:     const auto now=request.at("_trusted_clock").at("now_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
   956:     json event = {{"schema_version", "1"}, {"event_id", *stream + ":" + number},
   957:         {"sequence", sequence}, {"operation", op}, {"created_at_unix_ms", now}, {"result", response}};
   958:     for(const auto* k:{"activity_id","activity_num","config_version","binding_version","monitoring_version"})
   959:         if(response.contains(k))event[k]=response.at(k);
   960:     event["retention_deadline_unix_ms"]=response.value("retention_deadline_unix_ms",now+face_trajectory::ActivityStore::RetentionMs);
   961:     // Store only results: no input face embedding, raw image or credentials.
   962:     state.Put("push_outbox", key, event.dump(),activity,event.at("event_id"));
   963:     state.Put("push_meta", "sequence", number);
   964:     state.Put("push_meta", "pending", std::to_string(PushCounter(state, "pending") + 1));
   965: }

    23:         {"cameras", json::array()}, {"annotations", json::array()}};
    24:     int i = 0;

    58: }

FILE: face-trajectory/docs/activity-retention.md
SHA256: dcd81a89f609d90c0be4fc0af3d782e0e54c713d19929d9f8c2fb05e17e9c002
================================================================================
     1: # 活动隔离与168小时滚动保留：统一设计（2026-10-10）
     2: 
     3: 本文件记录编写各阶段代码前的统一设计，以及最后核对后收紧的保留规则。只有带验证证据的项目才是实现完成；当前可执行接入、启动和迁移以[0.13服务合同](activity-service.md)为准，实测见两个项目现有HANDOFF。生产、Java、生产数据库及摄像头只读。本轮所有写入、迁移、清理验证使用新建隔离本地库。
     4: 
     5: ## 作用域与生命周期
     6: 
     7: activity_id为security_activity.id，activity_num为权威唯一业务编号，venue_id为场地。三者由后端活动同步合同提供，禁止按场地、计划时间、最新活动猜归属。活动创建默认为停止；配置同步、用户选择、明确监控启停三个操作独立。活动配置、绑定、启停分别用CAS版本。配置或绑定变更使旧上下文事件隔离，停止后的迟到事件隔离，不改变其它活动。计划结束时间仅资料，不自动关闭监控。
     8: 
     9: 同一个SQLite权威事务内，State活动视图将关联、监控、人员分类、匿名图库、会话、轨迹版本及其缓存按activity_id隔离，业务person_id保持原值。登记图库与活动状态分开：首版采用每活动登记图库，登记模板不随轨迹到期删除；图库跨活动共享不是默认隐式行为，若后端需要共享，须显式将权威登记模板同步到每个有权活动。匿名模板及来自抓拍的模板更新属于轨迹衍生历史，按期限清理。
    10: 
    11: 设备绑定是明确活动启用范围和route_rule_id/binding_version，不是场地设备列表。共享摄像头输入必须指定权威活动和匹配版本；缺失、冲突或不明确绑定隔离，不能无条件复制。闸机人脸关联必须携带source_id+observation_id及同次通行evidence_id；验票activity_num必须与映射一致，不能认定身份。
    12: 
    13: ## 持久化、幂等、恢复
    14: 
    15: 事件作用域(activity_id,source_id,event_id)，内部采用结构化复合键，不拼接人员ID。同键同内容安全重试；同键异内容409，包括reconsider、时间、绑定、版本或route改变。当前公开接口没有原键补证修订操作；将来需独立有版本合同并保留首次隔离期限，不能把新ID当作延长原事件期限的办法。活动scope覆盖底层关联和状态，恢复时按scope构造独立热索引。旧全局状态不猜活动，保持未归属，全部轨迹内容仍适用清理规则。
    16: 
    17: 客户端身份由可信后端签名授权上下文验证，含subject/session/context_id/context_generation/authz_revision/显式activity动作授权/有限有效期。查询、订阅、配置、监控启停均验证动作；前端自报activity_id不构成授权。查询、推送带activity_id/activity_num/config_version/binding_version/monitoring_version及客户端context/subscription版本。用户关闭订阅、退出或切换不停止后台监控。公平调度按活动轮转；重点优先必须保留普通配额，身份确认门槛一致。
    18: 
    19: ## 时间与保留的共同设计
    20: 
    21: 既有ClockAdapter不可变DEVICE_CAPTURE profile、核验来源、有效校准和CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S继续使用。它保持时区明确的摄像头名义采集UTC，abs(offset)+测量/漂移/量化误差不得超过60000ms，未知/未经核验/超限HOLD。准入后误差重叠保留顺序歧义。
    22: 
    23: 可信当前UTC必须由受信后端或运维签名的有限期参考证明建立，并核验来源、有效期、误差及本地时钟跳变；system_clock可读、NTP开启、历史快照均不构成运行证明。冷启动先发每进程新随机challenge，签名证明必须绑定当前challenge并在短挑战有效期内返回；接收后按单调时钟推进UTC，续期再用新challenge。禁止依赖不可信墙钟判断旧签名是否新鲜。可信端必须将UTC溯源到核验参考（同步状态、来源和误差），不是把机器时间签名即视为核验。测试使用明确标注的合成参考。证明失效时拒绝依赖时间的操作，不凭未知时间删除或给新隔离载荷无限延期。可信UTC水位不可回退。
    24: 
    25: cutoff=可信now-604800000ms；名义采集时间==cutoff保留，<cutoff过期；不以接收、重试、活动停止、用户切换或恢复时间计时。无可信采集时间从首次可信接收入隔离时起最多168小时，重接收或恢复不重置。期限在存活intake固定，到期墓碑只保留不可逆键/内容摘要，删除原时刻/相机/载荷，防止清理后未知时间输入重新开始期限。
    26: 
    27: ## 清理全部存储位置
    28: 
    29: P2：observation及历史、monitoring_observation及revision、monitoring_gate及revision、所有trajectory历史版本与head、refs-v1/v2 object树、association派生frame/track/target索引、owned_template与抓拍匿名模板、monitoring_projection缓存、push_outbox载荷及重放来源。窗口内版本必须修剪超窗证据与可恢复该证据的visit/anchor/segment，再按仍存在根引用做共享对象标记清扫。热缓存、重启加载与队列取件统一使用当前期限。
    30: 
    31: P1：monitoring_delivery库captures的图像/metadata/result、deliveries的payload/receipt/error；旧trajectory_bridge库frames/outbox。Python仅做活动字段传递及兼容，不实现新的清理生产模块；C++/Go清理适配器覆盖这些库。P1旧缺活动来源隔离，不继续发送到默认活动。
    32: 
    33: 旧全局/未归属/待决数据有可信时间按采集时间清理。缺可信首次隔离依据的旧数据和P1未知时间数据采用立即到期，不在迁移时给新168小时窗口；新P2未知事件由可信接收入隔离时固定首次期限。登记模板、活动主表、必要配置/绑定/监控生命周期、后端验票历史及录像排除。最小运行状态不可含超窗位置、时间序列、旧事件载荷；继续监控所需状态与轨迹历史分别处理。
    34: 
    35: 清理以可恢复SQLite事务为批次，dry_run只读统计不改变水位/索引/数据；真实清理提交后重建热索引，再secure_delete、VACUUM与截断WAL/空闲页。P1外部清理请求驱动匹配消费者暂停、排空进行中的推理与发送、清空热缓存/原生reader、关闭连接及释放租约，维护成功再重开并恢复；失败保持待维护，下一轮续做。报告不可查询/不可重放、有效数据量、可复用空间、文件体积、多轮轨迹增长约束和墓碑增长，不能仅以文件变小或宣称总文件恒定为依据。持续清理默认只统计，明确启动retention-enabled才删除；需有计数、耗时、最近成功/失败、时钟状态；中断事务回滚，下次重跑安全。
    36: 
    37: ## 阶段门与交付
    38: 
    39: 阶段1先实现并验证C++作用域、活动配置/启停/绑定、幂等、底层关联及P1字段兼容。通过后阶段2实现Go授权、接入、查询、订阅/推送上下文及真实Go/C++隔离库测试。通过后阶段3实现全存储清理、边界/恢复/中断/dry-run/增长测试。最后同步现有两个HANDOFF、OpenAPI、运行合同、配置、迁移回退、脚本及证据，不增加交接入口。
    40: 
    41: 本地实现、后端联调、生产部署、容量验收分别记录。约600路/3090优先/2秒目标3秒可接受仅设计约束；本轮不进行容量验收。真实页面切换、登录退出、生产鉴权及清理上线均现场联调待完成。

     1: # 多活动服务与168小时保留合同（0.13.0）
     2: 
     3: 2026-10-10。C++17 管理活动状态、身份关联、监控与清理；Go 管理签名授权、HTTP、按活动轮转请求、订阅与周期任务。P1 Python 只传递作用域字段并兼容隔离、墓碑和维护握手。当前验证结果及四层交付状态以两个项目现有 `HANDOFF.md` 为准。本文件是可执行接入合同，不代表生产已部署。
     4: 
     5: ## 身份、活动与监控
     6: 
     7: `activity_id` 是 `security_activity.id`；唯一 `activity_num` 经权威同步映射到该 ID；`venue_id` 是场地。创建活动默认 `enabled=false`。用户选择、创建活动、监控启停三个操作独立：关页、退出、切换、关闭订阅均不改变监控；计划结束时间不自动停止。算法不扫描处理全部历史活动，不选择“最新活动”，不把共享场地设备无条件分发到所有活动。
     8: 
     9: 底层 State 的物理命名空间为 JSON `["activity", activity_id, namespace]`，图库、人员类别、匿名身份、同人关联、会话、轨迹版本及热索引均在其中；业务 `person_id/target_id` 保持原值。登记图库首版也是每活动同步；后端想复用同一人员照片时，须将相同权威登记模板显式同步到各有权活动。登记模板排除于轨迹清理，抓拍衍生的匿名/自动模板按轨迹期限清理。
    10: 
    11: 活动接口使用 CAS：
    12: 
    13: | HTTP | 动作授权 | 请求字段 |
    14: | --- | --- | --- |
    15: | `POST /v1/activities/sync` | `config` | `activity_id,activity_num,venue_id,config_version,expected_config_version`，可选 `configuration` |
    16: | `POST /v1/activities/bindings` | `config` | `activity_id,config_version,binding_version,expected_binding_version,bindings[]` |
    17: | `POST /v1/activities/monitoring` | `monitor` | `activity_id,config_version,binding_version,monitoring_version,expected_monitoring_version,enabled` |
    18: | `POST /v1/activities/get` | `query` | `activity_id` |
    19: 
    20: 新版本大于 expected；首次 expected=0；已有配置用其当前值。相同修订与完全相同内容安全重试；内容变更或旧 CAS 返回 409。已建立的 `activity_num/venue_id` 不能用配置更新换成其他活动。get 返回身份、当前三版本和 enabled，完整配置与绑定资料仍由后端持有。
    21: 
    22: 完整无凭据请求示例见[activity-service.example.json](../collection/activity-service.example.json)，包括创建停止活动、完整设备范围、停止状态登记分类、明确启动、查询/订阅、绑定修订、明确停止及dry_run。示例claims/proof只是待签名结构，固定时间和placeholder不能作为真实授权或可信UTC；现场需签发当次有限期内容。
    23: 
    24: 每条 binding 包含 `source_id,device_id,kind=CAMERA|GATE,route_rule_id`。bindings 提交完整启用范围；同一活动内重复 `(source_id,device_id,kind)` 拒绝。共享摄像头可以由不同活动分别明确绑定，但每个事件必须有当前活动版本及匹配 route。绑定/配置变更后旧事件、停止后新到事件均 HOLD，不影响其他活动；已有原交易的相同重试只回原回执，不产生新副作用。
    25: 
    26: ## 授权与可信当前UTC
    27: 
    28: 除 `/health` 外，每个接口要求 `Authorization: Bearer <签名值>`。值为 `base64url(JSON原始字节).base64url(Ed25519签名)`，不是 JWT；签名覆盖解码后的 JSON 原始字节。服务只装公钥，不装后端私钥。公钥文件：`{"keys":{"key-id":"<32字节Ed25519公钥的base64>"}}`。issuer 和 key_id 必须匹配受信配置。
    29: 
    30: 授权正文含 `issuer,key_id,subject,session,context_id,context_generation,authz_revision,not_before_unix_ms,expires_unix_ms,grants,global_actions`。grant 是 `{"activity_id":"...","actions":["query","subscribe","config","monitor","ingest","identity"]}` 的明确子集；全局动作是 `global_config,push_status,retention` 的明确子集。有效期最多24小时，并按可信UTC误差区间核验。不能用前端活动 ID、自报 client_context、票号或 P1 回调机密替代用户授权。HTTP 禁止输入 `_` 开头字段及 `client_context`。
    31: 
    32: 相机准入仍使用不可变 ClockAdapter profile、已核验 `DEVICE_CAPTURE` 和 `CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S`。名义采集时间保持时区明确；`abs(offset)+测量/漂移/量化误差<=60000ms` 才准入。名义capture比本次可信UTC未来超过60000ms时HOLD，等于60000ms允许；离线补传的旧capture不因当前收件时间被改为now，仍按原期限。未知、未经核验或超限HOLD，从首次可信隔离最多168小时；准入事件的误差区间重叠保留顺序歧义。
    33: 
    34: 保留与授权需要另一条可信当前UTC链：外部时钟权威读 `/health` 的 `clock.challenge`，核验自己的参考来源、同步状态与误差，签名 `ClockAuthorityProof`，原子替换 `-clock-proof-file`。正文含 `issuer,key_id,challenge,now_unix_ms,uncertainty_ms,valid_for_ms,source_verified:true,source,evidence_id`。挑战有效30秒，proof最长120秒；签名误差加挑战往返年龄不得超过1000ms，实际必须快速签发。接收成功旋转挑战，UTC按进程单调时间推进，不允许水位倒退。Go进程冷启动需新挑战证明；同一Go进程中的C++子进程恢复仅可沿用仍有效的Go单调UTC租约，过期仍需刷新；缺失、过期、来源不合格、旧 challenge 均关闭相关服务操作。系统墙钟可读取、NTP开关或历史核验快照不能替代运行证明。测试脚本的 `SYNTHETIC_TEST` 仅验证合同。
    35: 
    36: ## 查询、通知与客户端切换
    37: 
    38: 所有人员、查询、归属修正接口都显式提供 `activity_id,config_version,binding_version,monitoring_version`；脸/闸机入流另需 `route_rule_id`。请求可带 activity_num，但必须与权威映射一致。归属修正引用脸另需其 `source_id`。每个活动接口分别验证动作，存在活动不等于有权限。原始 `association_observe/trajectory_rebuild/raw_trajectory/build_visits/point_trajectory_rebuild` 入流已拒绝，不能自报UTC绕过监控准入；现有查询、归属修正及基于核心权威集合的 association_rebuild 继续使用。
    39: 
    40: 回应带 `activity_id,activity_num,venue_id` 和三版本，Go 附签名授权的 `client_context` 五字段。客户端保存当前活动/版本/context_id/context_generation/authz_revision；请求发出后即使用户已切换，返回仍属原上下文。客户端逐项匹配，丢弃旧活动、旧选择上下文或旧版本的结果，不能只看人员 ID。
    41: 
    42: | HTTP | 请求 | 行为 |
    43: | --- | --- | --- |
    44: | `POST /v1/subscriptions/open` | 活动ID及三版本 | 验证 `subscribe` 权限；从当前已提交序号开始，不补发历史积压 |
    45: | `POST /v1/subscriptions/poll` | `subscription_id,generation`，可选一致的 activity_id | 每次最多100个真实已提交算法结果，推进该订阅游标 |
    46: | `POST /v1/subscriptions/close` | `subscription_id,generation` | 只关闭当前用户订阅 |
    47: 
    48: 订阅绑定 subject/session/context 全字段和授权期限，其他用户或新的选择上下文不能取旧订阅。回包含 subscription_id/generation/after_sequence，通知另含 subscription_generation、活动版本及 client_context。版本改变返回409，过期/关闭/进程重启丢失返回410，重新 open。订阅为内存用户访问状态；持久算法结果流、活动启停与监控状态不随之消失。后端主动结果推送是独立持久队列，每活动最多256、全局10000；活动间轮转，各活动内FIFO，失败活动单独退避不阻塞其它活动。原内容重试不重复占额，真正入队配额拒绝和算法结果整笔回滚。见[推送合同](backend-push.md)。
    49: 
    50: ## 幂等与168小时边界
    51: 
    52: 事件键为 `(activity_id,source_id,event_id)`，脸用 observation_id 作为 event_id；帧与跟踪会话也加入 source 作用域。不同活动、不同来源使用相同 event_id 不冲突。相同键相同全部内容只返原交易回执；同键变内容，包括活动版本、route、时间材料、reconsider、闸机后补 binding，返回409。不得改键重放同一物理事件逃避冲突/期限；需要原事件补证修订时，应先约定独立有版本的后台接口，当前没有自动改写原键的入口。
    53: 
    54: `cutoff=可信UTCnow-604800000ms`，合格相机名义采集时间等于 cutoff 仍保留，早于则过期。原始 ClockAdapter 误差留存用于判断，不因接收、投递、重试、重放、活动结束或用户切换重计时。P2 新未知/超限 HOLD 从首次可信隔离接收入库起最多168小时，重复/restart不重置；时间补齐也不能延长先前期限。缺可信首次隔离依据的旧/未归属数据及 P1 无合格采集时间数据采用立即到期，禁止迁移时凭空给新窗口。
    55: 
    56: 清理覆盖原入流、当前/历史脸与闸机、所有轨迹历史版本、refs-v1/v2共享对象、关联索引、自动模板、投影缓存、订阅结果、回执、推送/恢复来源，以及明确配置的 P1 captures/deliveries/旧frames/outbox。历史版本会被修剪超窗证据及派生路线；空的旧版本删除，最新空头仍保留版本号以防倒退。因此“指定历史版本”不意味着永远能还原过期内容。共享对象先以全部仍存在根做标记，再清理不可达对象；仍在窗口内的其他活动数据保留。依赖旧历史的仍活回执会压成 `detail_query_required=true`，当前详情重新查询。仍活闸机事件按自己的采集期限保留效果；其已确认绑定脸到期时，抹去原脸ID/绑定来源详情并保留当次核心确认的target及不可逆引用摘要，避免合法CLOSED/ENTRY效果因依赖清理丢失。脸仍活时归属修正继续动态跟随当前核心，清理冻结不允许调用者自报身份。
    57: 
    58: 登记图库、活动主表、必要配置/绑定版本、启停生命周期不随轨迹清理；后端验票历史和录像不由算法删除。最小监控checkpoint只保留继续监控所需状态与不可还原旧点的标识，不留过期摄像头/时刻/事件序列。跨cutoff误差组用存活事件不可逆哈希和pruned_positive/pruned_exit布尔量保留已有顺序歧义，相关存活事件全部到期后清除；随后新的非重叠证据仍可正常成为ACTIVE/CLOSED，不永久锁定歧义。哈希幂等墓碑仅保存不可逆逻辑键/内容摘要，阻止清理后重新入库；墓碑自身随不同事件累计，不能把总文件恒定当作已证明。
    59: 
    60: ## 隔离本地启动与清理观察
    61: 
    62: 使用本轮成对 worker/daemon，下面新目录不指向既有状态库；路径、公钥及签发服务由现场提供。先创建空隔离目录并准备公钥文件和外部证明签发端，公钥占位符不是凭据。该命令默认只统计，每分钟运行一次。
    63: 
    64: ```powershell
    65: $activityDemoRoot = 'D:\人脸算法\face-trajectory\runtime\activity-local-demo'
    66: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $activityDemoRoot -Force | Out-Null
    67: & 'D:\人脸算法\face-trajectory\evidence\2026-10-10-activity-retention\face-trajectoryd.exe' `
    68:   -worker 'D:\人脸算法\face-trajectory\cpp\build-activity\Release\face_trajectory_worker.exe' `
    69:   -state-file "$activityDemoRoot\isolated.sqlite" -addr 127.0.0.1:8081 `
    70:   -auth-public-key-file "$activityDemoRoot\auth-public-keys.json" -auth-issuer '<受信后端issuer>' `
    71:   -clock-public-key-file "$activityDemoRoot\clock-public-keys.json" -clock-issuer '<受信UTC权威issuer>' `
    72:   -clock-proof-file "$activityDemoRoot\clock-proof.txt" -retention-interval 1m
    73: ```
    74: 
    75: 服务启动只读 `/health` 可取得 challenge；在首次有效证明到达前其它HTTP失败关闭。本地重复验证直接运行唯一交接列出的 `verify_service.py/verify_retention.py`，它们生成合成签名器及新隔离库，不需要也不使用生产凭据。
    76: 
    77: 有 `retention` 全局授权的后台客户端：
    78: 
    79: ```powershell
    80: $activityHeaders = @{Authorization=$env:FACE_TRAJECTORY_AUTHORIZATION}
    81: Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1/retention/run' -Method Post -Headers $activityHeaders -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"dry_run":true}'
    82: Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1/retention/status' -Headers $activityHeaders
    83: ```
    84: 
    85: 删除要求启动时明确 `-retention-enabled`，请求 `{"dry_run":false}`；未启用返回409。指定P1库用重复 `-p1-retention-db '<已存在的绝对本地SQLite文件>'`，禁止HTTP传任意路径；缺库不自动新建，网络共享拒绝。不能漏掉仍使用的旧bridge库。P1维护请求、消费者租约、热缓存清空与重开需使用本轮匹配的P1程序；旧P1不配合时状态显示 BLOCKED/INCOMPLETE，不能据此认为全链清理成功。
    86: 
    87: Windows维护标记原子替换/清除遇到错误5/32/33时按5ms间隔有界重试，每个操作最多约1000ms；不是删掉旧标记再发布。P1单库成功须物理清理、统计和标记清除全部完成，报告 `pause_handshake=QUIESCENT, maintenance_request_status=CLEARED`；清除失败仍INCOMPLETE，不能仅凭VACUUM成功认定P1可恢复。已有屏障和COMMIT开始后的异常保留暂停，错误reason含Win32错误码、phase及retry_limit_ms。下一轮在同一显式配置库重试；不能手删request。2026-10-12本地修复证据见两个现有HANDOFF的恢复修复条目。
    88: 
    89: P1待投递载荷对过期脸/闸机的引用也会清除并隔离，原内容摘要及自身capture期限保留，不能把删掉引用当作允许原键新内容继续发送。Windows离线P1 dry_run采用主库/WAL/SHM拒绝写入句柄，已有WAL/SHM可只读检查；当前非Windows外部P1冻结dry_run明确fail closed，不为了统计建文件；C++核心不受此限制。Linux全链维护需补齐冻结支持并重新构建验证。
    90: 
    91: 观察status的attempts/successes/failures/running/last_duration_ms/last_error/last_result，以及报告各活动observations_before/after、snapshot版本改写/删除、共享对象回收、push删除、P1各表统计。before/after_logical/after_physical分别报告逻辑量、freelist/reusable_bytes、主库/WAL/SHM字节数；VACUUM与WAL截断完成才排除过去空闲页残留。物理维护失败保持PENDING，显式retention_run返回`ok=false,complete=false`，Go计入failures并保留last_error/last_result，下一轮继续。dry_run在内存PlanningCopy中执行与真实清理相同的修剪及共享对象标记清扫，再回滚内存副本，`count_semantics=EXACT_IN_MEMORY_PLAN_NO_SOURCE_MUTATION`；原数据库、水位、索引和墓碑不改，原始行删除与GC计数是该固定now的精确规划值。默认删除关闭时只有统计，不能宣称保留已生效。
    92: 
    93: ## 新活动、迁移与回退
    94: 
    95: 新活动顺序：后端签发该活动的明确授权 → sync身份/config版本 → bindings完整范围 → 同活动登记图库/分类并配置核验时间profile → 明确 monitoring enabled=true → P1传当前作用域 → 用户新context选择并open/query。更换设备范围先按CAS同步绑定，再刷新P1版本与客户端订阅；旧版本输入HOLD，不能偷偷重写旧持久请求。P1原型摄像头配置变更目前需要重新加载服务；核心活动同步无需改代码。
    96: 
    97: 生产启用属于另行部署授权，本轮未执行。启用前核对真实权威映射、权限动作、时钟签发溯源、全部P1库清单、当前版本与身份库、错误/容量告警、恢复和接收端到期拒绝。首次用新版本 `retention-enabled=false` 和 dry_run 核对，再在另行授权下启用删除。不得对生产库运行本轮隔离脚本。
    98: 
    99: 迁移前停写并用 SQLite 一致性备份包含WAL；在隔离副本验证。旧全局数据保持未归属，不按时间/场地猜活动；有可信采集时间按原采集期限，无可信原期限立即清除历史载荷。登记全局图库不会隐式成为各活动图库，后端显式重同步。新的作用域键和墓碑属于新合同；旧二进制会忽略隔离或不能读新存储，回退必须同时恢复匹配的旧程序与清理前备份到隔离路径，不在新库上直接降级。备份恢复也不能把超窗历史送回服务，应保持清理启用并先取得新的可信证明；保留备份本身亦需部署方单独管理。
   100: 
   101: 前后端最小配合：权威ID/num/venue及设备route/CAS接口、有限期签名授权、UTC挑战证明刷新、同次通行人脸关联、不可变source/event、选择上下文更新、旧回包/通知丢弃、推送活动版本/期限核验、全链存储清单及维护握手。真实登录退出、前端切换、生产鉴权、真实闸机/相机时间和容量均现场联调待完成；约600路/3090优先/2秒目标3秒可接受仅设计约束。
   102: 
   103: ## 合同复核

FILE: face-trajectory/docs/association.md
SHA256: a95f32e4c875fc32cf383fa79c93524d3cf15037f8f7502381c28ab70b15725b
