    13: // Subscriptions are user access state. Losing them on service restart requires
    14: // reopening a subscription and never changes durable algorithm monitoring.
    15: type subscription struct {
    16: 	mu         sync.Mutex
    17: 	id         string
    18: 	generation int64
    19: 	context    trust.ClientContext
    20: 	activity   string
    21: 	versions   map[string]json.RawMessage
    22: 	cursor     uint64
    23: 	expires    int64
    24: 	closed     bool
    25: }
    26: 
    27: type subscriptions struct {
    28: 	mu             sync.Mutex
    29: 	items          map[string]*subscription
    30: 	nextGeneration int64
    31: }
    32: 
    33: func newSubscriptions() *subscriptions { return &subscriptions{items: make(map[string]*subscription)} }
    34: 
    35: func versions(body map[string]json.RawMessage) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
    36: 	result := make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
    37: 	for _, field := range []string{"config_version", "binding_version", "monitoring_version"} {
    38: 		var value *uint64
    39: 		if json.Unmarshal(body[field], &value) != nil || value == nil {
    40: 			return nil, errors.New("explicit integer activity versions are required")
    41: 		}
    42: 		result[field], _ = json.Marshal(*value)
    43: 	}
    44: 	return result, nil
    45: }
    46: 
    47: func (s *Server) subscription(operation string) http.HandlerFunc {
    48: 	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    49: 		body, err := readBody(w, r)
    50: 		if err != nil {
    51: 			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error(), nil)
    52: 			return
    53: 		}
    54: 		claims, stamp, ok := s.authorize(w, r)
    55: 		if !ok {
    56: 			return
    57: 		}
    58: 		if operation == "open" {
    59: 			s.openSubscription(w, r, body, claims, stamp)
    60: 			return
    61: 		}
    62: 		var id string
    63: 		var generation int64
    64: 		if json.Unmarshal(body["subscription_id"], &id) != nil || id == "" || json.Unmarshal(body["generation"], &generation) != nil || generation < 1 {
    65: 			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "subscription_id and generation are required", &claims)
    66: 			return
    67: 		}
    68: 		s.subscriptions.mu.Lock()
    69: 		sub := s.subscriptions.items[id]
    70: 		s.subscriptions.mu.Unlock()
    71: 		if sub == nil {
    72: 			writeError(w, http.StatusGone, "subscription no longer exists; reopen with the current activity context", &claims)
    73: 			return
    74: 		}
    75: 		sub.mu.Lock()
    76: 		defer sub.mu.Unlock()
    77: 		if sub.closed || stamp.Now+stamp.Uncertainty >= sub.expires {
    78: 			writeError(w, http.StatusGone, "subscription has ended; reopen with a fresh authorization context", &claims)
    79: 			return
    80: 		}
    81: 		if sub.generation != generation || sub.context != claims.ClientContext {
    82: 			writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "subscription belongs to a different identity or activity selection context", &claims)
    83: 			return
    84: 		}
    85: 		if !claims.Allows(sub.activity, "subscribe") {
    86: 			writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "backend identity does not authorize this activity subscription", &claims)
    87: 			return
    88: 		}
    89: 		if supplied := activity(body); supplied != "" && supplied != sub.activity {
    90: 			writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "subscription activity cannot be replaced", &claims)
    91: 			return
    92: 		}
    93: 		if operation == "close" {
    94: 			sub.closed = true
    95: 			s.subscriptions.mu.Lock()
    96: 			delete(s.subscriptions.items, id)
    97: 			s.subscriptions.mu.Unlock()
    98: 			writeReply(w, http.StatusOK, subscriptionReply(sub, claims, map[string]json.RawMessage{"ok": json.RawMessage("true"), "closed": json.RawMessage("true")}))
    99: 			return
   100: 		}
   101: 		request := subscriptionRequest(sub)
   102: 		request["_authorization_validity"], _ = json.Marshal(map[string]int64{"not_before_unix_ms": claims.NotBefore, "expires_unix_ms": claims.Expires})
   103: 		request["after_sequence"], _ = json.Marshal(sub.cursor)
   104: 		request["limit"] = json.RawMessage("100")
   105: 		reply, status, err := s.exchange(r.Context(), request)
   106: 		if err != nil {
   107: 			writeError(w, status, err.Error(), &claims)
   108: 			return
   109: 		}
   110: 		if status == http.StatusOK {
   111: 			var events []map[string]json.RawMessage
   112: 			cursor := sub.cursor
   113: 			if json.Unmarshal(reply["events"], &events) != nil {
   114: 				writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "invalid activity result stream", &claims)
   115: 				return
   116: 			}
   117: 			for _, event := range events {
   118: 				var sequence uint64
   119: 				if activity(event) != sub.activity || json.Unmarshal(event["sequence"], &sequence) != nil || sequence <= cursor {
   120: 					writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "result stream violated activity scope or sequence", &claims)
   121: 					return
   122: 				}
   123: 				for key, value := range sub.versions {
   124: 					if string(event[key]) != string(value) {
   125: 						writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "activity versions changed; reopen the subscription", &claims)
   126: 						return
   127: 					}
   128: 				}
   129: 				event["client_context"], _ = json.Marshal(claims.ClientContext)
   130: 				event["subscription_id"] = rawString(sub.id)
   131: 				event["subscription_generation"], _ = json.Marshal(sub.generation)
   132: 				cursor = sequence
   133: 			}
   134: 			sub.cursor = cursor
   135: 			reply["events"], _ = json.Marshal(events)
   136: 		}
   137: 		writeReply(w, status, subscriptionReply(sub, claims, reply))
   138: 	}
   139: }
   140: 
   141: func subscriptionRequest(sub *subscription) map[string]json.RawMessage {
   142: 	request := map[string]json.RawMessage{"op": rawString("activity_results"), "activity_id": rawString(sub.activity)}
   143: 	request["_client_context"], _ = json.Marshal(sub.context)
   144: 	for key, value := range sub.versions {
   145: 		request[key] = value
   146: 	}
   147: 	return request
   148: }
   149: 
   150: func subscriptionReply(sub *subscription, claims trust.Claims, reply map[string]json.RawMessage) map[string]json.RawMessage {
   151: 	reply["activity_id"] = rawString(sub.activity)
   152: 	reply["client_context"], _ = json.Marshal(claims.ClientContext)
   153: 	reply["subscription_id"] = rawString(sub.id)
   154: 	reply["generation"], _ = json.Marshal(sub.generation)
   155: 	reply["after_sequence"], _ = json.Marshal(sub.cursor)
   156: 	return reply
   157: }
   158: 
   159: func (s *Server) openSubscription(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, body map[string]json.RawMessage, claims trust.Claims, stamp trust.Stamp) {
   160: 	id := activity(body)
   161: 	if id == "" {
   162: 		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "explicit activity_id is required", &claims)
   163: 		return
   164: 	}
   165: 	if !claims.Allows(id, "subscribe") {
   166: 		writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "backend identity does not authorize this activity subscription", &claims)
   167: 		return
   168: 	}
   169: 	selected, err := versions(body)
   170: 	if err != nil {
   171: 		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error(), &claims)
   172: 		return
   173: 	}
   174: 	buffer := make([]byte, 32)
   175: 	if _, err := rand.Read(buffer); err != nil {
   176: 		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "cannot allocate subscription context", &claims)
   177: 		return
   178: 	}
   179: 	sub := &subscription{id: hex.EncodeToString(buffer), context: claims.ClientContext, activity: id, versions: selected, expires: claims.Expires}
   180: 	request := subscriptionRequest(sub)
   181: 	request["_authorization_validity"], _ = json.Marshal(map[string]int64{"not_before_unix_ms": claims.NotBefore, "expires_unix_ms": claims.Expires})
   182: 	request["after_sequence"] = json.RawMessage("0")
   183: 	request["limit"] = json.RawMessage("1")
   184: 	reply, status, err := s.exchange(r.Context(), request)
   185: 	if err != nil {
   186: 		writeError(w, status, err.Error(), &claims)
   187: 		return
   188: 	}
   189: 	if status != http.StatusOK {
   190: 		reply["client_context"], _ = json.Marshal(claims.ClientContext)
   191: 		writeReply(w, status, reply)
   192: 		return
   193: 	}
   194: 	if json.Unmarshal(reply["latest_sequence"], &sub.cursor) != nil {
   195: 		writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "invalid activity result stream sequence", &claims)
   196: 		return
   197: 	}
   198: 	s.subscriptions.mu.Lock()
   199: 	for key, item := range s.subscriptions.items {
   200: 		if item.expires <= stamp.Now+stamp.Uncertainty {
   201: 			delete(s.subscriptions.items, key)
   202: 		}
   203: 	}
   204: 	count := 0
   205: 	for _, item := range s.subscriptions.items {
   206: 		if item.context.Subject == claims.Subject && item.context.Session == claims.Session {
   207: 			count++
   208: 		}
   209: 	}
   210: 	if len(s.subscriptions.items) >= 10000 || count >= 32 {
   211: 		s.subscriptions.mu.Unlock()
   212: 		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "subscription capacity reached; close unused subscriptions", &claims)
   213: 		return
   214: 	}
   215: 	s.subscriptions.nextGeneration++
   216: 	sub.generation = s.subscriptions.nextGeneration
   217: 	s.subscriptions.items[sub.id] = sub
   218: 	s.subscriptions.mu.Unlock()
   219: 	delete(reply, "events")
   220: 	writeReply(w, http.StatusOK, subscriptionReply(sub, claims, reply))
   221: }

    37: func New(worker Exchanger, endpoint, authorization string, clocks ...TrustedClock) (*Sender, error) {
    38: 	if endpoint != "" {
    39: 		u, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
    40: 		if err != nil || (u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https") || u.Host == "" || u.User != nil || u.Fragment != "" {
    41: 			return nil, errors.New("push-url must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL without userinfo or fragment")
    42: 		}
    43: 	}

    45: 		return nil, errors.New("invalid push authorization header")
    46: 	}

    48: 	if len(clocks) > 0 {
    49: 		clock = clocks[0]
    50: 	}

    52: 		wake: make(chan struct{}, 1), client: &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second,

    54: }

    56: // HTTP cancellation cannot remove an already committed outbox item. Run also
    57: // checks the queue periodically, including after a timed-out caller disconnects.
    58: func (s *Sender) Request(ctx context.Context, request json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
    59: 	result, err := s.worker.Request(ctx, request)
    60: 	var operation struct {
    61: 		Op string `json:"op"`
    62: 	}
    63: 	if err == nil && json.Unmarshal(request, &operation) == nil && operation.Op == "push_status" {
    64: 		var reply map[string]json.RawMessage
    65: 		if json.Unmarshal(result, &reply) == nil {
    66: 			var status map[string]any
    67: 			if json.Unmarshal(reply["push"], &status) == nil && status != nil {
    68: 				status["receiver_configured"] = s.endpoint != ""
    69: 				reply["push"], _ = json.Marshal(status)
    70: 				result, _ = json.Marshal(reply)
    71: 			}
    72: 		}
    73: 	}
    74: 	select {
    75: 	case s.wake <- struct{}{}:
    76: 	default:
    77: 	}
    78: 	return result, err
    79: }

    81: func (s *Sender) control(ctx context.Context, request any) (json.RawMessage, error) {
    82: 	body, err := json.Marshal(request)
    83: 	if err != nil {
    84: 		return nil, err
    85: 	}
    86: 	result, err := s.worker.Request(ctx, body)
    87: 	if err != nil {
    88: 		return nil, err
    89: 	}
    90: 	var status struct {
    91: 		OK    bool   `json:"ok"`
    92: 		Error string `json:"error"`
    93: 	}
    94: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(result, &status); err != nil {
    95: 		return nil, err
    96: 	}
    97: 	if !status.OK {
    98: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("push worker: %s", status.Error)
    99: 	}
   100: 	return result, nil
   101: }
   102: 
   103: func (s *Sender) deliver(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
   104: 	sent, _, err := s.deliverSelected(ctx, nil)
   105: 	return sent, err
   106: }
   107: 
   108: // The worker returns an eligible activity's oldest item. A failed activity is
   109: // excluded during its own backoff so it cannot hold another activity's queue.
   110: func (s *Sender) deliverSelected(ctx context.Context, excluded []string) (bool, string, error) {
   111: 	selection := map[string]any{"op": "push_next"}
   112: 	if len(excluded) > 0 {
   113: 		selection["exclude_activity_ids"] = excluded
   114: 	}
   115: 	result, err := s.control(ctx, selection)
   116: 	if err != nil {
   117: 		return false, "", err
   118: 	}
   119: 	var reply struct {
   120: 		Event json.RawMessage `json:"event"`
   121: 	}
   122: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(result, &reply); err != nil {
   123: 		return false, "", err
   124: 	}
   125: 	if len(reply.Event) == 0 || bytes.Equal(reply.Event, []byte("null")) {
   126: 		return false, "", nil
   127: 	}
   128: 	var event struct {
   129: 		ID                string  `json:"event_id"`
   130: 		ActivityID        string  `json:"activity_id"`
   131: 		ActivityNum       string  `json:"activity_num"`
   132: 		ConfigVersion     *uint64 `json:"config_version"`
   133: 		BindingVersion    *uint64 `json:"binding_version"`
   134: 		MonitoringVersion *uint64 `json:"monitoring_version"`
   135: 		Deadline          *int64  `json:"retention_deadline_unix_ms"`
   136: 	}
   137: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(reply.Event, &event); err != nil || event.ID == "" || event.ActivityID == "" || event.ActivityNum == "" || event.ConfigVersion == nil || event.BindingVersion == nil || event.MonitoringVersion == nil || event.Deadline == nil {
   138: 		return false, event.ActivityID, errors.New("queued push requires explicit activity identity, versions and retention deadline")
   139: 	}
   140: 	if s.clock == nil {
   141: 		return false, "", errors.New("backend push requires verified UTC")
   142: 	}
   143: 	stamp, err := s.clock.Now()
   144: 	if err != nil || !stamp.Verified || stamp.ValidUntil <= stamp.Now {
   145: 		return false, "", errors.New("backend push requires a fresh verified UTC lease")
   146: 	}
   147: 	if stamp.Now > *event.Deadline {
   148: 		return false, event.ActivityID, errors.New("backend push deadline expired")
   149: 	}
   150: 	// Equality at the cutoff is retained. The receiver must independently reject
   151: 	// delivery after the envelope deadline; sender cancellation cannot recall a
   152: 	// request already accepted by an external receiver.
   153: 	remaining := *event.Deadline - stamp.Now + 1
   154: 	if lease := stamp.ValidUntil - stamp.Now; lease < remaining {
   155: 		remaining = lease
   156: 	}
   157: 	if remaining > 10000 {
   158: 		remaining = 10000
   159: 	}
   160: 	deliveryCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Duration(remaining)*time.Millisecond)
   161: 	defer cancel()
   162: 	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(deliveryCtx, http.MethodPost, s.endpoint, bytes.NewReader(reply.Event))
   163: 	if err != nil {
   164: 		return false, event.ActivityID, errors.New("cannot create backend push request")
   165: 	}
   166: 	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   167: 	keyBytes, _ := json.Marshal([]string{event.ActivityID, event.ID})
   168: 	keyHash := sha256.Sum256(keyBytes)
   169: 	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", hex.EncodeToString(keyHash[:]))
   170: 	if s.authorization != "" {
   171: 		request.Header.Set("Authorization", s.authorization)
   172: 	}
   173: 	response, err := s.client.Do(request)
   174: 	if err != nil {
   175: 		return false, event.ActivityID, errors.New("backend push transport failed")
   176: 	}
   177: 	_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4096))
   178: 	_ = response.Body.Close()
   179: 	if response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300 {
   180: 		return false, event.ActivityID, fmt.Errorf("backend push HTTP %d", response.StatusCode)
   181: 	}
   182: 	_, err = s.control(ctx, map[string]string{"op": "push_ack", "event_id": event.ID})
   183: 	return err == nil, event.ActivityID, err
   184: }
   185: 
   186: type activityRetry struct {
   187: 	delay time.Duration
   188: 	next  time.Time
   189: }
   190: 
   191: func (r *activityRetry) failed(now time.Time) {
   192: 	if r.delay == 0 {
   193: 		r.delay = time.Second
   194: 	} else if r.delay < 30*time.Second {
   195: 		r.delay *= 2
   196: 		if r.delay > 30*time.Second {
   197: 			r.delay = 30 * time.Second
   198: 		}
   199: 	}
   200: 	r.next = now.Add(r.delay)
   201: }
   202: 
   203: func retrySelection(retries map[string]*activityRetry, now time.Time) ([]string, time.Duration) {
   204: 	excluded := make([]string, 0, len(retries))
   205: 	wait := time.Second
   206: 	for activity, retry := range retries {
   207: 		if remaining := retry.next.Sub(now); remaining > 0 {
   208: 			excluded = append(excluded, activity)
   209: 			if remaining < wait {
   210: 				wait = remaining
   211: 			}
   212: 		}
   213: 	}
   214: 	sort.Strings(excluded)
   215: 	return excluded, wait
   216: }
   217: 
   218: func waitRetry(ctx context.Context, delay time.Duration, wake <-chan struct{}) bool {
   219: 	timer := time.NewTimer(delay)
   220: 	defer timer.Stop()
   221: 	select {
   222: 	case <-ctx.Done():
   223: 		return false
   224: 	case <-timer.C:
   225: 		return true
   226: 	case <-wake:
   227: 		return true
   228: 	}
   229: }
   230: 
   231: // One sender preserves commit order inside each activity. The C++ selector
   232: // rotates activity heads; failure delays only that activity and retains its
   233: // oldest durable item. Global transport/clock failures use a separate backoff.
   234: func (s *Sender) Run(ctx context.Context) {
   235: 	if s.endpoint == "" {
   236: 		return
   237: 	}
   238: 	defer s.client.CloseIdleConnections()
   239: 	retries := make(map[string]*activityRetry)
   240: 	global := activityRetry{}
   241: 	for ctx.Err() == nil {
   242: 		excluded, idle := retrySelection(retries, time.Now())
   243: 		sent, activity, err := s.deliverSelected(ctx, excluded)
   244: 		if err != nil {
   245: 			if ctx.Err() != nil {
   246: 				return
   247: 			}
   248: 			if activity == "" {
   249: 				global.failed(time.Now())
   250: 				log.Printf("%v; queued results retained, global retry in %s", err, global.delay)
   251: 				// Producer wakeups cannot shorten a failed global reference's backoff.
   252: 				if !waitRetry(ctx, global.delay, nil) {
   253: 					return
   254: 				}
   255: 			} else {
   256: 				retry := retries[activity]
   257: 				if retry == nil {
   258: 					retry = &activityRetry{}
   259: 					retries[activity] = retry
   260: 				}
   261: 				retry.failed(time.Now())
   262: 				log.Printf("%v; activity=%s queued result retained, activity retry in %s", err, activity, retry.delay)
   263: 			}
   264: 			continue
   265: 		}
   266: 		global = activityRetry{}
   267: 		if sent {
   268: 			delete(retries, activity)
   269: 			continue
   270: 		}
   271: 		if !waitRetry(ctx, idle, s.wake) {
   272: 			return
   273: 		}
   274: 	}
   275: }

   153: func (w *scopedQueueWorker) Request(_ context.Context, raw json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
   154: 	w.mu.Lock()
   155: 	defer w.mu.Unlock()
   156: 	var request struct {
   157: 		Op       string   `json:"op"`
   158: 		ID       string   `json:"event_id"`
   159: 		Excluded []string `json:"exclude_activity_ids"`
   160: 	}
   161: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &request); err != nil {
   162: 		return nil, err
   163: 	}
   164: 	if request.Op == "push_ack" {
   165: 		for activity, queue := range w.queues {
   166: 			if len(queue) > 0 && queue[0]["event_id"] == request.ID {
   167: 				w.queues[activity] = queue[1:]
   168: 				w.acks = append(w.acks, request.ID)
   169: 				return json.RawMessage(`{"ok":true}`), nil
   170: 			}
   171: 		}
   172: 		return nil, errors.New("acknowledgment skipped an activity head")
   173: 	}
   174: 	excluded := make(map[string]bool)
   175: 	for _, activity := range request.Excluded {
   176: 		excluded[activity] = true
   177: 	}
   178: 	var event any
   179: 	for offset := 0; offset < len(w.order); offset++ {
   180: 		index := (w.next + offset) % len(w.order)
   181: 		activity := w.order[index]
   182: 		if queue := w.queues[activity]; !excluded[activity] && len(queue) > 0 {
   183: 			event = queue[0]
   184: 			w.next = (index + 1) % len(w.order)
   185: 			break
   186: 		}
   187: 	}
   188: 	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"ok": true, "event": event})
   189: 	return encoded, nil
   190: }
   191: 
   192: func TestActivityFailureDoesNotDelayOtherActivityAndPreservesScopeOrder(t *testing.T) {
   193: 	type attempt struct {
   194: 		activity string
   195: 		id       string
   196: 		at       time.Time
   197: 	}
   198: 	posted := make(chan attempt, 8)
   199: 	var recovered atomic.Bool
   200: 	receiver := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
   201: 		var event struct {
   202: 			Activity string `json:"activity_id"`
   203: 			ID       string `json:"event_id"`
   204: 		}
   205: 		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&event); err != nil {
   206: 			t.Error(err)
   207: 			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
   208: 			return
   209: 		}
   210: 		posted <- attempt{activity: event.Activity, id: event.ID, at: time.Now()}
   211: 		if event.Activity == "A" && !recovered.Load() {
   212: 			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
   213: 			return
   214: 		}
   215: 		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   216: 	}))
   217: 	defer receiver.Close()
   218: 	a1, a2, b1 := pushEvent("A"), pushEvent("A"), pushEvent("B")
   219: 	a1["event_id"], a2["event_id"], b1["event_id"] = "A-1", "A-2", "B-1"
   220: 	worker := &scopedQueueWorker{queues: map[string][]map[string]any{"A": {a1, a2}, "B": {b1}}, order: []string{"A", "B"}}
   221: 	sender, err := New(worker, receiver.URL, "", validClock())
   222: 	if err != nil {
   223: 		t.Fatal(err)
   224: 	}
   225: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
   226: 	defer cancel()
   227: 	done := make(chan struct{})
   228: 	go func() { sender.Run(ctx); close(done) }()
   229: 	selectAttempt := func(timeout time.Duration) attempt {
   230: 		t.Helper()
   231: 		select {
   232: 		case value := <-posted:
   233: 			return value
   234: 		case <-time.After(timeout):
   235: 			t.Fatal("expected scoped backend delivery did not arrive")
   236: 			return attempt{}
   237: 		}
   238: 	}
   239: 	first := selectAttempt(time.Second)
   240: 	if first.id != "A-1" {
   241: 		t.Fatalf("unexpected first activity head: %+v", first)
   242: 	}
   243: 	second := selectAttempt(700 * time.Millisecond)
   244: 	if second.id != "B-1" || second.at.Sub(first.at) >= 700*time.Millisecond {
   245: 		t.Fatalf("A failure held B's durable item: first=%+v second=%+v", first, second)
   246: 	}
   247: 	recovered.Store(true)
   248: 	// Producer wakeups may discover B/new activities, but must not defeat A's
   249: 	// independent backoff. This uses real HTTP delivery and the actual Run loop.
   250: 	wakesDone := make(chan struct{})
   251: 	go func() {
   252: 		defer close(wakesDone)
   253: 		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
   254: 		defer ticker.Stop()
   255: 		for {
   256: 			select {
   257: 			case <-ctx.Done():
   258: 				return
   259: 			case <-ticker.C:
   260: 				select {
   261: 				case sender.wake <- struct{}{}:
   262: 				default:
   263: 				}
   264: 			}
   265: 		}
   266: 	}()
   267: 	third := selectAttempt(2 * time.Second)
   268: 	if third.id != "A-1" || third.at.Sub(first.at) < time.Second {
   269: 		t.Fatalf("A's head/order/backoff was bypassed: first=%+v third=%+v", first, third)
   270: 	}
   271: 	fourth := selectAttempt(time.Second)
   272: 	if fourth.id != "A-2" {
   273: 		t.Fatalf("A's following event overtook its retry: %+v", fourth)
   274: 	}
   275: 	// The receiver posts an attempt before responding, so wait for C++'s mocked
   276: 	// commit acknowledgment rather than treating a request as a delivered item.
   277: 	ackDeadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
   278: 	for {
   279: 		worker.mu.Lock()
   280: 		acks := append([]string(nil), worker.acks...)
   281: 		worker.mu.Unlock()
   282: 		if len(acks) == 3 {
   283: 			if acks[0] != "B-1" || acks[1] != "A-1" || acks[2] != "A-2" {
   284: 				t.Fatalf("cross-activity acknowledgement order: %v", acks)
   285: 			}
   286: 			break
   287: 		}
   288: 		if time.Now().After(ackDeadline) {
   289: 			t.Fatalf("expected all three durable acknowledgments, got %v", acks)
   290: 		}
   291: 		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
   292: 	}
   293: 	cancel()
   294: 	select {
   295: 	case <-done:
   296: 	case <-time.After(time.Second):
   297: 		t.Fatal("sender did not stop after cancellation")
   298: 	}
   299: 	<-wakesDone
   300: }

   302: func TestActivityBackoffIsIndependentAndCapped(t *testing.T) {
   303: 	start := time.Now()
   304: 	a, b := &activityRetry{}, &activityRetry{}
   305: 	a.failed(start)
   306: 	b.failed(start.Add(500 * time.Millisecond))
   307: 	for range 10 {
   308: 		a.failed(start)
   309: 	}
   310: 	if a.delay != 30*time.Second || b.delay != time.Second {
   311: 		t.Fatalf("activity delays interfered or overflowed: A=%s B=%s", a.delay, b.delay)
   312: 	}
   313: 	excluded, wait := retrySelection(map[string]*activityRetry{"A": a, "B": b}, start.Add(time.Second))
   314: 	if len(excluded) != 2 || excluded[0] != "A" || excluded[1] != "B" || wait != 500*time.Millisecond {
   315: 		t.Fatalf("selection ignored nearest independent retry: %v %s", excluded, wait)
   316: 	}
   317: 	excluded, _ = retrySelection(map[string]*activityRetry{"A": a, "B": b}, start.Add(2*time.Second))
   318: 	if len(excluded) != 1 || excluded[0] != "A" {
   319: 		t.Fatalf("B was still excluded after its own deadline: %v", excluded)
   320: 	}
   321: }

     1: // Package retention schedules the C++ retention transaction. It never computes
     2: // trajectory deadlines or opens an algorithm/P1 SQLite database in Go.
     3: package retention
     4: 
     5: import (
     6: 	"context"
     7: 	"encoding/json"
     8: 	"errors"
     9: 	"face-trajectory/internal/trust"
    10: 	"log"
    11: 	"sync"
    12: 	"time"
    13: )
    14: 
    15: type Exchanger interface {
    16: 	Request(context.Context, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
    17: }
    18: 
    19: type Status struct {
    20: 	Enabled        bool            `json:"enabled"`
    21: 	IntervalMS     int64           `json:"interval_ms"`
    22: 	Running        bool            `json:"running"`
    23: 	Attempts       uint64          `json:"attempts"`
    24: 	Successes      uint64          `json:"successes"`
    25: 	Failures       uint64          `json:"failures"`
    26: 	LastDryRun     bool            `json:"last_dry_run"`
    27: 	LastDurationMS int64           `json:"last_duration_ms"`
    28: 	LastError      string          `json:"last_error,omitempty"`
    29: 	LastResult     json.RawMessage `json:"last_result,omitempty"`
    30: }
    31: 
    32: type Manager struct {
    33: 	worker   Exchanger
    34: 	interval time.Duration
    35: 	enabled  bool
    36: 	gate     chan struct{}
    37: 	mu       sync.Mutex
    38: 	status   Status
    39: }
    40: 
    41: func New(worker Exchanger, interval time.Duration, enabled bool) (*Manager, error) {
    42: 	if interval < time.Second || interval > 24*time.Hour {
    43: 		return nil, errors.New("retention interval must be between one second and 24 hours")
    44: 	}
    45: 	return &Manager{worker: worker, interval: interval, enabled: enabled, gate: make(chan struct{}, 1), status: Status{Enabled: enabled, IntervalMS: interval.Milliseconds()}}, nil
    46: }
    47: 
    48: func (m *Manager) Enabled() bool { return m != nil && m.enabled }
    49: 
    50: func (m *Manager) Status() Status {
    51: 	if m == nil {
    52: 		return Status{}
    53: 	}
    54: 	m.mu.Lock()
    55: 	defer m.mu.Unlock()
    56: 	result := m.status
    57: 	result.LastResult = append(json.RawMessage(nil), result.LastResult...)
    58: 	return result
    59: }
    60: 
    61: // Run is serialized with the periodic loop. Deadlines remain exclusively in
    62: // C++, using the trusted UTC inserted immediately before worker dispatch.
    63: func (m *Manager) Run(ctx context.Context, dryRun bool, claims *trust.Claims) (json.RawMessage, error) {
    64: 	if m == nil {
    65: 		return nil, errors.New("retention manager is not configured")
    66: 	}
    67: 	if !dryRun && !m.enabled {
    68: 		return nil, errors.New("destructive retention requires the explicit retention-enabled startup flag")
    69: 	}
    70: 	select {
    71: 	case m.gate <- struct{}{}:
    72: 		defer func() { <-m.gate }()
    73: 	case <-ctx.Done():
    74: 		return nil, ctx.Err()
    75: 	}
    76: 	start := time.Now()
    77: 	m.mu.Lock()
    78: 	m.status.Running = true
    79: 	m.status.Attempts++
    80: 	m.status.LastDryRun = dryRun
    81: 	m.mu.Unlock()
    82: 	request := map[string]any{"op": "retention_run", "dry_run": dryRun}
    83: 	if claims != nil {
    84: 		request["_client_context"] = claims.ClientContext
    85: 		request["_authorization_validity"] = map[string]int64{"not_before_unix_ms": claims.NotBefore, "expires_unix_ms": claims.Expires}
    86: 	}
    87: 	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(request)
    88: 	result, err := m.worker.Request(ctx, encoded)
    89: 	var reply struct {
    90: 		OK *bool `json:"ok"`
    91: 	}
    92: 	if err == nil && (json.Unmarshal(result, &reply) != nil || reply.OK == nil) {
    93: 		err = errors.New("invalid C++ retention response")
    94: 	}
    95: 	if err == nil && !*reply.OK {
    96: 		err = errors.New("C++ retention rejected the operation; inspect last_result")
    97: 	}
    98: 	m.mu.Lock()
    99: 	m.status.Running = false
   100: 	m.status.LastDurationMS = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
   101: 	m.status.LastResult = append(json.RawMessage(nil), result...)
   102: 	m.status.LastError = ""
   103: 	if err != nil {
   104: 		m.status.Failures++
   105: 		m.status.LastError = err.Error()
   106: 	} else {
   107: 		m.status.Successes++
   108: 	}
   109: 	m.mu.Unlock()
   110: 	return result, err
   111: }
   112: 
   113: // Default mode periodically reports a read-only dry run. Deletion starts only
   114: // when deployment explicitly enables retention; expired/missing clock proofs
   115: // make the adapter fail closed and are observable in Status.
   116: func (m *Manager) Loop(ctx context.Context) {
   117: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(m.interval)
   118: 	defer ticker.Stop()
   119: 	for {
   120: 		select {
   121: 		case <-ctx.Done():
   122: 			return
   123: 		case <-ticker.C:
   124: 		}
   125: 		_, err := m.Run(ctx, !m.enabled, nil)
   126: 		if ctx.Err() != nil {
   127: 			return
   128: 		}
   129: 		status := m.Status()
   130: 		if err != nil {
   131: 			log.Printf("retention run failed; dry_run=%t attempts=%d failures=%d duration_ms=%d", status.LastDryRun, status.Attempts, status.Failures, status.LastDurationMS)
   132: 		} else {
   133: 			log.Printf("retention run completed; dry_run=%t attempts=%d successes=%d duration_ms=%d", status.LastDryRun, status.Attempts, status.Successes, status.LastDurationMS)
   134: 		}
   135: 	}
   136: }

    21: type Claims struct {
    22: 	Issuer string `json:"issuer"`
    23: 	KeyID  string `json:"key_id"`
    24: 	ClientContext
    25: 	NotBefore     int64    `json:"not_before_unix_ms"`

    30: 
    31: type Verifier struct {
    32: 	Keys   Keys
    33: 	Issuer string
    34: }
    35: 
    36: // Verify uses the uncertainty interval of verified UTC, never local wall time.
    37: func (v *Verifier) Verify(authorization string, stamp Stamp) (Claims, error) {
    38: 	var claims Claims
    39: 	if v == nil {
    40: 		return claims, errors.New("authorization verifier is not configured")
    41: 	}
    42: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(authorization, "Bearer ") {
    43: 		return claims, errors.New("signed backend identity required")
    44: 	}
    45: 	if err := verify(strings.TrimPrefix(authorization, "Bearer "), v.Issuer, v.Keys, &claims); err != nil {
    46: 		return claims, err
    47: 	}
    48: 	if claims.Subject == "" || claims.Session == "" || claims.ContextID == "" || claims.ContextGeneration < 1 || claims.AuthzRevision < 1 || claims.NotBefore < 1 || claims.Expires <= claims.NotBefore || claims.Expires-claims.NotBefore > 86400000 {
    49: 		return Claims{}, errors.New("invalid identity context or validity interval")
    50: 	}
    51: 	if !stamp.Verified || stamp.Now-stamp.Uncertainty < claims.NotBefore || stamp.Now+stamp.Uncertainty >= claims.Expires {
    52: 		return Claims{}, errors.New("identity context is not currently valid")
    53: 	}
    54: 	return claims, nil
    55: }
    56: 
    57: func (c Claims) Allows(activity, action string) bool {
    58: 	for _, grant := range c.Grants {
    59: 		if grant.ActivityID != activity {
    60: 			continue
    61: 		}
    62: 		for _, allowed := range grant.Actions {
    63: 			if allowed == action {
    64: 				return true
    65: 			}
    66: 		}
    67: 	}
    68: 	return false
    69: }
    70: 
    71: func (c Claims) AllowsGlobal(action string) bool {
    72: 	for _, allowed := range c.GlobalActions {
    73: 		if allowed == action {
    74: 			return true
    75: 		}
    76: 	}

SHA256: a146e7789ef624b814e6d9fed539ed4929b510009dce346d0e34aa38d5a6de08

     1: package trust
     2: 
     3: import (
     4: 	"context"
     5: 	"crypto/rand"
     6: 	"crypto/sha256"
     7: 	"encoding/hex"
     8: 	"encoding/json"

    15: 
    16: const ChallengeLifetime = 30 * time.Second
    17: const MaxProofLifetime = 120 * time.Second
    18: const MaxUTCUncertaintyMS int64 = 1000
    19: 
    20: type Stamp struct {
    21: 	Verified    bool   `json:"verified"`
    22: 	Now         int64  `json:"now_unix_ms"`
    23: 	Uncertainty int64  `json:"uncertainty_ms"`
    24: 	ValidUntil  int64  `json:"valid_until_unix_ms"`
    25: 	EvidenceID  string `json:"evidence_id"`
    26: }
    27: 
    28: type ClockProof struct {
    29: 	Issuer         string `json:"issuer"`
    30: 	KeyID          string `json:"key_id"`
    31: 	Challenge      string `json:"challenge"`
    32: 	Now            int64  `json:"now_unix_ms"`
    33: 	Uncertainty    int64  `json:"uncertainty_ms"`
    34: 	ValidFor       int64  `json:"valid_for_ms"`
    35: 	SourceVerified bool   `json:"source_verified"`
    36: 	Source         string `json:"source"`
    37: 	EvidenceID     string `json:"evidence_id"`
    38: }
    39: 
    40: type Clock struct {
    41: 	mu           sync.Mutex
    42: 	keys         Keys
    43: 	issuer, path string
    44: 	challenge    string
    45: 	challengeAt  time.Time
    46: 	anchor       time.Time
    47: 	proof        ClockProof
    48: 	accepted     [32]byte
    49: 	now          func() time.Time // monotonic process time; injectable only inside unit tests
    50: }
    51: 
    52: func NewClock(keys Keys, issuer, path string) (*Clock, error) {
    53: 	c := &Clock{keys: keys, issuer: issuer, path: path, now: time.Now}
    54: 	if err := c.rotate(c.now()); err != nil {
    55: 		return nil, err
    56: 	}
    57: 	return c, nil
    58: }
    59: 
    60: func (c *Clock) rotate(now time.Time) error {
    61: 	buffer := make([]byte, 32)
    62: 	if _, err := rand.Read(buffer); err != nil {
    63: 		return errors.New("cannot create clock challenge")
    64: 	}
    65: 	c.challenge, c.challengeAt = hex.EncodeToString(buffer), now
    66: 	return nil
    67: }
    68: 
    69: func (c *Clock) Challenge() map[string]any {
    70: 	if c == nil {
    71: 		return map[string]any{"trusted": false, "error": "trusted clock is not configured"}
    72: 	}
    73: 	c.mu.Lock()
    74: 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
    75: 	now := c.now()
    76: 	if now.Sub(c.challengeAt) >= ChallengeLifetime {
    77: 		_ = c.rotate(now)
    78: 	}
    79: 	result := map[string]any{"challenge": c.challenge, "challenge_valid_for_ms": (ChallengeLifetime - now.Sub(c.challengeAt)).Milliseconds(), "max_proof_valid_for_ms": MaxProofLifetime.Milliseconds(), "trusted": false}
    80: 	if stamp, err := c.refresh(now); err == nil {
    81: 		result["trusted"] = true
    82: 		result["stamp"] = stamp
    83: 		result["challenge"] = c.challenge
    84: 		result["challenge_valid_for_ms"] = (ChallengeLifetime - now.Sub(c.challengeAt)).Milliseconds()
    85: 	}
    86: 	return result
    87: }
    88: 
    89: func (c *Clock) Now() (Stamp, error) {
    90: 	if c == nil {
    91: 		return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted clock is not configured")
    92: 	}
    93: 	c.mu.Lock()
    94: 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
    95: 	return c.refresh(c.now())
    96: }
    97: 
    98: func (c *Clock) refresh(now time.Time) (Stamp, error) {
    99: 	if len(c.keys) == 0 || c.issuer == "" || c.path == "" {
   100: 		return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC verifier is not configured")
   101: 	}
   102: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(c.path)
   103: 	if err != nil {
   104: 		return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC proof is unavailable")
   105: 	}
   106: 	data = []byte(strings.TrimSpace(string(data)))
   107: 	hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
   108: 	if hash != c.accepted || c.anchor.IsZero() {
   109: 		var proof ClockProof
   110: 		if err := verify(string(data), c.issuer, c.keys, &proof); err != nil {
   111: 			return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC proof signature rejected")
   112: 		}
   113: 		age := now.Sub(c.challengeAt)
   114: 		if proof.Challenge != c.challenge || age < 0 || age >= ChallengeLifetime {
   115: 			return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC proof challenge is stale or mismatched")
   116: 		}
   117: 		if !proof.SourceVerified || proof.Source == "" || proof.EvidenceID == "" || proof.Now < 604800000 || proof.Uncertainty < 0 || proof.Uncertainty > MaxUTCUncertaintyMS || proof.ValidFor < 1 || proof.ValidFor > MaxProofLifetime.Milliseconds() || proof.Now > 9223372036854775807-proof.ValidFor-MaxUTCUncertaintyMS {
   118: 			return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC proof source or duration rejected")
   119: 		}
   120: 		// Signed UTC refers to a point during the challenge round trip. Advancing
   121: 		// from receipt has uncertainty covering the entire challenge age.
   122: 		proof.Uncertainty += age.Milliseconds()
   123: 		if proof.Uncertainty > MaxUTCUncertaintyMS {
   124: 			return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC proof uncertainty exceeds policy")
   125: 		}
   126: 		if !c.anchor.IsZero() && proof.Now < c.proof.Now+now.Sub(c.anchor).Milliseconds() {
   127: 			return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC watermark cannot move backwards")
   128: 		}
   129: 		c.proof, c.anchor, c.accepted = proof, now, hash
   130: 		if err := c.rotate(now); err != nil {
   131: 			return Stamp{}, err
   132: 		}
   133: 	}
   134: 	elapsed := now.Sub(c.anchor).Milliseconds()
   135: 	if elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= c.proof.ValidFor {
   136: 		return Stamp{}, errors.New("trusted UTC proof expired")
   137: 	}
   138: 	return Stamp{Verified: true, Now: c.proof.Now + elapsed, Uncertainty: c.proof.Uncertainty, ValidUntil: c.proof.Now + c.proof.ValidFor, EvidenceID: c.proof.EvidenceID}, nil
   139: }
   140: 
   141: type Exchanger interface {
   142: 	Request(context.Context, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
   143: }
   144: type Clocked struct {
   145: 	Worker Exchanger
   146: 	Clock  *Clock
   147: }
   148: 
   149: // Clocked is the exclusive service-to-worker pipe. HTTP input cannot inject
   150: // either trust field; the API removes them before reaching this adapter.
   151: func (c *Clocked) Request(ctx context.Context, request json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
   152: 	var body map[string]json.RawMessage
   153: 	if json.Unmarshal(request, &body) != nil {
   154: 		return nil, errors.New("invalid worker request")
   155: 	}
   156: 	var op string
   157: 	_ = json.Unmarshal(body["op"], &op)
   158: 	delete(body, "_trusted_clock")
   159: 	if op != "health" {
   160: 		stamp, err := c.Clock.Now()
   161: 		if err != nil {
   162: 			return nil, err
   163: 		}
   164: 		if validity, ok := body["_authorization_validity"]; ok {
   165: 			var interval struct {
   166: 				NotBefore int64 `json:"not_before_unix_ms"`
   167: 				Expires   int64 `json:"expires_unix_ms"`
   168: 			}
   169: 			if json.Unmarshal(validity, &interval) != nil || stamp.Now-stamp.Uncertainty < interval.NotBefore || stamp.Now+stamp.Uncertainty >= interval.Expires {
   170: 				return nil, errors.New("authorization expired before worker dispatch")
   171: 			}
   172: 		}
   173: 		delete(body, "_authorization_validity")
   174: 		body["_trusted_clock"], _ = json.Marshal(stamp)
   175: 	}
   176: 	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(body)
   177: 	return c.Worker.Request(ctx, encoded)
   178: }

     1: // Package trust verifies backend authorization and challenge-bound UTC proofs.
     2: // Only Ed25519 public keys are loaded by this process.
     3: package trust
     4: 
     5: import (
     6: 	"crypto/ed25519"
     7: 	"encoding/base64"
     8: 	"encoding/json"
     9: 	"errors"
    10: 	"os"
    11: 	"strings"
    12: )
    13: 
    14: type Keys map[string]ed25519.PublicKey
    15: 
    16: func LoadKeys(path string) (Keys, error) {
    17: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    18: 	if err != nil {
    19: 		return nil, errors.New("cannot read verifier public key file")
    20: 	}
    21: 	var document struct {
    22: 		Keys map[string]string `json:"keys"`
    23: 	}
    24: 	if json.Unmarshal(data, &document) != nil || len(document.Keys) == 0 {
    25: 		return nil, errors.New("public key file requires a nonempty keys object")
    26: 	}
    27: 	keys := make(Keys)
    28: 	for id, encoded := range document.Keys {
    29: 		decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(encoded)
    30: 		if err != nil {
    31: 			decoded, err = base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(encoded)
    32: 		}
    33: 		if id == "" || err != nil || len(decoded) != ed25519.PublicKeySize {
    34: 			return nil, errors.New("invalid Ed25519 public key")
    35: 		}
    36: 		keys[id] = ed25519.PublicKey(decoded)
    37: 	}
    38: 	return keys, nil
    39: }
    40: 
    41: func verify(token, issuer string, keys Keys, destination any) error {
    42: 	if issuer == "" || len(keys) == 0 {
    43: 		return errors.New("verifier is not configured")
    44: 	}
    45: 	if len(token) > 65536 {
    46: 		return errors.New("signed token is too large")
    47: 	}
    48: 	parts := strings.Split(token, ".")
    49: 	if len(parts) != 2 {
    50: 		return errors.New("invalid signed token")
    51: 	}
    52: 	payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[0])
    53: 	if err != nil {
    54: 		return errors.New("invalid signed token")
    55: 	}
    56: 	signature, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[1])
    57: 	if err != nil {
    58: 		return errors.New("invalid signed token")
    59: 	}
    60: 	var header struct {
    61: 		Issuer string `json:"issuer"`
    62: 		KeyID  string `json:"key_id"`
    63: 	}
    64: 	if json.Unmarshal(payload, &header) != nil || header.Issuer != issuer {
    65: 		return errors.New("untrusted issuer")
    66: 	}
    67: 	key := keys[header.KeyID]
    68: 	if len(key) != ed25519.PublicKeySize || !ed25519.Verify(key, payload, signature) {
    69: 		return errors.New("invalid signature")
    70: 	}
    71: 	if json.Unmarshal(payload, destination) != nil {
    72: 		return errors.New("invalid signed claims")
    73: 	}
    74: 	return nil
    75: }

    50: func TestClockChallengeLeaseAndMonotonicUTC(t *testing.T) {
    51: 	c, key, now := testClock(t)

    53: 		t.Fatal("missing proof trusted")

    73: 	}

    52: func StartConfiguredPush(path, stateFile string, maxPending, maxStateMB, maxTemplates int, pushResults bool) (*Client, error) {
    53: 	return StartConfiguredRetention(path, stateFile, maxPending, maxStateMB, maxTemplates, pushResults, false, nil)
    54: }
    55: 
    56: func StartConfiguredRetention(path, stateFile string, maxPending, maxStateMB, maxTemplates int, pushResults, retentionEnabled bool, p1Paths []string) (*Client, error) {
    57: 	if maxStateMB < 1 || maxTemplates < 1 {
    58: 		return nil, errors.New("positive state and gallery capacity required")
    59: 	}
    60: 	if pushResults && stateFile == "" {
    61: 		return nil, errors.New("result push requires durable state-file")
    62: 	}
    63: 	options := []string{"--max-state-mb", fmt.Sprint(maxStateMB), "--max-templates", fmt.Sprint(maxTemplates), "--push-results", fmt.Sprint(pushResults), "--retention-enabled", fmt.Sprint(retentionEnabled)}
    64: 	for _, path := range p1Paths {
    65: 		options = append(options, "--p1-retention-db", path)
    66: 	}
    67: 	return start(path, stateFile, maxPending, options)
    68: }
    69: func start(path, stateFile string, maxPending int, extraArgs []string) (*Client, error) {
    70: 	if path == "" {
    71: 		return nil, errors.New("C++ worker path is required")
    72: 	}
    73: 	if maxPending < 1 {
    74: 		return nil, errors.New("max pending must be positive")
    75: 	}
    76: 	args := []string{}
    77: 	if stateFile != "" {
    78: 		args = []string{"--state-file", stateFile}
    79: 	}
    80: 	args = append(args, extraArgs...)
    81: 	cmd := exec.Command(path, args...)
    82: 	cleanup, err := configureProcess(cmd)
    83: 	if err != nil {
    84: 		return nil, err
    85: 	}
    86: 	stdin, err := cmd.StdinPipe()
    87: 	if err != nil {
    88: 		_ = cleanup()
    89: 		return nil, err
    90: 	}
    91: 	stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
    92: 	if err != nil {
    93: 		_ = stdin.Close()
    94: 		_ = cleanup()
    95: 		return nil, err
    96: 	}
    97: 	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
    98: 	if err := startProcess(cmd); err != nil {
    99: 		_ = stdin.Close()
   100: 		_ = cleanup()
   101: 		return nil, err
   102: 	}
   103: 	client := &Client{cmd: cmd, stdin: stdin, stdout: bufio.NewReader(stdout), gate: make(chan struct{}, 1), closing: make(chan struct{}), transactionTimeout: requestTimeout}
   104: 	client.processCleanup = cleanup
   105: 	client.pending = make(chan struct{}, maxPending)
   106: 	client.path = path
   107: 	client.args = args
   108: 	client.recoverState = stateFile != ""
   109: 	client.starting = client.recoverState
   110: 	client.gate <- struct{}{}
   111: 	return client, nil
   112: }
   113: 
   114: func (c *Client) Request(ctx context.Context, request json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
   115: 	select {
   116: 	case c.pending <- struct{}{}:
   117: 		defer func() { <-c.pending }()
   118: 	default:
   119: 		return nil, ErrBusy
   120: 	}
   121: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, requestTimeout)
   122: 	defer cancel()
   123: 	select {
   124: 	case <-ctx.Done():
   125: 		return nil, ctx.Err()
   126: 	case <-c.closing:
   127: 		return nil, errors.New("C++ worker is closing")
   128: 	case <-c.gate:
   129: 	}
   130: 	select {
   131: 	case <-c.closing:
   132: 		c.gate <- struct{}{}
   133: 		return nil, errors.New("C++ worker is closing")
   134: 	default:
   135: 	}
   136: 	if c.closed {
   137: 		if c.recoverState {
   138: 			if err := c.restartLocked(); err != nil {
   139: 				c.gate <- struct{}{}
   140: 				return nil, err
   141: 			}
   142: 		} else {
   143: 			c.gate <- struct{}{}
   144: 			return nil, c.failure
   145: 		}
   146: 	}
   147: 	if !json.Valid(request) || bytes.ContainsAny(request, "\r\n") {
   148: 		c.gate <- struct{}{}
   149: 		return nil, errors.New("request must be one JSON line")
   150: 	}
   151: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   152: 		c.gate <- struct{}{}
   153: 		return nil, err
   154: 	}
   155: 	done := make(chan transactionResult, 1)
   156: 	go c.transact(append([]byte(nil), request...), done)
   157: 	// Admission cancellation stops at this boundary. Once submitted, wait for
   158: 	// the worker's bounded transaction and preserve its committed receipt.
   159: 	reply := <-done
   160: 	return reply.response, reply.err
   161: }
   162: 
   163: // Only the next request restarts a durable worker. The interrupted mutation is
   164: // never silently replayed; producers retry using the same observation ID.
   165: func (c *Client) restartLocked() error {
   166: 	if c.cmd != nil {
   167: 		if err := c.finishReapLocked(); err != nil {
   168: 			return err
   169: 		}
   170: 	}
   171: 	cmd := exec.Command(c.path, c.args...)
   172: 	cleanup, err := configureProcess(cmd)
   173: 	if err != nil {
   174: 		return err
   175: 	}
   176: 	stdin, err := cmd.StdinPipe()
   177: 	if err != nil {
   178: 		_ = cleanup()
   179: 		return err
   180: 	}
   181: 	stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
   182: 	if err != nil {
   183: 		_ = stdin.Close()
   184: 		_ = cleanup()
   185: 		return err
   186: 	}
   187: 	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
   188: 	if err = startProcess(cmd); err != nil {
   189: 		_ = stdin.Close()
   190: 		_ = cleanup()
   191: 		return err
   192: 	}
   193: 	c.cmd = cmd
   194: 	c.processCleanup = cleanup
   195: 	c.stdin = stdin
   196: 	c.stdout = bufio.NewReader(stdout)
   197: 	c.closed = false
   198: 	c.failure = nil
   199: 	c.starting = true
   200: 	return nil
   201: }
   202: 
   203: type transactionResult struct {
   204: 	response json.RawMessage
   205: 	err      error
   206: }
   207: 
   208: func (c *Client) transact(request []byte, done chan<- transactionResult) {
   209: 	defer func() { c.gate <- struct{}{} }()
   210: 	ioDone := make(chan transactionResult, 1)
   211: 	go func() {
   212: 		if _, err := c.stdin.Write(append(request, '\n')); err != nil {
   213: 			ioDone <- transactionResult{err: fmt.Errorf("write to C++ worker: %w", err)}
   214: 			return
   215: 		}
   216: 		response, err := c.stdout.ReadBytes('\n')
   217: 		if err != nil {
   218: 			ioDone <- transactionResult{err: fmt.Errorf("read from C++ worker: %w", err)}
   219: 			return
   220: 		}
   221: 		response = bytes.TrimSpace(response)
   222: 		if !json.Valid(response) {
   223: 			ioDone <- transactionResult{err: errors.New("C++ worker returned invalid JSON")}
   224: 			return
   225: 		}
   226: 		ioDone <- transactionResult{response: response}
   227: 	}()
   228: 	// An abandoned transaction remains bounded. Reaching the bound loses the
   229: 	// single worker's in-memory state; this client does not silently restart it.
   230: 	timeout := c.transactionTimeout
   231: 	if c.starting && timeout < 5*time.Minute {
   232: 		timeout = 5 * time.Minute
   233: 	}
   234: 	timer := time.NewTimer(timeout)
   235: 	defer timer.Stop()
   236: 	var reply transactionResult
   237: 	select {
   238: 	case reply = <-ioDone:
   239: 		c.starting = false
   240: 		if reply.err != nil {
   241: 			c.stopLocked(reply.err)
   242: 		}
   243: 	case <-timer.C:
   244: 		reply.err = fmt.Errorf("C++ worker transaction exceeded %s", timeout)
   245: 		c.stopLocked(reply.err)
   246: 		<-ioDone // killed process and closed stdin unblock the stream operation
   247: 	case <-c.closing:
   248: 		reply.err = errors.New("C++ worker is closing")
   249: 		c.stopLocked(reply.err)
   250: 		<-ioDone
   251: 	}
   252: 	done <- reply
   253: }
   254: 
   255: // stopLocked is called only by the transaction holding the gate.
   256: func (c *Client) stopLocked(err error) {
   257: 	c.closed = true
   258: 	c.failure = err
   259: 	if c.cmd == nil {
   260: 		return
   261: 	}
   262: 	_ = c.stdin.Close()
   263: 	_ = c.cmd.Process.Kill()
   264: 	// Wait runs exactly once. If reaping exceeds the short bound, retain cmd
   265: 	// and fail closed: a replacement must never race the old state lock.
   266: 	cmd := c.cmd
   267: 	c.reapDone = make(chan error, 1)
   268: 	wait := c.reapDone
   269: 	go func() { wait <- cmd.Wait() }()
   270: 	_ = c.finishReapLocked()
   271: }
   272: 
   273: func (c *Client) finishReapLocked() error {
   274: 	select {
   275: 	case <-c.reapDone:
   276: 	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
   277: 		return errors.New("old C++ worker has not exited; restart is blocked")
   278: 	}
   279: 	c.cmd = nil
   280: 	c.reapDone = nil
   281: 	if c.processCleanup != nil {
   282: 		_ = c.processCleanup()
   283: 		c.processCleanup = nil
   284: 	}
   285: 	return nil
   286: }
   287: 
   288: func (c *Client) Close() error {
   289: 	c.closeOnce.Do(func() {
   290: 		close(c.closing)
   291: 		<-c.gate
   292: 		c.closed = true
   293: 		if c.failure == nil {
   294: 			c.failure = errors.New("C++ worker is closed")
   295: 		}
   296: 		if c.cmd != nil {
   297: 			if c.reapDone == nil {
   298: 				c.stopLocked(c.failure)
   299: 			}
   300: 			if c.cmd != nil {
   301: 				c.closeErr = c.finishReapLocked()
   302: 			}
   303: 		}
   304: 		c.gate <- struct{}{}
   305: 	})
   306: 	return c.closeErr
   307: }

FILE: face-trajectory/go/internal/worker/fair.go
SHA256: e24bbca5fc764ea5f71472b451e24bcd759cd8fb8de5ae4f8acb4ef3add11e7d
================================================================================
     1: package worker
     2: 
     3: import (
     4: 	"context"
     5: 	"encoding/json"
     6: 	"errors"
     7: 	"sync"
     8: )
     9: 
    10: // Requester is the existing C++ transaction transport. Fair serializes accepted
    11: // work with a round robin across explicit activities; cancelled viewers do not
    12: // cancel another activity or mutate its monitoring lifecycle.
    13: type Requester interface {
    14: 	Request(context.Context, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
    15: }
    16: type fairCall struct {
    17: 	ctx     context.Context
    18: 	data    json.RawMessage
    19: 	result  chan transactionResult
    20: 	started bool // protected by Fair.mu; cancellation is admission-only
    21: }
    22: type Fair struct {
    23: 	inner              Requester
    24: 	mu                 sync.Mutex
    25: 	queues             map[string][]*fairCall
    26: 	order              []string
    27: 	total              int
    28: 	limit, perActivity int
    29: 	wake               chan struct{}
    30: 	done               chan struct{}
    31: 	once               sync.Once
    32: 	closed             bool
    33: }
    34: 
    35: func NewFair(inner Requester, limit, perActivity int) *Fair {
    36: 	if limit < 1 || perActivity < 1 {
    37: 		panic("positive fair queue limits required")
    38: 	}
    39: 	f := &Fair{inner: inner, queues: make(map[string][]*fairCall), limit: limit, perActivity: perActivity, wake: make(chan struct{}, 1), done: make(chan struct{})}
    40: 	go f.run()
    41: 	return f
    42: }
    43: func (f *Fair) Request(ctx context.Context, request json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
    44: 	var scope struct {
    45: 		ActivityID string `json:"activity_id"`
    46: 	}
    47: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(request, &scope); err != nil {
    48: 		return nil, err
    49: 	}
    50: 	// Global config/control is one scheduler participant, not a priority bypass.
    51: 	id := scope.ActivityID
    52: 	c := &fairCall{ctx: ctx, data: append(json.RawMessage(nil), request...), result: make(chan transactionResult, 1)}
    53: 	f.mu.Lock()
    54: 	if f.closed {
    55: 		f.mu.Unlock()
    56: 		return nil, errors.New("fair worker is closing")
    57: 	}
    58: 	if f.total >= f.limit || len(f.queues[id]) >= f.perActivity {
    59: 		f.mu.Unlock()
    60: 		return nil, ErrBusy
    61: 	}
    62: 	if len(f.queues[id]) == 0 {
    63: 		f.order = append(f.order, id)
    64: 	}
    65: 	f.queues[id] = append(f.queues[id], c)
    66: 	f.total++
    67: 	f.mu.Unlock()
    68: 	select {
    69: 	case f.wake <- struct{}{}:
    70: 	default:
    71: 	}
    72: 	select {
    73: 	case r := <-c.result:
    74: 		return r.response, r.err
    75: 	case <-ctx.Done():
    76: 		f.mu.Lock()
    77: 		started := c.started
    78: 		f.mu.Unlock()
    79: 		if started {
    80: 			r := <-c.result
    81: 			return r.response, r.err
    82: 		}
    83: 		return nil, ctx.Err()
    84: 	case <-f.done:
    85: 		f.mu.Lock()
    86: 		started := c.started
    87: 		f.mu.Unlock()
    88: 		if started {
    89: 			r := <-c.result
    90: 			return r.response, r.err
    91: 		}
    92: 		return nil, errors.New("fair worker is closing")
    93: 	}
    94: }
    95: func (f *Fair) next() (*fairCall, bool) {
    96: 	f.mu.Lock()
    97: 	defer f.mu.Unlock()
    98: 	if f.closed || len(f.order) == 0 {
    99: 		return nil, false
   100: 	}
   101: 	id := f.order[0]
   102: 	f.order = f.order[1:]
   103: 	q := f.queues[id]
   104: 	c := q[0]
   105: 	q = q[1:]
   106: 	f.total--
   107: 	if len(q) > 0 {
   108: 		f.order = append(f.order, id)
   109: 		f.queues[id] = q
   110: 	} else {
   111: 		delete(f.queues, id)
   112: 	}
   113: 	// Check and mark atomically with Request's cancellation branch. A queued
   114: 	// cancelled call never crosses this boundary; a running call waits for I/O.
   115: 	c.started = c.ctx.Err() == nil
   116: 	return c, true
   117: }
   118: func (f *Fair) run() {
   119: 	for {
   120: 		if c, ok := f.next(); ok {
   121: 			if !c.started {
   122: 				err := c.ctx.Err()
   123: 				c.result <- transactionResult{err: err}
   124: 				continue
   125: 			}
   126: 			r, err := f.inner.Request(c.ctx, c.data)
   127: 			c.result <- transactionResult{response: r, err: err}
   128: 			continue
   129: 		}
   130: 		select {
   131: 		case <-f.wake:
   132: 		case <-f.done:
   133: 			return
   134: 		}
   135: 	}
   136: }
   137: func (f *Fair) Close() {
   138: 	f.once.Do(func() { f.mu.Lock(); f.closed = true; f.mu.Unlock(); close(f.done) })
   139: }

SHA256: d64eb113506c6186dd14a16bdcb0f565beafbc21ea913bdd5148a11f6e203f76

     1: package worker
     2: 
     3: import (
     4: 	"os/exec"
     5: 	"runtime"
     6: 	"sync"
     7: 	"syscall"
     8: )
     9: 
    10: var processThreads sync.Map
    11: 
    12: func configureProcess(cmd *exec.Cmd) (func() error, error) {
    13: 	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Pdeathsig: syscall.SIGKILL}
    14: 	release := make(chan struct{})
    15: 	processThreads.Store(cmd, release)
    16: 	return func() error { processThreads.Delete(cmd); close(release); return nil }, nil
    17: }
    18: func startProcess(cmd *exec.Cmd) error {
    19: 	value, _ := processThreads.Load(cmd)
    20: 	release := value.(chan struct{})
    21: 	started := make(chan error, 1)
    22: 	go func() {
    23: 		// Linux Pdeathsig follows the creating OS thread, not just the PID.
    24: 		// Keep that thread alive until the child is reaped, so Go scheduler
    25: 		// thread retirement cannot kill a healthy worker.
    26: 		runtime.LockOSThread()
    27: 		defer runtime.UnlockOSThread()
    28: 		err := cmd.Start()
    29: 		started <- err
    30: 		if err == nil {
    31: 			<-release
    32: 		}
    33: 	}()
    34: 	return <-started
    35: }

FILE: face-trajectory/go/internal/worker/proc_windows.go
SHA256: ee8cfcaa2f83c1db0a43480e7a179de25d0d7f850c0c50a06553760af3bfed4e
================================================================================
     1: package worker
     2: 
     3: import (
     4: 	"fmt"
     5: 	"os/exec"
     6: 	"sync"
     7: 	"syscall"
     8: 	"unsafe"
     9: 
    10: 	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
    11: )
    12: 
    13: // Keep the noninheritable job handle in the daemon. A suspended child cannot
    14: // open/lock state before job assignment. Closing the daemon kills the worker.
    15: var processJobs sync.Map
    16: 
    17: func configureProcess(cmd *exec.Cmd) (func() error, error) {
    18: 	job, err := windows.CreateJobObject(nil, nil)
    19: 	if err != nil {
    20: 		return nil, err
    21: 	}
    22: 	info := windows.JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION{}
    23: 	info.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE
    24: 	if _, err = windows.SetInformationJobObject(job, windows.JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&info)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(info))); err != nil {
    25: 		windows.CloseHandle(job)
    26: 		return nil, err
    27: 	}
    28: 	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{CreationFlags: windows.CREATE_SUSPENDED}
    29: 	processJobs.Store(cmd, job)
    30: 	return func() error { processJobs.Delete(cmd); return windows.CloseHandle(job) }, nil
    31: }
    32: func startProcess(cmd *exec.Cmd) error {
    33: 	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
    34: 		return err
    35: 	}
    36: 	if err := attachAndResume(cmd); err != nil {
    37: 		_ = cmd.Process.Kill()
    38: 		_ = cmd.Wait()
    39: 		return err
    40: 	}
    41: 	return nil
    42: }
    43: func attachAndResume(cmd *exec.Cmd) error {
    44: 	job, ok := processJobs.Load(cmd)
    45: 	if !ok {
    46: 		return fmt.Errorf("missing worker job")
    47: 	}
    48: 	process, err := windows.OpenProcess(windows.PROCESS_SET_QUOTA|windows.PROCESS_TERMINATE, false, uint32(cmd.Process.Pid))
    49: 	if err != nil {
    50: 		return err
    51: 	}
    52: 	defer windows.CloseHandle(process)
    53: 	if err = windows.AssignProcessToJobObject(job.(windows.Handle), process); err != nil {
    54: 		return err
    55: 	}
    56: 	snapshot, err := windows.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(windows.TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0)
    57: 	if err != nil {
    58: 		return err
    59: 	}
    60: 	defer windows.CloseHandle(snapshot)
    61: 	entry := windows.ThreadEntry32{Size: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.ThreadEntry32{}))}
    62: 	for err = windows.Thread32First(snapshot, &entry); err == nil; err = windows.Thread32Next(snapshot, &entry) {
    63: 		if entry.OwnerProcessID != uint32(cmd.Process.Pid) {
    64: 			continue
    65: 		}
    66: 		thread, e := windows.OpenThread(windows.THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME, false, entry.ThreadID)
    67: 		if e != nil {
    68: 			return e
    69: 		}
    70: 		_, e = windows.ResumeThread(thread)
    71: 		windows.CloseHandle(thread)
    72: 		return e
    73: 	}
    74: 	return fmt.Errorf("worker primary thread unavailable: %w", err)
    75: }

    21: ## 1. 目标与工作边界
    22: 
    23: 人员已关联的抓拍记录进入算法，按摄像头点位和时间形成经过序列，再推断可能经过的连接、可能到达的摄像头或通道。相机安装位置表示观测节点；节点之间的顺序连线不证明人的详细步行路线。
    24: 
    25: - **生产服务器及其 Java、数据库、模型、摄像头只允许读取。** 开发、构建、测试和查看均在本地；先前两次连接在SSH banner阶段超时的记录保留为历史状态，2026-10-10最新成功只读核查见第19节。
    26: - 用户2026-10-10明确扩展为实际人脸比对：人员资料提供 ID、重点/普通标记、照片；P1自行拉流或接海康/后端抓拍并提取兼容特征，P2负责比对关联与轨迹。已确认的经过记录接口继续可用，不能把此历史接口当成本轮全部链路。
    27: - C++17 负责算法，Go 提供薄 HTTP 接口，Java 负责业务资料、已有结果接入和权威原始记录保存，生产前端负责最终显示。SQLite 保存算法状态与不可变版本。
    28: - 既有 `AssociationStore` 能复用兼容的 512D 多模板特征判定匿名同人，但现场特征合同未接通。Java 的实名资料映射与视觉同人判定是不同职责。
    29: - 座位号查询、实际落座定位、鹰眼 ARM 设备算法包后置。鹰眼点位可以作为场景数据保留，当前 Windows 产物不属于该设备的上传包。
    30: 
    31: ## 2. 当前处理流程
    32: 
    33: | 环节 | 当前行为与关键限制 |
    34: | --- | --- |
    35: | 接收经过记录 | 要求稳定事件 ID、camera_id、已有归属证据及原始抓拍时间。身份未确认、设备未绑定或时间不合格的记录保持 HOLD，不强行拼成同一人。 |
    36: | 时间校正 | 按不可变相机校准版本处理时区、偏差、文本精度、误差和有效期。正偏差表示相机快，校正时减去；未知来源、过期、回拨歧义或溢出均 HOLD。不会自动从一次读时诊断估出历史校准。 |
    37: | 形成点位轨迹 | 保留合格经过事件、全部位置候选及时间顺序歧义。历史核心结合前后观测与给定图计算候选连接；图内唯一候选不等于唯一真实路线。 |
    38: | 推断后续位置 | 从可能的最后观测出发，按时间、通行下界、开放窗和停留扩展候选相机/通道。保留岔路，不输出精确人物坐标或未经校准的概率。默认预测期限 5 分钟。 |
    39: | 新观测修正 | 更新完整记录集形成新版本，比较旧预测，再从新版本重新推断。历史依据被更正、撤回或补入旧记录后，旧预测不能继续用于判定新事件矛盾。 |
    40: 
    41: 前向预测是保守可达集合，历史整链一致性由已有轨迹核心负责。时间误差使最后事件次序不确定时保留多个起点；查询落在末次抓拍误差区间内则返回 UNKNOWN。默认允许在节点及通道停留，开放窗关闭不代表强制离开。新观测使候选重新计算，不保证每次都是旧集合的子集。

    51: | 模型连接候选 | `camera-points-8a83765513dd48d41e56` 包有 878 条未核定主边，覆盖 52 台设备；另 10 台缺少主边。64 条涉及冲突位置的完整候选单独保留，2136 个未完成模型查询保留未知。 |

    53: | 真实抓拍与时间 | 30 条历史元数据尚未关联，6 份时间配置未核定；新接口实测仍为 30 条 HOLD、0 个确认锚点。最近只读检查的 `face_comparison` 表无记录。 |
    54: 
    55: 导入器从场景和全部模型查询结果构建通用候选图，不读取测试人的顺序或未来路线。模型长度结合速度假设得到的时间界限尚非现场实测下界，`topology_verified=false`、`topology_is_complete=false`；不能依据缺边或超出这些候选界限删除可靠观测。
    56: 
    57: 先后读时诊断曾出现约 48 秒、251 秒的相对偏差，哪端时钟变化尚未定位。`image_time/utc_time` 的来源及历史时区语义也未确认；NTP 开启或两字段相差八小时不足以建立校准。第三方 opaque 特征与核心 512D 特征未证明兼容；图片引用、face_id 或设备局部 track ID 不可直接当跨相机身份。
    58: 
    59: 来源及导入细节见[点位数据说明](docs/point-graph-data.md)、[最新只读复核](evidence/2026-10-07-reassessment/REVIEW.md)和[模型取证报告](evidence/2026-10-07-model-route/REVIEW.md)。模型报告中的轨迹还原通过结论已撤回，见第 7 节。
    60: 
    61: ## 4. 接入契约
    62: 
    63: 先登记场景、点位图和时间配置，再提交已有归属记录。完整字段与请求示例见[点位接入](docs/point-trajectories.md)。下列均为 POST：
    64: 
    65: | 用途 | 接口 |
    66: | --- | --- |
    67: | 场景登记及相机上下文 | `/v1/site-scenes`、`/v1/site-scenes/camera-context` |
    68: | 时间配置及单条归一化 | `/v1/clocks/profiles`、`/v1/clocks/normalize` |
    69: | 点位图登记及读取 | `/v1/point-graphs`、`/v1/point-graphs/get` |
    70: | 完整记录集重建及点位读取 | `/v1/point-trajectories/rebuild`、`/v1/point-trajectories/get` |
    71: | 前向预测及新观测比较 | `/v1/point-trajectories/predict`、`/v1/point-trajectories/compare` |
    72: 
    73: 接手时必须遵守：
    74: 
    75: 1. `rebuild` 接收该目标的**完整权威记录集**，不是追加接口；只传新一条会移除未包含的旧记录。接入端保存原始记录、已有同人结果及返回的 `admissions`，补齐资料后重放。相同合格输入重放不增加版本。
    76: 2. 每条记录至少包含 `observation_id/camera_id/source_id/link_status/attribution_evidence_id/clock_profile_version/raw_time`。身份和时间均需合格，不能为了测试把真实未知记录改成 CONFIRMED 或 `verified:true`。
    77: 3. 图、场景和校准按版本保持不可变；内容变化使用新版本。预测的图核验状态来自登记包，单次请求不能提升它。适配成功不等于核心接收：整秒时间加 100ms 校准误差得到 1099ms 总误差，可能超过核心默认 1000ms 门槛。
    78: 4. 保存预测使用的 `version`、`as_of_unix_ms`、`at_unix_ms` 和返回依据。`as_of` 是名义抓拍截止时间，不能冒充后台当时收到消息的时间，也不能还原后来才完成的身份修正。
    79: 5. `CONDITIONAL_CANDIDATE` 表示未核定图下的候选；`UNKNOWN` 表示依据不足；`TRUNCATED` 表示搜索不完整。候选之外不等于不可能。比较只有在旧依据未变、图核定完整且搜索完整时，才可能报告模型矛盾，仍保留新观测。
    80: 6. 旧 `/v1/timeline/query` 继续用于历史查询，最后观测之后用新 `predict`；`get` 返回点位顺序与位置候选。几何接口可按图版本和 edge_id 绑定外部折线，不能把它当实际脚步真值。
    81: 
    82: 时间和预测的完整语义分别见[时间适配](docs/clock-adapter.md)、[前向可达](docs/point-reachability.md)。已有特征自动关联接口另见[关联说明](docs/association.md)，运行状态、重试与备份见[运行说明](docs/runtime-and-geometry.md)。

    96: <a id="build"></a>
    97: ### 构建
    98: 
    99: 依赖 VS2022 BuildTools C++、CMake 和 Go。在项目根目录执行；若本地查看服务正在持有同名 exe，先停止该查看服务，或选用新的构建目录。不要覆盖运行中的生产文件。
   100: 
   101: ```powershell
   102: Set-Location -LiteralPath 'D:\人脸算法\face-trajectory'
   103: $p2CMake = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe'
   104: & $p2CMake -S cpp -B cpp/build-point-connections -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64
   105: & $p2CMake --build cpp/build-point-connections --config Release
   106: Push-Location -LiteralPath go
   107: try {
   108:     go build -o ../cpp/build-point-connections/Release/face-trajectoryd.exe ./cmd/face-trajectoryd
   109:     go vet ./...
   110:     go test -count=1 ./...
   111: } finally { Pop-Location }
   112: ```
   113: 
   114: 当前CMake构建算法库、SQLite、worker及`point_connections_test`（BUILD_TESTING可关闭），新增CTest目标`point_connections`。较早测试源码仍在归档，不恢复其历史通过数；当前点位检查与复跑见[点位连接交付](docs/point-connections.md)，2026-10-08记录保留原日期。

   155: ## 8. 接手顺序与资料入口
   156: 
   157: 1. 确认平台已有同人结果的读取合同和稳定人员/事件 ID；按同一接口接入，保留未关联与多候选。若只能提供已有特征，先核对格式及特征空间，继续遵守不重新提特征的要求。
   158: 2. 核对原始抓拍字段语义、可信参考时间、校准有效期和误差上界，以新时间配置重放原始记录；软件校正不需要写相机配置。
   159: 3. 逐步核定相机连接、通行时间、方向和开放限制，以新图版本登记；不要求用户提供逐米脚步路径。南门点位冲突未确认前继续保留两候选。
   160: 4. 用独立确认的同人摄像头序列验收分叉、漏拍、停留、迟到及修正，冻结预测后再对照后续观测，保留失败和歧义。再按真实负载验收吞吐、留存和恢复。
   161: 
   162: 接口、专项说明和历史证据按用途见[文档目录](docs/README.md)。现场采集参考[collection](collection/README.md)；其中座位/鹰眼内容仅作后置资料，不扩大当前范围。
   163: 
   164: 本次整理将重复流水、过时“未实现”描述、旧启动入口及打包细节移出主交接；保留当前能力、运行契约、撤回结论与原始证据。整理前正文和清单已压缩保存并逐项校验，见[整理记录](evidence/2026-10-08-handoff-cleanup/cleanup-report.json)。工作区原有三项目交付 ZIP 未重打包，不能作为本次算法完善后的版本；旧打包详情在[工作区打包记录](../workspace-docs/project-package-20261007.json)。

   166: ## 9. 2026-10-08 模型变更续接

   185: 
   186: ## 10. 2026-10-10 结果直接推送与按需查询
   187: 
   188: **传给后端的数据：** HTTP POST 的 JSON 正文，不是 `.js`、算法源码文件或 SQLite 文件。完整算法结果保留人员/事件 ID、原抓拍时间、版本、摄像头经过序列、位置及连接候选、admissions 的 HOLD/ACCEPTED、归属修正受影响人员。C++ 执行算法，Go 主动发送。历史点位、历史时间轴和前向候选仍按目标、版本与时刻查询。
   189: 
   190: **如何做的：** 在已有 C++ worker 的 SQLite 事务里同时保存结果及 `push_outbox` 消息，复用现有 state 表与索引，不新增消息中间件或识别模型。五类产生结果的操作为 association observe/correct/rebuild、trajectory rebuild、point trajectory rebuild。Go 独立发送器按提交顺序自动 POST；2xx 后 ack 删除队列项，失败保留并有界退避，重启读取未确认项继续发送。事件带持久化流 ID/递增序号；查询和配置不入队。新增 `GET /v1/push/status` 区分排队启用、URL 配置与待发送数量。
   191: 
   192: **踩坑和处理：** 原接口仅同步回复，没有后端主动接收链路。把 HTTP 回复后保存消息会留下结果已提交但消息丢失的窗口，现改为核心同事务写入，入队失败回滚结果；专项通过 SQLite trigger 注入失败验证。后端提交后回执丢失会重发，因此接收方必须按 event_id 去重，按目标/版本幂等更新；生产者重复重建可能产生新的消息 ID，不能仅按消息 ID防重复业务更新。Go 布尔参数不能写成 `-push-results true` 再跟地址，这会把 true 当位置参数并忽略后续配置；现启动时拒绝多余位置参数，正确写法是 `-push-results` 或 `-push-results=true`。首次误写参数的隔离测试日志保留，不作为通过证据。
   193: 
   194: **经验与交接：** 直接推送是传输行为，不等于同人/拓扑准确率验收。用户明确后端目前没有接收接口，本次未修改生产 Java 或数据库，也未配置猜测地址。可先用 `-push-results` 和独立持久状态文件排队，取得实际 URL 后以同一状态文件加 `-push-url` 重启；旧历史不会凭空补发。鉴权仅预留环境变量 `FACE_TRAJECTORY_PUSH_AUTHORIZATION`，真实合同尚待后端约定。最多 10,000 条待发送，满时新结果写入 503，查询继续可用；本次容量边界采用隔离计数注入，不是全场/满队列压力验收。
   195: 
   196: 传输改造当次 worker/daemon 在 `cpp/build-push/Release`；本节保留当时证据，当前使用第12节的 build-consistency 成对产物。C++/Go构建、go vet通过；33项推送专项、24项五类操作/FIFO、已有23项真实Go→C++回归均通过。OpenAPI无重复键、23条路径/76个结构/227个引用解析通过，未运行完整OpenAPI校验器。完整接收协议、启动配置与按需查询表见[后端结果推送](docs/backend-push.md)；失败记录及哈希见[验证报告](evidence/2026-10-10-direct-push/REVIEW.md)。生产投递与业务接收验收待实际接收接口配置后完成，旧交付 ZIP 不含本轮改动。
   197: 
   198: ## 11. 2026-10-10 剩余缺陷评估
   199: 
   200: **如何核查：** 读取当前C++/Go源码和已有证据，以build-push worker及独立合成SQLite复现，没有改算法或访问生产。详细结论和请求/返回见[剩余缺陷核查](evidence/2026-10-10-direct-push/REMAINING-DEFECTS.md)。
   201: 
   202: **当次审计确认的两处缺口（现已修复，见第12节）：** 全量重建缺少权威输入修订/expected_version保护，迟到的[A]能把已提交[A,C]的当前视图变回[A]并继续推送；旧完整版本仍保留。归属修正仅更新association，旧目标当前轨迹仍可返回被移走的观测，新目标没有自动生成轨迹，需调用方明确重建受影响目标，查询目前没有过期标记。
   203: 
   204: **踩坑和经验：** 单进程串行及相同输入幂等不能阻止业务旧请求覆盖新输入；算法轨迹版本号递增也不证明原始权威输入更新。同人修正推送成功不等于旧轨迹已重算。保留不可变历史与当前结果有效性是不同责任，需要修订前置条件和关联修订/过期保护，不能只按记录条数拦截合法撤回。
   205: 
   206: **交接：** 两处缺口在当次审计仅评估；后续修复及新证据见第12节。下一步接通真实同人/时钟合同、核定点位通路、配置实际推送接收器并做目标服务器长期容量验证。预测仍是保守可达集合，缺独立精度标签、经标定概率与无脸接续；当前采集截止审计不能还原实际消息到达历史。历史版本仍需留存/归档策略。2026-10-05吞吐报告是旧本机合成测量，不作当前生产容量结论。原80项传输/接口检查通过不覆盖这两种业务一致性情形；原证据及其当时哈希不改写。
   207: 
   208: 
   209: ## 12. 2026-10-10 版本与归属一致性修复
   210: 
   211: **独立服务器部署确认：** 已核对 CMake、Go 启动入口和 worker 子进程调用。C++ worker 与 Go daemon 同机运行，使用算法服务器自己的持久SQLite、场景/点位图/时钟配置；业务或采集端提交已有输入，算法按 push-url 向另一台服务器的后端主动 POST JSON，查询与预测按需调用。Java无需同机，时空核心无GPU推理依赖。当前仅验证Windows构建，Linux/其他架构须重新构建并做目标机验证；既有exe不能直接用于Linux。跨机接入须配置受控内网/鉴权网关，默认loopback仅本机可访问；单状态库单权威写入实例。此次仅确认架构并补充交接，未部署或修改服务器。
   212: 
   213: 升级保护作用于后续写入，不能自动恢复此前已被旧缺陷覆盖的完整记录。已有状态需核对外部权威资料后按新前置版本重放；升级前缺少新绑定字段的积压消息仅作历史审计，不应直接覆盖当前业务视图。本轮未升级实际业务状态库。
   214: 
   215: **如何做的：** 先用旧 build-push worker、独立合成 SQLite 重现两处缺陷，六项断言均失败；随后修改现有 C++/Go，未新增识别或跟踪依赖。三类完整重建增加 expected_version，已有目标的改变输入须基于当前轨迹版本；不一致返回409 / VERSION_CONFLICT，拒绝写入不推送。同当前输入和归属绑定完全相同的回执丢失重试仍幂等；明确基于最新版本的合法撤回可减少或清空记录。
   216: 
   217: 每目标持久保存关联修订，轨迹快照保存构建时 association_revision。新确认观测或归属修正使受影响当前快照失效，当前 get/point get/timeline/predict/geometry 返回409 / REBUILD_REQUIRED，历史明确版本保持可读并标明 freshness。observe/correct 推送 trajectory_effects，列出需重建的旧目标/新目标及最新轨迹版本；调用方按需 association_rebuild。对本地关联管理的目标，point/raw 输入与当前关联 Sightings 不一致时拒绝 SOURCE_CONFLICT。错误返回 conflict 元数据，便于核对当前版本。SQLite事务、推送和回滚绑定保持一致。
   218: 
   219: **踩坑与处理：** 单进程串行和相同输入幂等不足以保护旧完整请求；采用版本前置条件，不按观测条数拦截。全局关联版本会使无关人员失效，因此改用逐目标修订。归属修正后只更新前端标记不能消除算法旧当前视图，因此在核心当前读取处阻断；历史快照不改写。持久 Get 只有一个冷缓存，跨版本使用时保留独立拷贝。旧数据库缺新字段时仅补解码默认0，关联目标采用稳定迁移基线1并要求一次真实重建，不能直接写入当前修订冒充重算。事务回滚后重新绑定读取器，验证了 outbox 故障后的热状态恢复。第一次新产物测试在编译完成前启动，FileNotFoundError 不作为算法结果；等待构建完成后重新验证。
   220: 
   221: **成熟方案评估：** 按用户提供的 supervision 仓库及官方文档核查了单视频 ByteTrack、二维 PolygonZone 和版本弃用说明。它们可用于未来连续视频采集端局部跟踪/区域事件，需要实际帧、检测框和区域规则；不能修复本轮完整集合覆盖与跨目标归属状态问题，因此未安装或引入。许可、文档来源和适用范围见[评估记录](evidence/2026-10-10-consistency-fix/SUPERVISION.md)。
   222:

   237: ## 13. 2026-10-10 模型完成后的接入条件复核
   238: 
   239: **结论：** 可以等场地三维模型完成后接入新场景，现有时空核心已有版本化接入能力；不能据此认定只差模型或生产上线已就绪。同人数据、时钟合同与后端接收联调可以先做。当前能力是摄像头经过序列和条件可达范围，不保证精确人物坐标、唯一真实路线或经标定的概率。
   240: 
   241: **如何核查：** 对照当前交接、模型更新/一致性/推送合同、2026-10-10修复证据，并检索C++版本与归属保护、Go错误映射及FIFO重试代码。两处已复现的一致性缺陷已有本地修复；本次未重新运行测试、未做全面源码审计、未访问生产，不能宣称不存在其他缺陷。最新成对Windows产物已存在，运行进程及实际状态库仍未升级。
   242: 
   243: | 剩余条件或短板 | 接手处理 |
   244: | --- | --- |

   252: 
   253: **交接顺序：** 等待建模期间先确定同人/时间输入和后端接收合同；新模型完成后按[模型更新流程](docs/model-updates.md)重建场景与点位图，再用完整权威记录联调。先做少量已核定点位与真实人员试点，再在目标服务器按实际负载验收。局部试点通过不自动代表全场可用。

   273: ## 15. 2026-10-10 同人测试分工与摄像头时间容差确认
   274: 
   275: **用户已明确：** 同人数据后续由同事测试，暂不要求用户重复准备同人验收资料。经过事件直接使用摄像头抓拍时间；允许每台相机相对可信共同参考不超过60秒的偏差，超过60秒（包括半小时级偏差）不能进入确认时间轨迹。使用摄像头原值作为名义时刻，做必要的明确时区表示转换；零校正不表示零偏差，误差区间必须保留。时间门槛不能提升未确认身份。

   277: **已复用的数据来源：** 用户指定聊天 `codex://threads/01a0e6d6-5d18-7cd1-9560-f6478dfcf019` 已通过read_thread读取；主要包含2026-09-28设备清单、算法能力/启用核验及后续可访问性/凭据操作记录，可用于设备身份线索，不含可据以认证当前抓拍误差上界的测量。没有向该聊天发送消息。现有工作区资料不要求用户重新提供。

   279: **现有时间证据边界：** 本地2026-10-07诊断先有约47～48秒、后有约250～251秒的相机相对服务器时差，参考端变化未定位；详见[只读复核](evidence/2026-10-07-reassessment/REVIEW.md)。这些旧诊断不能认定当前设备符合60秒门槛，也不能据此批量平移历史记录。先前image_time/utc_time样本存在显式Z与疑似本地时间表达冲突；用户确认采用摄像头时间后仍须从采集字段映射明确实际设备时间和时区，不能对带Z字符串擅自减八小时。
   280: 
   281: **接入处理与踩坑：** 名义摄像头时间附带经核实的误差区间，顺序区间重叠则保留歧义；两台相机各允许±60秒时，相对误差最坏可达120秒，不强行按字符串先后拼接。可信测量表明超过60秒或误差上界未知时保留原始记录并HOLD，后续核验再重放。门槛应覆盖偏差、测量/漂移误差及时间量化误差；不能只看校正后的残差，让原本超限的相机通过。
   282: 
   283: **实现及交接状态：** 本轮只确认规则、读取聊天/本地证据及更新文档，未改算法、未重跑测试、未访问相机或生产。现有TrajectoryOptions/AssociationPolicy默认时间误差上限仍为1000ms，接入时须显式配置60000ms；单独提高该参数不构成设备原始偏差超限的独立检查。直接沿用名义设备时间时，时间适配配置的零校正须有来源说明，uncertainty包含该设备实际偏差及量化误差，且总界不超过60000ms；无核验来源继续使用未验证配置。正式数据接入后验证60秒边界、超限HOLD、区间重叠和未知时钟处理，不把当前文档更新当作已部署60秒策略。
   284: 
   285: **后续资料：** 当前优先确认建模交付格式及相机设备ID绑定；同人测试按同事进度接续，时间测量优先复用已有记录或后续只读核验。后端接收及目标服务器资料仍在联调/上线阶段补齐。

   297: ## 17. 2026-10-10 摄像头时间60秒规则已实现
   298: 
   299: **当前结果：** 第15节的规则已从文档落实到0.11.0本地算法。点位重建固定使用CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S，保留摄像头名义抓拍时间；偏差绝对值、测量/漂移和量化误差之和不超过60000ms才准入。超过60秒、半小时偏差、未核验、过期、时间非法或校准解释不唯一均HOLD。点位入口默认60000ms，可收紧，不允许提高上限或切回旧校正模式绕过。已构建成对产物`cpp/build-clock-policy/Release`，未替换运行中服务/真实状态库，旧ZIP未重打包。
   300: 
   301: **如何做及踩坑：** 先用旧产物复现半小时偏差被校正成零残差后NORMALIZED的问题；在ClockAdapter增加明确策略，并由点位重建入口强制调用。保留真实offset证据、applied_offset_ms=0及新误差上界，避免把offset伪填成0。对大整数先检查后取绝对值/相加。独立clocks/normalize默认CORRECTED_UTC保留兼容用途；现场预检须明确传新策略，底层已认证sighting接口仍由调用方负责原始时间认证。
   302: 
   303: **验证：** C++ Release、Go build、go vet通过。真实本机Go→C++接口75项、旧时钟契约51项、可达检查18项（含1248组独立枚举）通过，共144项。两台相机各±60秒时，相隔120秒仍保留顺序歧义；重叠连接保持UNKNOWN且没有primary路线，预测保留所有可能最后相机。旧可达套件首次缺少expected_version被409合同拒绝，内存适配当前版本字段后通过，未修改旧断言/独立oracle或覆盖旧证据。
   304: 
   305: **经验与接手：** 校正后的残差不能替代设备原始偏差门槛，60秒容差不能替代真实核验或提升身份状态。按[时间合同](docs/clock-adapter.md)提供有来源及有效期的真实profile；同人仍由同事测试。旧快照保留历史，按最新expected_version和完整权威记录重放；内部关联来源不一致则保持SOURCE_CONFLICT，先核对资料。图纸继续用于候选通路/点位核查，当前不作为已验证拓扑。算法、现场精度、三维接入和部署仍分别验收。
   306: 
   307: 方法、修复前反例、复跑命令、坑及SHA见[实现报告](evidence/2026-10-10-clock-policy/REVIEW.md)。OpenAPI升至0.11.0；本轮只做严格重复键/引用和新增门槛字段静态校核，未运行完整规范验证器。

   309: ## 18. 2026-10-10 人脸实际比对、三类人员与闸机监控
   310: 
   311: **当前范围：** 用户已确认ID+重点/普通标记+照片，未入库人员为第三类也建轨迹；闸机仅验票，出场事件需有明确人脸绑定才关闭该人监控，漏入口仍启动且标记UNKNOWN。P1自行拉流/接海康抓拍/后端图片并统一质量和特征，重点优先不改变确认身份标准。人脸库与场地模型后续提供；本轮实现本地算法接续，没有接管生产摄像头/Java/数据库或模型。
   312: 
   313: **如何做的：** C++ MonitoringStore新增版本化人员类别、原子多模板登记、不可变监控/闸机事件及可恢复投影。Go/OpenAPI0.12提供persons、observe、gate-event、get四个接口。monitoring/observe强制复用CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S，缺时间也持久保存HOLD，不调用关联、不创建匿名模板；合格时间与人脸比对后在同一SQLite事务用完整当前归属重建受影响轨迹。原CAS、历史版本、关联修订、错误回滚和可选结果推送保留。
   314: 
   315: **会话与乱序：** ENTRY/EXIT必须绑定已确认的人脸观测并带独立来源证据，单独票号/时间接近不做身份判断。未绑定票据、闸机先到脸后到、后补明确绑定均有状态。漏入口合格脸激活UNKNOWN入口，明确出闸CLOSED，后来再次出现可重开；未出现不等于出场。误差重叠保持AMBIGUOUS/继续监控，迟到旧证据按完整时间投影重放。已绑定的脸和gate时间分离时保留两项，避免后补EXIT抹掉原来的入场观察；同次时间重叠可合并表达，避免把EXIT脸立即视作再入场。
   316: 
   317: **回执与性能处理：** observe只返回监控紧凑摘要与轨迹版本引用，完整内容按版本get。回执receipt_scope=ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION，同ID重试可能返回历史状态；当前状态get查询，P1调度比较三项修订水位，不让旧ACTIVE覆盖新EXIT。长历史实测后将快照改为refs-v2不可变共享序列，原始输入只存一次；camera/frame/track派生索引同事务维护。可信纯新增证明允许单visit或满足严格尾部证书的多visit追加；更新incoming主/备选末节点边界，首时间范围变化、迟到、纠错或换图仍走完整计算。缓存与持久索引均覆盖回滚/重启，所有旧版本与原始记录保留。
   318: 
   319: **最终验证与容量边界：** 320项既有/新接口回归、824项对未改动完整核心逐版本对照、9项旧库迁移全部通过，另70组真实HTTP/OpenAPI实例通过。最终worker SHA256为`46725cf0f363afadf3c610af3bcf9ed823384d5731a475d0da1836d61698df4b`。同一1000条单相机合成输入末100条P50/P95由330.33/368.68ms降至30.20/80.97ms，完整SQLite页由72.25MB降至38.78MB；400条40次跨镜visit末段为48.27/130.76ms，复杂回退和跨镜身份约束仍随历史增长。计入object共享对象及全部namespace，没有只报快照根大小。详见[性能报告](evidence/2026-10-10-monitoring/p2/PERFORMANCE.md)。
   320: 
   321: **部署需求已确认：** 约600路，3090优先、低负载允许CPU；结果期望2秒、3秒可接受。上述是本机单序列逻辑/存储测量，不是600路、多人员高峰或3090容量证明。须结合原生抓拍比例、连续流路数、峰值人脸事件率、图库规模和现场完整链路验收；没有通过降低身份门槛、减少历史版本或漏掉自动轨迹来获得速度。旧refs-v1可读，但旧程序不认识refs-v2；升级前备份，回退必须恢复匹配的旧状态库，不能只换回旧exe。
   322: 
   323: **踩坑与经验：** 已注册但未观察的人查询应为NOT_STARTED；HOLD association为null需写入OpenAPI nullable并由消费端显式处理。人员类别、模板和轨迹分开提交会留部分成功，现同事务。模型维度一致不能替代特征契约；全库竞争和不同人员margin必须保留，不能只搜重点库就确认。旧history回执不是当前状态。只把观察绑定为gate却删除其原始时间会改变会话开始，现区分相交与分离区间。
   324: 
   325: **交接：** 新成对构建cpp/build-monitoring/Release；[监控合同](docs/monitoring.md)、[P1运行步骤](../face-recognition-engine/docs/monitoring-runtime.md)、[P2验证报告](evidence/2026-10-10-monitoring/p2/REVIEW.md)。源码/接口/本地照片与模拟输入验证同现场精度分开；真实图库标注由同事提供测试，时钟需可靠profile，进出场人脸绑定需独立证据。场地模型未接时只保留相机经过序列和未核定候选，不把电气图或相机连线当详细路线。本轮未替换在运行服务，旧ZIP未更新。
   326: 
   327: 最终联接复核：最终P1公平接纳及本节worker一起重跑，真实照片/CPU模型/HTTP整链27项通过、模糊视频主码补图与海康Digest整链21项通过，见[P1当前交接第9节](../face-recognition-engine/HANDOFF.md)。P1新增相机完成处理间隔统计，600路调度仅完成虚拟时钟模拟；不把帧龄低、逻辑配置600项或单序列P2性能当作全场2–3秒验收。

   355: 58台直接读取的设备时间中，48台相对业务服务器的保守偏差区间超过60秒；10台只通过当次快照比较。没有修改校时、关联或HOLD门槛。完整数据、853条通道覆盖、对应的失败处理与接手说明统一见[P1交接第14节](../face-recognition-engine/HANDOFF.md)和[计数核查报告](../face-recognition-engine/evidence/2026-10-10-people-counting/REPORT.md)。本轮没有改动P2核心/合同、现场服务或数据库。
